words.defJa: ほかにどうしようもない様子

cards.ja: 公用語をめぐる議論は、人口構成の変化に伴って新たな局面を迎えている。外国人住民が急に増えた地方の自治体では、窓口の係員が多言語で案内を出すことをやむを得ない対応として受け入れてきた。だが、機械翻訳に頼りすぎれば、行政文書の微妙な言い回しや敬語の含みが失われかねない。専門家は、やさしい日本語を軸にした運用を求めている。そのためには、職員の研修や相談の体制にも予算を回す必要がある。
cards.en: The debate over official languages has entered a new phase as the population makeup changes. In local municipalities where foreign residents have suddenly increased, the clerks at the counter have come to accept issuing guidance in several languages as an unavoidable measure. But if they lean too heavily on machine translation, the subtle phrasing and honorific implications of administrative documents could be lost. Experts are calling for an approach built around plain Japanese. That will require putting budget into staff training and consultation systems as well.

words.defJa: 気晴らしや娯楽のための活動

cards.ja: AI研究者が仕事の合間に楽しむレクリエーションが、意外にも囲碁や将棋だったりします。理由は単純で、ゲームは勝ち負けがはっきりしているので、アルゴリズムの強さを測る物差しになるからです。実際、二〇一六年に囲碁AIのアルファ碁が世界的な棋士に勝ち、何度も話題になりました。遊びの世界は、研究の最前線と地続きだったのです。娯楽と研究の境目は、思っているよりずっと薄いものです。
cards.en: The recreation AI researchers enjoy between bouts of work is, surprisingly, sometimes go or shogi. The reason is simple: games have clear wins and losses, so they become a yardstick for measuring an algorithm's strength. In fact, in 2016 the go AI AlphaGo beat a world-class player and made headlines again and again. The world of play turned out to be continuous with the research frontier. The boundary between entertainment and research is much thinner than you might think.

words.defJa: 電車やバスに乗るための切符

cards.ja: 駅の改札に乗車券を通すとき、私たちは目的地まで運ばれるという約束を、ほとんど意識せずに受け取っている。切符は、買った人にだけ門を開く小さな紙きれにすぎない。人生の切符には、行き先も料金も印字されていない。それでも乗り込まざるを得ないのだが、先を知らなければ動けない心は、いつまでも駅のベンチに座り続けることになる。切符の裏の空白を恐れるか、白紙の自由と見るかは、結局のところ主観の問題でもある。
cards.en: When we pass a ticket through the station gate, we receive, almost without noticing, the promise that we will be carried to our destination. A ticket is no more than a small slip of paper that opens the gate only for the person who bought it. The ticket of life has neither destination nor fare printed on it. We have no choice but to board anyway, yet a mind that cannot move without knowing what lies ahead will go on sitting on the station bench forever. Whether to fear the blank on the back of the ticket or to see it as the freedom of a blank sheet is, in the end, also a matter of subjective view.

words.defJa: 回数が多いさま

cards.ja: 人工知能が自信ありげに出した答えを、人は何度も疑ってみるべきなのだろうか。疑いすぎれば、道具としての便利さは失われ、仕事の速さも落ちてしまう。かといって、一度すっかり信じ込んだが最後、誤りに気づく機会さえ手放してしまう。学習データが偏っていれば、答えの癖も同じ方向に偏るのだから、なおさらである。大切なのは、確かめる手間を作業の一部として、最初から手順の中に組み込んでおくことだ。
cards.en: Should people doubt an answer that artificial intelligence has produced with an air of confidence many times over? If you doubt too much, its convenience as a tool is lost and your work slows too. Yet once you have fully come to believe it, you give up even the chance to notice errors. If the training data is skewed, the answers' habits will be skewed in the same direction, all the more reason. What matters is to build the effort of checking into the procedure from the start as a part of the work.

words.meaning: to think of, to hit upon
words.defJa: ふとある考えが頭に浮かぶ

cards.ja: インドの数学者ラマヌジャンは、新しい公式を思いつくたびに、ナマギリ女神が夢で示してくれたのだと語っていたという。学習科学の立場から見れば、これは無意識の処理が実を結んだ例と読める。夢の話そのものは検証できないが、行き詰まったとき、一度課題から離れて息抜きをすると、解決に近づくことがあるからだ。メタ認知を働かせて、自分がどんな時間帯にひらめきやすいかを知っておくに越したことはない。
cards.en: The Indian mathematician Ramanujan is said to have told people that each time he hit upon a new formula, the goddess Namagiri had shown it to him in a dream. From the standpoint of learning science, this can be read as an example of unconscious processing bearing fruit. The dream story itself cannot be verified, but when stuck, stepping away from the problem for a break can sometimes bring one closer to a solution. It is best to use metacognition to know at what time of day one is likely to have flashes of insight.

words.meaning: to come to like, to fall for
words.defJa: 好意を持つようになる

cards.ja: 歴史の話を年表から始める人は、とても多いですよね。けれども聞き手がその人物を好きになるのは、年号を聞いたときではなく、迷いや失敗が見えた瞬間です。たとえば桶狭間の名場面を語るなら、年号を並べることなく、雨の音、泥のにおい、息を殺した兵の顔を描写してみてください。そうして年表の人物が血の通った一人の人間に変わったとき、聞き手の想像はようやく自分の力で動きはじめます。
cards.en: Plenty of people start a talk about history with a chronology, don't they? But the moment listeners come to like a person is not when they hear the dates but when they see his hesitation and failures. If you tell the famous scene of Okehazama, for example, try describing the sound of rain, the smell of mud and the faces of soldiers holding their breath, without lining up dates. When the figure in the chronology turns into a flesh-and-blood human being that way, the listener's imagination at last starts to move under its own power.

words.meaning: to be free, to have time on one's hands
words.defJa: 仕事が一段落して、ほかのことができる

cards.ja: 人工知能に議事録を書かせるようになってから、毎週一時間くらい手が空くようになったんですよ。で、その空いた時間に何をするかが、実は一番むずかしいんです。メールの返信を片づけるだけでは、かえって忙しくなるに決まっているじゃないですか。スピードが上がったぶん、考える仕事にその時間を回さないと、せっかくの変化がもったいないですよね。空いたぶんを休みに充てるのも、立派な選択だとは思いますけどね。
cards.en: Since I started having artificial intelligence write the minutes, I've ended up with about an hour free every week, you know. But what to do with that freed-up time is actually the hardest part. If I just clear email replies, I'm bound to get busier, aren't I? Since things got faster, if I don't put that time into thinking work, the change goes to waste, doesn't it? Of course, using the freed-up time for rest is a perfectly good choice too.

words.defJa: うれしい気持ちで進んで

cards.ja: 頼まれごとを断れない人と、喜んで引き受ける人は、外から見ればまったく同じに映る。だが内側では、前者は負担を、後者は自分で選んだという感覚を抱いている。この違いは、のちの疲労感の差となって現れやすい。報酬のない仕事ですら続けられるかどうかは、この感覚がどれだけ自分の中にあるかで決まる。同じ作業をこなしても、動機が自分の内側にあるかどうかで、一日の終わりの顔つきはまるで違ってくる。
cards.en: A person who cannot refuse requests and a person who gladly takes them on look exactly the same from the outside. Inside, though, the former feels a burden and the latter a sense of having chosen. This difference tends to show up later as a difference in fatigue. Whether one can keep going even at unpaid work is decided by how much of this feeling lies within oneself. Even when doing the same task, whether the motive lies within oneself makes the expression at the end of the day quite different.

words.defJa: 実現しうる見込み。起こりうること

cards.ja: さて、ナーガールジュナ、日本では龍樹と呼ばれる大乗仏教の思想家が何を言ったのか、一言でまとめてみましょう。あらゆるものは他との関係によってのみ成り立ち、それ自体の固定した本質を持たない。これが「空」の教えです。もし本質が固定されていたら、人が変わる可能性はゼロになってしまいますよね。変われるという事実そのものが、悟りを目指す修行が成り立つ証拠だと、彼は考えたのです。
cards.en: Now, let me sum up in a word what Nagarjuna, the Mahayana thinker known in Japan as Ryuju, actually said. Everything arises only through its relations to other things and has no fixed essence of its own. This is the teaching of "emptiness." If essence were fixed, the possibility of a person changing would be reduced to zero, wouldn't it? The very fact that we can change, he reasoned, is the proof that practice aimed at awakening can work.

words.meaning: at most, at the very most
words.defJa: どんなに多く見積もっても

cards.en: It is often said that new words are best kept to about twenty a day at most. Even if you cram in more than that, only a little remains by the next morning. In exchange, say each word you learned out loud again during shadowing and tie sound to meaning. Increasing the number of times you recall a word works far better for retention than chasing quantity. Never skipping a small review each day is the surest shortcut.

cards.ja: 仏像のあの顔って、ブッダ本人の容姿を写したものじゃないんですよね。初期の仏教では、ブッダを人の姿で描くことすら避けて、足跡や菩提樹で代わりに表していました。人の姿の仏像が作られはじめたのは、ガンダーラやマトゥラーあたりで、紀元後一世紀ごろからと言われています。ガンダーラはアレクサンドロス大王の征服の影響が残る土地で、ギリシャ彫刻の様式が混ざったという説が有力なんです。
cards.en: That face on Buddha statues isn't a likeness of the Buddha's own looks, you know. In early Buddhism people even avoided depicting the Buddha in human form, representing him instead with footprints or a bodhi tree. Statues in human form began to be made around Gandhara and Mathura, from about the first century CE, it is said. Gandhara was a land where the influence of Alexander the Great's conquest lingered, and the theory that Greek sculptural style mixed in there is a strong one.

words.defJa: 問題がなく、そうしてもよい

cards.ja: 人工知能が下書きした文章を、自分の名前で発表して差し支えないのだろうか。道具として使っただけなら問題ないという意見は根強い。だが文章の主体は誰なのかと問われれば、構想を決め、結果に責任を負った人間だと答えるほかない。逆に言えば、責任を引き受けない者が署名する文章は、どれほど滑らかといえども、自分のものとは呼べないのである。技術が進むほど、署名という行為の意味はかえって重くなっていくだろう。
cards.en: Is it acceptable to publish, under one's own name, text that artificial intelligence drafted? The view that there is no problem if it was merely used as a tool is deeply rooted. But asked who the agent behind the text is, one has no choice but to answer that it is the person who decided the plan and bore responsibility for the result. Conversely, text signed by someone who does not take on that responsibility cannot be called one's own, however smooth it may be. The more technology advances, the heavier the meaning of the act of signing will probably become.

This unexpected sight is said to have led to the later discovery of penicillin. This kind of luck, called serendipity, does not come merely from waiting for chance. Only those who keep observing without letting up can turn a slight difference into a possibility. Whether one can make chance an ally is decided by differences in preparation and attentiveness.

cards.ja: 歴史の話は、時間の物差しを先に決めると聞きやすくなります。たとえば明治維新から数年のうちに、廃藩置県、学制、徴兵令と、大きな改革が矢継ぎ早に続きました。この矢継ぎ早という感覚を伝える上では、年号を並べる前に、スピード感を一言で示すのがコツです。そのうえで、一八七一年、一八七二年、一八七三年と順に出せば、聞き手は変化の連なりを一斉につかめます。数字は少なく、順序は明確に、が基本です。
cards.en: Talk about history becomes easier to follow if you decide the yardstick of time first. For example, within several years of the Meiji Restoration, big reforms followed in rapid succession: the abolition of domains, the school system and conscription. To convey this sense of rapid succession, the trick is to show the feeling of speed in a single phrase before lining up dates. Then, if you give 1871, 1872 and 1873 in order, listeners can grasp the chain of change all at once. The basics are few numbers and a clear order.

Even so, the feeling of speaking to a single person on the other side of the screen may be no different from the radio of old.

words.defJa: それぞれの国。いくつもの国々

cards.ja: 外国語の教え方は、各国で驚くほど違います。ある国では小学校から会話を重視し、別の国では文法の正確さを徹底して鍛える、といった具合です。とはいえ、どの方式にも共通しているのは、インプットの量が上達の土台になっているという点です。使う場面を想定したコミュニケーションの練習は、その土台の上ではじめて生きてきます。自分に合った方式を選ぶ目を持つことが、独学では特に大切です。
cards.en: How foreign languages are taught differs surprisingly from country to country. In one country conversation is stressed from elementary school, while in another accuracy of grammar is drilled thoroughly, and so on. That said, what every method has in common is that the amount of input forms the foundation of improvement. Communication practice that imagines real situations first comes alive on top of that foundation. Having the eye to choose the method that suits you is especially important in self-study.

words.defJa: 仕事の合間にひと休みすること

cards.ja: ヨーガと聞くと、今では健康法や息抜きのイメージが強いかもしれません。しかし本来は、古代インドで育まれた、心の働きを静めるための修行の体系でした。古い時代に編まれたパタンジャリの『ヨーガ・スートラ』は、ヨーガを心の作用の止滅と定義しています。身体を動かすポーズの練習は、ほんの入口の一部にすぎません。原典にあたると、体操ではなく、心を扱う精密な技法だったことがよくわかります。
cards.en: Hearing the word yoga, you may today have a strong image of a health method or a way to unwind. Originally, however, it was a system of training nurtured in ancient India meant to quiet the workings of the mind. Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, compiled long ago, define yoga as the cessation of the mind's fluctuations. Practicing the physical poses is only a small part of its entrance. Turning to the original text, you can see clearly that it was a precise technique for working with the mind, not gymnastics.

words.defJa: 戦いや競争で負ける

cards.ja: かつてヨーロッパの学術語だったラテン語は、各国の言葉との競争に敗れる形で、一般の読み書きの場から退いていった。十七世紀ごろまでは、学者が母語ではなくラテン語で論文を書くことも多かった。やがて自国語で書く人が増えるに伴い、文語としての力は教会や法律など限られた分野に狭まった。ただし、その語彙は今も科学の用語に深く残っている。言語の盛衰は、使う人の数だけでなく、使われる場面の広がりで決まるのだ。
cards.en: Latin, once the scholarly language of Europe, withdrew from the sphere of general reading and writing by losing out in competition with the languages of each country. Up to around the seventeenth century, scholars often wrote papers in Latin rather than in their mother tongues. As more people came to write in their own national languages, its power as a written language narrowed to limited fields such as the church and law. Its vocabulary, however, still remains deep in scientific terms. The rise and fall of a language is decided not only by the number of its users but by the range of situations where it is used.

words.defJa: 定価の四割を安くすること

cards.en: When I see a "40 percent off" sticker at the supermarket, my hand just reaches out, you know. But the Japanese unit wari is one tenth, isn't it? So that sticker means the price becomes sixty percent. It seems to be surprisingly hard for foreigners just learning Japanese, who might well mistake it for paying only forty percent. Remembering that doubling 20 percent off gives 40 percent works too, and the same way of counting turns up in senior discounts on train tickets.

words.defJa: 決勝で敗れ、優勝に次ぐ二位になること

cards.ja: 1996年夏の甲子園決勝は、延長十回に右翼手が見せた好返球で、今も語り継がれています。敗れた熊本工は準優勝に終わりましたが、最後まであきらめない戦いぶりは、勝った松山商とともに名場面として記憶されています。勝った側の物語は残りやすいものですが、敗れた側にも同じだけの物語があります。勝ち負けだけでは測れない価値が、スポーツにはあるということでしょう。だからこそ、私たちは結果にかかわらず熱戦を何度でも見返したくなるのです。
cards.en: The final of the summer 1996 Koshien is still talked about for the fine throw by the right fielder in the tenth inning. The defeated Kumamoto Kogyo finished as runners-up, but their never-give-up fighting spirit is remembered, along with the winning Matsuyama Shogyo, as a great scene. The stories of the winning side tend to survive, but the losing side has just as many stories. Sports must hold a value that cannot be measured by wins and losses alone. That is exactly why we want to rewatch a hard-fought game again and again regardless of the result.

words.defJa: 何よりも先に、いちばん最初に

cards.ja: 新しい技術が現れると、人は真っ先に「これで何が楽になるか」を考える。電卓や検索エンジンが現れたときも、同じ期待と不安が繰り返されてきた。だが歴史が教えるのは、本当に問うべきは「これで何が失われるか」のほうだということだ。AIが文章を書き、絵を描く時代に、私たちが手放しかけているのは、迷いながら考えるという営みそのものかもしれない。便利さに浮かれるのは簡単でも、その代償を直視することには根気が要る。
cards.en: When a new technology appears, people first of all ask what it will make easier. The same hopes and anxieties were repeated when calculators and search engines appeared. But what history teaches is that the question we should truly ask is what this will cost us. In an age when AI writes text and draws pictures, what we are on the verge of letting go of may be the very act of thinking while wavering. Getting carried away by convenience is easy, but facing its price squarely takes perseverance.

That should make the tedious work after meetings a lot easier, even this week. Still, there's a chance the AI will embellish things on its own, so we should be careful about that.

words.defJa: 気温が次第に高くなっていくこと

cards.ja: 2023年7月、国連のグテーレス事務総長は「地球温暖化の時代は終わり、地球沸騰の時代が到来した」と述べた。日本語のこの語はどこか婉曲で穏やかな響きがあり、危機の切迫感が伝わりにくいという指摘が以前からあった。「沸騰」ほど強い言葉なら、確かに報道の見出しにも載りやすい。言葉の選び方ひとつで、受け手の行動が左右される恐れがある。それだけに、各国の報道が表現をどう選ぶかは、見過ごせない問題である。
cards.en: In July 2023, UN Secretary-General Guterres said that the era of global warming had ended and the era of global boiling had arrived. It had long been pointed out that the Japanese term has a somewhat euphemistic, mild ring, which makes the urgency of the crisis hard to convey. A word as strong as boiling would, admittedly, also find its way into headlines more easily. There is a risk that the audience's behavior is swayed by a single choice of word. All the more so, how each country's media chooses its expressions is a problem that cannot be overlooked.

Great scenes from history come back to life again and again through the power of the people who play them.

cards.ja: 日本語学習者がよく注意するよう言われるのが、助詞の「は」と「が」の使い分けです。この二つは、文法書の説明を読んでもなかなか腑に落ちないんですよね。たとえば「私が行きます」と「私は行きます」では、相手に伝わる焦点がまるで違います。実は、「は」は話題を、「が」は新しい情報を示すという目安で、かなりの場面が整理できます。もちろん例外はあるものの、まず原則を押さえてから例外に進むのが、独学でも効率のいい道です。
cards.en: What Japanese learners are often told to watch out for is the distinction between the particles wa and ga. These two just don't click, no matter how much of the grammar book's explanation you read. For example, watashi ga ikimasu and watashi wa ikimasu convey a completely different focus to the listener. In fact, with the rule of thumb that wa marks the topic and ga marks new information, you can sort out quite a lot of cases. There are of course exceptions, but grasping the principle first and then moving on to the exceptions is an efficient path even for self-study.

So, to avoid relying on resolve, I go to bed with the textbook left open. Do that, and the next morning your hand starts moving without hesitation.

That's exactly why they have no choice but to consult the original and examine even the finest habits.

words.defJa: あまり長くない期間

One could even say that a mind in a hurry for results is farthest from stillness. The modern person seeking quick results from a meditation app stands at the opposite pole of this teaching.

words.defJa: 日本の流儀や様式にならったやり方

cards.ja: 「無駄を省いて細部を磨く」という日本式の仕事観は、客観的に見れば効率の追求に映る。だが現場の職人に言わせれば、それは効率ではなく、他人の時間への敬意にほかならない。見えない裏側まで根気よく整えるのは、誰かが使うその瞬間を思えばこそだ。たとえば老舗の料理屋では、客の目に触れない包丁の手入れに、毎朝かなりの時間が割かれる。結果として、手間をかけるほど静かな信頼が積み上がっていく。
cards.en: The Japanese-style view of work, 'trim the waste and polish the details,' looks like a pursuit of efficiency when seen objectively. But ask the craftsmen on site and they will say it is not efficiency but respect for other people's time. They patiently tidy even the unseen back side precisely because they imagine the moment someone will use it. In an old-established restaurant, for example, considerable time is set aside each morning for maintaining knives that customers never see. As a result, the more effort they invest, the more quiet trust accumulates.

cards.en: Researchers in behavioral science point out that merely urging people to be careful about heatstroke hardly changes their behavior. This is because the brain follows concrete procedures more readily than abstract warnings. An abstract warning ends the moment it is read, leaving the reader feeling they have understood it. For example, if you decide on 'drink a glass of water before going out,' the habit starts turning on its own without relying on resolve. Designing the structure of behavior based on findings makes more sense than polishing the wording of the appeal.

If the cost of producing text and images drops suddenly, competition intensifies and prices can't help but fall. For example, translation and summarization services increasingly come at close to free. On the flip side, though, it becomes harder to tell the genuine from the fake. That's why we need the habit of not swallowing information whole and checking it objectively once.

words.defJa: 物事が進んでいる、今の時点

cards.ja: AIが生成した画像や文章の著作権をめぐって、各国の見解は現段階では一致していない。米国の著作権局は、人間の創作的な関与がない部分には保護を認めない立場を示してきた。一方で、日本の著作権法には、AIの学習目的の利用を広く認める規定がある。裁判所の判断もまだ少なく、基準がはっきりしない領域が多いのが実情だ。法整備が技術に追いつくまで、利用者や企業は不確実なルールの中で判断を迫られることになる。
cards.en: Over the copyright of AI-generated images and text, countries' views do not agree at the present stage. The US Copyright Office has taken the position of not recognizing protection for parts without human creative involvement. On the other hand, Japan's copyright law has a provision broadly permitting use of works for AI training purposes. Court rulings are still few, and the reality is that many areas have no clear standard. Until legislation catches up with the technology, users and companies will be forced to make decisions amid uncertain rules.

words.defJa: 神や先祖をまつる行事。にぎやかな催し

cards.ja: 祭りの夜に、見ず知らずの人と一緒に踊ったり叫んだりして、妙に元気になった経験はないでしょうか。神経科学の研究では、同じリズムで体を動かす集団行動が、脳の報酬系を刺激し、信頼や一体感を高めるといわれています。それは単なる娯楽であるどころか、社会の結びつきを更新するための、とても古い仕組みなのです。そう考えると、日本各地で何百年も途絶えずに続いてきた行事が多い理由も、うなずけます。
cards.en: Haven't you had the experience on a festival night of dancing and shouting with total strangers and becoming oddly energized? Neuroscience research says that group actions of moving the body to the same rhythm stimulate the brain's reward system and heighten trust and a sense of unity. Far from being mere entertainment, it is a very old mechanism for renewing the bonds of society. Thinking of it that way, one can see why so many events across Japan have continued unbroken for hundreds of years.

words.defJa: はっきりせず、どちらとも取れること

cards.ja: 生成AIが的外れな答えを返す原因の一つは、指示の曖昧さにある。たとえば「いい感じにまとめて」という一言は、人間には通じても、モデルには基準が見えない。人間なら文脈から補える言い回しでも、モデルは確率の高い解釈を選んで進むほかない。そのため、利用する企業の間では、目的と条件を具体的に書く訓練が広がりつつある。可塑性の高い人間の側が先に学び方を変えるというのは、皮肉な構図でもある。
cards.en: One cause of generative AI returning off-target answers is the vagueness of the instructions. A phrase like 'summarize it nicely,' for instance, gets through to a human, but the model cannot see a standard. Even for phrasing a human could fill in from context, the model has no choice but to pick the most probable interpretation and go on. For that reason, training in writing purposes and conditions concretely is spreading among companies that use it. It is also ironic that it is the highly plastic human side that changes its way of learning first.

words.defJa: 酒を飲むこと。

cards.ja: 睡眠の質を下げる要因として、見落とされやすいのに影響が大きいのが就寝前の飲酒である。アルコールは寝つきを早くするものの、眠りの後半で何度も目覚めさせ、深い眠りを妨げることが知られている。その結果、翌日の集中力や記憶の定着が、目に見えて落ちてしまう。試験前の追い込みの時期ほど、この習慣を見直す価値が大きい。寝酒が習慣になっている人ほど、やめたときの睡眠の改善に驚くことが多いという。
cards.en: Drinking before bed is an easily overlooked factor that significantly lowers sleep quality. Although alcohol makes you fall asleep faster, it is known to wake you repeatedly in the latter half of sleep and to interfere with deep sleep. As a result, the next day's concentration and the consolidation of memory visibly drop. The closer to the pre-exam crunch, the greater the value of reviewing this habit. People for whom a nightcap has become routine are said to be often surprised at how their sleep improves when they stop.

cards.sense: 酒を飲むこと
cards.enTarget: Drinking before bed is an easily overlooked factor that significantly lowers sleep quality.

words.defJa: 相手に声をかけて話を始める。

cards.ja: ガンジス川のほとりで、知らないおじいさんが急に話しかけてきたんですよ。最初は観光客相手の客引きかと思って身構えたんですけど、ただ「どこから来たんだい」って聞きたかっただけだったんです。インドの人って、見知らぬ人にも気軽に声をかけるところがあるじゃないですか。ご縁というか、袖すり合うも他生の縁みたいな感覚なんでしょうね。そう思うと、あの短い会話が急にありがたく感じられました。
cards.en: A stranger, an old man, suddenly spoke to me by the Ganges, you know. At first I braced myself, thinking he was a tout going after tourists, but he only wanted to ask, “where are you from?” People in India do have a way of casually calling out even to strangers, don't they? It's probably a feeling like a bond of fate, like the saying that even a brush of sleeves is due to a connection from a previous life. Thinking that, that short conversation suddenly felt like something to be grateful for.

words.defJa: 全体ではなく一部であるさま。

cards.ja: AIの回答が部分的にしか正しくないとき、一番厄介なのは、全体がもっともらしく見えてしまうことです。九割が正確でも、残りの一割に致命的な誤りが混ざっていれば、そのまま使うのは危険です。ですから、重要な内容ほど、元の資料に当たって裏づけを取る習慣が欠かせません。ここで集中力を切らさずに確認できるかどうかが、AIを使いこなせる人とそうでない人の分かれ目になります。
cards.en: When an AI's answer is correct only in part, the most troublesome thing is that the whole looks plausible. Even if ninety percent is accurate, if a fatal error is mixed into the remaining ten percent, it is dangerous to use it as is. So the more important the content, the more indispensable the habit of going to the source material and getting corroboration. Whether you can check without letting your concentration lapse here becomes the dividing line between people who can use AI well and those who cannot.

cards.enTarget: When an AI's answer is correct only in part, the most troublesome thing is that the whole looks plausible.

words.defJa: 先を進むものに追いついて抜くこと。

cards.ja: 十九世紀の後半、アメリカの工業生産はイギリスの水準に追いつき、やがて世界一になった。この追い越しを可能にしたのは、豊富な資源と広大な国内市場、そして移民による労働力の流入である。鉄道網の拡大は、各地の産業を一つの市場に結びつけ、規格の統一も進めた。覇権の交代は、軍事力よりも先に、経済の静かな逆転として始まるものだ。鉄鋼の生産でも、他国を大きく引き離すようになっていた。
cards.en: In the latter half of the nineteenth century, American industrial output caught up with Britain's level and in time became the world's largest. What made this overtaking possible were abundant resources, a vast domestic market, and the inflow of labor through immigration. The expansion of the railway network tied industries in various places into a single market and also advanced the unification of standards. A change of hegemony begins, before military power, as a quiet reversal in the economy. In steel production too, it had come to pull far ahead of other countries.

cards.sense: 先を行くものを抜くこと
cards.enTarget: What made this overtaking possible were abundant resources, a vast domestic market, and the inflow of labor through immigration.

words.defJa: ある事柄と反対になるさま。

cards.ja: AIが人間の仕事を奪うという議論は、半分しか見ていない。逆に、AIによって新しい種類の仕事が生まれ、需要が増える分野も出てくるはずだ。表計算ソフトが登場したとき、帳簿をつける仕事は減ったが、数字を分析する職種はむしろ増えたと言われる。技術の影響は、失われるものと生まれるものの差し引きで考えなければならない。悲観も楽観も、数字を見ずに語ってしまうと、ただの気分の表明にとどまってしまう。
cards.en: The argument that AI will take human jobs sees only half. Conversely, AI should create new kinds of work, and fields where demand grows will also appear. When spreadsheet software appeared, bookkeeping jobs decreased, but jobs analyzing numbers are said to have increased instead. The impact of technology has to be considered as the balance between what is lost and what is born. Both pessimism and optimism, if voiced without looking at numbers, remain mere expressions of mood.

cards.sense: 反対に・かえって
cards.enTarget: Conversely, AI should create new kinds of work, and fields where demand grows will also appear.

words.defJa: 水準が高いこと。

cards.ja: 江戸時代の日本は、鎖国という言葉から閉ざされた社会のように思われがちですが、識字率は世界でも高水準にありました。寺子屋が各地に広がり、町人や農民の子どもまでが読み書きを学んでいたからです。この教育の土台が、明治になって欧米の知識を急速に吸収する力になったと考えられています。歴史は、断絶ではなく、静かな蓄積の連続として見るべきなのです。同じ時代の欧米諸国と比べても、庶民の識字の広がりは際立っていたといわれる。
cards.en: Edo-period Japan tends to be thought of as a closed society because of the word sakoku, but its literacy rate was at a high level even by world standards. This is because terakoya schools spread to various places and even the children of townspeople and farmers were learning to read and write. This foundation of education is thought to have become the power to absorb Western knowledge rapidly in the Meiji era. History should be seen not as ruptures but as a continuity of quiet accumulation. Even compared with the Western countries of the same period, the spread of literacy among commoners is said to have stood out.

words.defJa: 革で作られた靴。

cards.ja: 日本語には、英語から入った言葉が多いのに、「革靴」のように漢字で定着したものもあります。この語は、ビジネスの場で履く靴として、スニーカーと対比して使われます。面白いのは、「靴」だけで十分なはずなのに、わざわざ素材を前につけて区別している点です。生活の変化が、新しい言葉の組み合わせを生む好例だと思います。見かけはただの複合語でも、そこには暮らしの歴史が詰まっています。
cards.en: Japanese has many words that came in from English, but there are also ones, like “kawagutsu,” that have settled in kanji. This word is used in contrast with sneakers, as shoes worn in business settings. What is interesting is that although “shoes” alone should be enough, the material is deliberately attached in front to distinguish them. I think it is a good example of changes in life producing new word combinations. Even if it looks like a mere compound, the history of daily life is packed into it.

words.meaning: rate of advancement to higher education
words.defJa: 高校卒業者のうち上の学校へ進む人の割合。

cards.ja: 日本の大学進学率は、戦後の高度経済成長とともに急速に上昇した。一九五〇年代には一割に満たなかった数字が、現在では五割を超えている。この拡大は、高学歴を持つ人の割合を増やし、社会の人材の質を押し上げた一方で、学歴の価値を相対的に下げる面もあった。入試の傾向を考えるとき、こうした社会の背景も合わせて理解しておくと、論述問題で役に立つ。数字の増減だけでなく、その理由を説明できるかどうかが、得点の差になる。
cards.en: Japan's university enrollment rate rose rapidly along with postwar high economic growth. A figure that was under ten percent in the 1950s now exceeds fifty percent. While this expansion raised the share of people with high educational backgrounds and lifted the quality of society's human resources, it also had the aspect of relatively lowering the value of a degree. When considering entrance exam trends, understanding this social background as well will help in essay questions. What makes the difference in scores is whether you can explain the reasons, not just the rise and fall of figures.

words.defJa: 国や地域に住む人の全体の数。

cards.ja: 入試の地理で毎年のように必ず問われるのが、インドの総人口と、その年齢構成である。国連は二〇二三年の春に、インドが中国を抜いて世界で最も人口の多い国になったと推計した。ただし、数字の大きさだけを覚えても、得点にはなかなかつながらない。若い世代が多いという構造が、教育や雇用にどう影響するかまで説明できてこそ、論述問題で評価される。速さより、因果をたどる力が試されているのだと言ってよい。
cards.en: What is almost invariably asked every year in entrance exam geography is India's total population and its age structure. In spring 2023, the United Nations estimated that India had overtaken China to become the most populous country. Just memorizing the size of the total population, though, will not readily lead to points. You are rewarded in essay questions only if you can explain how the structure of having many young people affects education and employment. It is fair to say that what is being tested is the power to trace causes, not speed.

words.defJa: 動くものの進む早さ。

cards.ja: 話すときの速さは、聞き手の理解に大きく影響します。日本語の標準的な話速は、一分間に三百字前後と言われますが、ニュース原稿はそれよりやや遅めに読まれます。早口でまくしたてると、情報が多くても、内容がほとんど残りません。逆に、少しゆっくり話して適度な沈黙を入れると、聞き手は考える余裕を持てるようになり、話の印象も深まります。聞き手の様子を見ながら、その場で調節できる人が、話し上手と呼ばれるのだと思います。
cards.en: The speed at which you speak greatly affects the listener's understanding. The standard speaking rate in Japanese is said to be around three hundred characters per minute, but news scripts are read slightly slower than that. If you rattle on quickly, even with a lot of information, almost none of the content stays. Conversely, if you speak a little slower and put in suitable silences, listeners can have room to think, and the impression of the talk deepens. I think a person who can adjust on the spot while watching the listeners is the one called a good speaker.

cards.tipJa: 「速さ」は「速い」の名詞形。「早さ」は時期の早さ。動きの程度を指すときは「速さ」。
cards.sense: 動きの進む早さ
cards.enTarget: The speed at which you speak greatly affects the listener's understanding.

words.defJa: 結婚についての考え方や価値観。

cards.ja: 結婚観について語り合う場では、相手の価値観を否定せずに聞く姿勢が欠かせない。たとえば「結婚は安定のためのもの」と言う人に、いきなり「愛情が先でしょう」と返せば、会話はそこで止まってしまう。まず「なぜそう考えるようになったのか」と背景を尋ねると、相手は自分の経験を言語化し始める。縁や巡り合わせといった要素も認めたうえで話せば、意見の違いはむしろ対話を深くしてくれる。
cards.en: In a setting where people talk through their views of marriage, a stance of listening without denying the other's values is indispensable. If you answer someone who says “marriage is for stability” with an abrupt “but love comes first,” the conversation stops right there. If you first ask about the background, “why did you come to think so,” the other person begins to put their own experience into words. If you talk after acknowledging elements such as fate and chance meetings, differences of opinion rather deepen the dialogue.

cards.enTarget: In a setting where people talk through their views of marriage, a stance of listening without denying the other's values is indispensable.

words.meaning: hard to say; hard to put into words
words.defJa: うまく言い表せない。

cards.ja: インド哲学の入門書では、ブラフマンは言い難いものだと繰り返し説明される。言葉で捉えようとした瞬間に、それは対象になってしまい、本来の姿から離れるというのである。そのため、聖典は否定を重ねる「ネーティ・ネーティ」、つまり「これでもない、あれでもない」という語り口をとる。言語化の限界を知りながら語り続けるという矛盾に、この伝統は正面から向き合ってきた。だからこそ、比喩や物語が、説明の代わりに用いられてきた。
cards.en: In introductory books on Indian philosophy it is repeatedly explained that Brahman is hard to put into words. The moment one tries to grasp it with words, it becomes an object and departs from its true form, they say. For that reason the scriptures take the manner of speaking called “neti neti,” negating again and again, that is, “not this, not that.” This tradition has faced head-on the contradiction of continuing to speak while knowing the limits of verbalization. That is exactly why metaphors and stories have been used in place of explanation.

words.defJa: 封をしたものを開けること。

cards.ja: 新しい半導体を搭載したパソコンを開封する瞬間は、技術の進歩を実感できる楽しみの一つです。しかし、その小さな基板の中に、数百億個ものトランジスタが並んでいることは、箱を開けただけでは見えません。製造の工程は、数か月にわたり、ほこり一つない部屋で何百もの手順を重ねて進みます。見かけは地味な部品が、世界のサプライチェーンの頂点に立っているのです。小さな箱の中には、地球規模の分業の成果が収まっているわけだ。
cards.en: The moment of unboxing a computer carrying a new semiconductor is one of the pleasures in which you can feel technology's progress. But that tens of billions of transistors are lined up inside that small board cannot be seen just by opening the box. The manufacturing process runs for months, piling up hundreds of steps in a room without a speck of dust. A part that looks plain stands at the top of the world's supply chain. Inside the small box is housed the result of a division of labor on a global scale.

cards.enTarget: The moment of unboxing a computer carrying a new semiconductor is one of the pleasures in which you can feel technology's progress.

words.defJa: ある期間の売上をすべて合わせた額。

cards.ja: 仮に、ある書店の総売上が下がっているのに、辞書の棚だけは売れているとしましょう。理由は、言葉に迷う人が減ったのではなく、むしろ増えたからだと考えられます。SNSで毎日大量の文章を書くようになり、「この言い方で合っているのか」と不安になる人が増えたのです。便利な検索があっても、確かな根拠を求めて紙の辞書に戻ってくる。言語化の苦労が本の売れ行きを支えているのは、皮肉な話です。
cards.en: Suppose, hypothetically, that a bookstore's total sales are falling but only the dictionary shelf is selling. The reason, it can be thought, is not that people unsure of words have decreased but that they have increased. Now that people write large amounts of text on social media every day, more of them have come to worry, “is this way of putting it right?” Even with handy search, they return to paper dictionaries seeking a solid basis. It is ironic that the struggle to put things into words is supporting book sales.

cards.enTarget: Suppose, hypothetically, that a bookstore's total sales are falling but only the dictionary shelf is selling.

words.defJa: いろいろな国々。

cards.ja: 東南アジア諸国では、英語を第二言語として使う人が多く、教育制度にも英語の授業が深く組み込まれている。一方で、自国語を守る動きも強く、公共の場では現地語の使用が促されている。言語政策は、経済の国際化と文化の独自性という、ときに対立する二つの要請の間で揺れている。その調整のしかたは、国ごとの歴史によって大きく異なるのが実情だ。その結果、同じ地域でも、国によって言葉をめぐる空気はずいぶん違って見える。
cards.en: In the countries of Southeast Asia, many people use English as a second language, and English classes are deeply built into the education systems. On the other hand, movements to protect the national language are also strong, and the use of local languages is encouraged in public places. Language policy is swaying between two sometimes conflicting demands: the internationalization of the economy and cultural distinctiveness. How the adjustment is made differs greatly by each country's history. As a result, even within the same region, the atmosphere surrounding language looks quite different from country to country.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「諸国」は多くの国々。「東南アジア諸国」「欧米諸国」のように地域名に付く。
cards.sense: いろいろな国々
cards.enTarget: In the countries of Southeast Asia, many people use English as a second language, and English classes are deeply built into the education systems.

words.defJa: 他に比べるものがなく、それだけで成り立つさま。

cards.ja: AIの精度を評価するとき、絶対的な正解がある課題とない課題を分けて考えるのが基本である。計算問題や事実の確認なら正誤がはっきりするが、要約や翻訳の良し悪しは、読み手の目的によって変わってくる。後者を一つの数値で並べると、見かけの数字だけが独り歩きしてしまう。評価の枠組みそのものを疑う習慣は、モデルを選ぶ側に求められる適性でもある。この区別を意識するだけで、評価の読み違いはずいぶん減る。
cards.en: When evaluating the accuracy of AI, the basic approach is to separate tasks that have an absolute right answer from those that do not. For arithmetic problems or fact checks, right and wrong are clear, but how good a summary or translation is changes with the reader's purpose. If you line up the latter by a single number, only the apparent figure takes on a life of its own. The habit of doubting the evaluation framework itself is also an aptitude demanded of those who choose models. Just being conscious of this distinction cuts misreadings of evaluations considerably.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「絶対的な〜」は比較を許さない性質を表す。対は「相対的」で、評価の話に頻出。
cards.sense: 他と比べずそれだけで成り立つ
cards.enTarget: When evaluating the accuracy of AI, the basic approach is to separate tasks that have an absolute right answer from those that do not.

words.meaning: to run around; to fly about
words.defJa: あちこちを動き回る。

cards.ja: 地方紙でも全国紙でも、新聞記者は、事件の現場から現場へと飛び回る。締め切りという限られた時間のなかで情報を集め、裏を取り、原稿にまとめるまでの流れは、文字どおり体力の勝負でもある。しかし、足で稼いだ情報ほど、文章に現れる確かさが違う。言葉の選び方も、現場を見たかどうかで、驚くほど大きく変わってくる。だからこそ、デスクに座ったまま書く記事と、取材先で見たものを書く記事は、読めばすぐにわかるのである。
cards.en: Whether at a local newspaper or a national one, a newspaper reporter runs around from one scene to the next. The flow from gathering information within the limited time before a deadline, to confirming it, to putting it into a manuscript is literally also a contest of stamina. But information earned on foot differs in the certainty that shows in the writing. Even the choice of words changes surprisingly depending on whether you saw the scene. That is exactly why you can tell at once, on reading, an article written while sitting at the desk from one that writes what was seen at the place covered.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

ruby: わってくる。だからこそ、デスクに
めばすぐにわかるのである。
cards.tipJa: 「飛び回る」は忙しく動き回る。「走り回る」と近いが、範囲の広さや軽やかさを含む。
cards.sense: あちこち動き回る
cards.enTarget: Whether at a local newspaper or a national one, a newspaper reporter runs around from one scene to the next.

words.defJa: 外から見たときの様子。

cards.ja: 十九世紀の万国博覧会は、各国の産業力を競う場であると同時に、見かけの豪華さを競う舞台でもあった。一八五一年のロンドン万博では、鉄とガラスで造られた水晶宮が、近代の技術を象徴する建物として注目を集めた。会場に並ぶ展示品の多くは、実用よりも飾りの精巧さで評価されたと伝えられる。それは同時に、産業革命を経た国々が、自国の優位を諸国にアピールする場でもあった。華やかな装飾の裏で、労働環境の問題も見過ごされがちだった。
cards.en: The nineteenth-century world's fairs were both a place where countries competed in industrial strength and a stage where they competed in the lavishness of appearances. At the 1851 London Exhibition, the Crystal Palace, built of iron and glass, drew attention as a building symbolizing modern technology. Many of the exhibits lined up at the venue are said to have been judged by the refinement of their ornament rather than their usefulness. It was at the same time a place where nations that had passed through the Industrial Revolution advertised their superiority to other countries. Behind the splendid decoration, problems of working conditions also tended to be overlooked.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「見かけ」は外見。「見かけによらず」「見かけ倒し」の形で、中身との落差を言う。
cards.sense: 外から見た様子
cards.enTarget: The nineteenth-century world's fairs were both a place where countries competed in industrial strength and a stage where they competed in the lavishness of appearances.

words.defJa: 数字の後につけて、競争や成績の順番を表す言葉。

cards.ja: 全国大会のリレー決勝で、地元の高校は惜しくも二位に終わった。アンカーは最後の直線までトップを走っていたが、ゴール直前で後続の選手に抜かれたのだ。それでも選手たちは顔を上げ、大勢の人で埋まった応援席に向かって深く頭を下げた。監督は「この悔しさが来年の力になる」と静かに語った。
cards.en: In the relay final at the national championships, the local high school narrowly finished second. Their anchor had been in the lead right up to the final straight, only to be overtaken by a chasing runner just before the finish line. Even so, the athletes held their heads high and bowed deeply toward the packed stands of supporters. The coach said quietly, "This frustration will become our strength next year."

cards.enTarget: In the relay final at the national championships, the local high school narrowly finished second.

words.defJa: 人の手で整えた庭や施設を表す語。植物や動物を育てる場所などにつける。

cards.ja: 京都の寺院の庭園には、毎年秋になると紅葉を見ようと大勢の観光客が訪れる。池のまわりに配された石や木は、山や海の景色を小さく表したものだという。歩く位置によって見える景色が変わるよう、細かく計算されているのも特徴だ。庭師たちは、何百年も前の設計を受け継ぎながら、毎日手入れを続けている。
cards.en: Every autumn, crowds of tourists visit the gardens of Kyoto's temples to see the autumn leaves. The stones and trees arranged around the ponds are said to represent mountain and ocean scenery in miniature. Another distinctive feature is that the gardens are carefully calculated so the view changes depending on where you walk. The gardeners carry on designs made hundreds of years ago, tending the grounds every day.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: Every autumn, crowds of tourists visit the gardens of Kyoto's temples to see the autumn leaves.

words.defJa: ある状態や支配、影響を受けている中であることを表す語。

cards.ja: 戦時下の日本では、米や砂糖などの生活必需品が配給制になった。人々は限られた食料をやりくりし、庭や空き地で芋やかぼちゃを育てた。当時を知る祖母は、白いご飯が何よりのごちそうだったと振り返る。こうした記憶を記録に残そうとする取り組みが、各地で続いている。
cards.en: In wartime Japan, daily necessities such as rice and sugar were rationed. People made do with limited food and grew sweet potatoes and pumpkins in their gardens and on vacant lots. My grandmother, who lived through those days, recalls that a bowl of white rice was the greatest treat of all. Efforts to preserve such memories in written records continue across the country.

ruby: よりのごちそうだったと
cards.enTarget: In wartime Japan, daily necessities such as rice and sugar were rationed.

words.defJa: そのような状態や性質に変わること、変えることを表す語。

cards.ja: 地方の町では高齢化が急速に進み、バスの路線が次々と廃止されている。車を運転できなくなったお年寄りにとって、病院や商店に通うことは簡単ではない。そこで一部の自治体は、予約制の乗り合いタクシーを導入した。住民の評判は上々で、利用者は年々増えている。
cards.en: In rural towns the population is aging rapidly, and bus routes are being discontinued one after another. For elderly people who can no longer drive, getting to hospitals and shops is no easy matter. So some local governments have introduced shared taxis that run on reservations. Residents have welcomed them, and the number of users grows every year.

cards.enTarget: In rural towns the population is aging rapidly, and bus routes are being discontinued one after another.

words.meaning: family (in biological classification); department (of a hospital or school)
words.defJa: 生物を分類するときの一つのまとまり。また、学校や病院などの部門。

cards.ja: ライオンやトラは、飼い猫と同じネコ科に分類される動物だ。体の大きさはまるで違うが、鋭い爪を出し入れできることや、獲物にそっと忍び寄って襲う狩りの仕方など、共通点は多い。動物園でトラが前足をなめて毛づくろいする様子を見ると、家の猫とそっくりで驚かされる。分類を知ると、身近な生き物の見え方が変わってくる。
cards.en: Lions and tigers are classified in the cat family, the same as house cats. They differ enormously in size, but they have a great deal in common, such as sharp claws they can extend and retract and a way of hunting by creeping up on their prey before pouncing. Watching a tiger at the zoo lick its front paws to groom itself, you are struck by how much it looks like the cat at home. Knowing how animals are classified changes the way you see familiar creatures.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: Lions and tigers are classified in the cat family, the same as house cats.

words.defJa: ある目的や集団のために作られたうたを表す語。

cards.ja: 卒業式の最後に、全員で校歌を歌うのがこの学校の伝統だ。歌詞には、校舎から見える山や川の名前が織り込まれている。入学したころは意味もわからず口を動かしていた生徒たちも、三年間で自然と覚えてしまう。最後の一節に差しかかると、涙で声を詰まらせる生徒も少なくない。
cards.en: It is a tradition at this school for everyone to sing the school song at the end of the graduation ceremony. Its lyrics weave in the names of the mountains and rivers that can be seen from the school building. Students who just moved their lips without understanding the words when they started find they have learned them naturally over three years. When they reach the final verse, more than a few students are too choked with tears to sing.

cards.enTarget: It is a tradition at this school for everyone to sing the school song at the end of the graduation ceremony.

words.defJa: 絵のこと。描き方や描かれたものの種類を表す言葉の後につける。

cards.ja: 美術館で開かれている展覧会では、明治から昭和にかけて描かれた風景画が百点ほど並ぶ。どの作品にも、今では見られなくなった田園や港町の姿が細やかに描き込まれている。会場には、絵の前で足を止め、故郷の景色と重ねる年配の来場者が多い。担当者は「絵は時代の記録でもある」と話す。
cards.en: The exhibition now on at the art museum displays about a hundred landscape paintings from the Meiji through the Showa eras. Every work depicts in fine detail countryside and port towns that can no longer be seen today. Many older visitors stop in front of the paintings and see in them the scenery of their own hometowns. The curator says, "Paintings are also a record of their times."

cards.enTarget: The exhibition now on at the art museum displays about a hundred landscape paintings from the Meiji through the Showa eras.

words.defJa: ある範囲や枠に入らないこと、その範囲から出ていることを表す語。

cards.ja: 新しい会計システムの導入初日、想定外のトラブルが相次いだ。請求書の金額が二重に計上され、経理部の電話は朝から鳴りやまなかった。担当者たちは深夜まで原因を調べ、翌朝には何とか復旧にこぎつけた。課長は「事前のテストが不十分だった」と反省を口にした。
cards.en: On the first day the new accounting system went live, one unexpected problem followed another. Invoice amounts were booked twice, and the phones in the accounting department rang nonstop from the morning. The staff in charge worked late into the night to find the cause and managed to restore the system by the next morning. The section chief admitted, "Our testing beforehand was not thorough enough."

cards.enTarget: On the first day the new accounting system went live, one unexpected problem followed another.

words.defJa: そうすることがむずかしい、なかなかできないという意味を表す語。動詞の後につく。

cards.ja: 人は誰でも、いつか必ず死を迎える。この避け難い事実とどう向き合うかは、古今東西の哲学者が考え続けてきた問いだ。古代ギリシャのある哲学者は、死を恐れること自体が無意味だと説いた。死が訪れたとき、私たちはもうそれを感じることがないからだという。
cards.en: Everyone, without exception, will someday meet death. How to face this unavoidable fact is a question philosophers in every age and every land have kept thinking about. One ancient Greek philosopher taught that fearing death is in itself pointless. His reason was that when death arrives, we are no longer there to feel it.

ruby: じることがないからだという。
cards.enTarget: How to face this unavoidable fact is a question philosophers in every age and every land have kept thinking about.

words.meaning: edition; publication (of a newspaper or magazine)
words.defJa: 新聞や雑誌などを出すこと、また出す時期や回数を表す語。

cards.ja: 届いたばかりの朝刊を、コーヒーを片手に隅々まで読むのが父の日課だ。最近はスマートフォンでニュースを読む人が増え、新聞の発行部数は年々減っている。それでも父は、見出しの大きさで記事の重みがひと目でわかるのが紙の良さだと言う。読み終えた新聞は、母が野菜を包むのに使っている。
cards.en: My father's daily routine is to read the morning paper from cover to cover as soon as it arrives, coffee in hand. These days more people read the news on their smartphones, and newspaper circulation falls year after year. Even so, my father says the beauty of paper is that the size of a headline tells you at a glance how much a story matters. Once he has finished, my mother uses the paper to wrap vegetables.

words.meaning: between (places or groups); during, for (a period)
words.defJa: 二つ以上のもののあいだや、ある長さの時のあいだを表す語。

cards.ja: 新幹線の開業は、日本の都市間の移動を一変させた。東京から大阪へは、かつて朝の特急に乗っても着くのは昼過ぎだったが、今では二時間半ほどで行ける。日帰りの出張が当たり前になり、沿線の町には新しいビジネスも生まれた。一方で、在来線の利用者が減り、さびれてしまった地域もある。
cards.en: The opening of the Shinkansen transformed travel between Japan's cities. Going from Tokyo to Osaka once meant boarding a limited express in the morning and arriving after noon, but now the trip takes about two and a half hours. Day trips for business became the norm, and new businesses sprang up in towns along the line. On the other hand, some areas fell into decline as ridership on the conventional lines dropped.

cards.enTarget: The opening of the Shinkansen transformed travel between Japan's cities.

words.defJa: 本や作品をいくつかに分けたときの、一つ一つの冊を数える語。

cards.ja: 人気漫画の最終巻が発売された朝、書店の前には開店前から長い行列ができた。連載開始から十五年、壮大な物語はついに完結を迎えた。店長によると、予約の数だけで普段の新刊の十倍に上ったという。これを機に、全巻を最初からじっくり読み返すという熱心なファンも多い。
cards.en: On the morning the final volume of a popular manga went on sale, a long line formed outside the bookstore before it even opened. Fifteen years after serialization began, the sweeping story has finally come to an end. According to the store manager, preorders alone came to ten times those for an ordinary new release. Many devoted fans say they will take this chance to reread the whole series carefully from the very beginning.

words.defJa: 人が集まったり、物を展示したりするための大きな建物を表す語。

cards.ja: 駅前に新しくできた図書館が、平日の夕方でもにぎわっている。広い窓際には大きな机と座り心地のよい椅子が並び、学生や仕事帰りの会社員が思い思いに本を広げている。館内にはカフェも併設され、飲み物を片手に雑誌を読むこともできる。市の担当者は、本を借りる場所から「居場所」へ変えたかったと話す。
cards.en: The new library in front of the station is busy even on weekday evenings. Large desks and comfortable chairs line the wide windows, where students and office workers on their way home spread out their books as they please. There is also a café inside, so you can read a magazine with a drink in hand. A city official says they wanted to turn it from a place to borrow books into a place where people feel they belong.

cards.enTarget: The new library in front of the station is busy even on weekday evenings.

words.defJa: 心の中に生まれる気持ちや、体で受け取る印象を表す語。

cards.ja: 長い山道を登り切り、頂上に立ったときの達成感は何ものにも代えがたい。息を切らしながら一歩ずつ進んだ時間が、すべて報われたように思える。心理学では、こうした成功体験の積み重ねが自信を育てると考えられている。目標を細かく区切ることが、やる気を保つこつだという。
cards.en: The sense of accomplishment when you have climbed a long mountain trail to the end and stand at the summit is like nothing else. All the time spent pressing on step by step, out of breath, seems to have been rewarded. In psychology, an accumulation of such experiences of success is thought to build self-confidence. Breaking a goal into small pieces is said to be the trick to staying motivated.

cards.enTarget: The sense of accomplishment when you have climbed a long mountain trail to the end and stand at the summit is like nothing else.

words.defJa: ある区切られた時間の長さや、時代のひとまとまりを表す語。

cards.ja: 高度成長期の日本では、毎年のように給料が上がり、家電製品が次々と家庭に広まった。テレビ、洗濯機、冷蔵庫は「三種の神器」と呼ばれ、豊かさの象徴だった。一方で、工場の排水や排ガスによる公害が各地で深刻な問題となった。経済の発展と環境の保護をどう両立させるかという課題は、この時代に大きく浮上したといえる。
cards.en: During Japan's period of rapid economic growth, wages rose almost every year and household appliances spread into homes one after another. Televisions, washing machines and refrigerators were called the "three sacred treasures" and stood as symbols of prosperity. At the same time, pollution from factory wastewater and exhaust became a serious problem in many places. The challenge of balancing economic development with environmental protection can be said to have come to the fore in this era.

cards.enTarget: During Japan's period of rapid economic growth, wages rose almost every year and household appliances spread into homes one after another.

words.defJa: ある働きをする道具や入れ物を表す語。

cards.ja: 年を取って耳が遠くなっても、補聴器を使っている人はそれほど多くない。見た目が気になる、雑音がうるさいといった理由で敬遠されがちだからだ。しかし最近の研究では、聞こえにくさを放っておくと、認知症のリスクが高まる可能性が指摘されている。小型で目立たない製品も増えており、早めの相談を勧める医師は多い。
cards.en: Even when their hearing fades with age, not many people actually use hearing aids. They tend to be shunned because people worry about how they look or find the background noise annoying. Recent research, however, points to the possibility that leaving hearing loss untreated may raise the risk of dementia. Small, inconspicuous models are becoming more common, and many doctors recommend seeking advice early.

ruby: されがちだからだ。しかし
cards.enTarget: Even when their hearing fades with age, not many people actually use hearing aids.

words.defJa: 電気やエンジンの力で動き、決まった仕事をする装置を表す語。

cards.ja: スイッチ一つで床をきれいにしてくれるロボット掃除機が、忙しい家庭を中心に人気を集めている。部屋の形を記憶し、家具を避けながら効率よく動き回る。最新の機種は、スマートフォンから外出先でも操作できる。家事の時間が減った分、家族と過ごす時間が増えたという声も多い。
cards.en: Robot vacuum cleaners that clean the floor at the push of a button are gaining popularity, especially among busy households. They memorize the layout of each room and move around efficiently while avoiding furniture. The latest models can even be operated from a smartphone while you are out. Many people say that the time saved on housework has given them more time with their families.

words.meaning: slightly ~, a touch of ~; tending to ~
words.defJa: 少しそのような様子や傾向があることを表す語。

cards.ja: 仕事と子育てに追われる共働きの夫婦は、平日になるとどうしても疲れ気味になる。朝は慌ただしく、夜は互いに口数が減り、会話は用件を伝えるだけで終わってしまう。ある調査では、平日に交わす会話が一日わずか数分という夫婦も珍しくないという。週末に一緒に料理をするなど、小さな習慣を取り入れるだけでも関係は変わってくるそうだ。
cards.en: Working couples juggling jobs and child-rearing inevitably find themselves a little worn out on weekdays. Mornings are hectic, by night both say less and less, and conversation ends once whatever needs saying has been said. According to one survey, it is not unusual for couples to talk for only a few minutes a day during the week. Apparently even adopting small habits, such as cooking together on weekends, can change a relationship.

words.defJa: 神や仏などを信じ、その考えに従う信仰の集まりを表す語。

cards.ja: 仏教は紀元前五世紀ごろ、インド北部で生まれた。やがて教えは中国や朝鮮半島を経て、六世紀に日本へ伝わったとされる。ところが発祥の地インドでは、ヒンドゥー教が勢いを増す中で仏教は次第に衰え、信者は少数派となった。現在、インドの仏教徒は人口の一パーセントにも満たない。
cards.en: Buddhism arose in northern India around the fifth century BCE. Its teachings later spread through China and the Korean Peninsula and are said to have reached Japan in the sixth century. In India, its birthplace, however, Buddhism gradually declined as Hinduism gained strength, and its followers became a minority. Today Buddhists make up less than one percent of India's population.

words.meaning: line (of text); row (of the kana chart)
words.defJa: 文字を横または縦に一列に並べたもの。また、それを数える語。

cards.ja: 文章の読みやすさは、改行の位置で大きく変わる。スマートフォンで読まれることの多い記事では、一つの段落を三行程度に収めるのが基本だとされる。文字がぎっしり詰まった画面を見ただけで、読む気をなくしてしまう人もいるからだ。書き手には、内容だけでなく見た目への気配りも求められている。
cards.en: How easy a piece of writing is to read changes greatly depending on where the lines break. For articles that are often read on smartphones, the basic rule is said to be keeping each paragraph to about three lines. That is because some people lose the will to read just by seeing a screen crammed with text. Writers are expected to pay attention not only to content but also to how it looks.

words.defJa: 仕事や商売の種類、その分野を表す語。

cards.ja: 観光業は、地域の経済を支える重要な産業の一つだ。ホテルや飲食店だけでなく、土産物の製造や交通機関まで、多くの仕事が観光客の消費に支えられている。感染症の流行で客足が途絶えた時期には、廃業に追い込まれる店も相次いだ。その後、外国人旅行者が大きく増え、各地の観光地はにぎわいを取り戻している。
cards.en: Tourism is one of the key industries supporting the regional economy. Not only hotels and restaurants but many other jobs, from making souvenirs to running transportation, depend on tourist spending. When the pandemic stopped visitors from coming, one shop after another was forced to close for good. Since then, the number of foreign travelers has risen sharply, and tourist spots around the country have regained their bustle.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: Tourism is one of the key industries supporting the regional economy.

words.defJa: 物がなくなったり、決められた期間が過ぎたりすることを表す語。

cards.ja: 運転免許の更新を忘れ、気づかないうちに期限切れになっていたという人は意外に多い。そのまま車を運転すると無免許運転とみなされ、重い罰則の対象となる。ただし、失効から一定の期間内であれば、試験の一部が免除される救済措置もある。誕生日が近づいたら、通知のはがきを必ず確認しておきたい。
cards.en: A surprising number of people forget to renew their driver's license and find it has expired without their noticing. Driving in that state counts as unlicensed driving and is subject to heavy penalties. However, there is a relief measure that exempts you from part of the testing if you act within a certain period after it lapses. When your birthday is approaching, you will want to make sure to check the reminder postcard.

cards.enTarget: A surprising number of people forget to renew their driver's license and find it has expired without their noticing.

words.defJa: 人が出入りする所や、外へ開いた所を表す語。

cards.ja: 大きな駅で待ち合わせをするときは、改札口の名前まで決めておくと安心だ。同じ駅でも北口と南口では、出てくる場所がまるで違う。地下街が複雑に入り組んだ駅では、地元の人でも迷うことがあるという。最近は、駅の構内を案内する地図アプリを頼りにする人も増えている。
cards.en: When meeting someone at a big station, it is reassuring to agree beforehand on which ticket gate to use. Even at the same station, the north exit and the south exit bring you out in completely different places. At stations with sprawling underground shopping arcades, even locals are said to get lost. Recently more people have come to rely on map apps that guide them through the inside of stations.

words.defJa: 物のかたちや、決まった型を表す語。

cards.ja: ミツバチの巣は、正六角形の小部屋がすき間なく並んだ構造をしている。この形は、少ない材料で広い空間を確保できる、きわめて効率のよい作りだという。同じ発想は、航空機の部品や建物の壁などにも応用されている。小さな昆虫の知恵が、最先端の工学を支えているのだ。
cards.en: A honeybee comb is built of regular hexagonal cells packed together without any gaps. This shape is said to be an extremely efficient design that secures a large amount of space with very little material. The same idea has been applied to aircraft parts and the walls of buildings. The ingenuity of a tiny insect underpins cutting-edge engineering.

words.meaning: system; group or lineage of a type
words.defJa: 互いにつながり合って一つのまとまりをなすものや、同じ流れをくむ集まりを表す語。

cards.ja: 外来種の魚が湖に放たれ、在来の魚や貝が急速に数を減らしている。天敵のいない環境で外来種は爆発的に増え、湖の生態系が大きく崩れつつある。地元の漁業者たちは網や釣りによる駆除を続けているが、すべてを取り除くのは難しい。専門家は、一度乱れた自然を元に戻すには長い年月がかかると警告する。
cards.en: Non-native fish released into a lake are causing native fish and shellfish to decline rapidly. With no natural predators, the invasive species are multiplying explosively, and the lake's ecosystem is falling badly out of balance. Local fishers keep removing them with nets and rods, but getting rid of them all is difficult. Experts warn that once nature has been disrupted, it takes many years to restore it.

words.defJa: ある力や影響が及ぶ範囲、まとまった地域を表す語。

cards.ja: アジアの国々の間で、関税を段階的になくして貿易を活発にする広い経済圏づくりが進んでいる。参加国の人口を合わせると、世界の約三割に達する。企業にとっては、部品の調達や製品の輸出がしやすくなる利点がある。一方、安い輸入品が増えることで、国内の農業が打撃を受けるとの懸念も根強い。
cards.en: Asian countries are building a broad economic bloc that will phase out tariffs step by step and stimulate trade. The combined population of the participating countries comes to about thirty percent of the world's. For companies, it has the advantage of making it easier to procure parts and export products. On the other hand, there are persistent concerns that a flood of cheap imports will deal a blow to domestic agriculture.

cards.enTarget: Asian countries are building a broad economic bloc that will phase out tariffs step by step and stimulate trade.

words.defJa: 学ぶための施設や、その数を数えるときに使う語。

cards.ja: 少子化の影響で、地方では小中学校の統廃合が相次いでいる。県内でも、この十年間に三十校が閉校となった。使われなくなった校舎は、宿泊施設や地域の交流拠点として活用される例が増えている。かつての教室で地元の野菜を使った料理を味わえるカフェも人気を集めている。
cards.en: Because of the falling birthrate, elementary and junior high schools in rural areas are being merged or closed one after another. In this prefecture, too, thirty schools have closed over the past ten years. More and more of the empty school buildings are being reused as lodgings or as community gathering places. A café where you can enjoy dishes made with local vegetables in a former classroom is also proving popular.

cards.enTarget: In this prefecture, too, thirty schools have closed over the past ten years.

words.defJa: 船が出入りし、とまる場所を表す語。

cards.ja: 夜明け前の漁港では、水揚げされたばかりの魚が次々と競りにかけられる。威勢のいい掛け声が飛び交い、買い付けに来た業者たちは魚の鮮度を素早く見極めていく。ここで値がついた魚は、その日のうちに各地の市場やスーパーに並ぶ。最近は、港の食堂で朝どれの海鮮丼を味わおうと、早朝から訪れる観光客も多い。
cards.en: At the fishing port before dawn, freshly landed fish are put up for auction one after another. Lively calls fly back and forth as the buyers who have come to bid quickly judge how fresh each fish is. Fish that get their price here are on the shelves of markets and supermarkets around the region the same day. Lately many tourists also come early in the morning to enjoy a seafood rice bowl made from the morning's catch at the harbor diner.

cards.enTarget: At the fishing port before dawn, freshly landed fish are put up for auction one after another.

words.meaning: No. (in a series); issue (of a magazine)
words.defJa: 順番を示す数や、雑誌の発行の回、船や列車の名前などにつける語。

cards.ja: 大型で強い台風十号は、あすの朝にも九州南部に上陸するおそれがある。気象庁は、記録的な大雨や暴風に厳重な警戒を呼びかけている。すでに一部の地域では避難指示が出され、住民が公民館などに身を寄せ始めた。交通機関にも影響が広がり、航空各社は多くの便の欠航を決めた。
cards.en: Typhoon No. 10, large and powerful, could make landfall in southern Kyushu as early as tomorrow morning. The Japan Meteorological Agency is urging the utmost vigilance against record-breaking rain and violent winds. Evacuation orders have already been issued in some areas, and residents have begun taking shelter in community centers and similar places. The disruption is spreading to transportation, and airlines have decided to cancel many flights.

words.defJa: 一つの政府のもとにまとまった土地や人々を表す語。

cards.ja: 生成AIの急速な普及を受けて、各国で規制づくりが進んでいる。欧州連合は加盟国に共通のルールを定め、危険性の高い用途には厳しい義務を課した。一方、技術開発を優先したい国々は、過度な規制が競争力を損なうとして慎重な姿勢を崩さない。国境を越えて広がる技術をどう管理するかが問われている。
cards.en: With generative AI spreading rapidly, countries are moving to draw up regulations. The European Union has set common rules for its member states and imposed strict obligations on high-risk uses. Meanwhile, countries that want to put technological development first remain cautious, arguing that excessive regulation would undermine their competitiveness. The question now is how to govern a technology that spreads across borders.

words.meaning: every ~, each ~ (at each interval or unit)
words.defJa: ～のたびに。一つ一つの区切りについて、同じことをくり返すようす。

cards.ja: この観測所では、気温や湿度、風速を五分ごとに自動で記録している。集められたデータはすぐに気象台のサーバーへ送られ、天気予報の精度を高めるために使われる。以前は職員が一日に数回、計器の目盛りを目で読み取っていた。測定の間隔が短くなったことで、急な天気の変化もとらえやすくなったという。
cards.en: At this observation station, temperature, humidity and wind speed are recorded automatically every five minutes. The collected data is sent straight to the meteorological observatory's servers and used to improve the accuracy of weather forecasts. In the past, staff read the instrument scales by eye a few times a day. With the shorter measurement interval, sudden changes in the weather are reportedly easier to catch.

words.defJa: 名前の後につけて、それが「やま」の名であることを表すことば。

cards.ja: 夏の富士山には、毎年二十万人前後の登山者が訪れる。山頂で日の出を見ようと、夜のうちに山小屋を出発する人も多い。ところが、薄い空気や急な冷え込みで体調を崩す人が後を絶たない。地元の山梨・静岡両県は、十分な防寒装備と余裕のある日程で登るよう、繰り返し呼びかけている。
cards.en: Every summer, around 200,000 climbers visit Mount Fuji. Many set out from mountain huts during the night, hoping to see the sunrise from the summit. Yet there is no end of people who fall ill from the thin air and the sudden cold. The two local prefectures, Yamanashi and Shizuoka, repeatedly urge climbers to go with proper cold-weather gear and an unhurried schedule.

cards.ja: 駅前のスーパーでは、北海道産のじゃがいもが山積みになっている。秋は収穫したての芋が店頭に並ぶ季節で、今年は値段も例年より手ごろだ。店長によると、産地を確かめてから買う客がここ数年で目に見えて増えたという。味だけでなく、どこでどう育てられたかを気にする人が多くなっているのだろう。
cards.en: At the supermarket in front of the station, potatoes from Hokkaido are piled high. Autumn is the season when freshly harvested potatoes reach the shelves, and this year prices are more reasonable than usual. According to the store manager, the number of customers who check where produce comes from before buying has grown visibly over the past few years. It seems more and more people care not only about taste but also about where and how their food was grown.

words.defJa: ある分野やものごとが、これまでどのように移り変わってきたかの記録や研究。

cards.ja: 科学史の研究者たちは、偉大な発見が一人の天才のひらめきだけで生まれたわけではないと指摘する。同じ時代に、別々の場所で同じ答えにたどり着いた例は少なくない。背景には、新しい観測道具の普及や、学者どうしの手紙のやりとりがあった。発見の物語を時代の流れの中に置き直すと、科学の見え方は大きく変わる。
cards.en: Historians of science point out that great discoveries did not arise solely from a single genius's flash of insight. There are many cases in which people in different places arrived at the same answer in the same era. Behind this lay the spread of new observational instruments and the letters scholars exchanged with one another. When the stories of discovery are placed back into the flow of their times, the way we see science changes greatly.

words.meaning: newspaper (of a given kind, e.g. a local paper); type of paper
words.defJa: 新聞のこと。とくに、どんな種類の新聞かを表すときに後ろにつけて使う。また、かみの種類を表すこともある。

cards.ja: 地方紙の発行部数は、この二十年で大きく落ち込んだ。それでも、市議会の議論や地元の祭り、小さな事件を丁寧に追い続けているのは地方紙だけだという声は根強い。ある編集局長は、全国紙が取り上げない話題こそ地域の記録として残す意味があると語る。紙面からネットへの移行をどう進めるかが、生き残りの鍵になっている。
cards.en: The circulation of local newspapers has dropped sharply over the past twenty years. Even so, there is a persistent view that only local papers keep carefully following city council debates, local festivals and small incidents. One editor-in-chief says that precisely the stories national papers ignore are worth preserving as a record of the community. How to manage the shift from print to the internet has become the key to survival.

cards.enTarget: The circulation of local newspapers has dropped sharply over the past twenty years.

words.defJa: 仏をまつる建物の名前の最後につけることば。

cards.ja: 奈良の東大寺には、修学旅行の時期になると全国から生徒たちが集まる。大仏殿に入ると、高さ十五メートル近い大仏の大きさに誰もが言葉を失う。奈良時代に国の力を結集して造られたこの像は、たび重なる火災や地震を乗り越えてきた。千三百年近い時を経た今も、人々はその前で静かに手を合わせている。
cards.en: At Todaiji in Nara, students gather from all over the country during the school-trip season. On entering the Great Buddha Hall, everyone is left speechless by the size of the Great Buddha, nearly fifteen meters high. Built in the Nara period with the combined strength of the state, the statue has survived repeated fires and earthquakes. Even now, after nearly 1,300 years, people quietly put their palms together before it.

words.defJa: 学校の授業で、一日のうち何番目の授業かを表すことば。

cards.ja: 小学生のころ、月曜日の三時間目はいつも体育の授業だった。運動が苦手だった私は、月曜の朝になるたびに気が重くなったものだ。ところが、ある年に担任が替わり、授業の最初に好きな種目を選べるようになった。たったそれだけのことで、三時間目を待ち遠しく思うようになったのを今でも覚えている。
cards.en: When I was in elementary school, third period on Monday was always physical education. Being bad at sports, I used to feel gloomy every Monday morning. One year, however, we got a new homeroom teacher, and we were allowed to choose our favorite activity at the start of class. I still remember how that one small change made me start looking forward to third period.

words.defJa: 部屋の数をかぞえることば。また、ある目的のための部屋の名をつくる。

cards.ja: 温泉街の外れに、古い旅館を改装した宿が先月開業した。客室は全八室と少ないが、どの部屋からも川の流れが見えるように設計されている。経営者は、部屋数を増やすより、一組一組に目の行き届いたもてなしをしたいと話す。週末の予約は、すでに三か月先まで埋まっているという。
cards.en: Last month an inn set in a renovated old ryokan opened on the edge of the hot-spring town. It has only eight guest rooms in all, but it was designed so that the river can be seen from every room. The owner says that rather than adding more rooms, they want to give every party attentive hospitality. Weekend bookings are reportedly already full three months ahead.

words.meaning: vehicle, -car (a type of vehicle, e.g. ambulance)
words.defJa: ある目的や種類の乗り物であることを表すことば。

cards.ja: 救急車の出動件数が増え続けている。高齢化に加え、軽い症状でも救急車を呼ぶ人が少なくないことが背景にある。そのため、本当に急を要する患者のもとへ到着するまでの時間が延びているという。消防は、迷ったときは専用の相談窓口に電話するよう呼びかけている。
cards.en: The number of ambulance dispatches keeps rising. Behind this are the aging population and the fact that quite a few people call an ambulance even for minor symptoms. words.defJa: そのことをする人、またはそういう立場にある人。

cards.ja: 市立図書館の利用者は、ここ数年で年齢層が大きく変わった。以前は学生や高齢者が中心だったが、今は平日の夕方に仕事帰りの会社員の姿が目立つ。館内にはパソコン作業ができる席が設けられ、閉館時間も夜九時まで延びた。図書館は本を借りる場所から、誰もが過ごせる居場所へと変わりつつある。
cards.en: The age profile of the city library's users has changed greatly over the past few years. Students and the elderly used to be the core, but now office workers on their way home stand out on weekday evenings. Seats for working on computers have been set up inside, and closing time has been extended to 9 p.m. The library is changing from a place to borrow books into a place where anyone can spend time.

words.defJa: 企業の数をかぞえることば。

cards.ja: 生成AIの開発競争は、資金力のある大手数社に集中しつつある。最先端のモデルを一から作るには、膨大な計算資源と電力が必要になるからだ。国内でも十社以上が独自モデルの開発を表明しているが、海外の大手との規模の差は大きい。一部の企業に技術が偏ることで、選択肢が狭まるのではないかと心配する声も出ている。
cards.en: The race to develop generative AI is increasingly concentrated among a handful of large, well-funded companies. That is because building a cutting-edge model from scratch requires enormous computing resources and electricity. In Japan, too, ten or more companies have announced they are developing their own models, but they are far smaller in scale than the overseas giants. Some worry that technology concentrated in a few firms could narrow the range of choices.

cards.enTarget: The race to develop generative AI is increasingly concentrated among a handful of large, well-funded companies.

words.meaning: person who does a job or role (e.g. driver, player)
words.defJa: そのことを仕事としてしたり、役目として受け持ったりする人。

cards.en: Bus companies around the country are cutting services one after another because there are not enough route bus drivers. Long hours and low wages put people off, so it is hard to attract the younger generation. At one depot, the drivers' average age has passed fifty. The companies are revising working hours and hiring more women, but there is no prospect of the situation improving soon.

cards.en: Sake exports have grown substantially over the past decade. Besides the rise in Japanese restaurants abroad, a tailwind has come from the spread of drinking it like wine, enjoying how it pairs with food. Meanwhile, domestic consumption has been falling for a long time, and quite a few breweries are closing down. Brewers around the country are actively exhibiting at overseas trade fairs in search of new sales channels.

cards.en: Japan, with its many volcanoes, is said to have some of the world's largest geothermal resources. However, many of the most promising areas lie inside national parks or near hot-spring resorts, and building geothermal power plants has taken a long time. Talks with local communities worried that the hot springs' flow will drop are also essential. Even so, expectations are rising again for geothermal energy as a stable power source unaffected by the weather.

words.defJa: 家族の中で何番目に生まれた娘かを表すことば。

cards.ja: 三人姉妹の次女として育った母は、子どものころ、家の中に自分の居場所がないように感じていたという。しっかり者の姉と甘え上手の妹にはさまれ、いつも聞き役に回っていたからだ。けれども大人になってみると、その経験のおかげで人の話をじっくり聞けるようになったと笑う。家族の中の位置が性格をつくるという説も、母を見ていると少しうなずける。
cards.en: My mother, who grew up as the second of three sisters, says that as a child she felt there was no place for her at home. That was because, sandwiched between a dependable older sister and a younger sister who was good at getting her way, she always ended up as the listener. Yet as an adult, she laughs, that experience taught her to listen carefully to others. Watching my mother, I can half believe the theory that your place in the family shapes your personality.

Customers no longer had to fuss over haggling, and the shop was no longer plagued by collecting payments. This new way of doing business was eventually passed on to the modern department store.

cards.ja: 雨の日の駅の階段は、思った以上に滑りやすい。構内には足元に注意するよう呼びかける放送が繰り返し流れている。特に急いでいるときや荷物が多いときは、スマートフォンを見ながら歩くのはやめたほうがいい。転んでけがをすれば、数分の遅れどころでは済まなくなる。
cards.en: Station stairs on rainy days are more slippery than you might think. Announcements urging people to watch their step play over and over throughout the station. Especially when you are in a hurry or carrying a lot, it is best not to walk while looking at your smartphone. If you fall and get hurt, it will cost you far more than a few minutes' delay.

cards.ja: 久しぶりに連絡してきた昔の同級生は、近況を少し話すとすぐに本題に入った。来月から一週間、家に泊めてほしいというのだ。十年近く会っていなかった相手に、よくそんな厚かましい頼みができるものだと思った。結局、丁寧に断ったが、それ以来向こうからの連絡は途絶えている。
cards.en: An old classmate who got in touch after a long silence chatted briefly about how things were going and then got straight to the point. They wanted me to put them up at my place for a week starting next month. I was amazed that anyone could make such a shameless request of someone they hadn't seen in nearly ten years. In the end I politely refused, and I haven't heard from them since.

cards.ja: 年末になると、年賀状の宛名書きに追われる家庭は今も少なくない。最近はパソコンで印刷する人が増えたが、手書きの文字にはやはり温かみがある。一方で、年賀状そのものをやめる人も年々増えている。郵便料金の値上げも重なり、発行枚数は最盛期の半分をはるかに下回っている。
cards.en: At the end of the year, there are still quite a few households busy writing the addresses on their New Year's cards. More people now print them on a computer, but handwritten characters still have a certain warmth. At the same time, the number of people giving up New Year's cards altogether grows every year. With postage increases adding to the trend, the number of cards issued has fallen far below half of its peak.

words.meaning: to apply (to), to fit, to hold true (for)
words.defJa: ある条件や説明に、ちょうど合う。

cards.ja: 性格診断の結果を読んで、自分にぴったり当てはまると驚いた経験はないだろうか。実は、誰にでも当てはまりそうなあいまいな文章でも、人は自分のことを言い当てられたと感じやすい。心理学ではよく知られた傾向で、占いが当たったように思える理由の一つとされる。診断を楽しむのはいいが、結果を信じ込みすぎないほうがよさそうだ。
cards.en: Have you ever read the results of a personality test and been surprised at how perfectly they fit you? In fact, people tend to feel they have been read accurately even by vague descriptions that could apply to almost anyone. It is a well-known tendency in psychology and is considered one reason fortune-telling seems to hit the mark. Enjoying such tests is fine, but it seems best not to put too much faith in the results.

cards.ja: 法律の多くは、インターネットが登場するずっと前に作られたものだ。そのため、新しいサービスをめぐるトラブルに古い条文をそのまま当てはめると、無理が生じることがある。裁判所は条文の趣旨をくみ取りながら判断しているが、限界もある。技術の変化に合わせて、ルールそのものを見直す議論が欠かせない。
cards.en: Many laws were written long before the internet appeared. So when old provisions are applied as they stand to disputes over new services, the fit can become strained. Courts reach their judgments by reading the intent behind the provisions, but there are limits. Debate on revising the rules themselves to keep pace with technological change is essential.

words.meaning: storm shutter (sliding shutter outside a window)
words.defJa: 風や雨を防ぐためや、防犯のために窓の外側に付ける戸。

cards.ja: 大型の台風が近づいているとの予報を受け、夕方から近所の家々が次々と雨戸を閉め始めた。強風で飛んできた物が窓ガラスを割るのを防ぐためだ。我が家でも雨戸を閉め、庭の植木鉢を物置にしまって非常用の水を用意した。最近は雨戸の代わりに電動のシャッターを付ける家も増えているが、台風の前に窓を守る習慣そのものは変わらない。
cards.en: With forecasts that a large typhoon was approaching, houses in the neighborhood began closing their storm shutters one after another from the evening. The aim is to stop objects blown by the strong wind from breaking the window glass. At our house too we closed the shutters, put the potted plants from the garden away in the shed and set aside emergency water. More homes these days have electric roller shutters instead of storm shutters, but the habit of protecting the windows before a typhoon has not changed.

words.defJa: 子どもなどを必要以上に大事にして、好きなようにさせる。

cards.ja: 祖父母が孫を甘やかすのは、どこの国でも同じらしい。親が禁じているお菓子をこっそり与えたり、欲しがるおもちゃを買い与えたりする。親にとっては困った話だが、子どもにとっては逃げ場のある安心感にもつながるという見方もある。大切なのは、大人同士で最低限のルールを共有しておくことだろう。
cards.en: Grandparents spoiling their grandchildren seems to be the same in every country. They secretly give sweets the parents have forbidden or buy whatever toys the children ask for. It is a headache for the parents, but some see it as giving children the reassurance of a place to retreat to. What matters is that the adults agree on a minimum set of rules among themselves.

cards.en: Knitting has become a quiet boom among younger people. More and more of them learn the basic stitches from video sites and show off the scarves and hats they have made on social media. Many also say that repeating the monotonous hand movements calms them down. Some apparently choose this hobby as a way to spend time away from screens.

cards.en: As winter approaches, my mother sits knitting yarn in front of the TV every evening. This year, she says, she is making a sweater with her grandchild's initial on it. It takes about a month to finish, but she apparently enjoys watching it take shape little by little. Handmade things have a special warmth that clothes bought in a shop lack.

words.meaning: rough, violent (of waves, wind or manner); harsh
words.defJa: 勢いが激しく、おだやかでない様子。乱暴な様子。

cards.ja: 冬の日本海は波が荒いことで知られる。北西の季節風が強まる日には、五メートルを超える高波が防波堤に打ち寄せることも珍しくない。このため漁に出られない日が続き、港では漁師たちが網の手入れをしながら天候の回復を待つ。それでも冬のブリやカニは味がよく高値で取引されるため、波の穏やかな日が来ると、漁船は待ちかねたように沖へ向かう。
cards.en: The Sea of Japan in winter is known for its rough waves. On days when the northwesterly seasonal wind strengthens, it is not unusual for waves more than five meters high to pound the breakwaters. As a result, the boats often cannot go out for days on end, and in port the fishermen mend their nets while they wait for the weather to improve. Even so, winter yellowtail and crab taste good and fetch high prices, so when a calm day comes, the boats head out to sea as if they could hardly wait.

cards.ja: 初期の気象衛星が送ってきた画像は、今と比べるとかなり粗いものだった。雲のおおまかな形はわかっても、小さな積乱雲が発生する様子まではとらえられなかった。現在の衛星は解像度が大幅に向上し、数分おきに細かな雲の動きを観測できる。その結果、局地的な大雨の予測精度も上がりつつある。
cards.en: The images sent back by the early weather satellites were quite coarse compared with today's. Although the general shape of the clouds could be made out, they could not capture small cumulonimbus clouds as they formed. Today's satellites have greatly improved resolution and can observe fine cloud movements every few minutes. As a result, the accuracy of forecasts for localized heavy rain is also improving.

cards.ja: 映画の宣伝では、あらすじをどこまで明かすかが悩ましい問題だ。結末に触れてしまえば観客の楽しみを奪うが、情報が少なすぎると興味を持ってもらえない。最近は、本編の冒頭十分間をそのまま無料で公開する作品も増えている。物語の入り口だけを見せて、続きは劇場で確かめてもらうという考え方である。
cards.en: In film promotion, how much of the synopsis to reveal is a tricky problem. Touching on the ending robs the audience of their enjoyment, but too little information fails to draw their interest. Recently, a growing number of films have put the first ten minutes of the actual film online, unedited and free of charge. The idea is to show just the entrance to the story and let viewers find out the rest in the theater.

words.defJa: もう一度、新しい気持ちで。また、別の機会にもう一度。

cards.ja: 台風で三日間停電が続き、電気に頼った暮らしのもろさを改めて実感した。冷蔵庫は止まり、スマートフォンの充電もままならず、夜は懐中電灯一本で過ごすしかなかった。復旧した翌日、私は家族と相談し、乾電池や水の備蓄を見直すことにした。天災は忘れたころにやってくるという言葉が、今回ほど身にしみたことはない。
cards.en: After a typhoon left us without power for three days, I realized anew how fragile a life dependent on electricity is. The refrigerator stopped, I could barely charge my smartphone, and at night there was nothing to do but get by with a single flashlight. The day after the power came back, I talked it over with my family and decided to review our stock of batteries and water. Never has the old saying that natural disasters strike just when you have forgotten about them hit home as hard as it did this time.

words.defJa: 人の親切や物事がうれしく、感謝したい気持ちだ。

cards.ja: ある電機メーカーが在宅勤務を導入して三年、社内アンケートでは「通勤がなくなったのはありがたい」と答えた社員が七割を超えた。浮いた時間を家事や睡眠に充てられるようになったという声が目立つ。一方で、同僚と雑談する機会が減り、孤独を感じるという意見も少なくない。会社は週に一度の出社日を設け、対面での交流を補う方針だ。
cards.en: Three years after an electronics maker introduced remote work, more than 70 percent of its employees answered in an in-house survey, "I'm grateful not to have to commute anymore." Many say they can now put the time saved toward housework or sleep. On the other hand, quite a few say they have fewer chances to chat with colleagues and feel lonely. The company plans to set one office day a week to make up for reduced face-to-face interaction.

words.meaning: to become rough or chapped (skin); to be stormy (weather, sea)
words.defJa: おだやかな状態がくずれて乱れる。肌がかさかさになる。

cards.ja: 空気が乾燥する冬は、手や唇が荒れやすい季節だ。湿度が下がると皮膚の水分が奪われ、外からの刺激を防ぐ働きが弱まってしまう。皮膚科の医師は、手を洗った後すぐに保湿クリームを塗ることを勧めている。熱すぎるお湯で洗うのも、肌に必要な油分を落とす原因になるという。
cards.en: Winter, when the air is dry, is the season when hands and lips easily become chapped. When humidity drops, moisture is drawn out of the skin, weakening its ability to block outside irritants. Dermatologists recommend applying moisturizing cream right after washing your hands. Washing with water that is too hot can also strip the skin of oils it needs, they say.

words.meaning: to bring up, to suggest; to start saying
words.defJa: 話を始める。ある考えや希望を初めて口にする。

cards.ja: 家族旅行の行き先を決める話し合いで、普段はおとなしい中学生の息子が「温泉に行きたい」と言い出した。理由を聞くと、部活動で疲れた体を休めたいのだという。思いがけない提案に家族みんなで笑ったが、反対する者はいなかった。親が決めた予定についてくるだけだった息子が、自分の希望を口にするようになったことが少しうれしかった。
cards.en: During a family discussion about where to go on vacation, our usually quiet son, a junior-high student, spoke up and said he wanted to go to a hot spring. When we asked why, he said he wanted to rest his body, worn out from club activities. The whole family laughed at the unexpected suggestion, but no one objected. I was a little happy that a boy who used to simply tag along with plans his parents made had started voicing his own wishes.

words.defJa: 目下の人に用事などをするよう命じる。人の悪い行いを目上の人に知らせる。

cards.ja: 江戸時代の商家では、十歳前後で奉公に入った子どもたちが、店の主人や先輩に言いつけられた用事を朝から晩までこなしていた。掃除や使い走りをしながら、読み書きやそろばん、客への応対を少しずつ身につけていったのである。厳しい生活ではあったが、ここで鍛えられた者の中から、やがて自分の店を持つ者も現れた。
cards.en: In merchant houses of the Edo period, children who entered service at around the age of ten carried out, from morning till night, the errands they were ordered to do by the shop's master and their seniors. While cleaning and running errands, they gradually acquired reading and writing, the abacus, and how to deal with customers. It was a harsh life, but from among those trained there, some eventually came to own shops of their own.

cards.ja: 山あいの古い木の橋は、江戸時代に架けられて以来、幾度となく洪水で流されてきた。そのたびに村人たちは材木を集め、ほぼ同じ形で橋を架け直した。現在の橋は九代目にあたり、昔ながらの工法を伝える貴重な建造物として知られ、多くの観光客が訪れる。橋のたもとには、歴代の架け替えの年を刻んだ石碑が立っている。
cards.en: The old wooden bridge in the mountains has been washed away by floods time and again since it was built in the Edo period. Each time, the villagers gathered lumber and rebuilt the bridge in almost the same form. The present bridge is the ninth; it is known as a valuable structure that preserves traditional building methods, and many tourists visit it. At the foot of the bridge stands a stone monument engraved with the year of each rebuilding.

words.defJa: 小さな子どもを育てること。

cards.ja: 男性の育児休業の取得率は、この十年で大きく伸びた。それでも取得期間が二週間未満という人が多く、本格的に子育てを分担するには短すぎるとの指摘もある。職場に迷惑をかけたくないという遠慮が、長期の休みをためらわせているようだ。人員の補充や業務の見直しなど、休みを取りやすくする職場の工夫が求められている。
cards.en: The rate at which men take childcare leave has risen sharply over the past decade. Even so, many take less than two weeks, and some point out that this is too short to genuinely share in raising children. A reluctance to burden their workplaces seems to make them hesitate to take long leave. Workplaces are being called on to make leave easier to take, for example by adding staff and reviewing workloads.

cards.ja: 九月に入り、朝晩の暑さは幾分やわらいできた。日中はまだ三十度を超える日もあるが、日が沈むと涼しい風が吹き、草むらから虫の声が聞こえるようになった。気象台によると、今年は残暑が長引く見込みで、本格的な秋の訪れは十月半ばごろになるという。長袖の出番は、もう少し先になりそうだ。

According to the meteorological observatory, the lingering summer heat is expected to drag on this year, and autumn proper will arrive around mid-October. It looks like long sleeves will have to wait a little longer.
