words.defJa: 草花や木の枝を器に挿して、美しく見せる日本の伝統的な芸術。

cards.ja: 生け花は、ただ花を美しく飾るための技術ではない。枝の曲がり方や葉の向きを見極め、余白を生かしながら、自然の中にある姿を器の上に表現するのである。最近は海外でも愛好者が増え、各地の教室で現地の草花を使った作品づくりが行われている。限られた空間に季節を感じさせるという考え方が、国境を越えて共感を呼んでいるのだろう。
cards.en: Ikebana is not merely a technique for displaying flowers beautifully. Discerning how the branches bend and which way the leaves face, and making use of empty space, the arranger expresses on the vessel the form that things take in nature. Recently the number of enthusiasts abroad has grown, and classes in many countries create works using local plants. The idea of evoking the season within a limited space likely resonates across borders.

words.meaning: after (that time), since then; from now on
words.defJa: ある時から後。また、今から後。

cards.ja: 1872年に新橋と横浜の間で鉄道が開業すると、それ以後、日本各地で線路の建設が急速に進んだ。わずか30年ほどで、主な都市はほとんど鉄道で結ばれるようになった。人や物の移動にかかる時間は大きく縮まり、地方の産物が都市の市場に並ぶようになった。鉄道は、近代日本の経済と暮らしを根本から変えたのである。
cards.en: When the railway opened between Shinbashi and Yokohama in 1872, from then on the construction of lines advanced rapidly across Japan. In only about thirty years, nearly all the major cities came to be connected by rail. The time needed to move people and goods shrank dramatically, and products from the provinces began to appear in city markets. The railway fundamentally transformed the economy and daily life of modern Japan.

words.meaning: on and after, from (a point in time) onward
words.defJa: その時を含めて、それより後。

cards.en: The city library announced that from the first of next month onward, it will extend its weekday opening hours until 9 p.m. This is because there were many requests from office workers on their way home and from high school students who study after school. cards.ja: 人はたとえ不便でも、慣れたやり方を変えることを嫌がる傾向がある。心理学では、これを現状維持バイアスと呼ぶ。新しい方法のほうが得だとわかっていても、変化に伴う手間や失敗への不安が、実際以上に大きく感じられるためだ。職場で新しい仕組みを導入するときは、この心理を理解したうえで、少しずつ慣れてもらう工夫が必要になる。
cards.en: People tend to dislike changing familiar ways of doing things, even when those ways are inconvenient. In psychology this is called status quo bias. Even when people know a new method is more advantageous, the effort that comes with change and the fear of failure feel larger than they really are. When introducing a new system at work, it is necessary to understand this psychology and find ways to help people get used to it gradually.

cards.ja: この春から、新任の教師として三年生のクラスを受け持つことになった。最初の一週間は、三十人の名前と顔を覚えるだけで精一杯だった。それでも、休み時間に話しかけてくる子どもたちのおかげで、少しずつ教室の雰囲気がつかめてきた。ベテランの先輩からは、焦らずに一人ひとりの様子を見ることが大切だと助言されている。
cards.en: This spring, as a new teacher, I was put in charge of a third-grade class. In the first week, just learning thirty names and faces was all I could manage. Even so, thanks to the children who come to talk to me during breaks, I have gradually gotten a feel for the classroom. A veteran colleague has advised me that the important thing is not to rush and to pay attention to each child.

cards.en: When I stepped into the main hall of the old temple, the inside was dim and hushed, as if the strong sunlight outside had never existed. The lighting is deliberately kept low, I was told, to bring the scene closer to what people long ago would have seen.

cards.en: When exercising in summer, drinking water frequently is essential. However, because commercial sports drinks contain a lot of sugar, some experts recommend diluting them with about an equal amount of water before drinking. On the other hand, some point out that when you sweat heavily you also lose salt, so diluting them too much makes them less effective. It is important to adjust how you drink to your physical condition and the intensity of the exercise.

Even so, by meeting face to face and talking frankly, they have uncovered one problem after another that the documents alone did not reveal. The department head says the final stage in particular should be handled with care.

Attention is once again focused on what the minister says and does next.

words.defJa: 相手を目上の人として大切にし、尊いものとして扱う。

cards.ja: 日本では九月の第三月曜日が敬老の日にあたり、長年社会に尽くしてきた高齢者を敬う日として法律で定められている。各地の自治体では、長寿を祝う式典が開かれたり、記念品が贈られたりする。ただ、高齢化が進むなかで対象となる人が増え、記念品を取りやめる自治体も出てきた。祝い方は変わっても、年長者への感謝を形にする機会であることに変わりはない。
cards.en: In Japan, the third Monday of September is Respect for the Aged Day, designated by law as a day to honor elderly people who have contributed to society over many years. Local governments around the country hold ceremonies celebrating long life and present commemorative gifts. However, as society ages and the number of eligible people grows, some municipalities have stopped giving gifts. Even if the way of celebrating changes, it remains an occasion to show gratitude to one's elders in a tangible way.

After flipping, cover it with a lid and cook it slowly all the way through, and it will come out nicely toasted outside and fluffy inside.

words.meaning: to tell fortunes, divine; to forecast (an outcome)
words.defJa: いろいろな方法で、これから先のことや運勢を予想する。

cards.ja: 古くから各地の神社では、新年にその年の天候や作物の出来を占う行事が行われてきた。ある神社では、かゆを炊く大釜に細い竹の筒を何本も入れ、筒の中に入った米粒の量で豊作かどうかを判断する。科学的な根拠はないとわかっていても、結果を聞きに訪れる農家は今も少なくない。行事そのものが、地域の人々が顔を合わせる大切な機会になっているのだ。
cards.en: Since long ago, shrines in various regions have held New Year rituals to divine the year's weather and how the crops will turn out. At one shrine, several thin bamboo tubes are placed in a large pot of rice porridge as it cooks, and whether the harvest will be good is judged by how many grains end up inside the tubes. Even knowing there is no scientific basis, quite a few farmers still come to hear the results. The ritual itself has become an important occasion for local people to see one another.

words.defJa: ひどいことをされた相手を、いつまでも憎く思う気持ち。

cards.ja: 仏教の古い経典には、恨みに恨みで報いても恨みはやまない、という意味の一節がある。二千年以上前のインドで説かれたとされるこの教えは、思わぬ形で戦後の日本と結びついている。一九五一年のサンフランシスコ講和会議で、現在のスリランカにあたるセイロンの代表がこの一節を引き、日本に賠償を求めないと述べたのだ。報復ではなく許しを選んだその演説は、今も日本で語り継がれている。
cards.en: An ancient Buddhist scripture contains a verse meaning that repaying resentment with resentment never brings it to an end. This teaching, said to have been given in India more than two thousand years ago, is tied to postwar Japan in an unexpected way. At the San Francisco Peace Conference in 1951, the delegate of Ceylon, today's Sri Lanka, quoted the verse and said his country would not seek reparations from Japan. That speech, which chose forgiveness over retaliation, is still remembered and retold in Japan today.

It is becoming clear that even small shops can cut waste by making use of data.

words.defJa: 英語の言葉の意味を日本語で説明する形式。主に辞書について言う。

cards.ja: スマートフォンで何でも調べられる時代になっても、紙の英和辞典を手放さない高校生がいる。目当ての単語の周りに並ぶ例文や派生語が自然と目に入り、思わぬ発見があるからだという。英語教師の中にも、授業ではあえて紙の辞書を使わせる人が少なくない。調べる手間そのものが、記憶を定着させる助けになると考えているのだ。
cards.en: Even in an age when you can look anything up on a smartphone, some high school students refuse to give up their paper English-Japanese dictionaries. They say the example sentences and related words around the word they are looking for naturally catch their eye, leading to unexpected discoveries. Quite a few English teachers, too, deliberately have students use paper dictionaries in class. They believe the very effort of looking words up helps fix them in memory.

cards.enTarget: Even in an age when you can look anything up on a smartphone, some high school students refuse to give up their paper English-Japanese dictionaries.

words.defJa: 水や油のように、決まった形がなく流れる状態のもの。

cards.ja: 常温で液体の金属といえば水銀がよく知られているが、ガリウムという金属も、手のひらに乗せておくだけで溶けて液体になる。融点がおよそ三十度と低いため、体温でも十分に溶けてしまうのだ。一方で沸点は二千度を超えるので、液体のままでいられる温度の幅が非常に広い。この性質は、高温を測る温度計などに生かされている。
cards.en: When it comes to metals that are liquid at room temperature, mercury is well known, but a metal called gallium also melts into a liquid just from resting on your palm. Because its melting point is low, about 30 degrees Celsius, body heat is enough to melt it. Its boiling point, on the other hand, is over 2,000 degrees, so the range of temperatures at which it stays liquid is extremely wide. This property is put to use in things such as thermometers for measuring high temperatures.

cards.enTarget: When it comes to metals that are liquid at room temperature, mercury is well known, but a metal called gallium also melts into a liquid just from resting on your palm.

words.defJa: 絵に色をつけるために使う材料。水や油でといて使う。

cards.ja: 昔の画家たちにとって、絵の具を自分の手で作るのは当たり前のことだった。鉱物や植物をすりつぶして粉にし、それを油や卵と混ぜ合わせて色を生み出していたのだ。なかでも鮮やかな青を出す鉱石は金よりも高価とされ、聖母の衣など特に大切な部分に限って使われることが多かった。チューブ入りの絵の具が登場したのは十九世紀のことで、画家が屋外で気軽に描けるようになったのはそれからである。
cards.en: For painters of the past, making their own paints by hand was taken for granted. They ground minerals and plants into powder and mixed it with oil or egg to create colors. The stone that produced a vivid blue, in particular, was said to be more expensive than gold, and it was often reserved for the most important parts of a picture, such as the Virgin Mary's robe. Paint in tubes appeared in the nineteenth century, and only after that could painters easily work outdoors.

words.defJa: 大勢が集まって、酒や料理を楽しみながら開く会。

cards.ja: 年末が近づくと、多くの会社で忘年会と呼ばれる宴会が開かれてきた。しかし近年は、勤務時間外の飲み会を負担に感じる若い社員が増え、忘年会を開かない職場も珍しくなくなった。ある調査では、参加したくないと答えた人が半数近くに上ったという。代わりに、昼休みに少し豪華な弁当を囲むなど、新しい形の交流を模索する会社も出てきている。
cards.en: As the year draws to a close, many companies have long held banquets called bonenkai, or year-end parties. In recent years, however, more young employees find after-hours drinking parties a burden, and workplaces that skip the year-end party are no longer unusual. In one survey, nearly half of respondents said they did not want to attend. Instead, some companies have started exploring new forms of socializing, such as sharing slightly fancy boxed lunches during the lunch break.

cards.enTarget: As the year draws to a close, many companies have long held banquets called bonenkai, or year-end parties.

words.defJa: 草花や野菜、果樹などを育てること。また、その技術。

cards.ja: 定年後に園芸を始める人が増えている。ベランダの小さなプランターでも、トマトやハーブなら十分に育てられる。土に触れる時間が気分転換になり、よく眠れるようになったと話す人も多い。園芸店では、初心者向けに道具と苗をまとめたセットの売れ行きが好調だという。
cards.en: More and more people are taking up gardening after retirement. Even in a small planter on a balcony, tomatoes and herbs can be grown well enough. Many say that the time spent touching the soil gives them a change of pace and that they now sleep better. Garden centers report that starter sets bundling tools and seedlings for beginners are selling well.

cards.enTarget: More and more people are taking up gardening after retirement.

words.defJa: 俳優が舞台の上で物語を演じ、観客に見せる芸術。

cards.ja: 地方の小さな町で、住民が自ら舞台に立つ演劇の公演が開かれた。出演者は高校生から八十代の農家までさまざまで、半年かけてせりふを覚えたという。物語は町の歴史をもとにしたもので、客席からは何度も笑いと拍手が起こった。世代を超えた交流が生まれたと、主催者は手応えを語る。
cards.en: In a small rural town, a theatrical production was staged with the residents themselves on stage. The cast ranged from high school students to farmers in their eighties, and they reportedly spent six months memorizing their lines. The story was based on the town's history, and laughter and applause rose from the audience again and again. The organizers say they feel it has created connections across generations.

cards.enTarget: In a small rural town, a theatrical production was staged with the residents themselves on stage.

words.defJa: 円のまわりをぐるりと囲む線。また、その長さ。

cards.ja: 円周の長さは、直径に円周率をかけると求められる。円周が直径のおよそ三倍になることは、古代エジプトやバビロニアの人々もすでに経験から知っていた。紀元前のギリシャには、多角形を使って円周率を3.14あたりまで絞り込んだ数学者もいた。身近な丸い物を測ってみると、この比の不思議さを実感できるだろう。
cards.en: The circumference of a circle can be found by multiplying its diameter by pi. The ancient Egyptians and Babylonians already knew from experience that a circle's circumference is roughly three times its diameter. In ancient Greece, before the Common Era, there was even a mathematician who used polygons to narrow pi down to about 3.14. If you measure round objects around you, you can feel for yourself how curious this ratio is.

words.defJa: 学校などで、見学や運動のために日帰りで出かける行事。

cards.ja: その小学校の春の遠足は、毎年近くの山の上にある公園が行き先だ。子どもたちは前の晩から、お弁当やおやつの中身を楽しみにしている。今年は雨で一度延期になったが、二週間後には晴れ渡った空の下で無事に実施された。頂上で広げたお弁当の味は、大人になっても忘れられない思い出になるだろう。
cards.en: Every year, the elementary school's spring field trip heads to a park on top of a nearby mountain. From the night before, the children look forward to what will be in their lunch boxes and snack bags. This year the trip was postponed once because of rain, but two weeks later it went ahead safely under clear skies. The taste of a lunch spread out at the summit will likely remain an unforgettable memory even when they are grown up.

words.defJa: けむりを外へ出すために、建物の上に高く立てた筒。

cards.ja: かつて銭湯の煙突は、町のどこからでも見える目印だった。銭湯が暮らしに欠かせなかった時代には、夕方になると白い煙が立ちのぼり、人々はそれを見て一日の終わりを感じたという。しかし銭湯の数は減り続け、高い煙突も次々と取り壊されている。一部の地域では、町の景観の一部として保存を求める声も上がっている。
cards.en: The chimneys of public bathhouses were once landmarks visible from anywhere in town. In the days when bathhouses were part of everyday life, white smoke would rise in the evening, and people say that seeing it told them the day was ending. But the number of bathhouses keeps falling, and their tall chimneys are being torn down one after another. In some areas, people are calling for them to be preserved as part of the townscape.

words.defJa: 先を行くものに追いつこうとして、後ろから急いで進む。

cards.ja: チーターは、地上で最も速く走る動物として知られている。獲物を追いかけるときには、わずか数秒で時速百キロ近くまで加速するという。ただ、その速さを保てるのは数百メートルほどで、狩りが失敗に終わることも少なくない。力を使い果たした後は、しばらく息を整えなければ次の狩りに移れない。
cards.en: The cheetah is known as the fastest-running animal on land. When it chases prey, it reportedly accelerates to nearly 100 kilometers per hour in just a few seconds. However, it can keep up that speed for only a few hundred meters, and many of its hunts end in failure. Once it has used up its strength, it has to catch its breath for a while before it can move on to the next hunt.

words.meaning: to overtake, to pass (a vehicle or person); to surpass
words.defJa: 後ろから進んで、前にいるものより先に出る。

cards.ja: 高速道路で前の車を追い越すときは、右側の車線を使うのが原則だ。左側から抜くと相手の死角に入りやすく、事故につながりかねない。また、追い越しが終わったら、速やかに元の車線に戻らなければならない。右側の車線を走り続けると、通行帯違反として取り締まりの対象になることもある。
cards.en: On an expressway, the rule when overtaking the car ahead is to use the right-hand lane. Passing on the left makes it easy to slip into the other driver's blind spot and can lead to an accident. Once you have finished overtaking, you must also return promptly to your original lane. If you keep driving in the right-hand lane, you may even be cited for a lane violation.

words.defJa: 国王の娘。

cards.ja: ヨーロッパのある王室で、王女が軍の訓練課程を修了したことが大きく報じられた。かつて王女の役割は、外国の王家に嫁いで国同士の結びつきを強めることだとされてきた。しかし現在では、王位を継ぐ立場として学業や軍務に励む例も珍しくない。王室のあり方は、社会の変化に合わせて少しずつ形を変えている。
cards.en: In one European royal family, the news that a princess had completed a military training course received wide coverage. The role of a princess was long thought to be marrying into a foreign royal house to strengthen ties between nations. Today, however, it is not unusual for a princess to devote herself to her studies and military service as an heir to the throne. The way royal families operate is gradually changing in step with society.

words.meaning: to respond to, to comply with (a request or demand)
words.defJa: 相手の求めや、その場の状況に合わせて行動する。

cards.ja: 政府は、従業員の賃上げに応ずる中小企業への税の優遇を拡充する方針を固めた。物価の上昇に賃金が追いつかない状況が続き、家計の負担は増す一方だ。ただ、原材料費の高騰に苦しむ企業も多く、制度の効果を疑問視する声もある。経済団体は、取引価格の適正化と合わせて進めるよう求めている。
cards.en: The government has decided to expand tax incentives for small and medium-sized companies that agree to raise their employees' wages. With wages still failing to keep pace with rising prices, the burden on households only keeps growing. However, many companies are struggling with soaring raw material costs, and some question how effective the scheme will be. Business groups are calling for it to go hand in hand with efforts to make transaction prices fair.

words.defJa: 訪ねてきた客を迎えて相手をすること。

cards.ja: 創業から十年を迎えた設計事務所が、手狭になった社屋を改装した。以前は作業机の脇で打ち合わせをしていたが、新たに応接室を設けたという。壁には過去に手がけた建物の写真を飾り、初めて訪れる客にも仕事ぶりが伝わるよう工夫した。社員からは、落ち着いて商談に臨めるようになったと好評だ。
cards.en: A design firm marking ten years since its founding has renovated its cramped office. Meetings used to be held beside the work desks, but the firm has now added a reception room for visitors. Photos of buildings it has worked on hang on the walls, so that even first-time visitors get a sense of what it does. Staff are pleased that they can now go into business talks in a calm setting.

words.meaning: dealing with (people), handling callers or customers
words.defJa: 人の話を聞いて、受け答えをすること。

cards.ja: 企業のコールセンターで、電話応対の一部をAIに任せる動きが広がっている。AIは住所の変更や料金の確認といった決まった問い合わせに二十四時間答え、複雑な相談だけを人間の担当者に回す。待ち時間が短くなったことで、利用者の評判はおおむね良い。ただ、高齢者からは、機械が相手では話しにくいという声も根強い。
cards.en: Companies are increasingly handing part of their call centers' telephone handling over to AI. The AI answers routine inquiries, such as changes of address and billing checks, around the clock, and passes only complex consultations on to human staff. Because waiting times have become shorter, customers' reviews are generally good. Among older people, however, the complaint that it is hard to talk to a machine persists.

words.meaning: round trip; going back and forth
words.defJa: 行って、また戻ってくること。

cards.ja: 実家までは新幹線で片道三時間かかり、往復の運賃は三万円近くになる。そのため帰省は年に一度、正月だけと決めていた。ところが最近、早めに予約すると割安になる切符を使うようになり、季節ごとに顔を出せるようになった。年老いた両親にとっても、それが何よりの楽しみらしい。
cards.en: It takes three hours each way by bullet train to get to my parents' home, and the round-trip fare comes to nearly 30,000 yen. So I had decided to go back only once a year, at New Year. Recently, though, I have started using tickets that are cheaper when booked early, and now I can visit every season. For my aging parents, too, that seems to be the greatest joy of all.

words.defJa: ヨーロッパとアメリカ。西洋の国々。

cards.ja: 戦後、日本人の食生活は大きく変わった。米と魚、野菜を中心とした献立から、肉や乳製品を多くとる欧米型の食事へと移り変わったのだ。それに伴い、大腸がんや糖尿病など、かつては少なかった病気が増えたと指摘されている。近年は、伝統的な和食のよさを見直す動きが国内外で広がっている。
cards.en: The Japanese diet changed dramatically after the war. Meals shifted from menus built around rice, fish and vegetables to a Western-style diet with plenty of meat and dairy. It has been pointed out that, along with this, diseases that were once uncommon, such as colorectal cancer and diabetes, have increased. In recent years, a movement to reappraise the merits of traditional Japanese cuisine has been spreading both in Japan and abroad.

cards.enTarget: Meals shifted from menus built around rice, fish and vegetables to a Western-style diet with plenty of meat and dairy.

words.defJa: 知識や原理を、実際の場面に当てはめて使うこと。

cards.ja: 研究チームは、蚊が血を吸う仕組みを応用して、刺してもほとんど痛みを感じない注射針を開発した。蚊の針は非常に細いうえ、先端がぎざぎざになっていて、皮膚に触れる面積が小さい。チームはこの形を金属で再現し、試作を何度も重ねた。毎日の注射が欠かせない患者の負担を減らせると期待されている。
cards.en: A research team has applied the mechanism mosquitoes use to suck blood to develop an injection needle that causes almost no pain. A mosquito's mouthpart is extremely thin, and its tip is serrated, so only a small area touches the skin. The team reproduced this shape in metal and built prototype after prototype. The needle is expected to ease the burden on patients who need injections every day.

cards.ja: 駅前の大通りを週末だけ歩行者に開放する社会実験が始まった。普段は車が行き交う片側三車線の道路にテーブルやいすが並び、家族連れが思い思いに過ごしている。周辺の商店街では、人出が増えて売り上げが伸びたという。一方、迂回を強いられるバスやタクシーの運転手からは、戸惑いの声も聞かれる。
cards.en: A social experiment has begun that opens the main street in front of the station to pedestrians on weekends only. Tables and chairs now line the road, which normally carries traffic on three lanes in each direction, and families spend their time however they like. Shops in the surrounding shopping streets say crowds have grown and sales have risen. Meanwhile, bus and taxi drivers forced to take detours have voiced their bewilderment.

cards.ja: 成人の体は、おおよそ六割が水分でできている。このうち一、二パーセントが失われただけでも、のどの渇きや集中力の低下が起こるとされる。特に高齢者は渇きを感じにくく、気づかないうちに脱水が進むことがある。こまめに水を飲む習慣をつけることが、夏を乗り切る鍵になる。
cards.en: An adult's body is roughly 60 percent water. Losing just one or two percent of it is said to bring on thirst and a drop in concentration. Older people in particular are less sensitive to thirst, and dehydration can set in without their noticing. Getting into the habit of drinking water often is the key to getting through the summer.

words.defJa: 外から家に戻ってきた人を迎えるときのあいさつ。

cards.ja: 一人暮らしを始めて意外に寂しかったのは、ドアを開けても誰も「おかえり」と言ってくれないことだった。実家にいた頃は、当たり前すぎて気にも留めなかった言葉である。先日、久しぶりに帰省すると、台所から母の声がした。たった四文字なのに、肩の力がふっと抜けるのを感じた。
cards.en: What turned out to be unexpectedly lonely about living alone was that no one said 'welcome home' when I opened the door. When I lived with my family, it was a word so ordinary that I never gave it a thought. The other day, when I went home for the first time in a while, my mother's voice called out from the kitchen. Just four little syllables, yet I felt the tension drain from my shoulders.

words.meaning: to pray (with palms together), to worship
words.defJa: 手を合わせたり頭を下げたりして、神や仏に祈る。

cards.ja: 元日の早朝、海沿いの展望台には初日の出を待つ人々が集まった。水平線が赤く染まり始めると、ざわめきが静まり、あちこちで手を合わせて拝む姿が見られた。太陽そのものを神聖なものとして敬う習わしは、古くから日本各地に残っている。昇る日の光を浴びながら、一年の無事を願う人も多い。
cards.en: Early on New Year's Day, people waiting for the first sunrise of the year gathered at an observation deck by the sea. As the horizon began to turn red, the chatter died down, and here and there people could be seen praying with their palms pressed together. The custom of revering the sun itself as sacred has survived in many parts of Japan since ancient times. Many people bathe in the light of the rising sun while praying for a safe year.

words.defJa: 同じ食べ物や飲み物を、もう一杯もらうこと。

cards.ja: 学生街のその定食屋では、ご飯のおかわりが何杯でも無料だ。店主によると、腹をすかせた若者に遠慮なく食べてほしいという思いから、開店以来ずっと続けているという。米の値段が上がった今も、このサービスをやめるつもりはない。常連だった学生たちは、卒業後も時々ふらりと顔を見せに来る。
cards.en: At this set-meal restaurant in a student district, refills of rice are free no matter how many bowls you have. According to the owner, he has kept this up ever since opening because he wants hungry young people to eat without holding back. Even now that rice prices have risen, he has no intention of ending the service. Students who were regulars still drop in now and then to say hello, even after graduating.

words.defJa: 建物の外。家の外。

cards.ja: 猛暑が続くなか、屋外での部活動を中止する学校が増えている。暑さ指数が一定の値を超えた日は、グラウンドでの練習を取りやめ、体育館や校舎内での筋力トレーニングに切り替える。ただ、体育館に冷房がない学校も少なくない。生徒の安全と練習時間の確保をどう両立させるかが問われている。
cards.en: As the extreme heat continues, more and more schools are calling off outdoor club activities. On days when the heat index exceeds a set level, they cancel practice on the sports ground and switch to strength training in the gym or inside the school building. Yet many schools have no air conditioning in their gyms. The question is how to balance students' safety with securing enough practice time.

words.meaning: okurigana (kana written after a kanji stem to show inflection or reading)
words.defJa: 漢字の読み方をはっきりさせるため、漢字の後ろにつけて書くかな。

cards.ja: 送り仮名のつけ方には、意外なほど揺れがある。たとえば「行う」と「行なう」はどちらも目にするが、国の目安では前者を基本とし、後者も認めている。また、「申し込み」のように送り仮名をつける語も、「申込書」のような複合語になると省かれることが多い。公用文や新聞には統一した基準があるものの、個人の文章では書き手の好みが表れやすい。
cards.en: The way okurigana are attached varies surprisingly widely. For example, the verb 'okonau' (to carry out) is seen both with one trailing kana and with two, and the national guidelines treat the former as standard while also allowing the latter. Likewise, a word written with okurigana, such as 'moshikomi' (application), often drops them once it becomes part of a compound such as 'moshikomisho' (application form). Official documents and newspapers follow unified standards, but in personal writing the writer's preferences tend to show.

words.meaning: take care, all the best (said when parting for a long time)
words.defJa: しばらく会えない人と別れるときに、相手の健康と幸せを願って言うあいさつ。

cards.ja: 三月の駅のホームは、別れの場面であふれている。転勤する同僚を見送る人もいれば、進学で故郷を離れる子どもに手を振る家族もいる。発車のベルが鳴ると、あちこちから「お元気で」という声が上がる。短い言葉だが、次にいつ会えるか分からない相手への精いっぱいの思いが込められている。
cards.en: In March, station platforms are full of farewells. Some people are seeing off colleagues who are being transferred, while others are families waving to children leaving their hometowns for school. When the departure bell rings, cries of 'Take care!' rise from all around. The words are brief, but they carry all the feeling people hold for someone they may not see again for who knows how long.

words.meaning: to hold down, to pin down; to secure

cards.ja: 強風の日にテントを張るのは、一人ではなかなか難しい。布が風にあおられ、杭を打つ前に飛ばされそうになるからだ。キャンプ場の管理人は、まず風上側の端を重い荷物で押さえてから作業するよう勧めている。それでも不安なら、無理をせず風が弱まるのを待つのが賢明だという。
cards.en: Pitching a tent on a windy day is quite hard to do alone. The fabric gets caught by the wind and threatens to blow away before you can drive in the pegs. The campsite manager recommends first holding down the windward edge with heavy bags before getting to work. If you are still uneasy, he says, it is wise not to force it and to wait for the wind to die down.

words.meaning: before you, ahead (as in leaving first or letting someone go first)
words.defJa: 自分がほかの人より前に何かをするときや、相手を前に行かせるときに使う言葉。

cards.ja: 日本の職場では、自分が先に帰るとき「お先に失礼します」と声をかけるのが習わしになっている。かつては上司より早く帰ることに気まずさを感じる人も多く、この一言を言い出せずに残業を続ける若手もいたという。働き方改革が進んだ今では、定時になると次々にこの挨拶が聞こえる職場も増えた。言葉は同じでも、その響きは少しずつ変わってきている。
cards.en: In Japanese workplaces, it is customary to say 'Excuse me for leaving before you' when you go home earlier than others. In the past, many people felt awkward about leaving before their boss, and some young employees reportedly kept working overtime because they could not bring themselves to say those words. Now that work-style reform has advanced, there are more workplaces where the greeting is heard one after another as soon as quitting time comes. The words are the same, but their ring is gradually changing.

cards.en: My uncle, my father's older brother, has run a forestry business in a mountain village for many years. When I visited during summer vacation as a child, he would take me into the mountains early in the morning and teach me the names of the trees one by one. Now past seventy, he still goes out to the work site to train a successor. His rough, calloused palms have not changed a bit since those days.

When I was unsure about my future in high school, he was also the one who listened to the worries I could not tell my parents. Now that I am a working adult too, the two of us sometimes share a drink.

cards.ja: 高校サッカーの決勝は、最後まで目が離せない展開になった。一点を追う後半の終了間際、エースの放ったシュートはゴールポストに当たってはね返った。あまりに惜しい場面に、スタンドからは大きなため息が漏れた。試合後、監督は最後まで粘り抜いた選手たちをたたえた。
cards.en: The high school soccer final turned into a game you could not take your eyes off until the very end. Trailing by a goal in the dying moments of the second half, the team's ace fired a shot that hit the post and bounced back out. At such an agonizing near miss, a great sigh rose from the stands. After the match, the coach praised his players for battling on to the end.

words.meaning: uncle (familiar term for a parent's older brother)
words.defJa: 父または母の兄を、親しみをこめて呼ぶ言い方。

cards.ja: 毎年夏になると、母の兄にあたる伯父さんから、畑でとれた野菜が段ボールいっぱいに届く。トマトやきゅうりは形こそ不ぞろいだが、スーパーのものより味がずっと濃い。とても家族だけでは食べきれず、近所におすそ分けするのが恒例になった。お礼の電話をかけると、伯父さんはいつも「来年はもっと作るよ」と笑う。
cards.en: Every summer, a cardboard box packed with vegetables from his field arrives from my uncle, my mother's older brother. The tomatoes and cucumbers may be uneven in shape, but they taste far richer than the ones from the supermarket. There is no way our family can eat them all, so sharing them with the neighbors has become a yearly custom. When I call to thank him, my uncle always laughs and says, 'Next year I'll grow even more.'

He is a neighbor who takes part in the community's watch program and has reportedly kept at it for more than ten years. words.meaning: take care (of yourself); said to someone who is ill or injured
words.defJa: 病気やけがをした人に、早く良くなるよう願って言うあいさつ。

cards.ja: 診察を終えて会計を済ませると、受付の人が「お大事に」と声をかけてくれた。病院や薬局では決まり文句のように使われる言葉だが、熱でぼんやりしていた身には不思議と温かく響いた。体調を崩した同僚に送るメールの最後にも、同じ一言を添える人は多い。形式的な挨拶に見えて、相手の回復を願う気持ちがきちんと込められているのだ。
cards.en: After the consultation, when I had paid at the counter, the receptionist said, "Take care of yourself." It is a phrase used almost as a set formula at hospitals and pharmacies, yet to me, foggy with fever, it sounded strangely warm. Many people also add the same words at the end of an email to a colleague who has fallen ill. It may look like a mere formality, but it genuinely carries the wish for the other person's recovery.

words.meaning: to calm down, to settle down; (of a situation) to settle
words.defJa: 興奮や不安がおさまって、静かな状態になる。

cards.ja: 大きな発表の直前になると、心臓の鼓動が速くなり、手のひらに汗がにじむ。そんなときは、ゆっくり息を吐くことを意識するだけで気持ちが落ち着いてくるという。呼吸を整えると自律神経の働きが変わり、体の緊張がほぐれやすくなるからだ。慌てて原稿を読み返すより、まず数回深呼吸してみるほうが効果的かもしれない。
cards.en: Right before a big presentation, your heartbeat quickens and sweat beads on your palms. At such times, it is said that simply focusing on breathing out slowly helps you calm down. That is because regulating your breathing changes how the autonomic nervous system works, making it easier for the body's tension to ease. Rather than frantically rereading your script, taking a few deep breaths first may be more effective.

Many were young women who had come from the countryside, and they took on a wide range of tasks, from cooking and laundry to looking after the children. cards.en: It is often remarked overseas that in Japan, even if you drop your wallet, it usually comes back. In fact, lost items handed in to the police in Tokyo amount to several million a year, with cash alone reaching several billion yen. A system has taken root in which the finder takes the item to a police box and it is returned if the owner comes forward. This custom is also closely tied to having a neighborhood police box close at hand.

words.defJa: 相手に何かを頼むときに使う、ていねいな言葉。

cards.ja: 日本語を学ぶ人がまず覚える表現の一つに「お願いします」がある。店で注文するとき、タクシーで行き先を告げるとき、仕事を頼むときなど、使える場面は実に幅広い。英語の「プリーズ」に近いが、相手に何かを委ねるという姿勢がより強くにじむ。短い一言だが、日本の人間関係の作法が凝縮されているともいえる。
cards.en: One of the first expressions that learners of Japanese memorize is "onegaishimasu." It can be used in a remarkably wide range of situations: ordering at a shop, telling a taxi driver your destination, asking someone to do a job, and so on. It is close to the English "please," but it conveys more strongly an attitude of entrusting something to the other person. It is a short phrase, yet one could say it condenses the etiquette of Japanese human relationships.

words.defJa: 一人一人、または一つ一つ。それぞれ。

cards.ja: 同じ景色を眺めていても、人は各々の経験や記憶を通してそれを見ている。夕焼けを美しいと感じる人もいれば、故郷を思い出して寂しくなる人もいるだろう。どちらが正しいということはなく、世界の見え方はそもそも一つではないのだ。他人との違いに戸惑うとき、この単純な事実を思い出すと少し気が楽になる。
cards.en: Even when looking at the same scenery, each person sees it through their own experiences and memories. Some will find a sunset beautiful, while others may feel lonely as it reminds them of home. Neither is more correct than the other; there was never just one way of seeing the world to begin with. When you are bewildered by how you differ from others, remembering this simple fact makes things a little easier.

I remember the sound of ink being ground echoing through the quiet room when I visited during summer vacation. It was also my aunt who taught me, starting with how to hold the brush, and she was fond of saying that handwriting reflects one's character. cards.en: The woman who runs the greengrocer on the corner of the school route knows almost all the children's faces and names. In the morning she calls out "Have a good day" from the shopfront, and if a child is coming home late, she sometimes lets the parents know. Even now that security cameras have multiplied, there is no doubt that the watchful eyes of adults like her support the neighborhood's sense of safety. Perhaps children grow up more freely in towns where people know each other by sight.

words.meaning: visit to a shrine, temple or grave to pray
words.defJa: 神社や寺、墓などに行って、神や仏、先祖を拝むこと。

cards.ja: 年が明けると、全国の神社や寺は初詣の人々でにぎわう。参道に長い列ができても、多くの人は辛抱強く順番を待ち、賽銭を入れて静かに手を合わせる。願うのは家族の健康や受験の合格などさまざまだ。特定の信仰を持たない人でも、新しい年の区切りとしてお参りを欠かさないのが日本らしいところだろう。
cards.en: When the new year begins, shrines and temples across the country bustle with people making their first visit of the year. Even when long lines form along the approach, most people wait patiently for their turn, toss in an offering and quietly put their hands together in prayer. What they pray for varies, from their family's health to passing entrance exams. It is characteristically Japanese that even people without any particular faith never skip a shrine visit to mark the new year.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: It is characteristically Japanese that even people without any particular faith never skip a shrine visit to mark the new year.

words.defJa: 前もって考えてもいなかった様子だ。予想外だ。

cards.ja: 道路の拡幅工事のために地面を掘り返していたところ、作業員が古い土器の破片を見つけた。調査を進めると、そこは千年以上前の集落の跡であることが判明した。こうした思いがけない発見は、全国の工事現場で決して珍しくない。開発と遺跡の保存をどう両立させるかは、自治体にとって長年の課題となっている。
cards.en: While digging up the ground for a road-widening project, workers found fragments of ancient pottery. As the investigation went on, the site turned out to be the remains of a settlement more than a thousand years old. Such unexpected discoveries are by no means rare at construction sites around the country. How to balance development with the preservation of archaeological sites has long been a challenge for local governments.

words.meaning: with all one's might, to one's heart's content; (noun) decisiveness
words.defJa: 力や気持ちを全部出して、ためらわずに何かをする様子。

cards.ja: 試合終盤、一点を追うチームの四番打者は、初球を思い切り振り抜いた。打球は高く舞い上がり、スタンドの最前列に飛び込む同点本塁打となった。試合後、本人は「迷ったら振ると決めていた」と淡々と語った。ためらいを捨てて全力を出し切れるかどうかが、勝負どころでは何よりも物を言う。
cards.en: Late in the game, the cleanup hitter of the team trailing by one run swung with all his might at the very first pitch. The ball soared high and dropped into the front row of the stands for a game-tying home run. After the game, he said matter-of-factly, "I had decided that if I was in doubt, I would swing." At the decisive moment, being able to throw off hesitation and give everything you have counts more than anything.

cards.enTarget: Late in the game, the cleanup hitter of the team trailing by one run swung with all his might at the very first pitch.

words.meaning: to be convinced (often wrongly), to assume; to set one's heart on
words.defJa: よく確かめずに、そうだと強く信じてしまう。

cards.ja: SNSで繰り返し目にする情報を、人はいつの間にか事実だと思い込んでしまいやすい。心理学では、同じ主張に何度も触れるだけで信じやすくなる現象が知られている。発信元が不確かな投稿ほど、拡散する前に一度立ち止まって確かめることが大切だ。自分は騙されないという自信こそが、最も危ういのかもしれない。
cards.en: People easily come to believe, before they know it, that information they see over and over on social media is fact. Psychology has documented a phenomenon whereby simply being exposed to the same claim many times makes it easier to believe. The more uncertain a post's source, the more important it is to pause and check before sharing it. Perhaps the very confidence that one won't be fooled is the most dangerous thing of all.

cards.enTarget: People easily come to believe, before they know it, that information they see over and over on social media is fact.

words.meaning: to one's heart's content, as hard as one can; really, a lot
words.defJa: 遠慮やためらいをすべて捨てて、力や気持ちを出し切る様子。

cards.ja: 疲れがたまっているときは、思いっ切り泣ける映画を一本見るのもいい。涙を流したあとに気持ちがすっと軽くなる、と感じる人は少なくない。我慢を重ねるより、感情を素直に外へ出したほうが心の回復は早いとも言われる。週末の夜くらいは、誰にも気兼ねせずに心のふたを開けてみてはどうだろうか。
cards.en: When fatigue has built up, it can be good to watch a movie that lets you cry your heart out. Quite a few people feel that their mood lightens at once after shedding tears. It is also said that the mind recovers faster when you let your emotions out honestly rather than holding them in again and again. At least on a weekend night, why not take the lid off your feelings without worrying about anyone else?

words.meaning: as hard as one can, to one's heart's content; (colloquial) totally
words.defJa: 力の限り、心ゆくまで何かをする様子。

cards.ja: 放課後の校庭では、子どもたちが歓声を上げながら思いっきり走り回っている。体を存分に動かす遊びは、体力だけでなく集中力や社会性も育てるとされる。ところが近年は、公園でのボール遊びが禁止されるなど、自由に遊べる場所が減りつつある。大人が安全を気にするあまり、子どもの大切な時間を奪っていないか考えたい。
cards.en: In the schoolyard after classes, children are running around as hard as they can, shrieking with joy. Play that lets them move their bodies freely is said to develop not only stamina but also concentration and social skills. In recent years, however, the places where children can play freely have been shrinking, with ball games banned in parks, for example. We should ask whether adults, out of excessive concern for safety, are robbing children of precious time.

cards.ja: 坂の多い住宅地では、スーパーからの帰り道が高齢者にとって大きな負担になる。米や飲み物の入った重たい袋を提げて歩くうちに、途中で休まなければならなくなる人も多い。そこで最近は、購入した商品を自宅まで届けるサービスを始める店が増えている。買い物の手間を減らすことは、住み慣れた家で暮らし続けるための支えにもなっている。
cards.en: In hilly residential areas, the walk home from the supermarket is a heavy burden for older people. Many of them, carrying heavy bags of rice and drinks, end up having to rest along the way. So recently, more and more stores have started services that deliver purchases to customers' homes. Reducing the hassle of shopping also helps people go on living in homes they know well.

words.meaning: day off, holiday, absence; (as a greeting) good night
words.defJa: 仕事や学校に行かない日や、店が営業しない日。寝る前のあいさつとしても使う。

cards.ja: 日本の職場では、有給休暇を取るときに「お休みをいただきます」と伝えるのが一般的だ。休暇は労働者の権利であるにもかかわらず、周囲に迷惑をかけるという意識がこうした表現に表れている。近年は取得率の向上を目指し、計画的な休暇を勧める企業も増えてきた。気兼ねなく休める雰囲気づくりは、働き方改革の重要な柱の一つである。
cards.en: In Japanese workplaces, it is common, when taking paid leave, to say that you will "humbly receive a day off." Even though vacation is a worker's right, expressions like this reveal a feeling of causing trouble for those around you. In recent years, aiming to raise the rate at which leave is taken, more companies have begun encouraging planned vacations. Creating an atmosphere where people can take time off without hesitation is one of the key pillars of work-style reform.

words.defJa: 手や足の指のうち、いちばん太い指。

cards.ja: 人間の親指は、ほかの四本の指と向かい合わせにして物をつまむことができる。この動きのおかげで、私たちは細い針に糸を通したり、道具を器用に操ったりできるのだ。サルの仲間にも似た構造を持つ種はいるが、人間ほど自在に動かせるものは少ない。親指の進化は、道具の使用や文化の発展とも深く結びついてきたと考えられている。
cards.en: The human thumb can be placed opposite the other four fingers to pinch objects. Thanks to this movement, we can thread a fine needle and handle tools deftly. Some other primates have a similar structure, but few can move it as freely as humans. The evolution of the thumb is thought to have been closely tied to the use of tools and the development of culture.

words.defJa: ガラスやビニールで囲み、中を暖かく保って植物を育てる建物。

cards.ja: 植物園の温室に足を踏み入れると、湿った熱気が全身を包み込んだ。天井近くまで伸びたヤシの木の下では、色鮮やかなランが咲き誇っている。外が雪景色の季節でも、ガラス越しの光と暖房で熱帯の環境が保たれているのだ。珍しい植物を守り、次の世代に伝えることも、こうした施設の大切な役割である。
cards.en: When I stepped into the botanical garden's greenhouse, humid heat wrapped around my whole body. Beneath palm trees reaching almost to the ceiling, brightly colored orchids were in full bloom. Even in the season when snow covers the landscape outside, a tropical environment is maintained by sunlight through the glass and by heating. Protecting rare plants and passing them on to the next generation is another important role of facilities like this.

words.defJa: 地下から湧き出る温かい水や、一定の成分条件を満たす水。また、その水を使った入浴施設や土地。

cards.ja: 火山の多い日本には、全国に三千近い温泉地があるといわれる。泉質は地域によって大きく異なり、硫黄の香りが漂う白く濁った湯もあれば、無色透明でとろりとした湯もある。旅先で地元の共同浴場に立ち寄り、住民と並んで湯につかるのも楽しみの一つだ。湯上がりに冷たい牛乳を飲むのが定番だという人も多い。
cards.en: Japan, with its many volcanoes, is said to have nearly three thousand hot spring areas across the country. The water differs greatly by region: there are cloudy white baths with a whiff of sulfur, and others that are colorless, clear and silky. Dropping by a local communal bathhouse while traveling and soaking alongside residents is one of the pleasures. Many people say drinking cold milk after the bath is a must.

words.defJa: 熱帯と寒帯の間にある、気候が穏やかな地域。

cards.ja: 地球の気候は、気温や降水量をもとにいくつかの気候帯に分けられる。日本の大部分は温帯に属し、四季の変化がはっきりしているのが特徴だ。熱帯ほど暑くなく寒帯ほど寒くもない穏やかな気候のもとで、草木や生き物は季節の巡りに合わせて暮らしている。ただ近年は温暖化の影響で、生き物の分布が少しずつ北へ移りつつある。
cards.en: Earth's climate is divided into several climate zones based on temperature and precipitation. Most of Japan belongs to the temperate zone and is characterized by clearly marked changes between the four seasons. Under this mild climate, neither as hot as the tropics nor as cold as the polar regions, plants and animals live in step with the turning seasons. In recent years, however, global warming has been gradually shifting the distribution of living things northward.

words.meaning: Messrs.; honorific added after the name of a company, department or organization in an address
words.defJa: 会社や団体に手紙を送るとき、宛名の後に付ける敬称。

cards.ja: 企業や団体に郵便を送るとき、宛名の書き方に迷う人は意外と多い。個人に宛てる場合は名前の後に「様」を付けるが、部署や組織そのものに送るなら「人事部御中」のように書くのが正式だ。担当者の名前がわかっている場合は、部署名の後ではなく個人名の後に「様」を付ける。両方を重ねて書くのは誤りなので、注意したい。
cards.en: Surprisingly many people are unsure how to write the address when sending mail to a company or organization. When writing to an individual, you add "sama" after the name, but if you are sending it to a department or the organization itself, the proper form is to add "onchu," as in "Human Resources Department onchu." If you know the name of the person in charge, you put "sama" after that person's name rather than after the department name. Writing both together is a mistake, so be careful.

words.defJa: 大人の女性を指す、ふつうの言い方。

cards.ja: 旅先の朝市を歩いていると、野菜や漬物を並べていた女の人が手招きをしてくれた。勧められるままに漬物を一切れ口に入れると、ほどよい酸味がじんわりと広がった。作り方を尋ねると、母親から受け継いだ味なのだと嬉しそうに話してくれた。観光名所を巡るより、こうした出会いのほうが旅の記憶として長く残るものだ。
cards.en: As I was walking through a morning market on a trip, a woman laying out vegetables and pickles beckoned me over. When I put a slice of pickle in my mouth as she urged, a pleasant sourness slowly spread. When I asked how she made them, she happily told me it was a flavor handed down from her mother. Encounters like this, more than touring famous sights, tend to stay with you longest as memories of a trip.

words.defJa: 「よその国の」「内側ではない」という意味を表し、語の頭につく言葉。

cards.ja: 外資系企業への転職を考える若手社会人が増えている。成果に応じた報酬や、年齢にかかわらず責任ある仕事を任される環境が魅力とされるからだ。一方で、業績が振るわなければ部署ごと縮小されることもあり、安定を重視する人には向かないとの声もある。待遇だけでなく、自分の働き方に合うかどうかを見極めることが欠かせない。
cards.en: More and more young working people are considering moving to foreign-affiliated companies. That is because performance-based pay and an environment where they are given responsible work regardless of age are seen as attractive. On the other hand, entire departments can be scaled down when business is poor, and some say such companies do not suit people who value stability. It is essential to judge not only the pay and benefits but also whether the company fits the way you want to work.

words.meaning: opening (of a meeting, session or event)
words.defJa: 会議や式、大会などを始めること。

cards.ja: 秋の臨時国会が開会し、首相は本会議で所信表明演説を行った。物価高への対策や経済の立て直しが、今国会の大きな焦点となる見通しだ。野党は政府の説明が不十分だとして、予算委員会での集中審議を求めている。会期は限られており、どれだけの法案が成立するかに注目が集まっている。
cards.en: The autumn extraordinary session of the Diet opened, and the prime minister delivered a policy speech at the plenary session. Measures against rising prices and rebuilding the economy are expected to be the main focal points of this session. The opposition parties, saying the government's explanations are insufficient, are demanding intensive deliberations in the Budget Committee. The session is short, and attention is focused on how many bills will pass.

words.meaning: meeting hall, assembly hall, public hall
words.defJa: 集会や催し物などのために使われる大きな建物。

cards.ja: 高度成長期に各地で建てられた市民会館の多くが、いま建て替えの時期を迎えている。老朽化した設備の改修には巨額の費用がかかり、財政の厳しい自治体にとっては重い負担だ。人口が減るなか、ホールの規模を縮小したり、図書館などと一体化したりする例も出てきた。地域の文化を支えてきた場をどう残すかが問われている。
cards.en: Many of the civic halls built around the country during the era of rapid economic growth are now reaching the point where they need to be rebuilt. Renovating aging facilities costs enormous sums, a heavy burden for municipalities with tight finances. As the population shrinks, some halls are being downsized or merged with libraries and other facilities. The question now is how to preserve places that have supported local culture.

words.defJa: 駅で乗客の切符を調べること。また、その場所。

cards.ja: 駅の改札では、交通系ICカードやスマートフォンをかざして通るのがすっかり当たり前になった。最近は、顔認証や二次元コードで通過できる改札を試験的に導入する鉄道会社も出てきている。顔認証なら何もかざさずに通れるため、大きな荷物を抱えた旅行者や車いすの利用者にも便利だという。駅員が切符を一枚ずつ確かめていた時代から、仕組みは大きく変わった。
cards.en: At station ticket gates, passing through by holding up a transit IC card or a smartphone has become completely normal. Recently, some railway companies have begun trials of ticket gates that you can pass using facial recognition or QR codes. Because face recognition lets you pass without holding anything up, it is said to be convenient for travelers carrying large luggage and for wheelchair users. The system has changed enormously since the days when station staff checked tickets one by one.

words.meaning: sea bathing, swimming in the sea
words.defJa: 夏などに海に入って、泳いだり遊んだりすること。

cards.ja: 日本で海水浴が広まったのは、明治時代のことだといわれる。当時は娯楽というより、海の水に体を浸して病気を治す健康法として医師が勧めていた。やがて鉄道の開通とともに海辺の保養地がにぎわい、夏の行楽として定着していった。近年は熱中症や水難事故への備えも欠かせず、楽しみ方も少しずつ変わってきている。
cards.en: Sea bathing is said to have spread in Japan during the Meiji era. At the time, doctors recommended it not as entertainment but as a health practice, curing illness by immersing the body in seawater. Eventually, as railways opened, seaside resorts flourished, and it took root as a summer pastime. In recent years, precautions against heatstroke and water accidents have become indispensable, and the ways people enjoy it are gradually changing.

words.defJa: 同じことが何度起きたか、または何度行ったかの数。

cards.ja: 歯磨きの回数を増やせば虫歯を防げるかといえば、必ずしもそうではない。歯科医によると、大切なのは一日に何度磨くかよりも、一回ごとにどれだけ丁寧に磨くかだという。特に寝る前の歯磨きは、唾液が減って細菌が増えやすい夜に備える意味で欠かせない。回数ばかりを気にして手早く済ませるのでは、せっかくの習慣も効果が薄れてしまう。
cards.en: Brushing your teeth more often does not necessarily prevent cavities. According to dentists, what matters is not so much how many times a day you brush as how carefully you brush each time. Brushing before bed in particular is essential, because it prepares the mouth for the night, when saliva decreases and bacteria multiply easily. If you only worry about the number of times and rush through it, even a good habit loses much of its effect.

words.meaning: book of discount tickets, coupon tickets (for a set number of rides or uses)
words.defJa: 何回分かの乗車券などをまとめて、割安な値段で売る券。

cards.ja: 通勤や通学でバスを使う人にとって、回数券は長く身近な存在だった。十一枚つづりを十回分の運賃で買えるため、頻繁に乗る人ほど得をする仕組みだ。しかし交通系ICカードの普及に伴い、紙の回数券の販売をやめる事業者が全国で増えている。割引という考え方は、乗車ポイントの還元という形で引き継がれつつある。
cards.en: For people who commute to work or school by bus, coupon tickets were long a familiar part of life. Because a strip of eleven tickets could be bought for the fare of ten rides, the more often you rode, the more you saved. With the spread of transit IC cards, however, a growing number of operators nationwide are ending sales of paper coupon tickets. The idea of a discount is being carried over in the form of ride-point rebates.

cards.ja: 改正道路交通法が施行され、自転車に乗りながらスマートフォンを操作する行為への罰則が強化された。これまでも禁止されてはいたが、重大な事故が後を絶たないことから、より重い罰則が設けられた。警察は当面、悪質な違反を中心に取り締まりを進める方針だ。法改正をきっかけに、自分の乗り方を見直す人も少なくない。
cards.en: With the amended Road Traffic Act now in force, penalties for operating a smartphone while riding a bicycle have been toughened. The practice was already prohibited, but because serious accidents kept occurring, heavier penalties were introduced. For the time being, police plan to focus their enforcement on flagrant violations. Not a few people are taking the change in the law as an occasion to rethink how they ride.

words.defJa: 空に雲がほとんどなく、よく晴れわたっていること。

cards.ja: けさの東京は雲一つない快晴となり、都心からも富士山がくっきりと見えた。冬型の気圧配置が強まり、乾いた北風が空気中のちりを吹き払ったためだという。ただ、晴れた夜は地面の熱が逃げやすく、あすの朝は今季一番の冷え込みになる見込みだ。気象庁は、水道管の凍結などに注意するよう呼びかけている。
cards.en: Tokyo had perfectly clear skies this morning without a single cloud, and Mount Fuji could be seen sharply even from the city center. This was reportedly because the winter pressure pattern strengthened and a dry north wind swept the dust out of the air. Clear nights, however, let heat escape from the ground easily, and tomorrow morning is expected to be the coldest of the season so far. The Japan Meteorological Agency is urging people to watch out for frozen water pipes and similar problems.

words.meaning: opening (of a road, tunnel or line) to traffic
words.defJa: 道路や鉄道、トンネルなどが完成して、通れるようになること。

cards.ja: 山あいの二つの町を結ぶトンネルが今月開通し、これまで峠道で四十分かかっていた移動が十五分ほどに縮まった。冬場は雪で道路が閉ざされることも多く、地元にとっては長年の悲願だった。開通式には住民も大勢集まり、完成したばかりの道を歩いて祝った。病院への救急搬送が早くなることにも期待が寄せられている。
cards.en: A tunnel linking two towns in the mountains opened this month, cutting a trip that used to take forty minutes over a mountain pass to about fifteen. The road was often closed by snow in winter, so the tunnel had been a long-cherished wish of the local community. Many residents gathered at the opening ceremony and celebrated by walking along the newly finished road. Hopes are also high that emergency transport to hospitals will become faster.

words.defJa: ある点や軸を中心にして、ぐるぐる回ること。

cards.ja: フィギュアスケートのジャンプは、空中で何回転するかによって難度が大きく変わる。四回転ジャンプの場合、氷を離れてから降りるまでのわずか0.7秒ほどの間に、高速で回転しなければならない。腕を体にぴたりと引きつけるほど回転は速くなり、広げると遅くなる。着氷の瞬間まで軸をぶらさないことが、成功の鍵となる。
cards.en: In figure skating, the difficulty of a jump depends greatly on how many rotations the skater makes in the air. In a quadruple jump, skaters must spin at high speed during the roughly 0.7 seconds between leaving the ice and landing. The more tightly they pull their arms in to the body, the faster they spin, and spreading them out slows the rotation. Keeping the axis steady right up to the moment of landing is the key to success.

words.defJa: 問題を解いて答えを出すこと。また、その答え。

cards.ja: 試験が終わると、予備校は当日の夜には問題の解答と解説をウェブサイトに公開する。受験生はそれを見ながら自己採点をし、出願先を最終的に決めていく。ただ、記述式の問題では模範解答が一つとは限らず、採点の基準をめぐって議論になることもある。答えの正しさだけでなく、そこに至る道筋が問われているからだ。
cards.en: After an exam ends, cram schools post the answers to the questions, with explanations, on their websites that same evening. Test takers score themselves while looking at them and make their final decisions about where to apply. With written-answer questions, however, there is not necessarily only one model answer, and the grading criteria sometimes become a matter of debate. That is because what is being tested is not only whether the answer is correct but the path taken to reach it.

cards.en: About 3,000 people responded to a resident survey that a regional city conducted last year. More than 70 percent said they wanted to go on living there, but among people in their twenties the figure fell below half. As reasons, many pointed to a lack of places to work and inconvenient transportation. Based on the results, the city announced plans to strengthen housing support for younger generations.

words.defJa: ある組織や物の外側。また、そこに属さない人や物。

cards.ja: 大手通信会社で、顧客情報が外部に流出していたことが明らかになった。社内の調査によると、委託先の社員が管理用のパスワードを不正に持ち出していたという。会社は外部の専門家を交えた調査委員会を立ち上げ、原因の究明を急いでいる。情報を守るには、社内だけでなく取引先を含めた管理の徹底が欠かせない。
cards.en: It has come to light that customer information at a major telecommunications company had leaked to outside parties. According to an internal investigation, an employee of a subcontractor had improperly taken an administrator password. The company has set up an investigative committee that includes outside experts and is hurrying to determine the cause. Protecting information requires thorough controls not only within the company but across its business partners as well.

words.defJa: 体や心をしばっていたものを取り除いて、自由にすること。

cards.ja: 定年を迎えた父は、毎朝の満員電車からようやく解放されたと笑っていた。最初の数か月は旅行や趣味に時間を使い、自由な生活を満喫しているように見えた。ところが半年ほどたつと、することがない一日の長さに戸惑うようになったという。人は縛りから解き放たれたとき、初めて自分で時間を組み立てる難しさに気づくのかもしれない。
cards.en: When my father reached retirement age, he laughed that he had finally been freed from the packed trains every morning. For the first few months he spent his time on travel and hobbies and seemed to be thoroughly enjoying his freedom. After about half a year, though, he said he had begun to feel at a loss at how long a day with nothing to do could be. Perhaps it is only when people are released from their constraints that they first realize how hard it is to structure their time themselves.

cards.en: The plastic waste flowing into the oceans is estimated to amount to several million tons a year worldwide. Microplastics, broken into fine pieces by waves and ultraviolet light, have been found even inside fish and shellfish. A research team confirmed that such particles are also accumulating in the mud of the deep sea. Ocean pollution is not just a matter of the visible litter washed up on beaches.

words.defJa: ある学問や分野の全体について、大まかに述べたもの。

cards.ja: 大学一年の春に取った「哲学概論」の授業が、今も心に残っている。古代ギリシャから現代まで、主な思想家の考えを駆け足でたどるだけの講義だったが、毎回新しい扉が開くような気がした。広く浅い入門の授業は退屈だと思われがちだ。しかし全体の地図を先に手に入れておくと、後から一つの分野を深く学ぶときに迷わずに済む。
cards.en: The 'Introduction to Philosophy' class I took in the spring of my first year at university still stays with me. The lectures merely raced through the ideas of the major thinkers from ancient Greece to the present, yet every session felt like a new door opening. Broad but shallow introductory classes tend to be thought of as boring. But if you get hold of a map of the whole field first, you will not lose your way later when you study one area in depth.

words.meaning: on the contrary, instead; only (making things worse than expected)
words.defJa: 予想や期待とは反対の結果になるようす。むしろ。

cards.ja: 眠れない夜に「早く寝なければ」と焦ると、かえって目がさえてしまう。睡眠の専門家によれば、眠ろうと努力すること自体が脳を緊張させるのだという。そのため、二十分ほどたっても眠れないときは、いったん寝床を離れることが勧められている。眠りは意志の力で呼び寄せるものではなく、訪れるのを待つものなのだ。
cards.en: On a sleepless night, if you fret that you must hurry up and fall asleep, you only end up more wide awake. According to sleep experts, the very effort to sleep puts the brain on alert. For that reason, if you still cannot sleep after about twenty minutes, it is recommended that you get out of bed for a while. Sleep is not something you summon by willpower but something you wait for to arrive.

words.defJa: 人が住むために建てられた建物。

cards.ja: 1923年の関東大震災では、木造家屋の倒壊や大規模な火災によって、十万人を超える命が失われた。特に被害を広げたのは、昼食の支度で火を使っていた時間帯に揺れが起きたことだった。この教訓から、建物の耐震基準や都市の防火対策が少しずつ整えられていった。九月一日が「防災の日」とされているのは、この震災に由来する。
cards.en: In the Great Kanto Earthquake of 1923, more than 100,000 lives were lost to collapsing wooden houses and massive fires. What especially spread the damage was that the shaking struck at the hour when people were using fire to prepare lunch. Drawing on this lesson, earthquake-resistance standards for buildings and urban fire-prevention measures were gradually put in place. The designation of September 1 as Disaster Prevention Day derives from this earthquake.

words.meaning: to be involved with, to have to do with; to affect
words.defJa: 人や物事とつながりを持つ。また、影響が及ぶ。

cards.ja: 都会のマンションでは、隣に誰が住んでいるのかさえ知らないという人が珍しくない。他人とあまり関わらないで暮らせる気楽さは、確かに都市生活の魅力の一つだ。ただ、災害の際に頼りになるのは、結局は顔見知りの近所の人だという調査結果もある。日ごろのあいさつ程度の付き合いが、いざというときの安心につながる。
cards.en: In city apartment buildings, it is not unusual for people not even to know who lives next door. The ease of living without getting much involved with others is certainly one of the attractions of urban life. Yet some surveys have found that in a disaster, the people you can rely on in the end are the neighbors you know by sight. Everyday relationships, even at the level of exchanging greetings, lead to peace of mind when an emergency comes.

cards.ja: 現金を郵便で送るときは、普通郵便ではなく現金書留を使うことが法律で定められている。専用の封筒に入れて窓口に出すと、配達までの記録が残り、万一なくなった場合も一定額まで補償される。受け取りには印鑑かサインが必要なため、留守だと持ち帰りになる。お祝いを遠方の親戚に送る際など、今も根強い需要がある。
cards.en: When sending cash by post, the law requires you to use cash registered mail rather than ordinary mail. If you put the money in a special envelope and hand it in at the counter, a record is kept until delivery, and if it is lost, compensation is paid up to a certain amount. Because a seal or signature is needed to receive it, the item is taken back if no one is home. There is still steady demand, for example when sending gifts of money to relatives far away.

We were made to write the same character dozens of times in our notebooks until the hand gripping the pencil ached. With more occasions these days to type on keyboards and smartphones, quite a few adults feel that the number of kanji they can read but not write has grown. Writing by hand may have been important practice for learning the shapes of characters with the body.

cards.ja: 駅前の小さな食堂の名物、焼き豚丼は一日三十食限りで、昼前には売り切れることが多い。店主によると、肉の仕込みに手間がかかるため、これ以上は増やせないのだという。量を追えば味が落ちる、というのが長年の信念だ。数に限りがあると知りながら、客は開店前から列をつくる。
cards.en: The roast-pork rice bowl, the signature dish of a small diner in front of the station, is limited to thirty servings a day and often sells out before noon. According to the owner, preparing the meat takes so much work that he cannot make any more. His long-held belief is that chasing quantity makes the flavor suffer. Knowing that the number is limited, customers line up before the diner even opens.

cards.ja: 新しい首相の就任から一夜明け、新聞各紙は一面で新内閣の顔ぶれを大きく伝えた。社説では、物価高への対応や外交の立て直しを求める論調が目立った。一方で、閣僚の半数近くが前内閣からの再任であることに注目し、「新鮮味に欠ける」と評する新聞もあった。同じ出来事でも、見出しを並べて読むと切り口の違いが鮮やかに浮かび上がる。
cards.en: The morning after the new prime minister took office, every newspaper gave front-page prominence to the lineup of the new cabinet. In the editorials, calls for measures against rising prices and for rebuilding diplomacy stood out. Some papers, meanwhile, noted that nearly half of the ministers were holdovers from the previous cabinet and described it as lacking freshness. Even with the same event, reading the headlines side by side brings the differences in angle vividly to light.

Because parts of the route are slippery stone paving, participants are advised to come in shoes they are used to walking in. It is best to keep your bag as light as possible and not to forget rain gear.

words.meaning: expansion and enhancement (of a service or system)
words.defJa: 設備や制度などの規模を広げ、中身もより豊かにすること。

cards.ja: 共働き世帯の増加を受け、多くの自治体が放課後の子どもの居場所づくりを急いでいる。ある市では、小学校の空き教室を活用して学童保育の受け皿を拡充し、待機児童をほぼゼロにした。指導員の確保は依然として課題だが、地域の高齢者が見守り役として加わる例も出てきた。親にとっては、安心して働き続けられるかどうかに直結する問題だ。
cards.en: With the rise in dual-income households, many local governments are rushing to create places for children to spend time after school. One city expanded its after-school care capacity by using empty classrooms in elementary schools, bringing its waiting list down to nearly zero. Securing enough staff remains a challenge, but there are now cases of older local residents joining as supervisors. For parents, it is an issue directly tied to whether they can keep working with peace of mind.

words.defJa: 専門的な研究によって積み上げられた学問や知識。

cards.ja: 生成AIで書かれたとみられる論文が、学術誌に掲載される例が相次いでいる。存在しない文献が引用されていたり、AIの定型的な言い回しがそのまま残っていたりして、読者の指摘で発覚することが多い。出版社の中には、AIの使用を申告するよう投稿者に義務づけるところも出てきた。研究の信頼性をどう守るかは、学術界全体の課題になっている。
cards.en: There has been a string of cases in which papers apparently written with generative AI have been published in academic journals. They often come to light when readers point out citations of nonexistent sources or stock AI phrasing left in the text as is. Some publishers have begun requiring authors to declare their use of AI. How to protect the reliability of research has become an issue for the academic world as a whole.

cards.ja: お盆の時期になると、各地で盆踊りが開かれ、浴衣姿の人々が輪になって踊る。もともとは先祖の霊を迎え、また送り出すための行事だったとされる。近年は担い手の高齢化で中止に追い込まれる地域がある一方、若者が企画して復活させる例も増えている。地元の曲に合わせて踊るひとときは、世代を超えた交流の場にもなっている。
cards.en: When the Obon season comes, Bon dances are held in many parts of the country, and people in summer kimono dance in a circle. They are said to have originally been events for welcoming the spirits of ancestors and then sending them off again. In recent years, while some areas have been forced to cancel them as the people who run them grow older, there are also more cases of young people organizing and reviving them. Dancing to a local song has also become an occasion for exchange across generations.

words.defJa: 範囲や規模、施設などを広げて大きくすること。

cards.ja: アジアと北米を結ぶ航路の拠点となっている国内のある港で、大型コンテナ船の入港に対応するため、岸壁を拡張する工事が進んでいる。近年は船の大型化が著しく、従来の設備では受け入れられない船が増えてきたためだ。工事が終われば、取り扱える貨物の量はおよそ1.5倍になる見込みだという。港の競争力は、地域経済の行方を左右する。
cards.en: At a domestic port that serves as a hub on shipping routes linking Asia and North America, work is under way to extend the quays so that large container ships can call there. This is because ships have grown markedly larger in recent years, and more of them can no longer be handled by the existing facilities. Once the work is finished, the volume of cargo the port can handle is expected to grow to about 1.5 times its current level. A port's competitiveness shapes the course of the regional economy.

words.defJa: 二つの線や面が交わってできる開きの大きさ。また、物を見る向き。

cards.ja: 同じ花を撮っても、カメラを構える角度ひとつで写真の印象はがらりと変わる。上から見下ろすように撮れば図鑑のような説明的な一枚になり、地面すれすれから見上げれば、空に向かって伸びる力強い姿になる。写真家の多くは、シャッターを切る前に被写体の周りをゆっくり歩き回るという。最良の視点は、たいてい最初に立った場所とは別のところにある。
cards.en: Even when photographing the same flower, the impression of the picture changes completely with nothing more than the angle at which you hold the camera. Shoot looking down from above, and you get an explanatory shot like one in a field guide; look up from just above the ground, and the flower becomes a powerful figure stretching toward the sky. Many photographers are said to walk slowly around their subject before pressing the shutter. The best viewpoint is usually somewhere other than where you first stood.

cards.en: With the new term under way, elementary schools have formed new classes in each grade. These days many schools also include activities that cross grade boundaries, and mixed-age groups in which older pupils look after younger ones are popular. Taking on the role of teacher is also said to deepen the older children's own learning. Relationships that are not confined to a single grade are also expected to help prevent bullying.

words.meaning: faculty or school (of a university); undergraduate level
words.defJa: 大学の中で、専門の分野ごとに分けた大きな組織。

cards.en: Undergraduate admission to the Indian Institutes of Technology is known as one of the toughest in the world. More than a million applicants take the common entrance exam every year, but only a tiny fraction pass and enroll. Many graduates go on to successful careers at major IT companies in India and abroad, and that track record raises parents' expectations even higher. The competition is so fierce that whole towns full of exam-prep schools have sprung up.

words.defJa: ある出来事が起こる見込みを、数で表したもの。

cards.ja: 天気予報の降水確率が30%と聞いて、傘を持つかどうか迷う人は多い。この数字は、同じような気象条件の日が100回あれば、そのうち30回は1ミリ以上の雨が降るという意味だ。雨の強さや降る時間の長さを表しているわけではない。数字の意味を正しく知っておくと、毎日の判断がぐっと楽になる。
cards.en: Many people hesitate over whether to take an umbrella when they hear the forecast put the chance of rain at 30 percent. The figure means that if there were 100 days with similar weather conditions, it would rain 1 millimeter or more on 30 of them. It does not indicate how heavy the rain will be or how long it will last. Knowing what the number really means makes everyday decisions much easier.

cards.en: Various surveys have shown a close link between a household's economic situation and children's academic ability. This is because differences in how much money can be spent on cram schools and lessons tend to show up directly as differences in grades. To narrow this gap, learning-support programs in which university students teach for free are spreading. Equal opportunity to learn is also a foundation for keeping society vibrant.

cards.en: Japanese children learn their multiplication tables, called kuku, in the second grade of elementary school. A distinctive feature is chanting the special readings to a rhythm, as in 'ni san ga roku' (two threes are six) and 'sazan ga ku' (three threes are nine). Devices that make them easier to remember can be seen throughout, such as shortening 'san' to 'sa' to even out the number of sounds. Kuku is said to have come from China more than a thousand years ago, and traces of it can already be found in a poetry anthology from the Nara period.

According to the Japan Meteorological Agency, volcanic earthquakes have recently increased slightly on this mountain. If the volcanic alert level is raised, entry to the area around the crater will be restricted immediately.

cards.en: The team, which had led the league since opening day, went into a steady decline after a key pitcher was sidelined by injury in June. Game after game, the lineup also failed to come up with the hit it needed with runners in scoring position, and by August the team had slipped all the way to fourth place. Even so, the manager has vowed to turn things around in the remaining games by giving young players more chances.

words.defJa: 地下のマグマが地表に噴き出してできた山。

cards.ja: 日本列島には百十一の活火山があり、世界の活火山の七パーセントほどが集中している。プレートが沈み込む境界に位置しているため、地下でマグマが生まれやすいのだ。火山は噴火による災害をもたらす一方で、温泉や美しい景観、豊かな土壌といった恵みも与えてきた。人々はその両面と付き合いながら暮らしてきたと言える。
cards.en: The Japanese archipelago has 111 active volcanoes, about 7 percent of all the active volcanoes in the world. Because it sits on boundaries where tectonic plates sink beneath one another, magma readily forms underground. While volcanoes bring disasters through eruptions, they have also given blessings such as hot springs, beautiful scenery and fertile soil. One could say people have lived alongside both sides of them.

Books can be kept for two weeks and are returned automatically when the period ends. The library says it hopes elderly people who find it hard to visit, and families busy raising children, will feel free to use the service.

words.defJa: 大学などで、専門ごとに分けた勉強の区分。

cards.ja: 少子化で受験生が減るなか、地方の大学では学科の再編が相次いでいる。志願者の少ない学科を統合し、データ分析や観光など、地域の需要に合った分野を新たに設けるのが主な狙いだ。ただ、在学生や卒業生からは、伝統ある学科の名前が消えることを惜しむ声も聞かれる。
cards.en: As the number of applicants falls with the declining birthrate, regional universities are reorganizing their departments one after another. The main aim is to merge departments with few applicants and newly create fields that match local demand, such as data analysis and tourism. Current students and graduates, however, can be heard lamenting the disappearance of the names of long-established departments.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: As the number of applicants falls with the declining birthrate, regional universities are reorganizing their departments one after another.

words.defJa: 研究者が集まり、研究の成果を発表し合う団体や会合。

cards.ja: 来月京都で開かれる学会で、研究チームは認知症を早く見つける新しい方法について発表する予定だ。血液を少し採るだけで、発症の十年以上前から兆候をとらえられる可能性があるという。会場には国内外からおよそ三千人の医師や研究者が集まる見込みで、注目度は高い。
cards.en: At an academic conference to be held in Kyoto next month, the research team plans to present a new method for detecting dementia early. With just a small blood sample, it may be possible to catch signs more than ten years before onset. Around 3,000 doctors and researchers from Japan and abroad are expected to gather at the venue, and interest is high.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: At an academic conference to be held in Kyoto next month, the research team plans to present a new method for detecting dementia early.

words.defJa: 学校で、一緒に授業を受ける児童や生徒のまとまり。

cards.ja: 国は小学校の一学級あたりの人数の上限を、四十人から三十五人へと段階的に引き下げてきた。人数が少なくなれば、教員が子ども一人ひとりに目を配りやすくなると期待されている。ただ、学級の数が増える分だけ教員や教室も必要になり、人手不足に悩む地域では確保が追いついていない。
cards.en: The national government has gradually lowered the maximum number of pupils per elementary school class from forty to thirty-five. Smaller classes are expected to make it easier for teachers to keep an eye on each child. However, as the number of classes increases, more teachers and classrooms are needed, and regions struggling with staff shortages have been unable to secure enough.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: The national government has gradually lowered the maximum number of pupils per elementary school class from forty to thirty-five.

words.meaning: to carry on one's shoulder(s), to shoulder
words.defJa: 荷物などを肩にのせて運ぶ。

cards.ja: 夏祭りの最終日、そろいの衣装を着た若者たちが神輿を担いで商店街を練り歩いた。重さは一トン近くあり、数十人が交代しながら肩に載せて進む。威勢のいい掛け声が響くたびに、沿道の見物客からは大きな拍手が起こった。祭りが本来の形で開かれるのは四年ぶりで、町は久しぶりの熱気に包まれた。
cards.en: On the last day of the summer festival, young people in matching outfits paraded through the shopping street carrying a portable shrine on their shoulders. It weighs nearly a ton, and dozens of people take turns bearing it on their shoulders as they move along. Each time their spirited chants rang out, spectators along the route broke into loud applause. It was the first time in four years the festival had been held in its full traditional form, and the town was wrapped in an excitement it had not felt for a long while.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: On the last day of the summer festival, young people in matching outfits paraded through the shopping street carrying a portable shrine on their shoulders.

words.defJa: 文字や語句を前と後ろからはさんで区切るための記号。

cards.ja: 日本語の文章では、会話や引用を示すときにかぎ括弧を使うのが一般的だ。英語の引用符とは形が違うだけでなく、文の最後の句点を括弧の内側に入れるかどうかなど、細かな決まりもある。新聞では、閉じ括弧の直前には句点を打たないのが原則となっている。一方、学校の国語の教科書では句点を入れる書き方が一般的で、媒体によって慣習が異なる。
cards.en: In Japanese writing, it is common to use corner brackets to indicate dialogue or quotations. They differ from English quotation marks not only in shape but also in fine rules, such as whether to put the sentence-final period inside the brackets. In newspapers, the rule is not to put a period right before a closing bracket. School Japanese textbooks, by contrast, usually include it, so the convention differs from one medium to another.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: In Japanese writing, it is common to use corner brackets to indicate dialogue or quotations.

words.defJa: 印刷に使う文字の型。また、印刷された文字や文章。

cards.ja: 若者の活字離れが言われて久しいが、本や新聞を読む人が本当に減っているかについては意見が分かれる。スマートフォンでニュースや小説を読む時間は、むしろ増えているという調査もあるからだ。紙か画面かという違いはあっても、文字を読む習慣そのものは形を変えて続いているのかもしれない。
cards.en: It has long been said that young people are drifting away from the printed word, but opinions differ on whether the number of people reading books and newspapers is really falling. That is because some surveys find that time spent reading news and novels on smartphones has actually increased. Paper or screen aside, the habit of reading itself may be continuing in a different form.

かれる。スマートフォンでニュースや
いているのかもしれない。
cards.enTarget: It has long been said that young people are drifting away from the printed word, but opinions differ on whether the number of people reading books and newspapers is really falling.

words.defJa: 生き生きと活動する力。

cards.ja: 人口の減少が続く山あいの町に、都市部から移り住む若い世代が少しずつ増えている。空き店舗を改装したカフェやパン屋が次々と開き、週末には町の外からも人が訪れるようになった。町も空き家の情報を積極的に発信し、移住を後押ししている。古くからの住民は、町に活力が戻ってきたと目を細める。
cards.en: In a mountain town whose population keeps shrinking, the number of younger people moving in from the cities is gradually increasing. Cafés and bakeries in renovated empty shops have opened one after another, and on weekends people now come from outside the town as well. The town, for its part, actively publicizes vacant houses to encourage people to move in. Longtime residents smile with pleasure, saying vitality has returned to the town.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: Longtime residents smile with pleasure, saying vitality has returned to the town.

words.defJa: 漢字をもとに日本で作られた、音を表す文字。ひらがなとカタカナがある。

cards.ja: 文字を持たなかった古代の日本人は、中国から伝わった漢字の音を借りて、自分たちの言葉を書き表していた。やがて漢字を崩したり、その一部を取り出したりして、仮名が生まれた。崩した形からはひらがなが、一部を取った形からはカタカナが発達した。平安時代には仮名で多くの物語や日記が書かれ、日本語ならではの細やかな表現が花開いた。
cards.en: The ancient Japanese, who had no writing system of their own, wrote down their language by borrowing the sounds of kanji brought over from China. Eventually, by writing kanji in a flowing cursive style or taking parts of them, they created kana. Hiragana developed from the cursive forms, and katakana from the parts. In the Heian period, many tales and diaries were written in kana, and the subtle expression unique to Japanese flourished.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: Eventually, by writing kanji in a flowing cursive style or taking parts of them, they created kana.

words.defJa: ものに熱を加えて温度を上げること。

cards.ja: 夏は、生や生焼けの鶏肉による食中毒が増える季節だ。原因となる細菌は肉の中心部までしっかり加熱すれば死滅するが、表面だけ焼いて中が赤いままだと危険が残る。目安は、中心部が七十五度で一分以上とされている。また、生肉を切ったまな板や包丁で、そのままサラダの野菜を切らないよう注意したい。
cards.en: Summer is the season when food poisoning from raw or undercooked chicken increases. The bacteria responsible die if the meat is heated thoroughly to the center, but if only the surface is cooked and the inside stays red, the danger remains. The guideline is at least one minute at 75 degrees Celsius in the center. You should also take care not to cut salad vegetables with the same cutting board and knife you used for raw meat without washing them first.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: The bacteria responsible die if the meat is heated thoroughly to the center, but if only the surface is cooked and the inside stays red, the danger remains.

words.defJa: 全体の半分より多い数。

cards.ja: 民間の調査会社が会社員千人に尋ねたところ、過半数が週に一日以上は在宅で働きたいと答えた。通勤の負担が減り、家族と過ごす時間が増えることを理由に挙げる人が多かった。一方で、同僚と顔を合わせる機会が減り、気軽に相談しにくくなったと感じている人も三割ほどいた。
cards.en: When a private research firm surveyed 1,000 office workers, a majority said they would like to work from home at least one day a week. Many cited a lighter commuting burden and more time with their families as reasons. On the other hand, about thirty percent felt that with fewer chances to see colleagues face to face, it had become harder to ask for advice casually.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: When a private research firm surveyed 1,000 office workers, a majority said they would like to work from home at least one day a week.

words.meaning: to cover (something) with; to put (a hat etc.) on someone
words.defJa: ものの上から、ほかのものを覆うようにのせる。

cards.ja: 冬の冷え込みが厳しくなる前に、庭の野菜や鉢植えには霜よけの対策をしておきたい。夜のあいだ薄い布をふんわりとかぶせておくだけでも、葉が凍って傷むのをかなり防げる。ただし、日中に気温が上がったら布を外して、日光と風に当てることを忘れないようにしよう。
cards.en: Before the winter cold sets in hard, you'll want to protect the vegetables and potted plants in your garden from frost. Just loosely covering them with a thin cloth at night goes a long way toward keeping the leaves from freezing and getting damaged. But when the temperature rises during the day, remember to take the cloth off and let them get sunlight and air.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: Just loosely covering them with a thin cloth at night goes a long way toward keeping the leaves from freezing and getting damaged.

words.meaning: iron pot (for cooking rice or boiling water)
words.defJa: ご飯を炊いたり湯をわかしたりするのに使う、金属などでできた深くて大きななべ。

cards.ja: 山あいの古い旅館では、朝食のご飯を今も薪で炊いている。厨房の奥に据えられた大きな鉄の釜は、創業当時から使い続けてきたものだという。火加減は板長が音と香りだけで見極め、ふたを開けるのは炊き上がってから十分ほど蒸らした後だ。底にできるおこげを目当てに、毎年通ってくる客も少なくない。
cards.en: At an old inn in the mountains, the rice for breakfast is still cooked over firewood. The large iron pot set at the back of the kitchen has reportedly been in use since the inn was founded. The head chef judges the heat by sound and smell alone, and the lid comes off only after the cooked rice has steamed for about ten minutes. Quite a few guests come back every year for the crispy rice that forms at the bottom.

cards.enTarget: The large iron pot set at the back of the kitchen has reportedly been in use since the inn was founded.

words.defJa: それでも問題はない、気にしない、という意味のていねいな言い方。

cards.ja: 駅前の市立図書館では、今月から返却ボックスを二十四時間使えるようにしました。「期限を一日過ぎたくらいなら、窓口に来なくてもボックスに入れていただいて構いません」と担当者は話します。ただし、予約の入っている本はほかの利用者が待っているため、できるだけ早く返してほしいとのことです。
cards.en: The city library in front of the station has made its book-return box available around the clock starting this month. "If a book is only a day or so overdue, you're welcome to drop it in the box instead of coming to the counter," a staff member says. However, since other patrons are waiting for reserved books, the library asks that those be returned as soon as possible.

してほしいとのことです。

words.defJa: いらなくなって捨てる紙や、その切れはし。

cards.ja: オフィスから出る紙くずは、かつては一般のごみと一緒に燃やされることが多かった。最近では、書き損じのメモやシュレッダーにかけた書類も古紙として分けて回収に出し、トイレットペーパーなどの原料に回す企業が増えている。捨てればただのごみでも、集めれば立派な資源になる。机の横に古紙専用の箱を一つ置くだけで、紙くずの行き先は大きく変わるのだ。
cards.en: Wastepaper from offices used to be burned along with ordinary garbage much of the time. Recently, more companies separate even spoiled memos and shredded documents as recovered paper, send them off for collection, and have them turned into raw material for products such as toilet paper. Thrown away, it is just garbage; collected, it becomes a real resource. Simply placing one box just for used paper beside a desk makes a big difference to where wastepaper ends up.

words.defJa: 人の力をこえた不思議な力をもち、人々に信じられ、まつられる存在を親しみをこめて呼ぶ語。

cards.ja: 日本では昔から、山や川、台所やかまどにまで神様が宿ると考えられてきた。正月に飾る鏡餅も、もとは新しい年の神様を家に迎えるための供え物である。こうした感覚は今も暮らしの中に残っていて、食べ物を粗末にすると罰が当たると子どもに教える家庭は少なくない。
cards.en: In Japan, people have long believed that gods dwell in mountains and rivers, and even in kitchens and cooking stoves. The kagami mochi displayed at New Year was originally an offering to welcome the god of the new year into the home. This sensibility still survives in daily life, and many families teach their children that wasting food will bring divine punishment.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: In Japan, people have long believed that gods dwell in mountains and rivers, and even in kitchens and cooking stoves.

words.defJa: ひげや髪の毛をそるのに使う、よく切れる薄い刃物。

cards.ja: ドラッグストアのひげそり売り場には、刃の枚数を競うようにさまざまなカミソリが並んでいる。皮膚科の医師によれば、肌荒れを防ぐには刃の数よりも、切れ味が落ちる前にこまめに替えることのほうが大切だという。そる前に蒸しタオルでひげを柔らかくしておくだけでも、肌への負担はかなり減るそうだ。
cards.en: In the shaving aisle of drugstores, all kinds of razors line the shelves, as if competing over the number of blades. According to a dermatologist, to prevent skin irritation it matters more to change the blade often, before it dulls, than how many blades it has. Simply softening the beard with a hot towel before shaving reportedly reduces the strain on the skin considerably.

らかくしておくだけでも、
