words.defJa: トラックや列車、船などで運ぶ荷物。

cards.ja: トラック運転手の不足が深刻になるなか、長距離の貨物輸送を鉄道や船に切り替える動きが広がっている。鉄道なら、同じ量の荷物を運んでも、排出される二酸化炭素はトラックのおよそ十分の一で済むとされる。一方で、駅から倉庫までの短い区間はトラックに頼らざるをえず、積み替えの手間をどう減らすかが課題になっている。
cards.en: As the shortage of truck drivers grows serious, there is a widening shift toward moving long-distance freight by rail and ship. By rail, carrying the same load is said to emit only about one-tenth of the carbon dioxide that trucks produce. On the other hand, the short stretch from the station to the warehouse still has to rely on trucks, and how to reduce the work of transferring cargo has become a challenge.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: As the shortage of truck drivers grows serious, there is a widening shift toward moving long-distance freight by rail and ship.

words.defJa: 中に何も入っていないこと。また、そのようす。

cards.ja: 長い出張から帰って冷蔵庫を開けると、中は見事に空っぽだった。仕方なく近所のコンビニに向かったが、深夜のせいか弁当もほとんど売り切れていた。結局、カップ麺とバナナを一本買って帰り、台所に立ったまま夕食を済ませた。明日こそはちゃんと買い物に行こうと心に決めて、その夜は早めに布団に入った。
cards.en: When I got home from a long business trip and opened the fridge, it was completely empty. I had no choice but to head to the convenience store nearby, but perhaps because it was late at night, the boxed meals were almost sold out too. In the end I bought a cup of instant noodles and a banana, went home, and ate dinner standing in the kitchen. Resolving that tomorrow I would go grocery shopping properly, I went to bed early that night.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: When I got home from a long business trip and opened the fridge, it was completely empty.

words.defJa: 草や木が水分を失って、生きる力がなくなる。

cards.ja: 今年の夏は記録的な猛暑と少雨が続き、市内では街路樹や公園の芝生が枯れる被害が相次いだ。市の担当者は、水やりの回数を増やしたものの、地中深くまで水が届かず、根が弱ってしまったと説明する。秋以降は、暑さや乾燥に強い樹種への植え替えを少しずつ進める方針だという。
cards.en: This summer, record heat and scant rainfall persisted, and the city suffered one case after another of street trees and park lawns withering. A city official explains that although they watered more often, the water did not reach deep into the soil and the roots weakened. From autumn on, the city plans to gradually replace them with tree species that better tolerate heat and drought.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: This summer, record heat and scant rainfall persisted, and the city suffered one case after another of street trees and park lawns withering.

words.meaning: to dote on, to treat with affection
words.defJa: 子どもや動物などを大切にして、愛情をもって接する。

cards.ja: 祖母の家では、もう十五年以上も同じ猫を飼っている。祖母はその猫を孫以上にかわいがっていて、食事の時間になると自分の皿から魚を分けてやるほどだ。猫のほうもそれをよく分かっているらしく、祖母が台所に立つと必ず足元にすり寄ってくる。獣医からは太りすぎだと注意されているのだが、祖母はまったく気にする様子がない。
cards.en: My grandmother has kept the same cat for more than fifteen years. She dotes on it even more than on her grandchildren, to the point of sharing fish from her own plate at mealtimes. The cat seems to know this well and always rubs up against her feet whenever she stands in the kitchen. The vet has warned that the cat is overweight, but my grandmother doesn't seem to mind in the least.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: She dotes on it even more than on her grandchildren, to the point of sharing fish from her own plate at mealtimes.

words.defJa: 国と国のお金を交換するときの比率や、その取引。また、現金を送らずに支払いをするしくみ。

cards.ja: 円安が進んだことで、海外から原材料を輸入する食品メーカーの経営が圧迫されている。為替が一円動くだけで、年間の利益が数億円単位で変わる企業も少なくない。そのため多くのメーカーは、あらかじめ決めたレートで将来外貨を買う契約を結び、急な変動に備えている。
cards.en: The weakening of the yen has squeezed food manufacturers that import raw materials from abroad. For quite a few companies, a move of just one yen in the exchange rate changes annual profit by hundreds of millions of yen. For this reason, many manufacturers sign contracts to buy foreign currency in the future at a rate set in advance, guarding against sudden swings.

ruby: くのメーカーは、あらかじめ
cards.enTarget: For quite a few companies, a move of just one yen in the exchange rate changes annual profit by hundreds of millions of yen.

words.defJa: 粘土を焼いて作った、屋根をおおうための板。

cards.ja: 古い町並みが残る地区では、家々の屋根に黒くつやのある瓦がびっしりと並んでいる。瓦は重いため地震に弱いと言われてきたが、最近は一枚ずつくぎで固定する工法が広まり、強い揺れでも落ちにくくなった。地元の職人たちは、景観を守りながら安全性も高めようと、若い世代への技術の継承に力を入れている。
cards.en: In a district where the old townscape survives, glossy black roof tiles are packed tightly across the roofs of the houses. Tiles have long been said to fare badly in earthquakes because of their weight, but a method of nailing down each tile has recently spread, making them less likely to fall even in strong shaking. Local craftsmen are working hard to pass their skills on to the younger generation, aiming to improve safety while preserving the townscape.

cards.enTarget: In a district where the old townscape survives, glossy black roof tiles are packed tightly across the roofs of the houses.

words.defJa: 部屋の中のよごれた空気を外に出し、外の新しい空気を入れること。

cards.ja: 冬は寒さのせいで窓を閉め切りがちだが、室内の空気は思った以上に汚れている。専門家によると、三十分に一度、数分間窓を全開にするだけで、二酸化炭素の濃度は大きく下がるという。対角線上にある二か所の窓を開けると空気の通り道ができ、短い時間でも効率よく換気できるそうだ。
cards.en: In winter people tend to keep the windows shut because of the cold, but indoor air gets dirtier than you might think. According to experts, simply opening the windows wide for a few minutes every thirty minutes greatly lowers the concentration of carbon dioxide. Opening two windows diagonally across from each other creates a path for the air, so you can ventilate efficiently even in a short time.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: Opening two windows diagonally across from each other creates a path for the air, so you can ventilate efficiently even in a short time.

words.defJa: 強く心を動かされて、深く喜んだりありがたく思ったりすること。

cards.ja: 地元の高校が初めて全国大会への出場を決め、商店街は朝からお祝いムードに包まれた。三十年前に同じ高校で主将を務めた店主は、まさか自分が生きているうちにこの日が来るとは思わなかったと、感激した様子で語った。店先には選手たちへの寄せ書きが張り出され、通りかかった人が次々と足を止めている。
cards.en: The local high school has qualified for a national tournament for the first time, and the shopping street was wrapped in a festive mood from the morning. A shop owner who captained the same school's team thirty years ago said, visibly moved, that he never imagined this day would come in his lifetime. Boards of good-luck messages for the players have been put up in front of the shops, and passersby keep stopping to look.

words.meaning: Kansai, the region around Osaka, Kyoto and Kobe
words.defJa: 大阪や京都、神戸を中心とする地方。近畿地方とほぼ重なる。

cards.ja: 関西では、うどんのつゆが透き通った薄い色をしていることに驚く旅行者が多い。昆布のうまみを生かした味付けで、見た目は薄くても塩分はしっかり含まれている。一方、東京のつゆはしょうゆの色が濃く、かつお節の香りが強いのが特徴だ。同じ一杯のうどんにも、土地ごとの好みがはっきりと表れている。
cards.en: Many travelers are surprised that in Kansai the udon broth is a clear, pale color. It is seasoned to bring out the umami of kelp, and though it looks light, it contains plenty of salt. Tokyo broth, by contrast, is marked by the dark color of soy sauce and a strong aroma of bonito flakes. Even in a single bowl of udon, regional tastes show clearly.

words.defJa: 一年の最初の日。一月一日。

cards.en: On the morning of New Year's Day, people making their first shrine visit of the year formed a long line at the neighborhood shrine. Sweet sake was handed out on the grounds, and families waiting their turn with their breath white in the cold were a common sight. These days, more people reportedly avoid the crowds and visit at a leisurely pace after the first three days of the year. Even so, many still want to pray on the very first morning of the year, and the line stayed unbroken until past noon.

cards.en: More and more art museums now allow visitors to take photos in front of the works. On the other hand, some curators point out that merely looking at a painting through a smartphone screen does not amount to truly appreciating it. One museum began an experiment in which it holds visitors' devices at the entrance and asks them to spend ten minutes in front of a single painting, and the trial has been well received.

cards.ja: 年を重ねるにつれて、季節の移り変わりをより鋭く感ずるようになった。若いころは気にも留めなかった風の匂いや、夕暮れの光の色の変化に、ふと足を止めることが多い。それは衰えではなく、急ぐ必要のなくなった心が、ようやく周りの世界に目を向け始めた証なのかもしれない。
cards.en: As I have grown older, I have come to sense the changing of the seasons more keenly. I often stop in my tracks at the smell of the wind or the shifting color of the evening light, things I never noticed when I was young. Perhaps this is not decline but a sign that a mind no longer in a hurry has finally begun to turn toward the world around it.

cards.en: Cigarette smoke affects the health not only of the smoker but of the people around them. Recent research has shown that even without inhaling the smoke directly, people indirectly take in harmful substances that have soaked into clothes, walls and furniture. In response to these findings, a growing number of local governments are urging people to refrain from smoking at home.

words.defJa: 北極や南極に近く、一年中とても寒い気候の地域。

cards.ja: 地球の気候は、気温や降水量の違いから、熱帯や温帯、寒帯などに大きく分けられる。寒帯は一年の大半を雪や氷に覆われ、最も暖かい月でも平均気温が十度に届かない地域を指す。こうした厳しい環境でも、ツンドラと呼ばれる地域では、地面をはうように生えるコケや地衣類が、トナカイなどの動物の大切な食料となっている。
cards.en: Earth's climates are broadly divided into tropical, temperate, frigid and other zones according to differences in temperature and precipitation. The frigid zone refers to regions covered with snow and ice for most of the year, where the average temperature stays below ten degrees even in the warmest month. Even in such a harsh environment, in the areas called tundra, mosses and lichens growing low across the ground are vital food for animals such as reindeer.

cards.en: In the government office district in the heart of the capital, buildings with lights still on late at night are nothing unusual, and long working hours have long been seen as a problem. The burden on young officials swamped with preparing answers for Diet sessions is heavy and is said to be contributing to a drop in applicants. To change this, the government is reviewing work practices, for example by asking the Diet to submit its questions earlier.

With disruption to transport also expected, the agency is urging people to allow extra time when they travel.

words.meaning: nursing (a sick person), caring for the sick
words.defJa: 病気の人のそばにいて、世話をすること。

cards.ja: 先週から熱を出して寝込んでいた息子が、ようやく学校に戻った。仕事を休んで看病していた妻は、ほっとしたせいか、今度は自分が風邪をひいてしまった。夜中に何度も起きて額のタオルを替えていたのだから、無理もない。今週末は私が家事を引き受けて、妻にゆっくり休んでもらうつもりだ。
cards.en: My son, who had been laid up with a fever since last week, finally went back to school. My wife, who had taken time off work to nurse him, came down with a cold herself this time, perhaps out of relief. No wonder, since she had been getting up again and again in the night to change the towel on his forehead. This weekend I plan to take over the housework and let her rest properly.

cards.en: Ancient kings wore crowns decorated with gold and jewels to show their authority to the people. One piece on display at the museum was found in a burial mound about 1,500 years old, and fine patterns are embossed into its thin gilded copper plate. Dozens of small ornaments are said to have hung from it so that it would sway and catch the light with every step.

cards.en: Quite a few people say they get headaches before it rains. cards.ja: 学校の成績のつけ方には、評価規準と呼ばれる考え方がある。これは、その単元で子どもに身につけてほしい力を、具体的な姿として言葉にしたものだ。同じ読みの評価基準が到達の度合いを測る物差しであるのに対し、こちらは何を評価するかという目標そのものを示す。紛らわしいため、教員の間では読み方を変えて呼び分けることもある。
cards.en: Behind the way school grades are given lies a concept called evaluation criteria. These put into words, as concrete descriptions of what children can do, the abilities they are expected to acquire in a given unit. Whereas the evaluation standard, which is read the same way, is a yardstick for measuring the degree of attainment, the criteria show the goal itself: what is to be evaluated. Because the two are easily confused, teachers sometimes tell them apart by reading them differently.

words.defJa: ほかの人に服などを身につけさせる。

cards.ja: 冬の朝、保育園へ出かける前に子どもに上着を着せるのは、親にとってひと苦労だ。暑がりな子ほど嫌がって逃げ回り、玄関で五分以上かかることも珍しくない。最近は、子どもが自分で着られるよう、前開きで軽い上着を選ぶ家庭も増えている。忙しい朝の小さな攻防は、どこの家でも似たようなものだ。
cards.en: On winter mornings, getting a jacket onto a child before setting off for nursery school is a real struggle for parents. The children who feel the heat most are the ones who resist and run around, and it is not unusual for this to take more than five minutes at the front door. Recently, more families are choosing light, front-opening jackets so that children can put them on by themselves. These small morning battles are much the same in every household.

words.defJa: 物事が成り立つための、いちばん下の土台となる部分。

cards.ja: 強豪校のサッカー部ほど、練習時間の大半を地味な基礎練習に費やしている。パスやトラップを何百回も繰り返すのは退屈だが、試合の緊張の中で体が自然に動くのは、その積み重ねがあるからだ。ある名門校の監督は、派手な技を覚えるのは基礎が固まってからでいいと、口癖のように選手に言い聞かせている。
cards.en: The stronger a high school soccer team is, the more of its practice time it devotes to unglamorous basic drills. Repeating passes and ball control hundreds of times is boring, but it is that accumulation that lets the body move naturally amid the tension of a match. The coach at one top school tells his players, almost as a catchphrase, that flashy moves can wait until the fundamentals are solid.

cards.ja: 南極にある日本の観測基地では、毎年およそ三十人の隊員が越冬し、丸一年を過ごす。気温が氷点下三十度を下回ることもあり、太陽が昇らない日が何週間も続く冬の間も、気象やオーロラの観測は休みなく行われる。物資を運ぶ船が来るのは年に一度だけなので、食料や燃料の計画には細心の注意が必要だ。
cards.en: At Japan's observation base in Antarctica, about thirty team members winter over every year, spending a full year there. Even in winter, when the temperature can drop below minus thirty degrees and the sun does not rise for weeks on end, observations of the weather and the aurora go on without a break. The ship carrying supplies comes only once a year, so planning food and fuel requires the utmost care.

cards.en: What brought the two coworkers close was that they had been reading the same book on the train home. Neither could say who spoke first, but they began sharing their impressions of it, and before they knew it they were spending every weekend touring bookstores together. In his speech at their wedding, their boss laughed that you never know where a connection might be lying around.

cards.en: When the bell signaling the start of the show rang, the murmuring audience gradually fell silent. The lights dimmed, and a single actor stood at the center of the stage. The instant the first line rang out, you could sense the full house catch its breath at once. This theater's seats are close to the stage, and its appeal is that you can feel even the actors' sweat and breathing.

cards.ja: 祖父母の家には、ふだんは使わない客間があった。床の間には季節の掛け軸が飾られ、子どもが勝手に入ると叱られたものだ。正月や法事で親戚が集まるときだけ、ふすまが開け放たれ、部屋は急ににぎやかになった。今の住宅では、こうした部屋を設ける家はずいぶん減っている。
cards.en: My grandparents' house had a guest room that was normally left unused. A seasonal hanging scroll was displayed in the alcove, and we children would be scolded if we went in without permission. Only when relatives gathered for New Year's or memorial services were the sliding doors thrown open, and the room would suddenly come alive. In today's homes, far fewer families set aside a room like this.

words.meaning: closure (of a business), suspension of operations
words.defJa: 店や会社、工場などが、一時的に仕事や営業をやめること。

cards.ja: 物価の高騰と人手不足が重なり、一時的な休業に追い込まれる飲食店が増えている。経営が苦しくなった店の多くは、営業日を減らしたり、ランチだけに絞ったりして持ちこたえようとしている。駅前の老舗の洋食店も、仕込みを担う料理人が見つからず、来月から長期の休業に入ると張り紙を出した。
cards.en: With soaring prices and labor shortages coinciding, more and more restaurants are being forced into temporary closure. Many struggling establishments are trying to hold on by cutting their business days or limiting themselves to lunch service. A long-established Western-style diner in front of the station has also put up a notice saying it will close for an extended period from next month, because it cannot find a cook to handle the prep work.

cards.ja: 大学の掲示板やアプリには、毎朝その日の休講情報が表示される。担当教員の出張や体調不良が主な理由で、学生にとっては思わぬ空き時間になる。ただし休講になった回は、学期末に補講として埋め合わせられることが多い。喜んでばかりもいられないというのが、多くの学生の本音だ。
cards.en: Every morning, the university bulletin board and app show that day's lecture cancellations. The main reasons are instructors' business trips or illness, and for students the result is an unexpected block of free time. However, canceled sessions are often made up with supplementary classes at the end of the term. The honest feeling of many students is that it is not purely something to celebrate.

words.defJa: 働いた人に、会社などが支払うお金や品物。

cards.ja: 会社員の給与明細には、基本給のほかにさまざまな手当や控除が並んでいる。額面の金額から税金や社会保険料が差し引かれるため、実際に口座に振り込まれる手取りは二割ほど少なくなる。新入社員の中には、初めての明細を見てその差に驚く人も多い。明細の見方を知っておくことは、お金の管理の第一歩といえる。
cards.en: An office worker's pay slip lists, besides the base salary, various allowances and deductions. Because taxes and social insurance premiums are subtracted from the gross amount, the take-home pay actually deposited into one's account is about twenty percent less. Many new employees are surprised by the difference when they see their first pay slip. Knowing how to read a pay slip can be called the first step in managing one's money.

words.meaning: clear, pure (of water); pure, innocent (of heart)
words.defJa: 汚れがなく、すきとおって美しい。また、心に濁りや悪いところがない。

cards.ja: 山あいの集落を流れる川の水は、底の石が一つ一つ数えられるほど清い。この水を守るため、住民たちは数十年前から上流での農薬の使用を控えてきた。夏になると水辺にはホタルが舞い、遠くから見物に訪れる人も少なくない。地元の小学校では、毎年この川で水辺の生き物の観察会が開かれている。
cards.en: The water of the river that runs through the mountain village is so clear that you can count the stones on its bed one by one. To protect this water, residents have refrained from using pesticides upstream for several decades. In summer, fireflies dance along the water's edge, and quite a few people come from far away to see them. Every year, the local elementary school holds a session on this river to observe the creatures living by the water.

words.defJa: 土地や物事を分けている、さかいめの線。

cards.ja: 隣の家との境界をめぐるもめごとは、法律相談にもよく持ち込まれる。昔の測量は精度が低く、塀や生け垣の位置が登記上の線とずれていることも珍しくない。弁護士は、家を建て替える前に土地の測量を依頼し、境界をはっきり確定させておくよう勧めている。費用はかかるが、将来の争いを防ぐ保険と考えれば安いものだという。
cards.en: Disputes with neighbors over property boundaries are frequently brought to legal consultations. Surveys in the past were not very accurate, and it is not unusual for a wall or hedge to stand off the line recorded in the land registry. Lawyers recommend having the land surveyed before rebuilding a house, so that the boundary is clearly settled. It costs money, they say, but it is cheap if you think of it as insurance against future disputes.

words.defJa: 財産を個人ではなく社会全体で持つという考え方に関わることを表す。

cards.ja: 二十世紀には、共産主義を掲げる国家が世界の広い範囲に誕生した。財産を社会全体で共有し、貧富の差をなくすという理想は、多くの知識人や労働者を引きつけた。しかし計画経済は次第に行き詰まり、一九九一年にはソ連が崩壊する。それでも、平等を求める思想そのものは、今も形を変えて議論され続けている。
cards.en: In the twentieth century, states proclaiming communism arose across wide areas of the world. The ideal of sharing property across society as a whole and eliminating the gap between rich and poor attracted many intellectuals and workers. But planned economies gradually reached a dead end, and in 1991 the Soviet Union collapsed. Even so, the idea of pursuing equality itself continues to be debated today in altered forms.

words.defJa: 決まった時期に、決まったやり方で行う催し。

cards.ja: 季節ごとの年中行事は、かつては家族や地域の暮らしの節目だった。春には花見、夏には盆踊り、秋には収穫を祝う祭りがあり、人々はそのたびに集まって食卓を囲んだ。しかし過疎化が進む地方では、担い手が足りずに途絶えてしまった行事も少なくない。一方で、若い移住者が加わって祭りを復活させた例も、各地で報告されている。
cards.en: Seasonal annual events were once the milestones of family and community life. There was cherry-blossom viewing in spring, Bon dancing in summer and festivals celebrating the harvest in autumn, and each time people gathered around the table together. But in rural areas where depopulation is advancing, many such events have died out for lack of people to carry them on. On the other hand, cases of festivals being revived with the help of young newcomers have also been reported in various places.

cards.en: In emails asking a favor of a business partner, it is standard to open with "I am terribly sorry to trouble you when you are busy, but..." Showing up front that you feel bad about taking up the other person's time softens the impression the request makes. However, repeating it several times in a single email can instead come across as stiff and distant.

cards.en: An hour before opening, a long line had already formed in front of the popular ramen shop. Many of the waiting customers held smartphones, browsing review sites as they waited their turn. According to the owner, ever since the shop was featured on television, a two-hour wait has become normal even on weekdays. Some local residents, it seems, are annoyed by the line blocking the sidewalk.

cards.ja: 十九世紀のドイツの心理学者は、意味のない音のつながりを覚え、時間とともにどれだけ忘れるかを自ら記録した。その結果をグラフにすると、覚えた直後に急に下がり、やがてなだらかになる曲線が描かれた。この忘却曲線は、復習の間隔を少しずつ広げていく学習法の土台となっている。
cards.en: In the nineteenth century, a German psychologist memorized meaningless strings of sounds and recorded for himself how much he forgot over time. When the results were graphed, they traced a curve that drops sharply right after memorizing and then gradually levels off. This forgetting curve underlies study methods in which the intervals between reviews are widened little by little.

words.defJa: 集団や生活の中で、人の行いを正しく保つための決まり。

cards.ja: 禅寺の修行では、起床から就寝まで一日の流れが細かく決められている。食事の作法や歩き方にまで厳しい規律があり、初めて参加した人の多くは戸惑う。しかし数日たつと、いちいち迷わずに済むことで、かえって心が静まっていくのを感じるという。決まりに身を任せることが、雑念を手放す助けになるのだ。
cards.en: In training at a Zen temple, the flow of the day is laid out in detail from waking to going to bed. There is strict discipline even in table manners and the way one walks, and many first-time participants are bewildered. But after a few days, they say, they feel their minds growing calmer precisely because they no longer have to deliberate over every little thing. Surrendering oneself to the rules helps one let go of stray thoughts.

words.meaning: to cut down with a sword, to slay; to criticize sharply
words.defJa: 刀などで人を切りつける。また、鋭く批判する。

cards.ja: 時代劇の立ち回りでは、刀で相手を斬る場面が最大の見せ場になる。実際には刃のない模造刀を使い、相手の体に触れないぎりぎりのところで振り抜く。斬られる側の役者も、倒れ方一つで迫力が大きく変わるため、何年も稽古を重ねている。画面に映る一瞬の場面は、こうした地道な工夫と鍛錬の上に成り立っている。
cards.en: In the sword fights of period dramas, the moment of cutting down an opponent with a sword is the biggest highlight. In reality, actors use imitation swords without sharp edges, swinging them through at a point just short of touching the other actor's body. The actors on the receiving end also train for years, because the way they fall alone makes a great difference to how powerful the scene looks. The fleeting moment on screen rests on this kind of patient ingenuity and training.

words.meaning: to be careful, to watch out, to pay attention
words.defJa: 危なくないように、また失敗しないように、注意する。

cards.ja: 夏の熱中症は、炎天下だけでなく室内でも起こる。とくに高齢者は暑さやのどの渇きを感じにくく、気づいたときには症状が進んでいることがある。専門家は、エアコンの使用を我慢せず、こまめに水分をとるよう気をつけてほしいと呼びかけている。室温は二十八度以下が目安とされ、夜間も油断は禁物だ。
cards.en: Heatstroke in summer occurs not only under the blazing sun but also indoors. Elderly people in particular are less sensitive to heat and thirst, and by the time they notice, their symptoms may already have progressed. Experts are urging people not to hold back on using air conditioning and to take care to drink fluids frequently. The guideline is to keep the room at 28 degrees or below, and one should not let one's guard down at night either.

words.defJa: フナを改良して作られた、赤や黒などの色が美しい観賞用の魚。

cards.ja: 金魚のふるさとは中国で、日本に伝わったのは室町時代のことだとされる。当初は貴族や武士だけが楽しめるぜいたく品だったが、江戸時代になると養殖が広がり、庶民の間でも飼われるようになった。夏の縁日でおなじみの金魚すくいも、この頃に始まったといわれている。
cards.en: The goldfish's homeland is China, and it is said to have been brought to Japan in the Muromachi period. At first it was a luxury that only aristocrats and samurai could enjoy, but in the Edo period breeding spread and ordinary people began keeping them too. Goldfish scooping, a familiar sight at summer fairs, is also said to have started around this time.

words.defJa: 中に何も入っていない、からの状態であることを表す。

cards.ja: 雨の夜の駅前で、空車のタクシーを見つけるのはなかなか難しい。最近は配車アプリを開けば、近くを走る車の位置や到着までの時間が、地図上にリアルタイムで表示される。運転手にとっても、客を探して街を流す時間が減り、燃料の節約につながっている。一方で、アプリを使わない高齢者にとっては、流しのタクシーを拾いにくくなったという声もある。
cards.en: On a rainy night in front of the station, finding a vacant taxi is quite difficult. These days, if you open a ride-hailing app, the locations of nearby cars and the time until they arrive are shown on a map in real time. For drivers, too, it cuts down the time spent cruising the streets for passengers, which leads to fuel savings. On the other hand, some say it has become harder for elderly people who do not use the app to hail a cruising taxi.

words.defJa: 二で割り切れる整数。

cards.ja: 結婚式のご祝儀では、万円単位で偶数になる金額は縁起が悪いとされてきた。夫婦の縁が切れることを連想させるからだ。ただし、末広がりを意味する八や、一対と考えられる二万円は、例外として受け入れられることも多い。地域や世代によって考え方には差があり、迷ったら年長者に相談するのが無難だ。
cards.en: With the cash gifts given at weddings, amounts that are even multiples of ten thousand yen have traditionally been considered unlucky, because they suggest the couple's bond being split. However, eight, which signifies ever-widening prosperity, and twenty thousand yen, which can be seen as a pair, are often accepted as exceptions. Views differ by region and generation, so if in doubt, it is safest to ask an elder.

words.defJa: 現実には起こりそうにないことを、頭の中で自由に思い描くこと。

cards.ja: 空想は、しばしば現実から目をそらす無駄な時間だと見なされる。だが、空を飛ぶ機械も月への旅も、最初は誰かの空想にすぎなかった。現実にないものを思い描く力がなければ、人は今ある世界を変えようとさえ思わないだろう。空想と現実の距離を測り続けることこそが、人間の創造の営みなのかもしれない。
cards.en: Fantasy is often regarded as wasted time, a way of looking away from reality. Yet flying machines and journeys to the moon were at first nothing more than someone's fantasy. Without the power to picture what does not exist, people would not even think of changing the world as it is. Perhaps it is precisely this ongoing measuring of the distance between fantasy and reality that makes up human creativity.

words.defJa: 地面から離れた、空のなか。

cards.ja: ヨーロッパに生息するアマツバメの仲間は、一生の大半を空中で過ごす鳥として知られている。研究チームが小型の記録装置を取り付けて調べたところ、繁殖期以外の約十か月間、ほとんど地上に降りなかった個体もいた。餌となる虫も空中で捕らえ、眠るときでさえ飛び続けていると考えられている。
cards.en: A species of swift that lives in Europe is known as a bird that spends most of its life in the air. When a research team attached small data loggers to study them, some individuals hardly touched down at all during the roughly ten months outside the breeding season. They also catch the insects they feed on in midair, and are thought to keep flying even while they sleep.

cards.ja: 賃貸住宅では、壁に釘を打つことを契約で禁じている場合が多い。守らなければ、退去するときに穴の修繕費を請求されることもある。そこで最近は、画びょうほどの小さな穴しか残らないフックや、はがせる粘着テープを使って、絵を飾ったり小さな棚を取り付けたりする人が増えている。ホームセンターにも、こうした商品を集めた売り場が目立つようになった。
cards.en: In rented housing, the lease often prohibits hammering nails into the walls. Break that rule, and you may be charged for repairing the holes when you move out. So these days more and more people hang pictures or put up small shelves using hooks that leave only a thumbtack-sized hole, or adhesive tape that peels off cleanly. Home improvement stores, too, now commonly have whole sections devoted to such products.

cards.en: When an AI makes sense of a text, it first processes it by dividing the sentences into small units called “tokens.” In English the spaces between words serve as a guide to where the breaks fall, but Japanese has no such markers. So where the text is cut changes how the meaning is read, and also affects how efficiently it is processed. Designing this segmentation is essential to building AI that handles Japanese well.

words.defJa: 髪をとかしたり整えたりするのに使う、細い歯が並んだ道具。

cards.ja: 日本では古くから、櫛は髪を整えるだけの道具ではなかった。神話にも登場し、身を守る力が宿るものと考えられていたのである。江戸時代になると、漆を塗ったり金で模様を描いたりした美しい櫛が、女性の髪を飾る装身具として流行した。こうした細工を受け継ぐ職人は、今では数えるほどしかいない。
cards.en: In Japan, since ancient times, the comb has been more than just a tool for tidying hair. It appears in myths and was believed to hold a power that protected the person who carried it. By the Edo period, beautiful combs coated with lacquer or painted with gold designs had become fashionable as ornaments worn in women's hair. Today only a handful of craftspeople still carry on this kind of fine work.

words.meaning: great pains; painstaking effort (to work something out)
words.defJa: よい方法や結果を得ようと、あれこれ考えて努力すること。

cards.ja: 研究チームは長年、深海の生き物を生きたまま船の上まで運ぶ方法に苦心してきた。水深数千メートルの強い水圧から急に解放されると、多くの生物は体を傷めてしまうからだ。チームは水圧を保ったまま引き上げられる特殊な容器を考案し、試作を何度も重ねた。その苦心が実り、昨年ついに生きた状態での観察に成功した。
cards.en: For years the research team struggled to find a way to bring deep-sea creatures up onto the ship alive. Suddenly released from the intense pressure thousands of meters down, many organisms suffer damage to their bodies. The team devised a special container that could be raised while keeping the water pressure constant, and built prototype after prototype. Their painstaking efforts paid off last year, when they finally succeeded in observing the creatures alive.

cards.en: Metal scrap from factories and demolition sites used to take enormous effort to sort by type. That is because iron, aluminum, copper and other metals are collected all mixed together. Recently, machines have appeared that identify materials with cameras and AI and sort them automatically. If the scrap can be reused as high-purity raw material, it will also help reduce the amount of metal that has to be imported.

cards.en: Many people who start learning the piano struggle because they cannot move their ring finger the way they want. The ring finger is connected to the middle and little fingers by tendons, so when you try to lift it on its own, the neighboring fingers get pulled along and move too. Even among professional pianists, many never skip their daily exercises to strengthen this finger. The only way to make up for this structural weakness of the hand is patient, repetitive practice.

words.defJa: かたいものが強い力を受けて、こなごなに割れる。

cards.ja: 高い山の斜面に、角ばった石が一面に転がっているのを見たことがあるだろうか。岩の割れ目にしみ込んだ水は、夜になると凍って膨らみ、内側から岩を押し広げる。昼に氷が解け、夜にまた凍るということが何年も繰り返されるうちに、硬い岩もやがて砕けてしまうのだ。こうして生まれた石が、少しずつ斜面を転がり落ちて積もっていく。
cards.en: Have you ever seen a high mountain slope covered all over with angular stones? Water that seeps into cracks in the rock freezes at night and expands, forcing the rock apart from within. As the ice melts by day and freezes again at night, year after year, even hard rock eventually breaks into pieces. The stones produced this way gradually tumble down the slope and pile up.

cards.ja: 冬になると唇がすぐに荒れてしまうのには、はっきりとした理由がある。唇の皮膚はほかの部分に比べて非常に薄く、水分の蒸発を防ぐ皮脂を分泌するしくみもほとんど備わっていない。そのため空気が乾燥すると、たちまち水分が奪われてしまうのだ。唇が赤く見えるのも、薄い皮膚を通して血管の色が透けているからである。
cards.en: There is a clear reason why lips get chapped so easily in winter. The skin of the lips is extremely thin compared with other parts of the body, and it has almost no means of secreting the sebum that keeps moisture from evaporating. So when the air turns dry, the moisture is quickly drawn away. The lips look red, too, because the color of the blood vessels shows through the thin skin.

words.defJa: 唇に塗って色をつけるための化粧品。

cards.ja: 江戸時代の女性が使った口紅は、紅花の花びらから作られていた。大量の花からわずかしか取れないため、紅は「金と同じ価値がある」と言われるほど高価だった。質のよい紅を何度も重ねて塗ると、唇は赤ではなく、緑がかった玉虫色に光る。この輝きは当時、おしゃれな女性たちの間で大流行したという。
cards.en: The lipstick used by women in the Edo period was made from safflower petals. Because only a tiny amount could be obtained from a huge quantity of flowers, the rouge was so expensive that it was said to be “worth its weight in gold.” When good-quality rouge was applied in layer after layer, the lips shone not red but an iridescent greenish color. This sheen is said to have been all the rage among fashionable women of the time.

words.defJa: 物をそれぞれの人に分けて渡す。

cards.ja: 大きな災害が起きると、避難所では食料や水を配る作業が欠かせない。しかし、物資が届いても、誰に何をどれだけ渡すかを決めるのは簡単ではない。アレルギーのある人や乳幼児、高齢者など、必要なものは人によって大きく異なるからだ。最近は、事前に住民の情報を登録しておき、必要な物資を素早く届ける仕組みを整える自治体も出てきた。
cards.en: When a major disaster strikes, handing out food and water is an essential task at evacuation shelters. Yet even when supplies arrive, deciding what to give to whom, and how much, is not simple. That is because what people need varies widely, from those with allergies to infants and the elderly. Recently some local governments have begun setting up systems that register residents' information in advance so that the necessary supplies can be delivered quickly.

words.defJa: よい方法を考え出すこと。また、その考え出した方法。

cards.ja: ある小学校では、算数の授業にトランプやすごろくを取り入れている。子どもたちが遊びながら自然に計算に親しめるよう、担任の教員が工夫を重ねてきたのだ。以前は計算問題を嫌がっていた子も、今では自分で問題を作り、友達と出し合うようになった。教え方を少し変えるだけで、学ぶ意欲は大きく変わる。
cards.en: At one elementary school, playing cards and board games are used in math classes. The homeroom teacher has kept devising ways for the children to get comfortable with calculation naturally while they play. Children who once hated arithmetic problems now make up problems of their own and quiz one another. Changing the way something is taught even a little can make a big difference in the desire to learn.

words.defJa: ある基準によって、全体をいくつかに分けること。また、分けたまとまり。

cards.ja: 電動キックボードは、以前は原付バイクと同じ区分に入っていた。2023年7月の法改正で、最高速度が時速20キロ以下などの条件を満たすものは新たな区分とされ、16歳以上であれば免許がなくても運転できるようになった。一方、ヘルメットの着用は努力義務にとどまっている。手軽になった分、交通ルールを知らないまま乗る人が目立つという指摘もある。
cards.en: Electric kick scooters used to fall into the same category as mopeds. Under a legal amendment in July 2023, those meeting conditions such as a top speed of 20 km/h or less were placed in a new category, and anyone aged 16 or over can now ride one without a license. Wearing a helmet, on the other hand, is still only encouraged rather than required. Some point out that because riding has become so easy, many people ride without knowing the traffic rules.

words.defJa: いくつかのものを合わせて、ひとまとまりにすること。また、そのまとまり。

cards.ja: 和食のだしに昆布とかつお節を一緒に使うのには、科学的な理由がある。昆布のうま味成分とかつお節のうま味成分は種類が異なり、両方が合わさると、うま味が何倍にも強く感じられるのだ。この組み合わせの効果は「うま味の相乗効果」と呼ばれ、トマトと肉を煮込むミートソースなど、洋食の定番にも見られる。料理人たちは経験から、この法則を知っていたことになる。
cards.en: There is a scientific reason why kombu and katsuobushi are used together in Japanese dashi stock. The umami compounds in kombu and those in katsuobushi are of different kinds, and when the two come together, the umami tastes several times stronger. The effect of this combination is called the “synergistic effect of umami,” and it can be seen in Western staples as well, such as meat sauce made by simmering tomatoes with meat. In other words, cooks knew this principle from experience.

words.defJa: すんだことを、ああすればよかったと残念に思う。

cards.ja: 人は長い目で見ると、「したこと」より「しなかったこと」を悔やむ傾向があるという。ある心理学の研究では、人生で最も後悔していることを尋ねると、挑戦しなかった経験を挙げる人が多かった。失敗した行動の記憶は時間とともに意味づけが変わるが、行動しなかった後悔は、ありえた可能性として心に残り続けるためだと考えられている。迷ったときは、一歩踏み出してみる価値がありそうだ。
cards.en: It is said that, in the long run, people tend to regret what they didn't do more than what they did. In one psychology study, when people were asked what they regretted most in their lives, many named challenges they had never taken on. This is thought to be because the memory of an action that failed takes on new meaning over time, while regret over not acting stays in the mind as a possibility that might have been. When in doubt, it may be worth taking a step forward.

cards.ja: 新入社員の研修で、多くの企業が時間を割いているのが敬語の指導だ。学生時代はアルバイト先で決まった言い回しを覚えれば足りたが、取引先とのやり取りでは、相手や場面に応じた使い分けが求められる。ただ、丁寧にしようとするあまり、敬語を重ねすぎて不自然になる例も少なくない。大切なのは形よりも、相手への配慮が伝わるかどうかである。
cards.en: In training for new employees, one thing many companies devote time to is instruction in honorific language. As students, they could get by at their part-time jobs by memorizing set phrases, but dealings with business partners require choosing the right forms for each person and situation. Yet in many cases, people trying too hard to be polite pile up honorifics until they sound unnatural. What matters is not the form but whether consideration for the other person comes across.

cards.ja: 家庭やオフィスで長く使われてきた蛍光灯が、姿を消そうとしている。水銀による環境汚染を防ぐための国際条約で、一般照明用の蛍光灯の製造と輸出入が2027年末までに禁止されることが決まったからだ。国内のメーカーもすでに生産の縮小を進めている。省エネ性能の高いLED照明への切り替えは、今後さらに加速しそうだ。
cards.en: The fluorescent lights long used in homes and offices are about to disappear. That is because, under an international treaty to prevent environmental pollution from mercury, it has been decided that the manufacture, import and export of fluorescent lamps for general lighting will be banned by the end of 2027. Domestic manufacturers are already scaling back production. The switch to energy-efficient LED lighting looks set to accelerate further.

words.defJa: ものごとを表したり行ったりするときの、決まった型ややり方。

cards.ja: ニュースを伝える形式は、この十年で大きく変わった。かつてはアナウンサーが原稿を読み上げるのが当たり前だったが、今では記者同士が語り合う音声番組や、短い動画で要点だけを伝える形式が若い世代に支持されている。一方で、情報を分かりやすくしようとするほど、複雑な背景が省かれてしまうという懸念もある。
cards.en: The format in which news is delivered has changed greatly over the past decade. It used to be taken for granted that an announcer would read out a script, but now audio programs in which reporters talk things over with each other, and formats that convey only the key points in short videos, are popular with the younger generation. On the other hand, there is concern that the harder one tries to make information easy to understand, the more its complex background gets left out.

cards.ja: 18世紀半ばまで、海の上で船の経度を正確に知ることは極めて難しかった。緯度は太陽や星の高さから求められるが、経度を知るには、出発地との時刻の差を正確に測る必要があったからだ。揺れる船の上でも狂わない時計が完成したことで、この問題はようやく解決に向かった。航海の安全は、時計職人の技術に支えられていたのである。
cards.en: Until the mid-18th century, it was extremely difficult to know a ship's longitude accurately at sea. Latitude could be found from the height of the sun or stars, but finding longitude required precisely measuring the time difference from the place of departure. The problem finally began to be solved when a clock was completed that kept accurate time even on a rolling ship. The safety of voyages, in other words, rested on the skill of clockmakers.

cards.en: Today's birds are thought to be creatures descended from the dinosaur lineage. That is because fossils of feathered dinosaurs have been found one after another in China and elsewhere, and their skeletal features have turned out to closely resemble those of birds. In other words, descendants of the dinosaurs that survived the mass extinction about 66 million years ago are still flying in the sky today. Even the sparrows in the garden, if you trace them back, lead to the dinosaurs.

words.defJa: 騎手を乗せた馬を走らせて速さを競うレース。また、その勝ち負けを予想してお金をかけるもの。

cards.ja: 競馬というと賭け事の印象が強いが、競技としての奥深さに魅力を感じるファンも多い。馬の血統や体調、騎手の判断、さらにはコースの状態まで、勝敗を左右する要素は数え切れない。近年は、引退した競走馬の第二の人生を支える取り組みにも関心が集まっている。レースを支える人や馬の物語を知ると、見方が大きく変わるだろう。
cards.en: Horse racing is strongly associated with gambling, but many fans are drawn to its depth as a sport. The horse's bloodline and condition, the jockey's judgment, even the state of the track: the factors that decide who wins are countless. In recent years, attention has also been growing to efforts that support retired racehorses in their second lives. Learning the stories of the people and horses behind the races will greatly change the way you see them.

cards.enTarget: Horse racing is strongly associated with gambling, but many fans are drawn to its depth as a sport.

words.defJa: ものの性質や状態を表し、言い切りの形が「い」で終わる言葉。

cards.ja: 日本語の形容詞は、英語とは違ってそれ自体が活用し、過去や否定を表すことができる。「高い」は「高かった」「高くない」と形を変え、動詞と同じように、文の終わりに置くだけで述語になるのだ。英語を母語とする学習者は、この点に最初は戸惑うことが多い。ただ、仕組みさえ分かれば、「寒い」「おいしかった」と一言で文を言い切れる便利さに気づくはずだ。
cards.en: Unlike English adjectives, Japanese adjectives inflect by themselves and can express the past or the negative. Takai ('high, expensive') changes form to takakatta and takakunai, and, just like a verb, it becomes the predicate simply by being placed at the end of a sentence. Learners whose native language is English are often puzzled by this at first. Once they grasp how it works, though, they should come to appreciate how handy it is to finish a sentence with a single word, such as samui ('it's cold') or oishikatta ('it was delicious').

cards.enTarget: Unlike English adjectives, Japanese adjectives inflect by themselves and can express the past or the negative.

words.defJa: 性質や状態を表し、言い切りの形が「だ」で終わる言葉。

cards.ja: 「静かだ」「きれいだ」のような言葉は、学校の国語では形容動詞と呼ばれている。性質を表す点は形容詞と同じだが、「だ」で終わり、活用の仕方も異なるため、別の品詞として扱われてきた。一方、外国人向けの日本語教育では「な形容詞」と呼ぶのが一般的だ。同じ言葉でも、教える相手によって分類の仕方が変わるのは興味深い。
cards.en: Words like shizuka da ('quiet') and kirei da ('pretty') are called keiyō-dōshi, or adjectival verbs, in Japanese classes at school. They are like adjectives in that they describe qualities, but because they end in da and conjugate differently, they have been treated as a separate part of speech. In Japanese-language teaching for foreigners, by contrast, it is common to call them 'na-adjectives.' It is interesting that the same words are classified differently depending on whom they are taught to.

words.meaning: surgery (as a medical field); surgical department
words.defJa: けがや病気を、手術によって治す医学の分野。

cards.ja: 外科医を目指す若い医師が減り続けている。手術は長時間に及ぶうえ、緊急の呼び出しも多く、心身への負担が大きいからだ。2024年からは医師の残業時間に上限が設けられたが、人手が足りない病院では、一人ひとりの負担がかえって重くなったという声もある。手術の一部を補助するロボットの導入など、働き方を変える取り組みが急がれている。
cards.en: The number of young doctors aiming to become surgeons keeps falling. Operations run for many hours, emergency call-outs are frequent, and the physical and mental strain is heavy. A cap on doctors' overtime was introduced in 2024, but some say that at understaffed hospitals the burden on each person has actually grown heavier. Efforts to change how surgeons work, such as introducing robots that assist with parts of operations, are urgently needed.

cards.en: Among high-end Western fashion brands, a move to stop selling products made with animal fur is spreading. That is because concern for animal welfare has grown and resistance to wearing fur has strengthened, especially among young consumers. In its place, artificial materials so good that they are indistinguishable from the real thing are being developed. Some, however, question the environmental impact of petroleum-based materials.

words.defJa: 数や量が、短い間に急にひどく増えること。

cards.ja: この三十年ほどの間に、全国の山林でニホンジカの数が激増した。狩猟をする人が高齢化で減ったことや、雪の少ない冬が増えて冬を越せるシカが多くなったことが原因とされる。シカが木の皮や若い芽を食べ尽くした結果、森の下草が失われ、大雨のたびに土砂が流れ出す場所も出てきた。各地で捕獲が強化されているが、一度荒れた森が元に戻るには長い年月がかかる。
cards.en: Over the past thirty years or so, the number of sika deer in mountain forests across the country has soared. The causes are said to include a decline in hunters as they grow older, and winters with less snow that allow more deer to survive. As the deer stripped bark and ate up young shoots, forest undergrowth disappeared, and in some places soil now washes away with every heavy rain. Culling has been stepped up in many areas, but once a forest has been degraded, it takes many years to recover.

words.meaning: getting off (a train or bus), alighting
words.defJa: 電車やバスなどの乗り物から降りること。

cards.ja: 長い距離を列車で旅するなら、あえて途中の駅で下車してみるのも楽しい。乗車券の種類や区間によっては、目的地までの切符を持ったまま途中で改札を出て、また旅を続けることができる。降りたことのない町を歩いてみると、地元の食堂や古い商店街など、思いがけない出会いがある。急ぐ旅では味わえない発見が、そこには待っている。
cards.en: If you are traveling a long distance by train, it can be fun to deliberately get off at a station along the way. Depending on the type of ticket and the route, you can leave the station partway with the ticket to your destination still in hand, then carry on with your journey. Walk around a town where you have never got off before, and you may stumble on unexpected finds, such as a local diner or an old shopping street. Discoveries you could never make on a hurried trip are waiting there.

words.meaning: the 21st through the end of a month; late (in the month)
words.defJa: 一か月を三つに分けたうちの、二十一日から月末までの期間。

cards.en: The rainy season usually reaches the Indian capital, Delhi, in late June. In the weeks before that, temperatures can top 45 degrees on some days, and people eagerly await the rains. Once the rainy season begins the heat eases, but then flooded roads and traffic chaos become part of daily life. Even so, as the blessed rain that farming depends on, the monsoon still carries a special meaning.

words.defJa: 家庭や工場などから流れ出る、使ったあとの汚れた水。また、それを流すしくみ。

cards.ja: 下水を調べることで、地域の感染症の流行をいち早く知ろうとする取り組みが広がっている。感染した人の便には、症状が出る前からウイルスが含まれていることがあるからだ。下水処理場で定期的に水を採って分析すれば、病院に患者が増える数日前に、流行の兆しをつかめる可能性がある。個人を特定せずに地域全体の状況を把握できる点も、利点とされる。
cards.en: Efforts are spreading to detect outbreaks of infectious disease in a community as early as possible by testing sewage. That is because the stool of infected people can contain the virus even before symptoms appear. By regularly sampling and analyzing water at sewage treatment plants, it may be possible to catch signs of an outbreak several days before patients start to increase at hospitals. Another advantage is that the situation of a whole area can be grasped without identifying individuals.

In the second half they are assigned to actual workplaces and learn the job by working alongside senior staff. According to the HR department, the bonds they form with fellow recruits during this period also matter a great deal.

The question is whether society can provide ways for people to retrain as things change.

cards.en: In 1960s Japan, serious pollution spread across the country in the shadow of rapid industrialization. Toxic substances flowing from factories contaminated rivers and seas, and many residents suffered damage to their health. As the voices of victims grew louder, the government set about putting laws in place to protect the environment. Those lessons are still applied in the environmental policies of many countries today.

After each session, people reportedly gather around the lecturer with endless questions.

cards.en: In mid-nineteenth-century London, cholera outbreaks repeatedly claimed many lives. One physician marked each house where someone had died on a map and pinpointed that the victims were clustered around a single communal well. The idea of public health, which treats disease not as an individual's misfortune but as a problem society as a whole must prevent, also took root on the accumulation of research like this.

That is because many people worry that a strong scent will bother those around them on packed trains or in cramped offices. Recently, more shops stock products with toned-down scents or recommend applying just a little to the wrists. The preference seems to be not for a scent that asserts itself but for one you notice faintly only when you come close.

words.defJa: まっすぐに進む光のすじ。

cards.ja: 夕焼けが赤く見えるのは、太陽の光線が大気の中を長い距離進むためだ。光は空気の分子などの小さな粒にぶつかると、あちこちに散らばる性質があり、青い光ほどその影響を受けやすい。夕方は太陽が低い位置にあるため、光が大気を通る道のりが長くなり、青い光の多くは途中で散らばって私たちの目まで届かなくなる。その結果、散らばりにくい赤やオレンジの光が主に目に届き、空が赤く染まって見えるのである。
cards.en: Sunsets look red because the sun's rays travel a long distance through the atmosphere. When light hits tiny particles such as air molecules, it tends to scatter in all directions, and blue light is particularly affected. In the evening the sun is low in the sky, so the path light takes through the atmosphere is longer, and much of the blue light scatters along the way and never reaches our eyes. As a result, it is mainly the red and orange light, which scatters less readily, that reaches us, and the sky looks dyed red.

words.defJa: 建物の階がたくさん重なっていて、高いこと。

cards.ja: 湾岸地域では、ここ十年で高層マンションが次々と建てられた。眺めのよさや駅への近さが人気を集め、上の階ほど価格が高く設定されている。一方で、地震で停電した際にはエレベーターが止まり、上の階に住む高齢者が外に出られなくなった例も報告されている。住まいを選ぶ際には、災害時の備えも確かめておきたい。
cards.en: In the waterfront area, high-rise condominiums have gone up one after another over the past decade. Their fine views and closeness to stations have made them popular, and the higher the floor, the higher the price. On the other hand, there have been reports of elevators stopping when an earthquake knocked out the power, leaving elderly residents on upper floors unable to get outside. When choosing a home, you'll want to check how it is prepared for disasters too.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: In the waterfront area, high-rise condominiums have gone up one after another over the past decade.

words.defJa: 決まった順番で、仕事や役目を入れかわること。

cards.ja: この工場では、生産ラインを二十四時間止めないよう、従業員が三交替制で働いている。夜勤明けの作業員は、次の班に機械の状態や注意点を細かく引き継いでから帰宅する。生活が不規則になりやすく、体調を崩す人も少なくないため、会社は最近、仮眠用の個室を新たに設けた。人手不足の中、長く働き続けられる環境づくりが課題になっている。
cards.en: At this factory, employees work in three rotating shifts so that the production line never stops, twenty-four hours a day. Workers coming off the night shift hand over the condition of the machines and points to watch out for in detail to the next crew before going home. Because their lives easily become irregular and quite a few fall ill, the company recently set up new private rooms for napping. Amid the labor shortage, creating an environment where people can keep working for the long term has become a challenge.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: At this factory, employees work in three rotating shifts so that the production line never stops, twenty-four hours a day.

words.defJa: ある人や物が退いて、ほかの人や物がその役目につくこと。

cards.ja: 後半二十分、監督は疲れの見えたエースを下げ、高校を卒業したばかりの新人を投入した。この大胆な選手交代に、スタンドからはどよめきが起きた。新人は投入からわずか五分後、相手守備の隙を突いて同点ゴールを決めた。試合後、監督は「練習での姿を見て、必ずやってくれると信じていた」と笑顔で語った。
cards.en: Twenty minutes into the second half, the coach pulled his visibly tired ace and sent on a rookie fresh out of high school. This bold substitution set off a stir in the stands. Just five minutes after coming on, the rookie exploited a gap in the opposing defense and scored the equalizer. After the match, the coach said with a smile, "Seeing how he played in practice, I believed he would come through for sure."

words.defJa: 田や畑など、作物を育てるために耕している土地。

cards.ja: 農家の高齢化が進む中、各地で使われなくなった耕地が増えている。一度放置された田畑は数年で雑草や低木に覆われ、元に戻すには大きな手間と費用がかかる。こうした土地を若い就農者に貸し出す仕組みを整えた町では、新たに野菜作りを始める人が少しずつ増えてきた。食料を自給する力を保つうえでも、耕地をどう守るかは重要な問題である。
cards.en: As farmers grow older, farmland that has fallen out of use is increasing across the country. Fields that are once abandoned are covered with weeds and shrubs within a few years, and restoring them takes a great deal of labor and money. In towns that have set up systems for leasing such land to young people entering farming, the number of people newly starting to grow vegetables has gradually risen. How to protect arable land is also an important question for keeping the capacity to be self-sufficient in food.

cards.enTarget: As farmers grow older, farmland that has fallen out of use is increasing across the country.

words.defJa: 電車やバス、飛行機など、人や物を運ぶための乗り物やしくみ。

cards.ja: 台風の接近に伴い、鉄道各社はあすの始発から計画運休を実施すると発表した。空の便も多くが欠航となる見通しで、主要な交通機関はほぼ終日止まることになる。観光地では予定を切り上げて帰路につく旅行者の姿が見られ、駅の窓口には長い列ができた。気象庁は、不要不急の外出を控えるよう呼びかけている。
cards.en: With a typhoon approaching, the railway companies announced that they will carry out planned suspensions of service from the first trains tomorrow. Many flights are also expected to be cancelled, so the major means of transportation will be halted for almost the entire day. At tourist spots, travelers could be seen cutting their plans short and heading home, and long lines formed at station ticket counters. The Japan Meteorological Agency is urging people to avoid going out unless it is necessary.

cards.enTarget: Many flights are also expected to be cancelled, so the major means of transportation will be halted for almost the entire day.

words.defJa: 程度や等級が高いこと。

cards.ja: 多くの国で、大学などの高等教育を受ける人の割合は年々高まっている。一方で、学費の上昇により、卒業後も長く奨学金の返済に追われる若者が少なくない。教育を個人への投資と見るか、社会全体の財産と見るかによって、費用を誰が負担すべきかの答えは変わってくる。ある国では授業料を無償化したが、財源をどう確保するかで議論が続いている。
cards.en: In many countries, the proportion of people receiving higher education at universities and similar institutions is rising year by year. Meanwhile, because of rising tuition, quite a few young people are still burdened with repaying student loans long after graduating. The answer to who should bear the cost changes depending on whether education is seen as an investment in the individual or as an asset of society as a whole. One country made tuition free, but debate continues over how to secure the funding.

cards.enTarget: In many countries, the proportion of people receiving higher education at universities and similar institutions is rising year by year.

words.meaning: joint, combined (of separate groups acting together)
words.defJa: 二つ以上の団体などが一つにまとまって、いっしょに物事を行うこと。

cards.ja: 部員の減少に悩む三つの中学校の吹奏楽部が、この夏、初めて合同で演奏会を開いた。それぞれの学校だけでは楽器のパートがそろわず、これまでは大きな曲に挑戦できなかったという。週末ごとに集まって練習を重ねるうちに、生徒たちは学校の垣根を越えて打ち解けていった。本番では、満員の客席から大きな拍手が送られた。
cards.en: This summer, the wind bands of three junior high schools struggling with shrinking membership held a joint concert for the first time. With only their own members, none of the schools could fill all the instrumental parts, so until now they had been unable to take on large pieces. As they gathered every weekend and rehearsed together, the students warmed to one another across school lines. At the concert itself, the packed audience gave them loud applause.

words.defJa: 中学校を卒業した人が進む、ふつう三年間の学校。

cards.ja: 日本では中学校までが義務教育だが、高等学校への進学率は九割を大きく超えている。そのため、高校に通うことは事実上当たり前のこととして受け止められている。近年は、通学の回数が少なく、インターネットで授業を受けられる通信制の高校を選ぶ生徒も増えてきた。学び方の選択肢が広がる中で、学校の役割そのものが問い直されている。
cards.en: In Japan, compulsory education ends with junior high school, yet the rate of going on to senior high school is well over ninety percent. As a result, attending high school is in practice taken for granted. In recent years, more students have chosen correspondence high schools, where they attend in person less often and can take classes online. As the options for how to learn widen, the very role of school is being questioned anew.

words.defJa: 世間の人々に向けて、情報や事実を広く発表すること。

cards.ja: 大手自動車メーカーは、ブレーキ部品に不具合が見つかったとして、約十万台のリコールを国に届け出たと公表した。不具合は社内の検査で判明したもので、現時点で事故の報告はないという。同社は対象となる車の所有者に通知を送り、無料で部品を交換する。専門家は、問題を早い段階で明らかにした姿勢を一定程度評価している。
cards.en: A major automaker announced that it had filed a recall of about 100,000 vehicles with the government after a defect was found in a brake component. The defect came to light in the company's own inspections, and so far no accidents have been reported. The company will send notices to the owners of the affected vehicles and replace the part free of charge. Experts give it some credit for disclosing the problem at an early stage.

words.defJa: 地中などで自然にできた、岩石のもとになる物質。

cards.ja: 河原の石をよく見ると、白や黒、きらきらと光るものなど、色の違う小さな粒が混じっていることに気づく。こうした粒の一つひとつが鉱物で、見た目の違う粒はたいてい種類も異なる。つまり多くの石は、一種類の物質ではなく、何種類もの鉱物が集まってできているのだ。どんな鉱物がどれだけ含まれているかは、その石がどこで、どのようにできたのかを知る手がかりになる。
cards.en: If you look closely at a stone from a riverbed, you notice small grains of different colors mixed together: white, black, some that glitter. Each of these grains is a mineral, and grains that look different are usually different kinds. In other words, most stones are made not of a single substance but of several kinds of minerals gathered together. Which minerals a stone contains, and how much of each, offers clues to where and how it formed.

words.defJa: 国や地方の役所などが行う、おおやけの仕事。

cards.ja: 知事は、海外出張中に私的な観光を行っていたとの報道を受け、きのう記者会見を開いた。会見では、日程はすべて公務であり、観光地には視察先へ向かう途中で立ち寄っただけだと説明した。しかし、県議会からは出張費の詳しい内訳を明らかにするよう求める声が上がっている。県は近く、旅程の記録を公開するとしている。
cards.en: Following reports that he had done some private sightseeing during an overseas business trip, the governor held a press conference yesterday. At the press conference, he explained that the entire itinerary was official business and that he had merely stopped at tourist spots on the way to the sites he was inspecting. However, members of the prefectural assembly are calling for him to disclose a detailed breakdown of the travel expenses. The prefecture says it will soon release the records of the trip's itinerary.

words.meaning: autumn colors, leaves turning red and yellow
words.defJa: 秋になって、木の葉が赤や黄色に色づくこと。

cards.ja: 今年は残暑が長引いた影響で、各地の紅葉が例年より一週間ほど遅れている。葉が赤く色づくには、朝晩の冷え込みがある程度続くことが欠かせない。気象の専門家によると、山の上のほうではようやく見頃を迎え始めたが、平地で色づくのは来月の中旬以降になりそうだという。観光地の旅館には、予約の時期を見直す客からの問い合わせが相次いでいる。
cards.en: This year, because the late-summer heat dragged on, the autumn colors in many areas are running about a week behind the usual. For leaves to turn red, it is essential that chilly mornings and evenings continue for a while. According to weather experts, higher up in the mountains the leaves are finally starting to reach their peak, but in the lowlands they probably won't color until mid next month or later. Inns at tourist spots are receiving a stream of inquiries from guests reconsidering when to book.

words.meaning: rationality, reasonableness (mostly in compounds meaning rational or streamlining)
words.defJa: 物事の筋道や理屈にかなっていること。

cards.ja: 経済学は長い間、人は自分の利益を最大にするように合理的に行動すると考えてきた。ところが実際には、セールの表示につられて不要な物を買ったり、目先の楽しみを優先して貯金を先延ばしにしたりする人は少なくない。こうした「ずれ」を心理学の手法で調べるのが行動経済学である。人間の判断には、思った以上に感情や習慣が入り込んでいるのだ。
cards.en: For a long time, economics assumed that people act rationally so as to maximize their own interests. In reality, however, quite a few people are lured by sale signs into buying things they don't need, or put off saving in favor of immediate pleasures. Behavioral economics is the field that uses the methods of psychology to study these "gaps." Emotions and habits creep into human judgment far more than we think.

words.defJa: 別々の流れや人のグループが、途中で一つになること。

cards.ja: 友人たちとの旅行に、仕事の都合で一日遅れて参加することになった。最終の新幹線で駅に着くと、先に到着していた仲間が改札の前で手を振って待っていてくれた。無事に合流したあとは、そのまま宿の近くの居酒屋へ向かい、前日の観光の話を聞きながら夜遅くまで語り合った。一人旅も悪くないが、やはり仲間と過ごす時間は格別だ。
cards.en: Because of work, I ended up joining a trip with friends a day late. When I reached the station on the last bullet train, the friends who had arrived earlier were waiting in front of the ticket gates, waving. Once we had met up safely, we went straight to a pub near the inn and talked late into the night while they told me about the previous day's sightseeing. Traveling alone isn't bad, but time spent with friends really is something special.

words.defJa: 法律や約束、薬などが持っている、はたらきや力。

cards.ja: 契約書に署名をしても、内容によっては法的な効力が認められない場合がある。たとえば、消費者に一方的に不利な条件や、法律で禁じられた行為を約束させる条項は無効とされることがある。また、未成年が親の同意なしに結んだ契約は、原則として後から取り消すことができる。サインをする前に、条文を一つずつ確かめる習慣をつけたい。
cards.en: Even if you sign a contract, depending on its content it may not be recognized as having legal force. For example, clauses that impose conditions one-sidedly unfavorable to the consumer, or that make someone promise to do something the law prohibits, may be deemed void. Also, a contract that a minor concluded without parental consent can generally be cancelled afterward. It's worth getting into the habit of checking each clause one by one before you sign.

words.defJa: 火に当てすぎて、物の表面を黒くしてしまう。

cards.ja: カレーを作るときは、玉ねぎをじっくり炒めるのが味の決め手になる。ただし、強火のまま目を離すと、鍋の底で焦がしてしまい、苦みが全体に広がる。料理研究家によれば、中火で少量の水を足しながら炒めれば、焦げつきを防ぎつつ短い時間で甘みを引き出せるという。このひと手間が、家庭のカレーの味をぐっと深くする。
cards.en: When you make curry, slowly sautéing the onions is the key to the flavor. But if you leave them on high heat and look away, you'll scorch them on the bottom of the pot, and the bitterness spreads through the whole dish. According to a cooking expert, if you sauté them over medium heat while adding a little water at a time, you can keep them from sticking and burning and draw out their sweetness in less time. That one extra step makes a home-cooked curry taste much deeper.

words.defJa: 一つの国をおさめる王。

cards.ja: 十八世紀の終わり、フランスは度重なる戦争で財政が行き詰まり、パンの値上がりに苦しむ民衆の不満も頂点に達していた。国王は新たな税への同意を取りつけようと、百七十年以上開かれていなかった身分制の議会を招集したが、議論はかえって身分間の対立を深める結果となった。やがて民衆が立ち上がり、絶対的な権力を誇った王政は崩れていく。この革命は、国の主権が国民にあるという考え方をヨーロッパ中に広めた。
cards.en: At the end of the eighteenth century, France's finances had been driven to the brink by repeated wars, and the discontent of a populace suffering from rising bread prices had also reached its peak. Seeking approval for new taxes, the king convened an assembly of the estates that had not met in more than 170 years, but the debate only deepened the conflict between the estates. Eventually the people rose up, and the monarchy, which had boasted absolute power, began to collapse. This revolution spread throughout Europe the idea that sovereignty lies with the people.

words.meaning: national, state-run (founded by the national government)
words.defJa: 国のお金でつくられ、国が運営していること。

cards.ja: ある国立博物館で、この秋、各地の寺に伝わる仏像を集めた特別展が開かれている。普段は堂の奥に安置され、間近で見ることのできない像も多く、平日でも入場を待つ列が途切れない。会場では照明に工夫が凝らされ、像の表情や衣のひだがくっきりと浮かび上がって見える。音声ガイドでは、それぞれの像が作られた時代の背景も紹介されている。
cards.en: This autumn, a national museum is holding a special exhibition that brings together Buddhist statues handed down at temples around the country. Many of the statues are normally enshrined deep inside temple halls and can't be seen up close, so even on weekdays the line to get in never lets up. The lighting in the galleries has been carefully worked out, so the statues' expressions and the folds of their robes stand out sharply. The audio guide also introduces the background of the period in which each statue was made.

words.meaning: thank you for your trouble, good work (said to someone who has worked or served)
words.defJa: 相手の働きや骨折りをねぎらうときに言うあいさつの言葉。

cards.ja: 職場でよく耳にする「ご苦労様です」を、目上の人に使ってよいのか迷う人は意外に多い。上の立場の人が下の人をねぎらう言葉とされ、部下が上司に言うのは失礼だと考えられているからだ。そのため、ビジネスの場では立場を問わず使える「お疲れ様です」が無難だとするマナー本が多い。もっとも、こうした使い分けが広まったのは比較的最近のことで、気にしないという人も少なくなく、受け止め方は世代によっても異なる。
cards.en: Surprisingly many people are unsure whether it is all right to say "gokurōsama desu," a phrase often heard at work, to someone above them. That is because it is said to be an expression for people in a higher position to thank those below them for their efforts, so for a subordinate to say it to a boss is considered rude. For that reason, many etiquette books say that in business settings "otsukaresama desu," which can be used regardless of rank, is the safe choice. Still, this distinction spread only fairly recently, quite a few people don't mind it, and how the phrase is received also differs from generation to generation.

words.meaning: to get burnt, to be scorched
words.defJa: 火に当たりすぎて、表面が黒く焼けてしまう。

cards.ja: パンを焼くと表面がきつね色になるのは、糖とたんぱく質が熱によって反応し、香ばしい成分が生まれるからだ。ところが、さらに加熱を続けると、成分が分解されて炭のようになり、黒く焦げてしまう。焦げた部分には苦みがあり、食べ過ぎは体によくないという説もある。おいしく焼き上げるには、温度と時間の見極めが肝心だ。
cards.en: When you toast bread, the surface turns golden brown because sugars and proteins react with the heat and produce aromatic compounds. But if you keep heating it, those compounds break down into something like charcoal, and the bread ends up burnt black. The burnt parts taste bitter, and some say that eating too much of them is bad for you. To toast bread just right, judging the temperature and time is essential.

words.meaning: to be numb with cold, to freeze (of a person or body)
words.defJa: 寒さのために体が冷えきって、思うように動かなくなる。

cards.ja: 冬山で道に迷ったときに最も恐ろしいのは、体温が下がり続ける低体温症である。体の芯まで冷えると、激しい震えが止まらなくなり、やがて判断力も鈍っていく。救助されたある登山者は、凍える指で何度もスマートフォンを操作し、ようやく位置情報を送ることができたと振り返る。専門家は、日帰りの登山でも防寒具と予備のバッテリーを必ず持つよう呼びかけている。
cards.en: When you get lost on a mountain in winter, the most frightening danger is hypothermia, in which body temperature keeps falling. Once you are chilled to the core, you shiver violently and can't stop, and eventually your judgment dulls as well. One climber who was rescued recalls working a smartphone again and again with freezing fingers until finally managing to send location data. Experts urge people to always carry warm gear and a spare battery, even on day hikes.

words.meaning: idea, clue (about something one may know of)
words.defJa: 思い当たること。それについて何か知っている、または見当がつくこと。

cards.ja: 駅の忘れ物センターには、毎日数百件の落とし物が届く。問い合わせの電話を受けると、担当者はまず、最後にその品を使った場所に心当たりがないかを尋ねる。多くの人は最初「まったく覚えていない」と答えるが、乗った電車の時刻や車両の位置を一緒にたどるうちに、記憶がよみがえることも少なくない。地道なやり取りが、持ち主の手元に品を戻す近道なのだという。
cards.en: Several hundred lost items arrive at the station's lost-and-found center every day. When staff take an inquiry call, they first ask whether the caller has any idea where they last used the item. Many people answer at first that they don't remember at all, but as they retrace together the time of the train they took and which car they rode in, the memory often comes back. These patient exchanges, staff say, are the shortest route to getting an item back into its owner's hands.

words.meaning: to know well, understand (how to do something); to be versed in
words.defJa: 物事のやり方や意味を十分に理解し、身につけている。

cards.ja: 老舗のすし店の主人は、魚ごとに最もおいしく食べられる時期をよく心得ている。同じマグロでも、とれてから数日寝かせたほうがうまみが増すものがあり、その見極めには長年の経験が欠かせない。客の食べる速さや好みを見ながら、握る順番を変えることもあるという。主人は「店に立つ限り、勉強に終わりはない」と笑う。
cards.en: The owner of a long-established sushi restaurant knows well when each fish is at its most delicious. Even with the same tuna, some fish gain more savory depth if left to rest for a few days after being caught, and judging this takes years of experience. He reportedly even changes the order in which he makes the sushi while watching how fast customers eat and what they like. "As long as I stand behind this counter, the learning never ends," he says with a laugh.

words.defJa: 人が座るための台やいす。

cards.ja: 山あいの無人駅には、木製の腰掛けが一つだけ置かれている。地元の住民が何十年も前に手作りしたもので、座面は長年の利用ですっかり丸みを帯びた。列車は一日に数本しか来ないが、待合室代わりのこの場所で、高校生や買い物帰りのお年寄りが言葉を交わす。鉄道会社はホームの改修工事の後も、この腰掛けを残すことに決めた。
cards.en: At an unstaffed station in the mountains, there is just one wooden bench. Local residents made it by hand decades ago, and its seat has been worn completely smooth and rounded by years of use. Only a few trains come each day, but in this spot that serves as a waiting room, high school students and elderly people on their way back from shopping chat with one another. The railway company decided to keep this bench even after renovating the platform.

cards.ja: 茶会に招かれた客は、茶室の庭に入るとまず、腰掛待合と呼ばれる屋根付きの腰掛で主人の迎えを待つ。そこで客同士が軽く会釈を交わし、日常の慌ただしさを少しずつ忘れていく。やがて主人が庭の門まで出てきて無言で一礼すると、客も立ち上がり、静かに礼を返す。わずか数分の待ち時間も、茶の湯では大切なもてなしの一部とされている。
cards.en: Guests invited to a tea gathering, on entering the tea-house garden, first wait for the host's welcome on a roofed bench known as the waiting bench. There the guests exchange light bows with one another and gradually let go of the bustle of daily life. Eventually, when the host comes out to the garden gate and bows in silence, the guests rise and quietly bow in return. In the tea ceremony, even these few minutes of waiting are considered an important part of hospitality.

cards.ja: 登山道の中腹にある見晴らし台で、年配の夫婦が岩に腰掛けて休んでいた。眼下には朝霧に包まれた町が広がり、遠くの海まで見渡せる。二人は毎週末この山に登っていて、水筒に入れてきた温かいお茶をここで飲むのが何よりの楽しみなのだという。山を下りる頃には、霧はすっかり晴れていた。
cards.en: At a lookout halfway up the hiking trail, an elderly couple was resting, seated on a rock. Below them spread a town wrapped in morning mist, and the view reached all the way to the distant sea. The two climb this mountain every weekend, and drinking the hot tea they bring in a flask here is said to be their greatest pleasure. By the time I came down the mountain, the mist had cleared completely.

cards.ja: 小学校に入学したばかりの子どもたちは、まず五十音を一字ずつ書く練習から始める。「あ」の丸みや「き」の横線の数など、大人には当たり前の形が、子どもにとっては意外に難しい。担任の教師は、文字を声に出して読みながら書くよう指導している。一学期が終わる頃には、ほとんどの子がひらがなで短い文を書けるようになる。
cards.en: Children who have just entered elementary school start by practicing writing the Japanese syllabary one character at a time. Shapes that adults take for granted, such as the curve of 'a' or the number of horizontal strokes in 'ki', are surprisingly hard for children. Their homeroom teacher tells them to read each character aloud as they write it. By the end of the first term, almost every child can write short sentences in hiragana.

cards.ja: 研究チームは、同じ森にすむニホンザルの群れを十年以上にわたって観察してきた。群れの中でも、新しい食べ物にすぐ手を出す個体と、なかなか近づかない個体がはっきり分かれるという。こうした性格の違いは、親から受け継がれる部分と、育った環境で決まる部分があるとみられる。チームは今後、遺伝子の解析も進める予定だ。
cards.en: A research team has been observing troops of Japanese macaques living in the same forest for more than ten years. Even within a troop, there is reportedly a clear split between individuals that readily reach for new foods and those that are slow to approach them. These differences in personality are thought to be partly inherited from parents and partly determined by the environment the monkeys grew up in. The team plans to move ahead with genetic analysis as well.

cards.ja: ある金融機関の調査によると、小学生が毎月受け取るお小遣いの平均額は、ここ十年ほとんど変わっていない。一方で、決まった額を渡すのではなく、家の手伝いに応じて金額を決める家庭が増えているという。専門家は、早いうちから自分でお金を管理する経験が、将来の金銭感覚を育てると指摘する。最近は、電子マネーでお小遣いを渡す親も珍しくなくなった。
cards.en: According to a survey by a financial institution, the average monthly allowance elementary school children receive has barely changed over the past ten years. Meanwhile, more households reportedly set the amount according to how much the child helps around the house rather than handing over a fixed sum. Experts point out that the experience of managing one's own money from an early age builds a sense of money for the future. Recently, parents who give an allowance in electronic money are no longer unusual.

words.defJa: 昔に書かれ、長い時代を経ても価値が認められている作品。

cards.ja: 高校の国語で古典を学ぶ意味は何か。この議論が起きるたびに、千年前の作品を読む時間は実用的な文章の学習に充てるべきだ、という声が上がる。だが、平安時代の物語や随筆に描かれた嫉妬や退屈、季節の移ろいを楽しむ心は、現代の読者にも驚くほど身近に感じられる。古典は、言葉が変わっても人の感情はそれほど変わらないことを教えてくれる。
cards.en: What is the point of studying the classics in high school Japanese class? Each time this debate comes up, voices argue that the time spent reading works from a thousand years ago should go to learning practical writing instead. Yet the jealousy and boredom, and the delight in the changing seasons, depicted in tales and essays of the Heian period feel surprisingly close even to modern readers. The classics teach us that even when language changes, human emotions do not change all that much.

words.meaning: to leave a message (with someone); to send something via someone
words.defJa: 直接会えない相手への伝言や品物を、ほかの人に頼んで届けてもらう。

cards.ja: 取引先を訪ねると、担当者はあいにく外出中だった。受付の人に、来週の打ち合わせの日程を変えてほしいと言付けて会社に戻ると、夕方には本人から電話がかかってきた。メールが当たり前になった今でも、こうした人づての伝言が意外なほど確実に届くことがある。人を介して伝えることで、用件の急ぎ具合まで伝わるのかもしれない。
cards.en: When I visited a client's office, the person in charge happened to be out. I left word with the receptionist that I wanted to change the date of next week's meeting, and after I got back to my office, the person called me that evening. Even now that email is the norm, a message passed along by word of mouth sometimes gets through surprisingly reliably. Perhaps conveying it through another person communicates even how urgent the matter is.

words.meaning: wording, way of speaking; choice of language
words.defJa: 話したり書いたりするときの、言い方や言葉の選び方。

cards.ja: 新入社員研修で、最も時間を割くのが電話応対での言葉遣いだ。社内の同僚同士なら自然な「了解です」も、取引先に対しては「承知しました」に言い換えるよう指導される。一方で、敬語を重ねすぎるとかえって不自然に聞こえるため、講師は「丁寧さよりも分かりやすさを優先してほしい」と話す。正しい形を覚えるだけでなく、相手との距離に合わせて使い分ける力が求められている。
cards.en: In new-employee training, the most time is spent on wording when handling phone calls. Trainees are taught that a casual "got it," natural between colleagues, should be rephrased as a more formal "understood" with clients. On the other hand, piling up honorifics can make speech sound unnatural, so the instructor says, "Please put clarity ahead of politeness." What is required is not just memorizing the correct forms but the ability to adjust one's speech to the distance between oneself and the other person.

words.meaning: long silence, failing to keep in touch for a long time
words.defJa: 長い間、訪ねたり連絡したりしないでいること。

cards.ja: 年賀状のやり取りだけが続いている恩師に、思い切って手紙を書いた。書き出しは「長らくご無沙汰しております」としたものの、その先がなかなか続かない。大学を出てからの二十年を数枚の便箋にまとめようとすると、何を書いても言い訳めいて見えるのだ。結局、近況を短く記し、一度お目にかかりたいと結んで投函した。
cards.en: I finally worked up the courage to write a letter to my former teacher, with whom I had exchanged nothing but New Year's cards. I opened with "Forgive me for having been out of touch for so long," but could not get much further. When I tried to fit the twenty years since leaving university onto a few sheets of letter paper, everything I wrote looked like an excuse. In the end, I described my recent life briefly, closed by saying I hoped to see him sometime, and mailed it.

cards.ja: 台風で三日間停電した地域の住民に話を聞くと、口をそろえて「あんな暮らしはもう御免だ」と言う。冷蔵庫の中身はすべて傷み、夜は懐中電灯の明かりだけで過ごした。その経験から、家庭用の蓄電池や太陽光パネルを導入する家が、この一年で目に見えて増えた。自治体も購入費の補助を拡充し、次の災害に備えている。
cards.en: When you talk to residents of the area that lost power for three days in the typhoon, they all say the same thing: "I never want to live like that again." Everything in their refrigerators spoiled, and they spent the nights with only flashlights for light. Because of that experience, the number of homes installing household batteries and solar panels has visibly increased over the past year. The local government has also expanded subsidies for the purchase costs, preparing for the next disaster.

cards.ja: 足の小指をたんすの角にぶつけ、思わずうずくまった経験のある人は多いだろう。小指は足の外側の端にあって家具に当たりやすいうえ、骨が細く衝撃を和らげる組織も少ないため、軽くぶつけただけでも鋭い痛みが走るのだ。整形外科医によると、数日たっても腫れや内出血が引かない場合は骨折している可能性もある。痛みが軽くなっても油断せず、早めに受診したほうがよいという。
cards.en: Many people have stubbed their little toe on the corner of a dresser and doubled over in pain. The little toe sits at the outer edge of the foot, where it easily strikes furniture, and its bones are thin with little tissue to cushion an impact, so even a light knock sends a sharp pain through it. According to an orthopedic surgeon, if the swelling or bruising has not gone down after several days, the toe may be broken. Even if the pain eases, it is best not to brush it off and to see a doctor early.

words.meaning: to hold back, suppress (an urge, tears, anger); to bear
words.defJa: 苦しさや感情が外に出ないように、がまんしておさえる。

cards.ja: 入社三年目の女性社員は、会議で自分の企画を頭ごなしに否定されたとき、反論したい気持ちをぐっと堪えた。その場で感情的に言い返せば、企画の中身ではなく態度が問題にされると分かっていたからだ。会議の後、彼女は上司に改めて時間をもらい、数字を示しながら冷静に説明し直した。翌週、企画は条件付きで採用されることになった。
cards.en: When her proposal was flatly dismissed in a meeting, a woman in her third year at the company held back her urge to argue. She knew that if she shot back emotionally on the spot, the issue would become her attitude rather than the substance of the proposal. After the meeting, she asked her manager for some time and calmly explained it again, backing it up with figures. The following week, the proposal was adopted with conditions.

words.defJa: 仕事や勉強の合間に、人の心を楽しませるもの。

cards.ja: テレビが一般家庭に普及する前、多くの人にとって最大の娯楽は映画だった。週末になると映画館の前には長い列ができ、ニュース映画で世の中の出来事を知る人も多かった。やがてテレビ、ゲーム、動画配信と娯楽の形は移り変わり、今では一人ひとりが手元の画面で好きなものを選ぶ時代になった。人々の限られた自由時間をめぐる奪い合いは、ますます激しくなっている。
cards.en: Before television spread into ordinary homes, the biggest form of entertainment for many people was the movies. Over time the forms of entertainment shifted from television to games to video streaming, and now we live in an age when each person picks what they like on the screen in their hand. The competition for people's limited free time is growing ever fiercer.

cards.ja: 雪が積もった朝、近所の公園では子どもたちが小さな雪玉を転がして、大きな雪だるまを作っていた。雪玉は転がすたびに周りの湿った雪をくっつけ、みるみる大きくなっていく。胴体が子どもの腰ほどの高さになると、今度は二人がかりで頭を持ち上げてのせる。完成した雪だるまには、拾ってきた枝で腕がつけられた。
cards.en: On a morning after a snowfall, children in the neighborhood park were rolling small snowballs to make a big snowman. cards.ja: 中学の理科では、斜面を転がる球の速さを測る実験を行う。一定時間ごとの球の位置を記録すると、球は下るにつれてどんどん速くなり、斜面が急なほど速さの増え方も大きいことが分かる。摩擦の小さい台車を使えば、結果はさらにはっきりする。生徒たちは、目で見た動きをグラフに表すことで、加速という考え方を実感していく。
cards.en: In junior high school science, students do an experiment measuring the speed of a ball rolling down a slope. Recording the ball's position at fixed time intervals shows that it moves faster and faster as it descends, and that the steeper the slope, the more quickly its speed increases. Using a cart with little friction makes the result even clearer. By turning the motion they see into graphs, students come to grasp the idea of acceleration firsthand.

cards.en: Indigo, long used as a dye that produces a deep navy blue, is said to have India as one of its places of origin. The English name "indigo" itself reportedly comes from a Greek word meaning "something from India." In the past, Indian indigo was carried across the sea to Europe and traded at high prices. In Japan, too, the deep navy of indigo-dyed cloth has long been a familiar color for common people's work clothes.

To achieve it, one policy after another has been rolled out to promote the adoption of renewable energy and the spread of electric vehicles. However, many challenges remain over upgrading the power grid and the burden of electricity bills. Experts say the government should lay out a concrete path for closing the gap between the goal and reality.

words.defJa: 性質の違うものがまじり合うこと。また、まぜ合わせること。

cards.ja: 卓球の混合ダブルスは、男女の選手が一組になって戦う種目だ。打球の速さや回転の質が異なる二人が交互に打つため、相手からすると球筋が読みにくいという強みがある。一方で、ペアの息が合わなければ、互いの動きを邪魔してしまう。そのため、強いペアほど練習以外の時間も共に過ごし、信頼関係を築いているという。
cards.en: Mixed doubles in table tennis is an event in which a male and a female player compete as a team. Because two players whose shots differ in speed and spin take turns hitting, the pair has the advantage that opponents find the ball's path hard to read. On the other hand, if the partners are not in sync, they end up getting in each other's way. That is why the strongest pairs reportedly spend time together outside practice as well, building mutual trust.

cards.ja: 使用済みのスマートフォンには、金や銀、レアメタルなどの貴重な資源が含まれている。国内で眠っている古い端末を回収し、これらの金属を再利用する取り組みが広がってきた。ただ、個人情報の流出を心配して、手放すのをためらう人も少なくない。回収業者は、データを確実に消去する手順を示し、利用者の不安を取り除こうとしている。
cards.en: Used smartphones contain valuable resources such as gold, silver and rare metals. Efforts to collect old devices lying unused in homes across the country and reuse these metals have been spreading. However, many people hesitate to part with them for fear that their personal information will leak. Collection companies are trying to remove users' worries by showing the steps they take to erase data reliably.

cards.en: In a shogi title match, a teenage player won a title at the youngest age in history. The game stretched over two days, and in the endgame it became a fierce battle in which both sides used up almost all their allotted time. The player reportedly attended study groups from a young age and began using AI in their research early on. In the shogi world, young players are coming to the fore one after another.

words.defJa: 学生や生徒として、その学校に籍を置いていること。

cards.ja: 大学在学中に起業する学生が増えている。授業の合間にアプリを開発し、卒業前に数千人の利用者を集めた例もある。大学側も、学内に共同の作業スペースを設けたり、卒業生の経営者を相談役として招いたりして後押しする。失敗しても学生のうちなら何度でもやり直せる、という考え方が広まりつつあるようだ。
cards.en: More and more students are starting businesses while still enrolled at university. In one case, a student developed an app between classes and gathered several thousand users before graduating. Universities are lending support too, setting up shared workspaces on campus and inviting alumni who run companies as advisers. The idea that as a student you can start over as many times as you like, even if you fail, seems to be spreading.

words.defJa: 国民の祝日を指す、くだけた言い方。もとは皇室の祭祀が行われた日を指した。また、神社などで祭りを行う日。

cards.ja: 年配の人の中には、国民の祝日を今でも「祭日」と呼ぶ人が少なくない。戦前は皇室の儀式が行われる日が祭日と定められ、その名残が言葉として残っているのだ。現在の法律に「祭日」という言葉はなく、正式には祝日という。店先の貼り紙にある「日・祭日休み」という表示も、少しずつ「日・祝休み」に置き換わりつつある。
cards.en: Quite a few older people still call national holidays "festival days." Before the war, days on which imperial rites were held were designated as festival days, and that legacy lives on in the language. The word does not appear in current law; the official term is "national holiday." Shop signs reading "closed Sundays and festival days" are also gradually being replaced with ones reading "closed Sundays and holidays."

words.defJa: 思いがけず身にふりかかる、不幸な出来事。

cards.ja: 海外旅行の初日に、空港で預けたスーツケースが行方不明になった。着替えも充電器もすべてその中に入っており、とんだ災難だと頭を抱えた。航空会社の窓口で手続きを済ませ、近くの店で歯ブラシや下着など最低限の日用品をそろえた。荷物がようやくホテルに届いたのは、帰国の前日のことだった。
cards.en: On the first day of a trip abroad, the suitcase I had checked at the airport went missing. My change of clothes, my charger, everything was inside it, and I held my head thinking what a disaster this was. I completed the paperwork at the airline's counter and bought the bare minimum of daily necessities, such as a toothbrush and underwear, at a nearby store. The bag finally reached my hotel the day before I flew home.

cards.ja: 服のボタンが取れたり裾がほつれたりすると、すぐに買い替えてしまう人が少なくない。そんな中、街の手芸店では大人向けの裁縫教室が人気を集めている。針と糸の扱い方から始めて、数回の講座で簡単な繕い物ができるようになるという。気に入った服を自分で直して長く着ることが、環境への配慮にもつながると受講者は話す。
cards.en: Many people buy replacements as soon as a button comes off or a hem frays. Against that backdrop, sewing classes for adults are gaining popularity at local craft shops. Starting with how to handle a needle and thread, participants reportedly become able to do simple mending after just a few sessions. Participants say that repairing clothes they love and wearing them for a long time is also a way of caring for the environment.

cards.en: This riverside town was once lined with lumber wholesalers, and logs cut from the mountains upstream were bound into rafts and floated down. As rail and truck transport spread, shipping by river ceased and the wholesalers disappeared one after another. Today the town's old houses still contain an abundance of the high-quality cedar and cypress brought down back then. Recently, moves have emerged to draw on these old streetscapes for tourism.

cards.ja: もらった花束を長く楽しみたいなら、ドライフラワーにする方法がある。茎を麻ひもで束ね、風通しのよい日陰に逆さにしてつるしておくだけでよい。こうすると花の重みで首が曲がらず、まっすぐな形のまま乾いていく。二週間ほどで色が落ち着き、部屋に飾れる状態になる。
cards.en: If you want to enjoy a bouquet you were given for a long time, one option is to turn it into dried flowers. All you have to do is tie the stems together with hemp string and hang them upside down in a well-ventilated, shady spot. This way the weight of the flowers doesn't bend their heads, and they dry while keeping a straight shape. In about two weeks the colors settle and they are ready to display in your room.
