words.defJa: 上下や順序などが、ふつうとは反対になっているようす。

cards.ja: カメラと同じように、目の水晶体を通った光は網膜の上に上下が逆さまの像を結ぶ。それでも私たちが景色を正しい向きで感じられるのは、脳がその信号を体の動きや触覚の情報と結びつけて解釈しているからだ。上下を反転させる眼鏡をかけ続けた古い実験では、数日もすると被験者が新しい見え方に慣れ、普通に歩けるようになったという。
cards.en: Just as in a camera, light passing through the lens of the eye forms an upside-down image on the retina. The reason we nonetheless perceive the scenery the right way up is that the brain interprets that signal by linking it with information from body movement and touch. In an old experiment in which subjects kept wearing glasses that flipped the view upside down, they reportedly got used to the new way of seeing within a few days and were able to walk normally.

words.defJa: 見えなくなった人や物を、見つけ出そうとしてあちこち調べる。

cards.ja: 山で行方が分からなくなった男性を捜すため、警察と消防は夜明けとともに約五十人態勢で活動を再開した。男性は三日前に一人で入山し、家族に夕方には戻ると連絡したのを最後に消息を絶っている。現場付近は霧が出やすく、ヘリコプターによる上空からの捜索は難航している。
cards.en: To search for a man who went missing in the mountains, police and firefighters resumed operations at dawn with about fifty personnel. The man entered the mountains alone three days ago, and nothing has been heard from him since he contacted his family to say he would be back by evening. Fog tends to form near the site, and the search from the air by helicopter is running into difficulties.

cards.ja: この町の酒造りの歴史は、江戸時代の初めにまで遡る。当時の記録によれば、川沿いに湧く良質な水を求めて、近隣の村から職人が集まってきたという。明治以降は鉄道の開通とともに販路が広がり、最盛期には三十を超える蔵が軒を連ねた。現在も残る蔵の一部は、資料館として一般に公開されている。
cards.en: The history of sake brewing in this town goes back to the beginning of the Edo period. According to records from the time, craftsmen gathered from neighboring villages in search of the high-quality water that springs up along the river. From the Meiji era onward, sales channels expanded with the opening of the railway, and at its peak more than thirty breweries stood side by side. Some of the breweries that remain today are open to the public as museums.

cards.en: Under the elevated tracks by the station, a dozen or so small bars where people gather after work stand in a row. Each place has only seven or eight seats at the counter, and customers who are strangers to one another sit shoulder to shoulder, nibbling on yakitori. Since word got out that this corner will be torn down for redevelopment, it has been packed every day lately with regulars sad to see it go.

Using a technique for stacking cells in three dimensions, they reportedly reproduced, on the inside of a tube less than one millimeter across, the same layered structure as a real blood vessel. It is hoped that this model will make it possible to examine the effects of new drugs on blood vessels without relying on animal testing.

cards.ja: 減塩を始めるなら、まず調味料を目分量で入れる習慣を見直したい。しょうゆを小さじで量ってみると、思っていたより多く使っていたことに気づく人が多いという。ひとさじ減らすだけでも、一日の塩分摂取量は確実に下がる。物足りなさは、レモンの酸味や香味野菜で補うとよい。
cards.en: If you are starting to cut down on salt, the first thing to rethink is the habit of adding seasonings by eye. Many people reportedly realize, when they measure their soy sauce with a teaspoon, that they had been using more than they thought. Cutting back by even a single spoonful reliably lowers your daily salt intake. Any lack of flavor can be made up for with the tartness of lemon or with aromatic vegetables.

cards.ja: 老舗の料理屋では、足腰の弱い高齢の客に配慮して、座敷にテーブルといすを置く店が増えている。ある店では、畳に正座するのがつらいという声が年々増え、今では予約の段階でいす席を希望する客が大半を占めるという。一方で、外国人観光客の間では、靴を脱いで畳に上がる体験そのものが人気を集めている。
cards.en: At long-established restaurants, more and more places are putting tables and chairs in their tatami rooms out of consideration for elderly customers with weak legs and backs. At one restaurant, complaints that kneeling on the tatami is hard have grown year by year, and now most customers reportedly ask for chair seating when they book. Among foreign tourists, meanwhile, the very experience of taking off one's shoes and stepping up onto the tatami is growing in popularity.

cards.ja: 今年の夏は記録的な暑さで、冷たい飲み物はよく売れた一方、日中の人通りが減った商店街も多かった。ある喫茶店の店主によれば、昼間の来客は二割ほど落ち込んだが、夕方以降のかき氷の注文が大きく伸びたという。差し引きすると売り上げは前年並みだったが、電気代の上昇分を考えると利益はわずかに減ったと苦笑いする。
cards.en: This summer brought record heat, and while cold drinks sold well, many shopping streets saw fewer people out during the day. According to the owner of one café, daytime customers fell by about twenty percent, but evening orders for shaved ice rose sharply. On balance, sales were about the same as the previous year, but once higher electricity bills are factored in, profits fell slightly, the owner says with a wry smile.

words.defJa: 新鮮な魚などを生のまま薄く切って、しょうゆなどをつけて食べる料理。

cards.ja: 港町の朝市では、水揚げされたばかりのアジやイカがその場でさばかれ、刺身として売られている。身が透き通っていて、口に入れるとこりこりとした歯ごたえがあるのは、とれたてならではだ。地元の人は、しょうゆにすりおろしたしょうがを溶いて食べるのが定番だという。観光客向けに、刺身をご飯に載せた丼を出す店も増えてきた。
cards.en: At the morning market in the port town, horse mackerel and squid that have just been landed are filleted on the spot and sold as sashimi. The flesh is translucent, and the crunchy texture when you put it in your mouth is something only freshly caught fish can offer. Locals reportedly tend to eat it with grated ginger mixed into soy sauce. A growing number of shops also serve rice bowls topped with sashimi for tourists.

cards.ja: 雨でぬかるんだグラウンドでも、ベテランの遊撃手は一度も送球を乱さなかった。試合後、監督は、さすが二十年近くプロの世界で生きてきた選手だと、その安定した守備をたたえた。本人は、雨の日の練習を若いころから欠かさなかっただけだと、照れくさそうに笑った。
cards.en: Even on a field turned to mud by the rain, the veteran shortstop did not make a single errant throw. After the game, the manager praised his steady fielding, saying it was just what you would expect from a player who had spent nearly twenty years in the professional game. The player himself laughed bashfully, saying he had simply never skipped practice on rainy days since he was young.

words.defJa: カメラで写真や映像をとること。

cards.ja: 野生のツキノワグマの子育てを記録するため、テレビ局の取材班は山中に無人カメラを十台以上仕掛けた。冬眠明けの母グマが子を連れて巣穴から出てくる瞬間の撮影に成功するまでに、三年の歳月を要したという。映像には子グマが木登りを覚えていく様子も細かく映っており、研究者からも貴重な資料として注目されている。
cards.en: To document how wild Asian black bears raise their young, a TV news crew set up more than ten unmanned cameras in the mountains. It reportedly took three years before they succeeded in filming the moment when a mother bear, just out of hibernation, emerges from her den with her cubs. The footage also shows in detail how the cubs learn to climb trees, and it is drawing attention from researchers as valuable material.

words.defJa: 聞きたい音のじゃまになる、不快で余計な音。

cards.ja: 最新のイヤホンには、周囲の雑音を打ち消す機能が搭載されている。マイクで拾った外の音と逆の波形の音を出すことで、電車の走行音や空調の低いうなりを大幅に弱める仕組みだ。ただ、車の接近にも気づきにくくなるため、屋外では外の音を取り込むモードに切り替えるよう、メーカーは注意を促している。
cards.en: The latest earphones come with a function that cancels out surrounding noise. It works by emitting sound with a waveform opposite to the outside sound picked up by a microphone, greatly reducing things like the rumble of trains and the low hum of air conditioning. However, because this also makes approaching cars harder to notice, manufacturers advise switching to a mode that lets outside sound in when outdoors.

cards.enTarget: The latest earphones come with a function that cancels out surrounding noise.

words.defJa: 金属の表面が空気や水にふれて変化してできる、赤や茶色などのもの。

cards.ja: 海に近い地域では、潮風に含まれる塩分のせいで、自転車や門扉に赤いさびが出やすい。塩は空気中の水分を引き寄せ、鉄が酸素と結びつく反応を速めてしまうからだ。専門家は、雨や風の強い日の後に真水で軽く拭くだけでも、さびの進行はかなり抑えられると話す。
cards.en: In areas near the sea, the salt carried on the sea breeze makes red rust form easily on bicycles and gates. That's because salt draws in moisture from the air and speeds up the reaction in which iron combines with oxygen. Experts say that simply wiping things down lightly with fresh water after rainy or windy days can slow the spread of rust considerably.

cards.enTarget: In areas near the sea, the salt carried on the sea breeze makes red rust form easily on bicycles and gates.

cards.ja: 利用者の減少で廃線となってから十年がたち、山あいの線路はすっかりさびて雑草に覆われている。かつての駅舎は地元の住民が手入れを続け、今では週末だけ開く小さな喫茶店になった。一部の区間では、線路の上を自転車型の車両で走る観光体験も始まり、遠方から訪れる家族連れの姿も見られるようになった。
cards.en: Ten years have passed since the line was shut down because of falling ridership, and the tracks in the mountains are thoroughly rusted and covered in weeds. Local residents have kept looking after the old station building, which is now a small café open only on weekends. On one section, a tourist attraction in which visitors ride bicycle-style carts along the rails has also started, and families coming from far away have become a familiar sight.

words.defJa: 床や畳の上に座るときに敷く、四角くて平たいクッション。

cards.ja: 落語家は、舞台に置かれた一枚の座布団の上だけで、何人もの登場人物を演じ分ける。扇子と手ぬぐいを箸や手紙に見立て、顔の向きを左右に変えるだけで会話の相手が入れ替わる。道具も舞台装置もほとんど使わないからこそ、聞き手は想像力を働かせ、自分だけの情景を頭の中に描くのだ。
cards.en: A rakugo storyteller plays many different characters while seated on nothing more than a single cushion placed on the stage. A folding fan and a hand towel stand in for chopsticks or a letter, and simply turning the head left or right switches who is speaking. Precisely because almost no props or stage sets are used, listeners put their imagination to work and paint their own scenes in their minds.

cards.ja: 大型連休に入り、ふだんは静かな山あいの温泉街が朝から騒がしい。駐車場には県外ナンバーの車が列をなし、土産物店の前では観光客が記念写真を撮り合っている。旅館の主人は、にぎわいはありがたいが、地元の人が使う生活道路まで渋滞するのが悩みの種だと話す。
cards.en: With the long holiday under way, the usually quiet hot-spring town in the mountains has been noisy since morning. Cars with out-of-prefecture license plates are lined up in the parking lots, and in front of the souvenir shops tourists take commemorative photos of one another. The innkeeper says the bustle is welcome, but traffic jams that reach even the roads locals use for daily errands are a headache.

cards.en: There are said to be several reasons why most convenience-store rice balls are triangular. Besides being easy to hold and bring to the mouth, they take up little space when lined up on shelves and are easy to run through packaging machines. On the other hand, there are regions where bale-shaped or round rice balls are still the norm, and their shapes reflect each area's own food culture.

cards.en: In elementary-school arithmetic classes, lessons built around real shopping are spreading. The children compare store flyers, work out what and how many items they can buy on a limited budget, and explain their reasoning to each other in small groups. According to teachers, this conveys the fun of thinking with numbers more easily than simply solving calculation problems.

cards.ja: 近年の猛暑の影響で、リンゴの産地が少しずつ北へ移りつつある。かつての主な産地では、実が十分に色づかないまま収穫期を迎える年が増え、農家は暑さに強い品種への植え替えを進めている。一方、これまで栽培に向かないとされてきた北海道の一部では、良質なリンゴがとれるようになった。
cards.en: Because of the extreme heat of recent years, apple-growing regions are gradually shifting northward. In the former main producing areas, there are more years when harvest time arrives before the fruit has fully colored, and farmers are replanting with heat-tolerant varieties. Meanwhile, in parts of Hokkaido long considered unsuitable for growing them, high-quality apples can now be harvested.

cards.ja: 相続の際に登記がされないまま放置され、持ち主の分からない山林が全国で増えている。所有者を特定できなければ、間伐や道の整備を進めることが難しく、大雨の際の土砂崩れの危険も高まる。こうした事態を防ごうと、国は土地を相続した人に登記を義務づける制度を導入した。
cards.en: Forested mountain land with no known owner, left unregistered after inheritance, is increasing across the country. If the owners cannot be identified, thinning and road maintenance are difficult to carry out, and the risk of landslides during heavy rain rises. To prevent this, the national government has introduced a system that obliges people who inherit land to register it.

cards.en: Lacquerware is completed by repeating, dozens of times, the process of coating the wooden base with lacquer, letting it dry and polishing the surface. Because the way lacquer dries changes with humidity and temperature, craftspeople check the weather every morning before deciding how to schedule the day's work. A single bowl can take nearly half a year to finish, and that labor is what gives it its distinctive deep luster.

Since that is a full week earlier than originally planned, I consulted the printing company right away. That means we have to finish the final proofreading by the end of tomorrow.

cards.ja: 高齢者を狙った電話詐欺の手口は年々巧妙になり、警察の取り締まりだけでは被害を防ぎきれなくなっている。犯人は家族や役所の職員を名乗り、言葉巧みに現金を振り込ませる。そのため専門家は、留守番電話を常に設定しておくなど、一人ひとりが自衛する意識を持つことが欠かせないと指摘する。見知らぬ番号からの電話には出ないことも、有効な対策の一つだ。
cards.en: The methods used in phone scams targeting the elderly grow more sophisticated every year, and police crackdowns alone can no longer fully prevent the damage. The perpetrators pose as family members or local-government staff and smooth-talk people into transferring cash. Experts therefore point out that it is essential for each person to be conscious of protecting themselves, for example by always keeping the answering machine switched on. Not answering calls from unknown numbers is also one effective countermeasure.

cards.ja: 港町の小さな食堂では、店主が毎朝仕入れたイカをさばき、自家製の塩辛を仕込んでいる。身と肝を塩とよく混ぜ、冷蔵庫で数日寝かせると、独特のうまみが生まれるという。市販品より塩分を控えめにしているため日持ちはしないが、そのぶんイカの甘みがよく分かると評判だ。わざわざこの一品を目当てに、遠方から訪れる客も少なくない。
cards.en: At a small diner in a port town, the owner cleans the squid he buys every morning and makes homemade shiokara from it. He says that if you mix the flesh and liver well with salt and let it rest in the refrigerator for several days, a distinctive savory depth develops. Because he uses less salt than store-bought versions it does not keep long, but it is known for letting the sweetness of the squid come through. Quite a few customers come all the way from far away just for this one dish.

words.defJa: 塩の味が強い。しょっぱい。

cards.ja: 日本人の食塩摂取量は、世界保健機関が勧める目安の約二倍に上るとされる。漬物やみそ汁、しょうゆをたっぷり使った煮物など、塩辛い料理を食べ慣れた舌は、なかなか薄味を受け入れない。そこで管理栄養士は、だしや酢、香辛料をうまく使って物足りなさを補うよう勧めている。薄味を続けていれば、数週間ほどで舌も慣れてくるという。
cards.en: Japanese people's salt intake is said to be about twice the guideline recommended by the World Health Organization. A palate used to salty food such as pickles, miso soup and dishes simmered in plenty of soy sauce is slow to accept lightly seasoned food. Registered dietitians therefore recommend making up for the lack of flavor by making good use of dashi, vinegar and spices. They say that if you stick with lighter seasoning, your tongue adjusts within a few weeks.

In the first broadcast, though visibly nervous, the announcer skillfully drew out the guests' real feelings with questions that were not in the script. Favorable comments are already coming in from viewers.

words.meaning: it can't be helped, there's no other way
words.defJa: ほかにどうすることもできない。あきらめるしかない。

cards.ja: 失敗したとき、「仕方がない」と口にするのは、ただのあきらめだと思われがちだ。しかし心理学では、変えられない出来事を受け入れることが、心の回復を早めると考えられている。過去を悔やみ続けるより、次に何ができるかに目を向けた方が、気持ちを切り替えやすいからだ。この言葉には、前を向くための知恵が込められているのかもしれない。
cards.en: When something goes wrong, saying 'it can't be helped' tends to be seen as mere resignation. In psychology, however, accepting events that cannot be changed is thought to speed emotional recovery. That is because it is easier to move on when you turn your attention to what you can do next than when you keep regretting the past. This phrase may hold a kind of wisdom for looking forward.

cards.en: At one public junior high school, the way the timetable is put together was overhauled starting this school year. Each period was shortened from fifty to forty-five minutes, and the time freed up goes to inquiry-based learning that students choose for themselves. At first some teachers worried they would not be able to fit in all the lesson content. But half a year on, more and more people are praising the rise in students' concentration.

words.defJa: 建物などを建てるための土地。また、ある建物が使っている土地の範囲。

cards.ja: 生成AIの普及に伴い、大量の計算をこなすデータセンターの建設が各地で相次いでいる。ある電力会社は、廃止された火力発電所の広大な敷地を活用し、大規模な施設を誘致する計画を発表した。送電網がすでに整っているため、新たに土地を探すよりも早く稼働できるという。地元では、雇用の増加に期待する声が上がっている。
cards.en: With the spread of generative AI, data centers that handle huge amounts of computation are being built one after another around the country. One power company has announced a plan to use the vast site of a decommissioned thermal power plant to attract a large-scale facility. Because the power grid is already in place, it says the facility can start operating sooner than if new land had to be found. Locally, people are voicing hopes for more jobs.

words.defJa: 布団やマットなどを、床の上に平らに広げて置く。

cards.ja: 昔ながらの旅館に泊まると、夕食の間に仲居さんが部屋に布団を敷いてくれることが多い。ベッドに慣れた外国人旅行者の中には、畳の上で眠る体験そのものを楽しみにしている人も少なくない。最近は人手不足から、布団は客が自分で敷くという宿も増えてきた。それだけに、きちんと整えられた寝床を目にすると、もてなしの心が改めて感じられる。
cards.en: When you stay at an old-fashioned ryokan, the room attendant often lays out the futons in your room while you are at dinner. Many foreign travelers who are used to beds look forward to the very experience of sleeping on tatami. Recently, because of staff shortages, more inns have guests lay out their own futons. That makes a neatly made-up bed, when you do find one waiting, all the more expressive of a spirit of hospitality.

words.defJa: 草や木の葉や枝が、たくさん伸びて重なり合う。

cards.ja: 初夏から夏にかけて、里山の雑木林では木々が枝葉を大きく広げ、昼間でも林の中が薄暗くなる。葉がよく茂った林の地面には直射日光がほとんど届かず、気温は周りより数度低く保たれる。このひんやりとした環境は、カエルや昆虫など多くの生き物にとって夏の隠れ家となっている。散策に訪れる人間にとっても、夏の林の木陰は格好の避暑地だ。
cards.en: From early summer through the summer months, the trees in the satoyama woodlands spread their branches and leaves wide, and inside the woods it grows dim even in the daytime. Hardly any direct sunlight reaches the ground of a wood thick with leaves, and the temperature there stays several degrees lower than the surroundings. This cool environment serves as a summer hideaway for many creatures, such as frogs and insects. For people who come to walk there, too, the shade of a summer wood is the perfect escape from the heat.

cards.en: A coffee-chain shop in front of the station is continuing a service that takes thirty yen off each cup for customers who bring their own bottle. It was started to cut down on disposable cups, but at first only a small fraction of customers used it. Recently, however, office workers stopping in with a bottle in hand on their way to work have become a common sight. The shop believes the bigger reason is not the discount itself but growing environmental awareness.

words.defJa: 鉄を引きつける性質を持つ物体。

cards.ja: 病院のMRI検査装置には、地球の磁場の数万倍もの強さを持つ磁石が使われている。この強い磁場で体内の水素原子核の向きをそろえ、電波を当てて返ってくる信号から断面の画像を作る仕組みだ。磁力が極めて強いため、検査室への金属製品の持ち込みは厳しく制限されている。過去には、誤って持ち込まれた酸素ボンベが装置に吸い寄せられる事故も起きている。
cards.en: MRI scanners in hospitals use a magnet whose field is tens of thousands of times stronger than the earth's. The machine uses this strong field to line up the hydrogen nuclei in the body, then sends in radio waves and builds cross-sectional images from the signals that come back. Because the magnetic force is so intense, bringing metal objects into the scanning room is strictly restricted. In the past there have even been accidents in which an oxygen cylinder brought in by mistake was pulled into the machine.

words.meaning: constantly, all the time; from start to finish
words.defJa: 初めから終わりまで、ずっと。いつも。

cards.ja: 久しぶりに実家へ帰ると、食事の間、父は始終にこにこしていた。普段は口数が少なく、電話でも用件だけを話してすぐに切ってしまう人だ。母によれば、帰省の日が決まってから、何度もカレンダーを眺めていたらしい。言葉にしない愛情というものもあるのだと、改めて気づかされた。
cards.en: When I went home to my parents' for the first time in a long while, my father smiled the whole way through the meal. He is usually a man of few words, someone who even on the phone says only what he must and hangs up right away. According to my mother, once the date of my visit was set, he kept looking at the calendar again and again. It made me realize anew that there is such a thing as affection that is never put into words.

words.defJa: 先生に教わらず、自分で勉強すること。

cards.ja: 外国語を身につけるうえで、授業の時間だけでは圧倒的に足りないと言われる。ある大学の調査では、上達の早い学生ほど、授業以外の自習に多くの時間を割いていた。単語を覚えるだけでなく、音声を聞いて口に出す練習を毎日続けている点が共通していたという。最近は、スマートフォンのアプリを使って通学中に学ぶ学生も多い。
cards.en: It is said that class time alone is nowhere near enough to master a foreign language. In one university's survey, the faster students improved, the more time they devoted to self-study outside class. What they had in common, apparently, was that besides memorizing vocabulary they kept up daily practice of listening to audio and repeating it aloud. These days many students also study on their commute using smartphone apps.

words.defJa: 騒がしかった音や気持ちなどが、落ち着いて静かになる。

cards.ja: 判決の言い渡しを前に、傍聴席は小さなざわめきに包まれていた。だが裁判長が入廷すると、法廷内は一瞬で静まった。被告は正面を見つめたまま身じろぎもせず、判決が読み上げられるのを待った。言い渡しが終わると、記者たちは速報を伝えるため、一斉に廊下へ駆け出していった。
cards.en: Before the verdict was handed down, a low murmur filled the public gallery. But when the presiding judge entered, the courtroom fell silent in an instant. The defendant stared straight ahead without moving a muscle, waiting for the judgment to be read out. As soon as it was over, the reporters all rushed out into the corridor to file the breaking news.

words.defJa: 物理学や化学、生物学など、自然の仕組みを研究する学問。

cards.ja: 自然科学は、実験や観察によって確かめられる事実を積み重ねて発展してきた。しかし、何を問い、何を観察するかを決めるのは、実験そのものではない。科学哲学者たちは、観察にはすでに理論や前提が入り込んでいると指摘してきた。科学の客観性とは何かという問いは、今も哲学の重要なテーマであり続けている。
cards.en: The natural sciences have developed by accumulating facts that can be confirmed through experiment and observation. But it is not experiments themselves that decide what to ask and what to observe. Philosophers of science have pointed out that theories and assumptions are already built into observation. The question of what scientific objectivity really is remains an important theme in philosophy today.

words.defJa: 一時間に進む距離で表した速さ。

cards.ja: プロ野球では近年、時速160キロを超える速球を投げる投手が次々と現れている。かつては夢の数字とされていたが、科学的なトレーニングや動作解析の普及が球速の向上を後押ししているとみられる。一方で、肩やひじへの負担は大きく、故障に苦しむ若手も少なくない。球速ばかりを追い求める風潮に、警鐘を鳴らす指導者もいる。
cards.en: In professional baseball, pitchers who throw fastballs of over 160 kilometers per hour have been appearing one after another in recent years. That was once considered a dream figure, and the spread of scientific training and motion analysis is thought to be driving the rise in velocity. On the other hand, the strain on shoulders and elbows is heavy, and many young pitchers struggle with injuries. Some coaches are sounding the alarm about the trend of chasing velocity above all else.

words.defJa: ある人の子や孫、さらにその後に続く血筋の人々。

cards.ja: 江戸時代に城下町で栄えた商家の子孫が、蔵に眠っていた古文書およそ三千点を市に寄贈した。帳簿や手紙の中には、飢饉の年に米を安く売り出したことを記した記録も含まれている。市の学芸員は、当時の町人の暮らしや経済の実態を知る貴重な手がかりになると話す。整理が済み次第、一部を資料館で公開する予定だ。
cards.en: The descendants of a merchant family that prospered in a castle town in the Edo period have donated to the city some three thousand old documents that had lain untouched in their storehouse. Among the account books and letters is a record noting that the family sold rice cheaply in a famine year. A city curator says the documents will be valuable clues to the lives of townspeople at the time and to how the economy actually worked. Once they have been sorted, some will be put on display at the city's archive museum.

cards.ja: 警察が取り扱う死体のうち、解剖に回されるのは一割ほどにとどまるとされる。背景には、解剖を担う法医学者の慢性的な不足がある。外見からは病死に見えても、詳しく調べると事件や事故だったと分かる例は少なくない。専門家は、死因を正確に突き止める体制づくりを急ぐべきだと訴えている。
cards.en: Of the dead bodies handled by the police, only around one in ten is said to be sent for an autopsy. Behind this lies a chronic shortage of the forensic pathologists who perform them. Even when a death looks natural from the outside, it is not uncommon for a closer examination to reveal a crime or an accident. Experts are urging that a system for accurately determining causes of death be put in place without delay.

words.defJa: 清書する前に、ためしに書いておくもの。

cards.ja: 職場で、報告書やメールの下書きを生成AIに任せる人が増えている。指示を入力すれば数秒で文章の骨組みができあがるため、作業時間が大幅に短くなったという声は多い。ただ、AIの文章にはもっともらしい誤りが紛れ込むことがあり、事実の確認は欠かせない。最終的に何を伝えるかを決めるのは、あくまで書き手自身だ。
cards.en: More and more people at work are leaving the rough drafts of reports and emails to generative AI. Because typing in an instruction produces the skeleton of a text in seconds, many say their working time has been cut dramatically. But plausible-sounding errors can creep into AI-written text, so checking the facts is essential. In the end, it is the writer alone who decides what to convey.

words.defJa: 自分が住んでいる家。

cards.ja: 感染症の流行をきっかけに広がった在宅勤務は、その後、多くの企業で定着した。通勤がなくなった分、自宅で家族と過ごす時間が増えたと答える人は多い。一方で、仕事と私生活の境目があいまいになり、夜遅くまでパソコンに向かってしまうという悩みも聞かれる。最近は、週に数日だけ出社する働き方を選ぶ会社が増えている。
cards.en: Remote work, which spread in the wake of the epidemic, has since taken root at many companies. Many people say that without the commute they spend more time at home with their families. On the other hand, some complain that the line between work and private life has blurred, so they end up at the computer until late at night. Recently, more companies are opting for a way of working in which staff come into the office only a few days a week.

words.defJa: 都市の中で、昔から商人や職人が多く住んできた、庶民的な地域。

cards.ja: 東京の東側に広がる下町には、今も小さな町工場や銭湯、商店街が数多く残っている。路地には植木鉢が並び、近所の人どうしが立ち話をする光景も珍しくない。最近は、こうした昔ながらの人情味に引かれて移り住む若い世代も増えてきた。古い長屋を改装したカフェや工房が、新たなにぎわいを生んでいる。
cards.en: In the old downtown districts that spread across the east side of Tokyo, many small neighborhood factories, public bathhouses and shopping streets still remain. Potted plants line the alleys, and it is not unusual to see neighbors stopping to chat. Recently, more young people have been moving in, drawn by this old-fashioned warmth. Cafés and workshops in renovated old row houses are bringing new life to the area.

words.defJa: 地域や団体が、自分たちのことを自分たちで決めて治めること。

cards.ja: 地方自治は「民主主義の学校」と呼ばれることがある。身近な地域の問題を住民自身が考え、決めていく経験が、国の政治を見る目を養うと考えられているからだ。ところが近年、地方議会の選挙では立候補者が定数に届かず、無投票で当選が決まる例が相次いでいる。担い手不足は、自治の土台そのものを揺るがしかねない。
cards.en: Local self-government is sometimes called 'the school of democracy.' That is because the experience of residents thinking through and deciding on the problems of their own communities is believed to sharpen their eye for national politics. In recent years, however, there has been a string of local assembly elections where the number of candidates fell short of the seats available and the winners were decided without a vote. The shortage of people willing to serve could shake the very foundations of self-government.

words.meaning: room-, indoor (as in indoors, room temperature)

cards.ja: 梅雨の時期は、洗濯物を室内に干す家庭が増える。ただ、湿度の高い部屋では乾くまでに時間がかかり、生乾きのにおいの原因になりやすい。扇風機の風を当てたり除湿機を使ったりすると、乾燥にかかる時間を大幅に縮められる。洗濯物どうしの間隔を十分にあけることも大切だという。
cards.en: During the rainy season, more households hang their laundry indoors. But in a humid room it takes a long time to dry and easily ends up smelling musty. Blowing air on it with an electric fan or running a dehumidifier can greatly shorten the drying time. Leaving plenty of space between the items is also said to be important.

words.defJa: 実際に体験して、本当にそうだと強く感じること。また、その気持ち。

cards.ja: 政府は、景気が緩やかに回復していると繰り返し説明している。企業の業績は好調で、大手を中心に賃上げも続いた。しかし、食料品や光熱費の値上がりが家計を圧迫し、豊かさを実感できないと答える人は多い。統計上の数字と暮らしの感覚とのずれをどう埋めるかが問われている。
cards.en: The government keeps explaining that the economy is recovering moderately. Corporate earnings are strong, and wage increases have continued, mainly at large companies. However, rising prices for food and utilities are squeezing household budgets, and many people say they cannot actually feel any prosperity. The question is how to close the gap between the statistics and how life actually feels.

words.defJa: 学んだ知識や技術を、実際の現場で使いながら身につけること。

cards.ja: ある大学の看護学部では、三年生が秋から病院での実習に臨む。教室で学んだ知識を、実際の患者さんを前に生かすのは簡単ではない。血圧を測る手が震えたり、言葉選びに迷ったりと、戸惑う場面の連続だという。それでも、患者さんからかけられる感謝の一言が、何よりの励みになっているようだ。
cards.en: At one university's nursing faculty, third-year students begin their practical training at a hospital in the autumn. Putting what they learned in the classroom to use in front of real patients is not easy. They say it is one bewildering moment after another, from hands trembling while taking a blood pressure reading to agonizing over what words to use. Even so, a word of thanks from a patient seems to be the greatest encouragement of all.

words.defJa: これまでに実際にあげてきた成果。

cards.ja: 創業間もないスタートアップにとって、最大の壁の一つは銀行から融資を受けることだ。売上や利益の実績がない段階では、どれほど優れた技術を持っていても、返済能力を示すのが難しい。そこで近年は、公的機関が融資を保証したり、投資家が事業の将来性を評価して出資したりする仕組みが広がっている。創業者には、技術だけでなく、事業の将来像を説得力をもって語る力も求められる。
cards.en: For a newly founded startup, one of the biggest hurdles is getting a loan from a bank. At a stage with no track record of sales or profit, it is hard to show an ability to repay, however excellent the technology may be. In recent years, therefore, arrangements have been spreading in which public bodies guarantee loans or investors put in money after judging a business's future potential. Founders are expected not only to have good technology but also to describe their business's future convincingly.

words.meaning: the real thing, the actual object
words.defJa: 写真や模型などではない、本当のもの。

cards.ja: 画集やインターネットで何度も見てきた名画でも、美術館で実物の前に立つと、印象はまるで違う。思っていたより小さかったり、絵の具の盛り上がりが光を受けて輝いていたりする。画面越しでは分からない筆の勢いや色の深みに、思わず足を止める来館者も多い。複製技術がどれほど進んでも、本物を見る体験の価値は失われていない。
cards.en: Even with a masterpiece you have seen many times in art books or online, the impression is completely different when you stand in front of the real thing in a museum. It may be smaller than you imagined, or the ridges of paint may gleam as they catch the light. Many visitors stop in their tracks at the energy of the brushwork and the depth of color that cannot be grasped through a screen. However far reproduction technology advances, the experience of seeing the original has lost none of its value.

words.defJa: 実際の生活や仕事に、役に立てて使うこと。

cards.ja: 電気自動車の弱点とされてきた航続距離を大きく伸ばす技術として、全固体電池の開発が進んでいる。電池の中に燃えやすい液体を使わないため、発火の危険が小さく、短時間での充電も可能になるとされる。ただ、量産にかかるコストは依然として高く、実用化までにはまだ課題が残る。国内の自動車メーカー各社は、数年以内の搭載を目指している。
cards.en: All-solid-state batteries are being developed as a technology that could greatly extend driving range, long seen as the weak point of electric vehicles. Because they contain no flammable liquid, the risk of fire is said to be low, and charging in a short time is expected to become possible. However, the cost of mass production is still high, and hurdles remain before they reach practical use. Domestic automakers are each aiming to put them in their cars within a few years.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

words.defJa: 実際にあった例。本当に起きたことや、実際に使われたものから取った例。

cards.ja: 文法の説明を読んでもわからなかったことが、実例を一つ見ただけですっと理解できることがある。ある高校の英語教師は、教科書の例文の代わりに、新聞記事や映画のせりふから集めた実例を授業で使っている。生徒たちは、言葉が実際の場面でどう使われているかを知ることで、規則の意味を自然に理解していくという。こうした授業は、暗記に頼らない学び方として、校内のほかの教科にも広がりつつある。
cards.en: Sometimes something you couldn't grasp from reading a grammar explanation suddenly makes sense the moment you see a single real example. One high school English teacher uses real examples collected from newspaper articles and film dialogue in class instead of the textbook's example sentences. By seeing how words are actually used in real situations, students reportedly come to understand the meaning of the rules naturally. As a way of learning that does not rely on rote memorization, this kind of lesson is spreading to other subjects at the school as well.

cards.en: The pain of heartbreak may not be merely a metaphor. A brain-imaging study of people who had recently broken up with a partner found that when they looked at a photo of their former partner, regions overlapping with those active during physical pain became active. That response, however, weakens over time. There are also reports that talking with friends and getting exercise speed recovery.

cards.en: Japan's major private railways do not make their money from trains alone. Since before the war they have developed residential areas along their lines, built department stores at their terminal stations, and provided amusement parks and hot springs in the suburbs. The idea is that if people live along the line and use the train for shopping and outings, fare revenue rises too. This business model has also drawn attention from railway companies overseas.

That's because plastic string takes extra work to remove during the recycling process.

cards.en: In a major earthquake, differences in damage even within the same town are often due to differences in the ground. Land reclaimed from rivers and marshes is soft, tends to amplify shaking, and is also at risk of liquefaction. The national and local governments publish this kind of ground information as maps. It is worth checking once before building a house or moving.

cards.en: A soufflé is at its most delicious the moment it comes out of the oven. Because the air trapped in the egg-white foam has expanded with the heat, it deflates within a few minutes as the temperature drops. At restaurants in France, it is standard practice to start baking one only after the order comes in. The wait is considered part of the dish.

cards.en: When working outdoors in midsummer, simply cooling the neck can considerably reduce the strain on the body. An easy method is to soak a towel in water, wring it out firmly, and wrap it around your neck. Because large blood vessels run along both sides of the neck, the cooled blood circulates easily through the whole body. Even so, you must not forget to drink fluids frequently, before you feel thirsty.

cards.ja: シマウマの白黒の縞が何の役に立っているのかは、長く謎とされてきた。天敵の目をくらますためだという説もあったが、近年の観察では、血を吸うアブが縞模様の上にはうまく着地できないことが確かめられている。研究者が馬に縞模様のコートを着せて実験したところ、止まるアブの数ははっきりと減った。
cards.en: What purpose the zebra's black-and-white stripes serve has long been considered a mystery. One theory held that they confuse the eyes of predators, but recent observations have confirmed that bloodsucking horseflies cannot land well on striped patterns. When researchers ran an experiment putting striped coats on horses, the number of flies that landed clearly dropped.

words.defJa: 名字と名前を合わせたもの。書類などで使うかたい言い方。

cards.ja: 日本の国政選挙の選挙区投票では、有権者が投票用紙に候補者の氏名を自分の手で書き込む。用紙にあらかじめ名前が印刷され、印をつけるだけの国が多いなかで、珍しい方式だといえる。名字だけや平仮名で書いても、だれのことか判断できれば有効票として数えられる。開票作業に時間がかかるのは、こうした判断が必要になるためでもある。
cards.en: In constituency voting in Japan's national elections, voters write the full name of their chosen candidate on the ballot by hand. It is an unusual system, given that in many countries the names are printed on the ballot in advance and voters simply make a mark. Even if a voter writes only the surname or writes it in hiragana, the vote is counted as valid as long as it is clear who is meant. Part of the reason vote counting takes time is that such judgments have to be made.

cards.en: The city's cultural center holds a haiku competition every autumn. This year's theme is scenes connected with water, and anyone from elementary school students to adults may submit up to three haiku each. According to the posters put up in the building, the entry deadline is September 30, and entries postmarked that day will be accepted. Selected works will be exhibited in the center's lobby in November, and an award ceremony is also planned.

cards.en: Why is it that people can't get serious until right before a deadline? Psychology explains that the tendency to put immediate pleasures ahead of rewards in the distant future is one cause of procrastination. In one experiment, students who were given several deadlines along the way achieved better results than those with a single deadline at the end of the term. Simply increasing the number of deadlines from one to several changes behavior.

cards.en: On a midsummer afternoon, the surface of asphalt in the sun can heat up to nearly 60 degrees. Even when it is 35 degrees at the height of a person's face, the closer you get to the ground, the higher the temperature. Dogs, being low to the ground, take the full brunt of that heat. Veterinarians urge owners to walk their dogs in the cool hours of morning and evening and to touch the ground with their palm to check how hot it is.

words.defJa: 経済学や政治学、社会学など、人間の社会の仕組みを研究する学問をまとめた呼び方。

cards.ja: 社会科学は、物理学のように条件をそろえた実験を繰り返すのが難しく、本当に科学と呼べるのかと昔から問われてきた。だが、その事情は近年大きく変わりつつある。二〇一九年のノーベル経済学賞は、途上国で対象者を無作為に分け、貧困対策の効果を比べる実験を重ねた研究者たちに贈られた。大量のデータや社会実験で因果関係を確かめる手法は、いまや政治学や社会学にも広がっている。
cards.en: Because social science finds it hard to repeat controlled experiments the way physics does, people have long asked whether it can truly be called a science. In recent years, however, that situation has been changing considerably. The 2019 Nobel Prize in Economics went to researchers who ran experiment after experiment in developing countries, randomly dividing participants into groups to compare the effects of anti-poverty measures. Methods that test cause and effect with large amounts of data and social experiments have now spread to political science and sociology as well.

cards.ja: 日本を訪れた外国人旅行者がよく驚くことの一つに、蛇口の水をそのまま飲めることがある。水道水を安全に飲める国は、世界的に見ればそれほど多くない。最近は駅や公園に給水機を置き、水筒やペットボトルへの補充を勧める自治体も増えてきた。ごみを減らす取り組みとしても注目されている。
cards.en: One of the things that often surprises foreign travelers visiting Japan is that you can drink water straight from the tap. Viewed globally, there are not that many countries where tap water is safe to drink. Recently, more local governments have been installing water dispensers at stations and in parks and encouraging people to refill water bottles and plastic bottles. The effort is also drawing attention as a way to reduce waste.

For this reason, it is considered essential for humans to check sources in important situations.

words.defJa: 自動車や電車などを入れておく建物や場所。

cards.ja: 日本で自動車を買うときには、原則として車庫証明が必要になる。自宅の車庫や近所の駐車場など、車を置く場所があることを警察に届け出て、確認を受けなければならない。路上駐車を防ぐための制度で、都市部では毎月料金を払う駐車場を借りてから車を買う人も多い。都心で車を持つ費用が高くなる理由の一つでもある。
cards.en: When buying a car in Japan, you generally need a parking space certificate. You must notify the police that you have a place to keep the car, such as a garage at home or a parking lot nearby, and have it confirmed. The system exists to prevent on-street parking, and in urban areas many people rent a monthly parking space before buying a car. It is also one reason why owning a car in city centers is expensive.

words.defJa: 列車やバスに乗って、案内や安全の確認、切符の点検などをする係の人。

cards.ja: 地方の鉄道では、運転士が一人で乗客の乗り降りまで確認するワンマン運転が当たり前になりつつある。人手不足に加え、利用者の減少で人件費を抑える必要があるためだ。最近は首都圏の路線でも、車掌の乗務をやめる動きが出てきた。一方で、急病人や災害への対応に不安を感じる利用者も少なくない。
cards.en: On regional railways, one-man operation, in which the driver alone even checks passengers getting on and off, is becoming the norm. This is because, on top of staff shortages, falling ridership means personnel costs must be kept down. Recently, moves to stop having conductors on board have appeared even on lines in the Tokyo metropolitan area. On the other hand, quite a few passengers feel uneasy about how sudden illnesses or disasters would be handled.

cards.en: Every spring, a sketching event for elementary school children is held in the neighborhood park. Holding drawing boards, the children sit down by the pond or in front of the flower beds and draw whatever scenery they like. Unlike drawing from a photograph, sketching from life means capturing the colors in front of you as the wind and light shift. The teachers say it is a time for developing the ability to look carefully.

cards.en: A newspaper's editorial is an article that presents the views of the newspaper as a company rather than of an individual reporter. Comparing the editorials of different papers on the same event on the same day makes the differences in their positions very clear. In a class at one university, students summarize the points made in several editorials in a table and analyze how they present their evidence. It is said to be highly effective as practice in telling opinion apart from fact.

cards.en: The wheel is thought to have been invented around Mesopotamia more than five thousand years ago. It was first used on carts and was later adopted for chariots as well. In the ancient Americas, by contrast, clay toys with wheels have been found, yet wheels were hardly used for transport. One reason given is that there were no large domestic animals to pull loads.

words.defJa: 音が同じ言葉や似た言葉を使って、人を笑わせる気の利いた言い方。

cards.ja: 日本語には同じ音で意味の違う言葉が多く、しゃれが生まれやすい。布団が吹っ飛んだといった単純な駄じゃれは、年配の男性が好むものとして笑いの種にされがちだ。だが、江戸時代の川柳や落語には、言葉の重なりを巧みに使ったしゃれが数多く残っている。言葉遊びは、日本語の豊かさを映す鏡でもある。
cards.en: Japanese has many words that sound the same but differ in meaning, so puns arise easily. Simple wordplay like 'the futon flew off' tends to be laughed at as the kind of joke older men love. Yet Edo-period senryu and rakugo preserve a great many puns that skillfully exploit overlapping words. Wordplay is also a mirror reflecting the richness of the Japanese language.

cards.enTarget: Japanese has many words that sound the same but differ in meaning, so puns arise easily.

words.defJa: ほかの言葉の前について、目方や負担が大きい、程度がはなはだしい、規模が大きいという意味を加える。

cards.ja: 介護の仕事は、体の大きな利用者を抱え上げる場面も多く、重労働として知られてきた。腰を痛めて職場を離れる人も少なくない。そこで最近は、装着すると腰の負担を減らせる補助スーツや、ベッドから車いすへの移動を助ける機器を導入する施設が増えている。働き手が長く続けられる環境づくりは、人手不足対策の柱でもある。
cards.en: Caregiving work often involves lifting users with large bodies, and it has long been known as heavy labor. Not a few people injure their backs and leave the workplace. Recently, therefore, more facilities have been introducing assist suits that reduce the strain on the lower back when worn, and devices that help move people from bed to wheelchair. Creating an environment where workers can keep going for a long time is also a pillar of efforts to tackle labor shortages.

words.defJa: 人が住むための家や建物。住んでいる場所。

cards.ja: 縄文時代の人々の多くは、竪穴住居と呼ばれる家で暮らしていた。地面を数十センチ掘り下げて床をつくり、柱を立てて木の枝や草で屋根を覆った造りである。地中の温度は一年を通じて変わりにくいため、夏は涼しく冬は暖かかったと考えられている。各地の遺跡では、復元された住居の中に入ることもできる。
cards.en: Many people of the Jomon period lived in houses called pit dwellings. They were built by digging the ground down several tens of centimeters to make a floor, raising posts, and covering the roof with branches and grass. Because the temperature underground changes little throughout the year, they are thought to have been cool in summer and warm in winter. At archaeological sites around the country, you can even go inside reconstructed dwellings.

words.defJa: 料金や会費などのお金を、払う人のところを回って集めること。

cards.ja: 町内会費の集金は、役員が一軒ずつ家を回るのが長年の習わしだった。だが、共働き世帯が増えて留守の家が多く、何度も足を運ぶ役員の負担が問題になっていた。ある町内会では今年からスマートフォンのアプリで会費を払えるようにしたところ、半年でほとんどの世帯が切り替えた。現金を預かる心配もなくなったという。
cards.en: For many years, it was the custom for officers of the neighborhood association to go door to door collecting association dues. But with more dual-income households, many homes were empty, and the burden on officers who had to visit again and again had become a problem. When one neighborhood association started letting members pay dues through a smartphone app this year, almost all households switched within six months. Officers reportedly no longer have to worry about holding onto cash, either.

words.meaning: gathering, assembling (at a set place and time)
words.defJa: 人やものが、決まった場所に一つに集まること。また、数学で、ある条件に合うものの集まり。

cards.ja: 修学旅行の初日、生徒たちは午前七時に駅の改札前に集合した。担任の教師は班ごとに人数を数え、体調の悪い生徒がいないか、一人ずつ声をかけて回った。今年は各班が自分たちで見学先を決める自由行動の時間が長く、生徒たちの表情も明るかった。新幹線が動き出すと、車内はすぐににぎやかになった。
cards.en: On the first day of the school trip, the students assembled in front of the station ticket gates at 7 a.m. Their homeroom teacher counted heads group by group and went around speaking to each student to make sure no one was feeling unwell. This year there was more free time in which each group chose its own places to visit, and the students looked cheerful. Once the bullet train started moving, the car quickly grew lively.

words.defJa: 筆や鉛筆で、字を正しく美しく書けるように練習すること。

cards.ja: 正月二日の書き初めは、習字を習う子どもにとって一年の始まりを告げる行事だ。墨をすり、半紙に向かって新年の目標や縁起のよい言葉を大きく書く。最近は習字教室に通う子どもが減っているが、字を丁寧に書く経験は集中力を養うとして、大人の受講者は増えているという。
cards.en: The first calligraphy of the year, on January 2, is an event that marks the start of the year for children learning calligraphy. They grind ink, face a sheet of calligraphy paper, and write their goals for the new year or auspicious words in large characters. The number of children attending calligraphy classes has been falling recently, but adult students are reportedly increasing, since the experience of writing characters carefully is said to build concentration.

words.defJa: 建物や道具などの壊れたところや傷んだところを直すこと。

cards.ja: 築年数の古いマンションでは、外壁や配管の大規模な修繕に備えて、住民が毎月お金を積み立てている。ところが、建築資材や人件費の高騰で工事費が膨らみ、当初の計画では足りなくなる例が相次いでいる。積立金を大幅に上げようとしても、年金で暮らす高齢の住民からは反対の声が上がりやすい。合意づくりの難しさが、老朽化をさらに進めかねない。
cards.en: In older condominium buildings, residents set aside money every month in preparation for large-scale repairs to exterior walls and plumbing. However, soaring prices for building materials and labor are driving up construction costs, and cases in which the original plans fall short keep emerging one after another. Even when there are attempts to raise the reserve contributions sharply, elderly residents living on pensions tend to voice opposition. The difficulty of reaching agreement could speed up the buildings' deterioration even further.

words.defJa: 電車やバスなどが最後に着く駅や停留所。また、物事の終わるところ。

cards.ja: 山あいを走るローカル線に揺られること二時間、列車はようやく終点の小さな駅に着いた。線路はここで途切れ、その先には谷と川が広がっているだけだ。駅前に食堂が一軒あり、旅人の多くはここで名物のそばを食べてから折り返しの列車を待つ。終点まで来なければ見られない風景が、この線の一番の魅力かもしれない。
cards.en: After two hours of swaying along a local line through the mountains, the train finally arrived at the small station at the end of the line. The tracks stop here, and beyond lies nothing but a valley and a river. There is a single eatery in front of the station, and many travelers eat the local specialty soba there before waiting for the return train. Scenery you can only see by coming all the way to the end of the line may be this line's greatest attraction.

words.defJa: 特に大切だとして、力を入れるところ。

cards.ja: 政府は来年度の予算案で、子育て支援と防災に重点を置く方針を示した。保育所の整備や児童手当の拡充に加え、老朽化した橋やトンネルの点検にも多くの予算を振り向ける。一方で、財源をどう確保するかについては具体策が乏しいとの批判も出ている。国会では今後、配分の優先順位をめぐって論戦が続く見通しだ。
cards.en: In its budget proposal for next fiscal year, the government announced a policy of placing priority on child-rearing support and disaster prevention. In addition to building more daycare centers and expanding child allowances, it will direct a large share of the budget to inspecting aging bridges and tunnels. On the other hand, criticism has also emerged that there are few concrete measures for how to secure the funding. In the Diet, debate over the order of priorities in the allocation is expected to continue.

words.meaning: assumption of office, taking up a post
words.defJa: ある役職や地位に新しくつくこと。

cards.ja: 四月に就任した新市長は、最初の記者会見で子育て支援の拡充を最優先の課題に掲げた。前市長の時代に削られた保育所への補助金を、来年度から段階的に元に戻すという。財源については、庁舎の建て替え計画を見直して確保する考えを示した。市議会の一部からは慎重な意見も出ており、実現には調整が必要になりそうだ。
cards.en: The new mayor, who took office in April, used the first press conference to put expanding child-rearing support at the top of the agenda. The subsidies for daycare centers that were cut under the previous mayor are to be restored in stages starting next fiscal year. As for funding, the mayor indicated a plan to secure it by reviewing the project to rebuild city hall. Some members of the city assembly have voiced caution, so making it happen will likely require some negotiation.

words.defJa: 会社で、経営にかかわる重要な地位についている人。

cards.ja: 創業百年を超える食品メーカーで、三十代の社員が初めて重役に抜擢された。商品開発部で若い世代向けの冷凍食品を次々とヒットさせた実績が評価されたという。社内では驚きの声も上がったが、古い体質を変えるきっかけになると期待する人も多い。本人は、現場の声を経営に届ける役目を果たしたいと話している。
cards.en: For the first time, an employee in their thirties has been promoted to the executive ranks at a food manufacturer founded more than a hundred years ago. What earned the promotion was reportedly a track record in the product development department of turning out one hit frozen food after another for younger consumers. There were voices of surprise within the company, but many hope it will be a chance to change the firm's old-fashioned culture. The new executive says the aim is to carry the voices of the front line to management.

words.defJa: 続いていた物事が終わること。また、終えること。

cards.ja: 長年親しまれてきた夕方の情報番組が、この春で放送を終了することになった。視聴者の高齢化に加え、ネット配信で番組を見る人が増え、スポンサーが集まりにくくなったのが理由だという。最終回には歴代の司会者が顔をそろえ、番組の歩みを振り返る予定だ。局には早くも、終了を惜しむ声が数多く寄せられている。
cards.en: A long-loved early-evening news and information program will end its run this spring. The reasons reportedly include an aging audience and the growing number of people who watch programs via online streaming, which has made sponsors harder to attract. For the final episode, the program's hosts over the years are set to gather and look back on its history. The station has already received many messages from viewers sorry to see it end.

words.defJa: 地球などの天体が、物をその中心に向かって引きつける力。

cards.ja: 国際宇宙ステーションでは重力がほとんど感じられないため、飛行士の体には地上とは違う変化が起きる。骨や筋肉は体重を支える必要がなくなり、数か月の滞在で目に見えて弱ってしまう。そこで飛行士は、毎日二時間ほど専用の装置を使って運動を続けている。地球に帰還した後も、体が地上の生活に慣れるまでにはしばらく時間がかかるという。
cards.en: Because gravity can hardly be felt on the International Space Station, astronauts' bodies undergo changes unlike those on the ground. Bones and muscles no longer have to support body weight, and over a stay of several months they visibly weaken. So astronauts keep exercising for about two hours every day on dedicated equipment. Even after returning to Earth, it reportedly takes some time for the body to get used to life on the ground again.

words.defJa: 二つ以上の漢字が結びついて、一つの言葉になったもの。

cards.ja: 漢字の学習が進むと、知らない熟語でも、一字一字の意味から全体の意味をある程度推測できるようになる。たとえば「登山」は「山に登る」、「読書」は「書を読む」と言い換えられ、上の字が動作を、下の字がその対象を表している。ただし、字の意味を足しただけでは理解できない言葉も少なくない。そうした例外に出会うたびに、言葉の歴史の奥深さを感じさせられる。
cards.en: As your kanji study progresses, you become able to guess, to some extent, the meaning of even unfamiliar compounds from the meanings of their individual characters. For example, the word for mountaineering can be rephrased as 'climb a mountain' and the word for reading as 'read books', with the first character expressing an action and the second its object. However, quite a few words cannot be understood simply by adding up the meanings of their characters. Every time you come across such an exception, you are struck by how deep the history of words runs.

words.defJa: 国が法律で定めた、記念やお祝いのための休みの日。

cards.ja: 五月の大型連休は祝日が続くため、全国の観光地は毎年大勢の人でにぎわう。一方で、サービス業や交通機関で働く人の中には、祝日こそ忙しくなるという人も少なくない。最近は混雑を避けて、あえて連休の前後に休みを取る会社員も増えてきた。休み方が多様になるにつれ、祝日の意味そのものも少しずつ変わりつつあるのかもしれない。
cards.en: Because national holidays come one after another during the long holiday period in May, tourist spots across the country are packed with people every year. On the other hand, quite a few people working in service industries or transportation say that holidays are precisely when they are busiest. Recently, more office workers have been deliberately taking time off just before or after the holiday period to avoid the crowds. As ways of taking time off diversify, the very meaning of national holidays may be gradually changing.

words.defJa: 入学や資格を得るための試験を受けること。

cards.ja: 首都圏では、中学受験に挑む子どもが年々増えている。多くの家庭が小学四年生のころから塾に通わせ、夏休みも朝から夜まで勉強漬けの日々が続く。教育費の負担は重く、親が仕事を増やしてまかなうケースも珍しくない。専門家の中には、子どもが自由に遊ぶ時間が奪われていると懸念する声もある。
cards.en: In the Tokyo metropolitan area, the number of children taking on junior high school entrance exams is rising every year. Many families start sending their children to cram school around fourth grade, and even summer vacation becomes a string of days steeped in study from morning to night. The burden of education costs is heavy, and it is not unusual for parents to take on extra work to cover them. Some experts worry that children are being robbed of time to play freely.

words.defJa: 文の中で、動作をする人や物、ある状態にある人や物を表す部分。

cards.ja: 日本語の会話では、主語が省かれることがよくある。誰の話なのかは、場面や前後の流れからおのずとわかるからだ。ところが、こうした文をAIで英語に翻訳すると、「彼」や「私たち」など、誤った主語が補われてしまうことがある。書かれていない情報を文脈からどこまで正しく読み取れるかは、翻訳AIにとって今も大きな課題だ。
cards.en: In Japanese conversation, the subject is often left out. That is because who is being talked about becomes naturally clear from the situation and the flow of the conversation. However, when such sentences are translated into English with AI, a wrong subject such as 'he' or 'we' sometimes gets filled in. How accurately unwritten information can be read from context remains a major challenge for translation AI.

words.defJa: 妻がほかの人に対して自分の夫を指して言う言葉。また、店や家の主。

cards.ja: 配偶者のことを人に話すとき、どう呼べばよいか迷うという声をよく耳にする。年配の女性の多くは、今でもごく自然に「うちの主人が」と口にする。しかし、この言葉には夫が家の主だという古い考えが残っているとして、「夫」や「パートナー」を選ぶ若い世代も増えている。呼び方一つにも、家族のあり方の変化が映し出されているようだ。
cards.en: One often hears people say they are unsure what to call their spouse when talking about them to others. Many older women still quite naturally refer to their husband with the word that literally means 'master of the house'. However, more and more younger people, feeling the word carries an old idea that the husband is head of the household, choose the plain word for 'husband' or 'partner' instead. Even a single choice of term seems to reflect how the shape of the family is changing.

words.defJa: 文の中で、主語がどうするか、どんなようすかを表す部分。

cards.ja: 日本語の文では、述語が最後に来るのが基本である。そのため聞き手は、話を最後まで聞かないと、相手が賛成なのか反対なのかわからないことがある。長い文を書くときは、主語と述語が離れすぎないように気をつけるだけで、ぐっと読みやすくなる。新聞記者が一文を短くするよう指導されるのも、一つにはこのためだ。
cards.en: In Japanese sentences, the basic rule is that the predicate comes at the end. For that reason, a listener sometimes cannot tell whether the speaker is for or against something without hearing them out to the very end. When writing a long sentence, simply taking care not to let the subject and predicate drift too far apart makes it much easier to read. This is partly why newspaper reporters are trained to keep each sentence short.

cards.en: With online meetings now the norm, day-trip business travel has dropped sharply. Even so, many companies still go to meet in person for the first business negotiation with a new client. That is because facial expressions and the atmosphere of the room do not come across well through a screen, so building trust takes longer. Even if the number of business trips has gone down, one could say each individual trip now carries more weight, if anything.

words.defJa: 電話機で、耳に当てて相手の声を聞き、口に向けて話す部分。

cards.ja: スマートフォンしか知らない子どもたちに、昔の黒電話を触ってもらう授業が小学校で開かれた。重い受話器を持ち上げ、ダイヤルを一つずつ回して電話をかける作業に、子どもたちは夢中になった。番号を回し終えるまでの時間の長さに驚き、一つでも間違えたら最初からやり直しだと知ると、教室には悲鳴が上がった。担任は、道具の変化から暮らしの移り変わりを考えてほしいと話す。
cards.en: An elementary school held a class in which children who have only ever known smartphones got to handle an old black rotary telephone. The children were absorbed in lifting the heavy receiver and turning the dial one digit at a time to place a call. They were surprised at how long it took to dial a whole number, and when they learned that a single mistake meant starting over from the beginning, the classroom erupted in shrieks. Their homeroom teacher says the hope is that they will think about how daily life has changed through the way tools have changed.

words.defJa: 警察官の階級の中でいちばん下の位。また、その位の警察官。

cards.ja: 駅前の交番に勤める若い巡査は、毎朝、通学路に立って子どもたちに声をかけている。地域の人とはすっかり顔なじみで、道案内や落とし物の相談に応じるだけでなく、一人暮らしの高齢者の様子を見に行くこともある。こうした地道な活動が、事件や事故を未然に防ぐことにつながっているという。交番は、地域の安心を支える身近な拠点なのだ。
cards.en: A young patrol officer stationed at the police box in front of the station stands on the school route every morning, greeting the children. The officer is on familiar terms with local residents, and besides giving directions and helping with lost property, sometimes goes to check on elderly people who live alone. Steady work like this is said to help prevent crimes and accidents before they happen. The police box is a familiar base that underpins the community's sense of safety.

cards.ja: 桜の開花は、例年三月の中旬から下旬にかけて西日本や関東の各地で始まり、北へ向かって順々に進んでいく。東京で満開を迎えるころ、東北ではまだつぼみが固く、北海道で花が咲くのは五月の連休前後になる。開花日の同じ地点を地図上で結んだ線は、桜前線と呼ばれている。この前線を追いかけて、ひと春に何度も花見を楽しむ旅行者もいるそうだ。
cards.en: Cherry blossoms usually start opening between mid- and late March in western Japan and the Kanto region, then advance northward in turn. Around the time they reach full bloom in Tokyo, the buds in the Tohoku region are still tight, and in Hokkaido the flowers open around the early-May holidays. The line on a map linking places with the same bloom date is called the cherry blossom front. There are reportedly travelers who follow this front and enjoy blossom viewing several times in a single spring.

words.defJa: 心がすなおで、けがれを知らないこと。特に、恋愛についてうぶなこと。

cards.ja: いま放送中の連続ドラマは、昭和の終わりの地方都市を舞台に、純情な高校生の初恋を描いた物語だ。主人公は思いを伝えられないまま、手紙を書いては破ることを繰り返す。派手な展開はないが、携帯電話のない時代の不器用なやりとりが、かえって新鮮に映るらしい。放送のたびに、若い視聴者からも共感の声がネットにあふれている。
cards.en: The drama series now on air tells of a pure-hearted high school student's first love, set in a provincial city in the last years of the Showa era. The protagonist, unable to confess their feelings, keeps writing letters and tearing them up. There are no flashy twists, but the clumsy exchanges of an era without cell phones apparently come across as all the more refreshing. Every time an episode airs, the internet overflows with sympathetic comments, even from young viewers.

cards.ja: 子どものころの純粋な好奇心が、大きな発見につながることがある。ある生物学者が研究者を志したのは、幼いころ庭で見つけたダンゴムシがなぜ丸くなるのか、不思議に思ったのがきっかけだったという。役に立つかどうかを考えず、知りたいという気持ちだけで続けた観察が、のちに新しい研究分野を開いた。成果ばかりが求められる今だからこそ、こうした動機を大切にしたい。
cards.en: The pure curiosity of childhood can sometimes lead to great discoveries. One biologist says the wish to become a researcher began with wondering, as a small child, why the pill bugs in the garden rolled up into balls. Observations pursued with no thought of usefulness, purely out of the desire to know, later opened up a new field of research. Precisely because results are all that is demanded nowadays, motives like this deserve to be cherished.

cards.en: Many people agonize over what to talk about when meeting someone for the first time. According to one psychology study, asking slightly more probing questions leaves both people with a better impression than safe small talk about things like the weather. What matters is asking about the other person's interests and listening to their answers with genuine interest. The first few minutes of conversation can greatly shape the relationship that follows.

cards.ja: 日本の食料自給率はカロリーで見ると四割に満たず、諸外国と比べても低い水準にとどまっている。小麦や大豆、家畜のえさとなるトウモロコシの多くを輸入に頼っているためだ。国際情勢が不安定になれば、価格が高騰したり、輸入が滞ったりするおそれがある。政府は国産小麦や米粉の利用を広げようとしているが、長年の食習慣を変えるのは容易ではない。
cards.en: Measured in calories, Japan's food self-sufficiency rate is below 40 percent, a low level even compared with other countries. That is because it relies on imports for much of its wheat, soybeans and the corn used as livestock feed. If the international situation becomes unstable, prices could soar or imports could be disrupted. The government is trying to expand the use of domestic wheat and rice flour, but changing long-standing eating habits is not easy.

Though at a physical disadvantage, they held off the opponent's attacks with quick passing and tenacious defense, and protected the single goal they scored late in the match. Families have recently begun turning up at domestic league matches that once drew only sparse crowds. It is hoped that this success will lead more people to take up the sport.

Simply replacing an air conditioner more than ten years old with the latest model can sometimes cut power consumption substantially. Putting insulating film on windows or blocking the sun with bamboo blinds is also said to go a long way toward keeping rooms from heating up. Small measures like these add up to a way of living that is kind to both the household budget and the environment.

cards.en: Eating a greasy meal late at night can leave your stomach feeling heavy until the next morning. That is because the stomach and intestines work more sluggishly while you sleep, so digesting what you ate takes longer. Doctors say it is best to finish dinner at least three hours before bed and to chew your food well. On days when eating late cannot be helped, they suggest choosing something easy on the stomach, such as udon noodles or tofu.

It is essential for each family to discuss and agree on rules for how the phone is used.

cards.ja: 将棋の世界では、ここ十年ほどでAIの存在感が一気に増した。プロ棋士もAIを使って序盤の研究を重ね、かつては悪い手とされていた指し方が見直されるようになっている。対局の中継では、AIがはじき出す形勢の数値が画面に表示され、ファンの楽しみ方も変わった。それでも、人間同士が時間に追われながら迷う姿にこそ魅力があると語るファンは多い。

Professional players, too, use AI to study openings in depth, and moves once considered bad are being reassessed. In broadcasts of matches, the evaluation figures that AI churns out are shown on screen, changing the way fans enjoy the game. Even so, many fans say the real appeal lies in watching two humans agonize over their moves while pressed for time.

words.defJa: 液体が熱などによって気体になったもの。特に、水が気体になったもの。

cards.ja: 十八世紀のイギリスで改良された蒸気機関は、人々の暮らしと働き方を大きく変えた。石炭を燃やして水を沸かし、生じた蒸気の力で機械を動かす仕組みによって、工場での大量生産が可能になった。やがて蒸気機関車や蒸気船が登場し、人や物の移動にかかる時間は劇的に短くなった。産業革命と呼ばれるこの変化は、現代社会の出発点ともいわれる。
cards.en: The steam engine, improved in eighteenth-century Britain, transformed how people lived and worked. A system that burned coal to boil water and used the resulting steam to drive machines made mass production in factories possible. Before long steam locomotives and steamships appeared, and the time it took to move people and goods shrank dramatically. This transformation, known as the Industrial Revolution, is said to be the starting point of modern society.

Even if drawing a straight line takes everything students have at first, after a few months they can produce drawings so beautiful they are hardly recognizable as the same person's work.

Steady accumulation eventually makes a big difference.

cards.en: In elementary school arithmetic, children learn to add and subtract decimals in the middle grades. By linking numbers to a sense of quantity, the teacher says, the children come to understand why the places must line up, and calculation errors have visibly decreased.

cards.ja: 契約は原則として、当事者の一方が申し込み、相手がそれを承諾した時点で成立する。書面を交わさなくても、口頭の約束だけで効力が生ずる場合が多い。たとえば店頭で商品を買うことも、法律上は売買契約の一つにあたる。後になって言った言わないの争いを避けるため、大きな取引では契約書を作るのが一般的である。
cards.en: As a rule, a contract is formed at the moment one party makes an offer and the other accepts it. Even without exchanging documents, in many cases an oral promise alone gives it legal effect. For example, buying an item in a shop is, legally speaking, also a kind of sales contract. To avoid later disputes over who said what, it is common to draw up a written contract for large transactions.

words.defJa: 薬や熱などを使って、病気のもとになる菌やウイルスを害のない状態にすること。

cards.ja: 病院の入り口には、手を消毒するためのアルコールが置かれている。感染症の流行をきっかけに各地へ広まった光景だが、今ではすっかり見慣れたものになった。ただ、専門家によれば、ノロウイルスのようにアルコールが効きにくいウイルスもあり、せっけんでの手洗いが基本であることに変わりはない。消毒だけに頼らず、場面に応じて手洗いと使い分けることが大切だという。
cards.en: At hospital entrances, alcohol is provided for disinfecting your hands. It is a sight that spread everywhere during an epidemic, and it has now become completely familiar. According to experts, however, some viruses, such as norovirus, are not easily killed by alcohol, and handwashing with soap remains the basic measure. They say it is important not to rely on disinfection alone but to choose between it and handwashing according to the situation.

words.meaning: victory or defeat; the outcome (of a contest)
words.defJa: 勝つことと負けること。戦いや試合の結果。

cards.ja: 今回の知事選は、両候補が終盤まで激しく競り合い、勝敗の行方が読めない展開となった。勝敗を分けたのは、若い世代の投票率だったとみられる。二十代の投票率は前回を大きく上回り、期日前投票の伸びも目立った。当選した候補の陣営は、ネットでの発信が若者に届いた手応えを口にしている。
cards.en: In this gubernatorial election, the two candidates stayed locked in a close race until the final stretch, making it impossible to read which way the outcome would go. What decided the result appears to have been turnout among younger voters. Turnout among people in their twenties greatly exceeded that of the previous election, and the rise in early voting also stood out. The winning candidate's camp says it felt its online messaging had reached young people.

words.defJa: 品がよく、落ち着いていて美しいようす。

cards.ja: 老舗の和菓子店が新たに出したようかんは、甘さを控えた上品な味わいが評判を呼んでいる。砂糖の量を従来の三割ほど減らし、代わりに小豆そのものの香りを引き立てたという。包装も落ち着いた色合いでまとめられ、手土産として選ぶ客が多い。店主は、若い世代にも和菓子の良さを知ってほしいと話す。
cards.en: The yokan newly released by a long-established Japanese confectionery shop is winning praise for its refined, restrained sweetness. The amount of sugar was cut by about thirty percent compared with before, and instead the aroma of the azuki beans themselves was brought out. The packaging, too, comes in subdued colors, and many customers choose it as a gift to take when visiting someone. The owner says the hope is that younger generations will also come to appreciate Japanese sweets.

words.defJa: 勝ち負けを争うこと。また、その戦い。

cards.ja: 高校野球の地方大会の決勝は、一点を争う緊迫した勝負になった。九回裏、走者を三塁に置いて打席に立ったのは、この日まだ一本もヒットを打っていない二年生だった。監督は代打を出さず、そのまま彼に勝負を任せた。初球を思い切り振り抜くと、打球は外野手の頭上を越えていった。
cards.en: The final of the regional high school baseball tournament became a tense contest fought over a single run. In the bottom of the ninth, with a runner on third, the batter who stepped up to the plate was a second-year student who had not had a single hit that day. The manager did not send in a pinch hitter and left the showdown to him. He swung hard at the first pitch, and the ball sailed over the outfielders' heads.

words.defJa: 体の中のいらない水分が、尿として外に出されたもの。また、それを出すこと。

cards.ja: 古い繁華街の路地では、夜になると酔った客が壁際で小便をしていく被害が後を絶たなかった。困った商店会が試しに置いたのが、高さ数十センチの小さな鳥居だった。神聖な場所を汚すことへのためらいが働くのか、それ以来、汚れは目に見えて減ったという。同じ工夫は全国の街角で見られ、日本ならではの対策として海外でも紹介されている。
cards.en: In the alleys of an old nightlife district, there was no end to drunken customers urinating against the walls at night. What the exasperated local shopkeepers' association tried, as an experiment, was a small torii gate a few dozen centimeters high. Perhaps a reluctance to defile a sacred place comes into play, but since then the mess has visibly decreased. The same trick can be seen on street corners across the country and has been introduced abroad as a distinctly Japanese measure.

words.defJa: 火事を消したり、急病人を救急車で運んだりする仕事の拠点となる、自治体の機関。

cards.ja: 市内の消防署では、毎年秋に施設を市民に開放するイベントを開いている。子どもたちは本物の消防車に乗り込んだり、防火服を着て記念写真を撮ったりして楽しむ。煙が立ちこめた部屋の中を、身をかがめて進む体験コーナーも人気で、大人が真剣に取り組む姿も見られる。署員は、楽しみながら防災の意識を高めてほしいと話している。
cards.en: The city's fire station holds an event every autumn that opens its facilities to residents. Children enjoy climbing into real fire engines and having souvenir photos taken in firefighting suits. A hands-on corner where you make your way crouched low through a smoke-filled room is also popular, and adults can be seen taking it seriously too. The station staff say they hope people will become more aware of disaster preparedness while having fun.

cards.ja: ある部署の定例会議は、毎回二時間の枠を取っていたが、正味の話し合いは三十分ほどにすぎなかった。冒頭の資料の読み合わせや、議題と関係のない雑談に多くの時間が取られていたからだ。そこで部長は、議題を前日までに配り、会議は一時間で切り上げるという決まりを作った。時間が短くなった分、かえって中身の濃い議論ができるようになったという声が多い。
cards.en: One department's regular meeting was always booked for two hours, yet the actual discussion came to no more than about thirty minutes. That was because a lot of time was taken up by reading through documents together at the start and by small talk unrelated to the agenda. So the department head made a rule that the agenda would be handed out by the day before and meetings would wrap up within an hour. Many say that now meetings are shorter, they have in fact been able to have more substantive discussions.

cards.en: The city's international exchange association runs beginner-level Japanese classes for foreign residents. The content centers on expressions that are immediately useful in daily life, such as greetings, shopping and checking in at a hospital. The instructors are all volunteers, with retired teachers and university students taking turns. Many go on to the intermediate class after completing the course, and some happily report that they have made friends in the community.

words.meaning: assistant professor (former title, now associate professor)
words.defJa: 大学で、教授の次の位の先生を指した、以前の呼び名。

cards.ja: 大学教員の肩書きは、2007年に施行された法改正で大きく変わった。それまでの助教授は准教授という名称に改められ、教授を補佐する立場ではなく、自ら研究や教育を担う職であることが明確にされた。ただ、年配の世代には今でも助教授という呼び方のほうが耳になじんでいる。大学を舞台にした昔の小説やドラマにも、この肩書きの人物がよく登場する。
cards.en: University faculty titles changed significantly with a legal revision that took effect in 2007. The former title of assistant professor was renamed associate professor, making it clear that the post is not one of assisting a professor but one that carries out research and teaching in its own right. Still, to older generations the old title sounds more familiar even now. Characters bearing it also appear often in older novels and TV dramas set at universities.

words.defJa: 料理などに使う、白くて細かい塩。

cards.ja: 夏休みの自由研究の定番に、食塩の結晶づくりがある。お湯に塩を溶けるだけ溶かし、糸をつるして静かに置いておくと、数日で四角い粒が育っていく。水が少しずつ蒸発するにつれて、溶けきれなくなった塩が結晶として現れるのだ。大きく育てるコツは、容器を動かさず、ほこりが入らないようにすることだという。
cards.en: One of the standard summer-vacation research projects is growing table-salt crystals. If you dissolve as much salt as will dissolve in hot water, hang a thread in it and leave it undisturbed, square grains grow over a few days. As the water gradually evaporates, the salt that can no longer stay dissolved appears as crystals. The trick to growing large ones, it is said, is not to move the container and to keep dust out.

cards.en: In a small workshop in Kyoto, a third-generation craftsman still weaves bamboo baskets by hand. He goes into the mountains himself to choose the bamboo, dries it for about a year and then splits it into thin strips. Finishing a single basket can take a week, and the price cannot be compared with that of mass-produced goods. Even so, word that the baskets last for decades with repairs has spread, and orders keep coming in from Japan and abroad.

cards.en: This year's new-crop rice began appearing in stores in early September, a little earlier than usual. That is because the summer heat sped up growth, but in some producing areas there are also worries that the heat has lowered quality. Rice prices remain high, and concern about the impact on household budgets runs deep. At retailers, measures such as selling cheaper blends mixed with older rice are spreading.

words.defJa: 印刷して出版された本。また、本をまとめていう言葉。

cards.ja: 出版業界では、電子書籍の売り上げが紙の書籍の落ち込みを補う形で伸び続けている。特に漫画は電子版の比率が高く、スマートフォンで読むのが当たり前になった。一方で、文芸書や専門書では、今も紙で読みたいという読者が多い。出版社は紙と電子を同時に発売するなど、読者の好みに合わせた売り方を探っている。
cards.en: In the publishing industry, sales of e-books keep growing in a way that offsets the decline in print books. Manga in particular has a high share of digital editions, and reading on a smartphone has become the norm. On the other hand, for literary works and specialist books, many readers still want to read on paper. Publishers are exploring ways of selling that suit readers' preferences, such as releasing print and digital editions at the same time.

words.defJa: 食事のときに使う、皿やおわん、はしなどの道具。

cards.en: When I moved house, I took the plunge and cut the tableware in my home by half. Plates and teacups I had kept in case I used them someday had been sitting at the back of the shelves for years. Once I kept only what I use every day, the washing-up was done in no time and the shelves became so tidy they were unrecognizable. I had a local secondhand shop take some of the dishes I let go.

cards.en: According to one survey, more than a quarter of municipalities nationwide have not a single bookstore. Besides the spread of online shopping and digital editions, the lack of successors is a major reason for closures. Against this backdrop, moves have emerged such as adding small bookstores to libraries and residents investing to open shops themselves. They are attempts to preserve places where people can pick up books and choose them in person.

words.defJa: 筆と墨を使って、文字を美しく書く芸術。

cards.ja: 書道の授業では、半紙に向かう前に、まず墨をすって気持ちを落ち着けることから始める。筆に含ませる墨の量や、紙に下ろす速さによって、同じ字でも印象がまったく変わる。最近は、大きな筆で音楽に合わせて書く書道パフォーマンスが高校生の間で人気を集めている。伝統の技が、新しい表現の場を得ていると言えるだろう。
cards.en: In calligraphy class, before facing the sheet of paper, you begin by grinding the ink to settle your mind. Depending on how much ink you load onto the brush and how quickly you bring it down onto the paper, the same character can give a completely different impression. Recently, calligraphy performances, in which huge brushes are used to write in time to music, have become popular among high school students. One could say a traditional skill has found a new stage for expression.

The first hurdle, however, lies less in the syntax itself than in not knowing what to fix when an error appears. Finding experienced peers you can ask questions casually is said to be the greatest help in sticking with it rather than giving up halfway.

cards.ja: 白髪が増えるのは、髪に色をつける色素を作る細胞の働きが年齢とともに衰えるためだ。ストレスで一晩にして髪が白くなるという話もあるが、医学的な裏付けは乏しいとされてきた。ただ近年、強いストレスが色素を作る細胞のもとになる幹細胞を減らしてしまうことを、マウスの実験で示した研究も報告されている。一方で、白髪を無理に染めず、そのまま生かした髪型を楽しむ人も増えている。
cards.en: Grey hair increases because the cells that produce the pigment giving hair its color work less well with age. Meanwhile, more and more people are enjoying hairstyles that make the most of their grey hair instead of forcing themselves to dye it.

As people have come to recognize more faces, the share of newcomers who stay on has also risen.

The appeal of private combined middle and high schools is said to be that, with no high school entrance exam, students can study on a curriculum planned over six years and also throw themselves into club activities. On the other hand, the burden of tuition and cram school fees is heavy, and quite a few families give up on the exams for financial reasons. cards.ja: 鶏のもも肉を焼くときは、皮目から中火でじっくり火を通すのが基本だ。いちばん厚い部分に竹串を刺してみて、透き通った汁が出てくれば焼き上がりの目安にはなる。ただし、汁の色だけでは、中まで火が通ったかどうかを確実には判断できない。焼き上がってもすぐには切らず、数分置いて落ち着かせると、切ったときに肉汁が流れ出にくいという。
cards.en: When cooking chicken thigh, the basic rule is to start skin-side down over medium heat and cook it through slowly. Pierce the thickest part with a bamboo skewer, and if clear juice runs out, that can be a rough sign it is done. However, juice color alone cannot reliably tell you whether it is cooked through to the center. Even once it is done, if you let it rest for a few minutes instead of cutting it right away, the juices are said to be less likely to run out when you slice it.

words.defJa: その仕事や分野を専門にしていない人。経験の浅い人。

cards.ja: かつて写真集を出せるのは、一部のプロの写真家に限られていた。ところが今では、素人がスマートフォンで撮った一枚がネットで話題になり、出版や広告の仕事につながることも珍しくない。機材の性能が上がり、技術の差が見えにくくなったことが背景にある。それでもプロの写真家たちは、光を読む力や、狙った一枚を確実に撮る安定感には今も大きな差があると口をそろえる。
cards.en: In the past, only a select few professional photographers could publish a photo book. Today, however, it is not unusual for a single shot taken by an amateur on a smartphone to go viral online and lead to publishing or advertising work. Behind this is the improved performance of equipment, which has made differences in skill harder to see. This difference between sound and light becomes clear when you consider what each kind of wave travels through.

cards.en: In recent years, universities have conspicuously been shrinking their humanities faculties and redirecting budgets toward science, engineering and information technology. We need to reconsider the value of scholarship that cannot be measured by efficiency alone.

Even without a dedicated tool, you can measure the tilt with a smartphone app. A beautiful finish depends on the accumulation of such careful checks.

cards.ja: 早朝の海岸に立つと、水平線の向こうから太陽がゆっくりと姿を現した。空と海の境目がオレンジ色に染まり、波の音だけが静かに響いている。地球が丸いため、浜辺に立った人の目の高さから見える水平線までの距離は、わずか五キロほどだという。それでも、その先に果てしない広がりがあるように感じられるのが不思議だ。
cards.en: Standing on the shore in the early morning, I watched the sun slowly emerge from beyond the horizon. The boundary between sky and sea was dyed orange, and only the sound of the waves echoed quietly. Because the earth is round, the distance to the horizon from the eye level of a person standing on the beach is said to be only about five kilometers. Even so, it is strange how it feels as though endless space stretches out beyond it.

cards.en: On a windless morning, the surface of the pond lay still as a mirror, reflecting the surrounding trees and sky just as they were. When a single frog jumped in, small ripples spread outward in rings. Because even a slight breeze breaks up the reflection, the quiet time just after dawn is a good opportunity to capture a scene like this on camera. For a photographer, capturing that moment is the reward for getting up early.

cards.en: The small Western-style restaurant in front of the station is closed every Wednesday. According to the owner, it began with the decision to close on the same day the wholesale market is closed. The idea is that rather than forcing the place open on a day when fresh ingredients cannot be had, it is better to spend the day on prep and cleaning. Among regulars, absentmindedly showing up on a Wednesday and slumping in front of the closed door has become a kind of running joke.

cards.ja: 行列のできるラーメン店で、知り合いを見つけたふりをして列の途中に割り込む客がいた。周りの人たちは顔をしかめたが、本人は気にする様子もなく平然と話し続けている。そのあまりに図々しい態度に、後ろに並んでいた年配の男性がとうとう声を上げた。客は気まずそうに列を離れ、あちこちから小さな拍手が起こった。
cards.en: At a ramen shop with a long line, a customer cut in partway down the queue by pretending to have spotted an acquaintance. The people around frowned, but he kept chatting calmly, showing no sign of caring. At such brazen behavior, an older man waiting behind finally spoke up. The customer left the line awkwardly, and scattered applause broke out here and there.

cards.ja: 三人きょうだいの末っ子として育った私は、幼いころから兄や姉の後をついて回っていた。両親は上の二人には厳しかったのに、私にはずいぶん甘かったと、今でも姉にからかわれる。末っ子は周りをよく観察して育つため、人の気持ちを読むのが得意だという説もある。本当かどうかはともかく、家族の中での立ち位置が性格に何らかの影響を与えるのは確かだろう。
cards.en: Having grown up as the youngest of three siblings, I followed my older brother and sister around from an early age. My sister still teases me that our parents were strict with the older two but much softer on me. There is a theory that youngest children grow up closely watching those around them and so are good at reading people's feelings. Whether or not that is true, one's position in the family surely has some influence on personality.

cards.ja: 子どものころ、擦り切れるほど眺めていたのが昆虫図鑑だった。夏休みに捕まえた虫を図鑑と見比べ、名前を調べるのが何よりの楽しみだった。最近は、スマートフォンのカメラを向けるだけで種類を教えてくれるアプリもある。それでも、ページをめくるうちに思いがけない生き物と出会える紙の図鑑には、別の魅力があると思う。
cards.en: As a child, the book I pored over until it was worn out was an illustrated guide to insects. My greatest pleasure was comparing the bugs I caught over summer vacation with the pictures in it and looking up their names. These days there are apps that tell you the species just by pointing a smartphone camera. Even so, I think a paper field guide, where you stumble upon unexpected creatures as you turn the pages, has a different charm.

cards.en: Phone-scam techniques grow more sophisticated every year. The perpetrators rattle their targets with stories of a family member's accident or a tax refund, leaving them no time to think calmly. Their typical method is to exploit anxiety or goodwill and strike at a moment when the target's guard is down. Experts urge people to hang up as soon as money comes up on a call and to consult their family or the police.

cards.ja: 春先になると、全国で多くの人が花粉症に悩まされる。その主な原因は、戦後に大量に植えられた杉の人工林だ。当時は住宅用の木材として需要が高かったが、安い輸入材に押されて伐採が進まず、成長した木が毎年大量の花粉を飛ばしている。林野庁は花粉の少ない品種への植え替えを進めているものの、すべてが入れ替わるには長い年月がかかる。
cards.en: Every early spring, large numbers of people across the country suffer from hay fever. Its main cause is the man-made forests of Japanese cedar planted in vast numbers after the war. Demand for the timber for housing was high at the time, but undercut by cheap imported wood, logging has stalled, and the grown trees release huge amounts of pollen every year. The Forestry Agency is pushing to replant with low-pollen varieties, but it will take many years for all of them to be replaced.

cards.en: Many parents fret over their children's picky eating. One nursery school has kept up an initiative in which the children grow green peppers and tomatoes themselves in a vegetable patch in the schoolyard. When the harvested vegetables are served at lunch, even children who usually leave their vegetables reportedly eat them eagerly if they grew them themselves. The nutritionist says that creating opportunities to get familiar with ingredients matters more than forcing children to eat.

This clarity comes from the islands having few large rivers, so little sediment or nutrients flow into the sea. In recent years, however, more areas have turned murky as red soil washes off farmland, and local communities are hurrying to take countermeasures.

cards.ja: 睡眠の専門家によれば、成人は少なくとも一日七時間の睡眠をとることが望ましい。ところが国内の調査では、働く世代の四割近くが六時間未満しか眠っていないという。睡眠不足が続くと、集中力が落ちるだけでなく、生活習慣病のリスクも高まる。寝る前の一時間はスマートフォンを手放すなど、小さな工夫から始めたい。
cards.en: According to sleep experts, it is desirable for adults to get at least seven hours of sleep a day. Yet a domestic survey found that nearly 40 percent of the working-age population sleeps less than six hours. If sleep deprivation continues, it not only lowers concentration but also raises the risk of lifestyle diseases. It is worth starting with small changes, such as putting the smartphone away for the hour before bed.

words.defJa: 点や線、面などで作られた形。三角形や円など。
