cards.en: In elementary-school math, quite a few pupils struggle with the unit on shapes. Rotating a triangle or cube from the page in one's head, or assembling a net into a solid, is a harder task than one might imagine. So an elementary school in one city introduced lessons in which children use tablets and learn while freely moving solids around on the screen. According to the teachers, many children deepen their understanding by manipulating the shapes with their hands.

cards.en: On autumn mountain walks, you need to watch out for encounters with bears. Bears preparing for hibernation roam actively in search of food and sometimes come down close to human settlements. Hikers walk with bells on their backpacks to signal their presence with sound and prevent accidents from sudden face-to-face encounters. Experts urge people to move in groups in addition to carrying bells, and to avoid entering the mountains early in the morning or in the evening.

words.defJa: 暑いときに、日陰や風の通る所へ行って、暑さをしのぐ。

cards.ja: 京都の夏は蒸し暑いことで知られる。日が沈むころになると、市内を流れる川の土手には大勢の人が腰を下ろし、川を渡る風に吹かれながら涼んでいる。川沿いの料理店が夏の間だけ設ける屋外の席も、昔から続く季節の風物詩だ。エアコンのない時代、人々は風の通り道や水辺を探し、少しでも快適に過ごす工夫を重ねてきた。
cards.en: Kyoto's summers are known for being hot and humid. Around sunset, crowds sit down on the banks of the river running through the city and cool off in the breeze blowing across the water. The outdoor seating that riverside restaurants set up only in summer is also a seasonal tradition of long standing. In the days before air conditioning, people sought out paths of the wind and waterside spots, devising ways to stay even a little more comfortable.

words.defJa: ひねくれたところがなく、人の言うことや自分の気持ちをそのまま受け入れるようす。

cards.ja: 新人の成長が早いかどうかは、能力よりも姿勢で決まると話す管理職は多い。先輩から指摘を受けたとき、言い訳をせずに素直に受け止められる人は、同じ失敗を繰り返しにくい。もちろん、何でも言われたとおりにすればよいわけではない。疑問があれば率直に尋ね、納得したうえで改める柔軟さこそが求められている。
cards.en: Many managers say that whether a newcomer grows quickly depends more on attitude than on ability. People who can take a senior colleague's criticism openly, without making excuses, are less likely to repeat the same mistake. Of course, that does not mean doing everything exactly as you are told. What is really needed is the flexibility to ask frankly when you have doubts and to change once you are convinced.

words.defJa: 物事を考えたり判断したりする力。また、そのような力を持つ優れた人。

cards.ja: 日本の研究力の低下が指摘されて久しい。若手研究者の多くは任期付きの不安定な職に就いており、より良い待遇を求めて海外の大学や企業へ移る例も目立つ。こうした頭脳の流出を食い止めるため、国は長期的に研究に専念できるポストを増やす方針を打ち出した。ただ、効果が表れるまでには時間がかかるとの見方が強い。
cards.en: Japan's declining research capacity has been pointed out for a long time. Many young researchers hold unstable fixed-term positions, and cases of them moving to overseas universities and companies in search of better conditions stand out. To stem this brain drain, the government has announced a policy of increasing positions that let researchers concentrate on their work over the long term. However, the prevailing view is that it will take time for the effects to show.

cards.ja: 新聞の経済面では、文章だけでは伝わりにくい数字の動きを図表で示すことが多い。たとえば、物価と賃金の推移を一枚の折れ線グラフに重ねれば、暮らしが苦しくなっている理由がひと目でわかる。ただし、目盛りの取り方次第で、受ける印象は大きく変わる。読み手の側にも、図表をそのまま信じ込まず、軸の数字まで確かめる習慣が求められる。
cards.en: On newspapers' business pages, movements in figures that are hard to convey in prose alone are often shown in charts and tables. For example, if you overlay the trends in prices and wages on a single line graph, you can see at a glance why life is getting harder. However, the impression you get can change greatly depending on how the scale is set. Readers, too, need the habit of not taking a chart at face value and of checking the numbers on the axes.

words.meaning: home, dwelling; place where one lives
words.defJa: 人が暮らしている家や場所。

cards.ja: 人口が減り続ける地方では、空き家の活用が大きな課題になっている。ある町は、古い民家を改修して若い移住者に安く貸し出す事業を始めた。都会の狭いマンションから広い庭付きの住まいへ移り、在宅で仕事を続ける家族も少なくない。町の担当者は、住む場所だけでなく地域とのつながりを用意することが定着の鍵だと話す。
cards.en: In rural areas where the population keeps shrinking, putting vacant houses to use has become a major challenge. One town has started a program that renovates old houses and rents them cheaply to young people moving in. Quite a few families have moved from cramped city apartments into homes with large gardens and continue working remotely. The town official says that providing not only a place to live but also ties with the community is the key to getting people to stay.

words.defJa: 土俵の中で二人が組み合い、相手を倒すか外に出せば勝ちとなる日本の伝統的な競技。

cards.ja: 大相撲の本場所は年に六回開かれ、一場所は十五日間にわたって行われる。力士は番付と呼ばれる序列で格付けされ、原則として勝ち越すか負け越すかによって次の場所での地位が上下する。最近は外国人の観客も増え、取組の前に力士が塩をまく所作に見入る姿も見られる。勝負そのものだけでなく、神事に由来する儀式の美しさも相撲の魅力だ。
cards.en: Grand sumo's official tournaments are held six times a year, each lasting fifteen days. Wrestlers are ranked in a hierarchy known as the banzuke, and whether they finish with a winning or losing record generally moves them up or down for the next tournament. Foreign spectators have recently increased too, and they can be seen absorbed in the ritual of wrestlers scattering salt before a bout. Beyond the contests themselves, part of sumo's appeal is the beauty of rituals rooted in Shinto ceremony.

cards.en: A common cause of sibling quarrels is the sense that only one of them is getting a better deal. Children are more sensitive to such differences than adults think, and they are quick to cry, "No fair!" Parents, for their part, are advised that it is important to explain the reasons properly so the children can accept them.

words.defJa: 物の長さや幅、高さなどの大きさ。

cards.ja: 通販で家具を買うときに失敗しやすいのが、サイズの確認だ。商品ページの寸法だけを見て注文し、届いてみたら玄関や廊下を通らなかったという相談が後を絶たない。部屋に置く場所だけでなく、運び込む経路の幅や天井の高さも測っておく必要がある。最近は、組み立てる前の箱の大きさを明記するメーカーも増えてきた。
cards.en: A common mistake when buying furniture online is failing to check the size. There is no end of complaints from people who ordered after looking only at the dimensions on the product page, only to find when it arrived that it would not fit through the front door or hallway. You need to measure not just the spot in the room where it will go but also the width of the route it will be carried along and the ceiling height. Recently, more manufacturers have started stating the size of the box before assembly.

cards.ja: 海外旅行から帰国した際、免税の範囲を超える買い物をしていれば、空港の税関で申告して税金を納めなければならない。酒やたばこ、香水などには、品目ごとに上限が決められている。また、肉製品や果物の多くは、家畜の病気や害虫の侵入を防ぐため、持ち込み自体が禁じられている。現地で何気なく買った土産が没収されることもあるので、事前に確認しておきたい。
cards.en: On returning from an overseas trip, if you have bought more than the duty-free allowance, you must declare it at airport customs and pay tax. Limits are set for each category of item, such as alcohol, tobacco and perfume. In addition, many meat products and fruits cannot be brought in at all, to prevent the entry of livestock diseases and pests. Souvenirs bought casually abroad are sometimes confiscated, so it is best to check in advance.

cards.en: It takes a long time, often several years, for a single animated film to be completed. From the script and storyboards to animation, background art and sound, hundreds of staff members share the work of the production. In recent years, digital technology has made the work more efficient, but quite a few directors remain committed to the texture of hand-drawn images. The sheer number of names in the end credits speaks to that effort.

words.defJa: 子どもから大人になる途中の、十代から二十歳前後の若い人たち。

cards.ja: スマートフォンの普及に伴い、青少年がインターネットを通じて犯罪に巻き込まれる事件が増えている。国は法律で、十八歳未満の利用者が使うスマートフォンについて、原則として有害なサイトの閲覧を制限する設定を行うよう携帯電話会社に義務づけている。しかし、子どもたちのほうが大人よりも機器の扱いに詳しく、制限が簡単に外されてしまう例もある。技術的な対策だけでなく、家庭や学校での話し合いが欠かせない。
cards.en: With the spread of smartphones, cases of young people being drawn into crimes through the internet are increasing. The national government generally requires mobile carriers by law to set up restrictions on access to harmful sites for smartphones used by customers under eighteen. But children are often more familiar with the devices than adults are, and in some cases the restrictions are easily removed. Technical measures alone are not enough; discussion at home and at school is indispensable.

cards.ja: コンピューターは数を、整数と小数とで異なる形式で扱っている。整数は正確に表せるが、小数の多くは二進数では割り切れず、ごくわずかな誤差を含んでしまう。たとえば、0.1を十回足しても、厳密には1にならないことがある。そのため、金額のように一円の狂いも許されない計算では、値をいったん整数に直して処理するのが一般的だ。
cards.en: Computers handle numbers in different formats depending on whether they are integers or decimals. Integers can be represented exactly, but many decimals cannot be expressed exactly in binary and end up containing a tiny error. For example, adding 0.1 ten times does not always give exactly 1. That is why, in calculations such as monetary amounts where not even a one-yen discrepancy is allowed, it is common to convert the values to integers before processing them.

words.defJa: 生きていること。危険な状況でも生き残ること。

cards.ja: 大きな地震で建物の下敷きになった人の生存率は、発生から七十二時間を過ぎると急激に下がるとされる。そのため、救助隊は限られた時間の中で、がれきの下に取り残された人の捜索を急ぐ。近年は、わずかな呼吸や心拍を感知するレーダーや、狭い隙間に入り込めるロボットも活用されている。それでも過去の大地震では、救出された人の多くが家族や近所の住民によって助け出されている。
cards.en: The survival rate of people trapped under buildings in a major earthquake is said to fall sharply once 72 hours have passed since the quake. Rescue teams therefore race against limited time to search for people left under the rubble. In recent years, radar that detects faint breathing and heartbeats, and robots that can crawl into narrow gaps, have also been put to use. Even so, in past major earthquakes, a large share of those rescued were pulled out by their own families or neighbors.

cards.ja: 選挙が近づくと、各政党は公約を発表し、街頭演説やインターネットを通じて支持を訴える。しかし、若い世代の投票率は依然として低く、政治への関心の薄さが課題とされている。そこで、ある大学の学生団体は、各党の政策を同じ項目で比べられる一覧表を作り、ウェブ上で公開した。主張の違いが一目でわかると好評で、閲覧数は予想を大きく上回ったという。
cards.en: As an election approaches, each political party announces its pledges and appeals for support through street speeches and the internet. Yet voter turnout among young people remains low, and their lack of interest in politics is regarded as a problem. So a student group at one university created a table that lets people compare each party's policies item by item and published it online. Being able to see the differences at a glance proved popular, and page views reportedly far exceeded expectations.

cards.en: When a passenger jet finishes its day of flights, the maintenance crew's work begins in the hangar at night. They inspect the engines, tires and flight controls one by one, keeping records so that not even the slightest abnormality is overlooked. The work must be finished before the next morning's departure, so it often becomes a race against time. Passengers rarely see it, but the safety of air travel rests on this painstaking maintenance.

Taking several medicines at once can mean taking the same ingredient twice over, which can lead to unexpected side effects. In particular, taking a painkiller together with a cold medicine easily doubles up on the ingredients that bring down fever and relieve pain. When in doubt, the surest course is to consult the pharmacist at a drugstore.

cards.ja: 折り紙の多くは、一枚の正方形の紙から始まる。はさみやのりを使わずに、折るだけで鶴や花、動物の形を生み出すのが基本だ。近年、この技術は宇宙工学の分野でも注目を集めている。大きな太陽電池パネルを小さく折りたたんで打ち上げ、宇宙空間で広げる仕組みに、折り紙の考え方が応用されているのだ。
cards.en: Most origami begins with a single square sheet of paper. The basic idea is to create cranes, flowers and animal shapes by folding alone, without scissors or glue. In recent years, this technique has also been drawing attention in the field of space engineering. The ideas of origami are applied to mechanisms that fold large solar panels into a small package for launch and then unfold them in space.

Recently, to avoid the crowds, more people are coming back to take photos the day before or after the ceremony.

The focus is a labor-related bill that includes a review of working practices. The government and ruling parties aim to have it enacted during the current session, but the opposition is stepping up its resistance, arguing that deliberations have not been exhausted. If the bill passes, it is expected to take effect in stages from next April.

cards.ja: 明治の初めに太陽暦が採用されてからも、日本では年を元号で数える習慣が続いてきた。西暦が日常的に使われるようになったのは主に戦後のことで、公文書などでは今も元号が主流だ。たとえば、令和元年は西暦二〇一九年にあたる。二つの数え方が併存しているため、行政手続きでも西暦での記入を認める動きが広がっている。

It was mainly after the war that the Western calendar came into everyday use, and era names are still the norm on official documents and the like. For example, the first year of Reiwa corresponds to 2019 in the Western calendar. Because the two systems coexist, there is a growing movement to allow dates in the Western calendar even in administrative procedures.

words.defJa: 物を背中にのせて運ぶ。また、重い責任や負担を引き受ける。

cards.ja: 大学を卒業する時点で、数百万円の奨学金という借金を背負っている若者は珍しくない。毎月の返済は家賃に次ぐ大きな負担となり、結婚や出産をためらう理由の一つにもなっている。こうした状況を受け、返済の一部を肩代わりする制度を設ける企業も増えてきた。人材の確保につながるとして、地方の中小企業でも導入が進んでいる。
cards.en: It is not unusual for young people to graduate from university already shouldering several million yen of debt in student loans. The monthly repayments are the biggest burden after rent and are one of the reasons people hesitate to marry or have children. In response, a growing number of companies have set up schemes that take over part of the repayment. Seen as a way to secure talent, such schemes are spreading even among small and medium-sized firms in the regions.

cards.ja: 赤道に近い地域では、一年を通じて昼と夜の長さがほとんど変わらない。太陽がほぼ真上から照りつけるため気温は高く、午後になると激しいスコールが降ることも多い。こうした安定した暑さと豊富な雨が、世界最大級の熱帯雨林を育ててきた。赤道は地図の上では一本の線にすぎないが、その周りに暮らす生き物の姿を大きく左右している。
cards.en: In regions close to the equator, the lengths of day and night barely change throughout the year. Because the sun beats down from almost directly overhead, temperatures are high, and heavy showers often fall in the afternoon. This steady heat and abundant rain have nurtured some of the largest tropical rainforests in the world. The equator is no more than a single line on a map, yet it greatly shapes the lives of the creatures that live around it.

The time I had spent preparing it was not wasted after all.

Veteran actors reportedly try dozens of ways of delivering a line during rehearsals, searching for the sound that best suits the scene. In the end, what breathes life into written words is the imagination of the person performing them.

cards.ja: ワインの栓といえばコルクを思い浮かべる人が多いが、最近はねじ式のキャップを採用する生産者も増えている。天然のコルクはまれにカビ由来の物質によってワインの香りを損なうことがあり、キャップはその対策として広まった。開けるのに道具がいらず、飲み残しを保存しやすいのも利点だ。それでも、コルクを抜くときの音を楽しみにする愛好家は少なくない。
cards.en: Many people picture cork when it comes to wine stoppers, but more and more producers are adopting screw caps these days. Natural cork occasionally spoils a wine's aroma because of a compound produced by mold, and screw caps spread as a countermeasure. Another advantage is that they need no tool to open and make leftover wine easy to keep. Even so, quite a few devoted fans still look forward to the sound of pulling a cork.

cards.en: The former mayor has decided to run again in next month's mayoral election. During two terms totaling eight years, he pushed ahead with putting the city's finances back in order, but four years ago he lost the election amid criticism over the redevelopment in front of the station. His camp aims to win back support by arguing that plans have stalled under the current administration. Attention is focused on which course voters will choose.

words.meaning: around, approximately (after a number); before and after, front and back
words.defJa: ある数や時間の少し上や下。また、前と後ろ。

cards.ja: 最近の調査によると、六十代の一日の平均歩数は六千歩前後にとどまっている。健康の維持には八千歩程度が望ましいとされ、目標との差は小さくない。ただ、専門家は無理に数字を追うより、食後に少し歩くなど、日常の動作を増やすことが大切だと指摘する。エレベーターの代わりに階段を使うだけでも、積み重ねれば効果は大きい。
cards.en: According to a recent survey, people in their sixties average only around 6,000 steps a day. About 8,000 steps is considered desirable for maintaining health, so the gap from the target is not small. Experts point out, however, that rather than forcing yourself to chase numbers, it is important to add movement to daily life, such as taking a short walk after meals. Even just taking the stairs instead of the elevator makes a big difference as it adds up.

words.defJa: ある作家などの作品をすべて集めて、何冊かの本にまとめたもの。

cards.ja: 明治の文豪の全集が、二十年がかりでようやく完結した。小説や評論だけでなく、友人に宛てた手紙や日記、走り書きのメモまで収められ、全体は五十巻を超える。編集に携わった研究者は、作品の裏にある迷いや苦しみが初めて一つの流れとして見えてきたと語る。図書館や大学からは、早くも問い合わせが相次いでいるという。
cards.en: The complete works of a great Meiji-era writer have finally been published in full, a project that took twenty years. They include not only his novels and essays but also letters to friends, diaries and even scribbled notes, running to more than fifty volumes in all. A researcher involved in the editing says that, for the first time, the doubts and struggles behind the works can be seen as a single continuous story. Inquiries are reportedly already pouring in from libraries and universities.

words.defJa: 竹の骨に紙や布を張った、折りたためるあおぐ道具。

cards.ja: 猛暑が続くなか、通勤電車で扇子を使う会社員の姿が目立つようになった。折りたためばかばんに収まり、取り出せばすぐに涼を得られる手軽さが人気の理由だ。最近は和紙や竹にこだわった品だけでなく、洋服に合う落ち着いた色柄も多く出回っている。電池のいらない昔ながらの道具が、意外な形で見直されている。
cards.en: As the extreme heat continues, office workers using folding fans on commuter trains have become a common sight. Their popularity comes from their convenience: folded, they fit in a bag, and taken out, they bring instant relief from the heat. Recently, besides items made with carefully chosen washi paper and bamboo, many fans in subdued colors and patterns that go well with Western clothes are on the market. An old-fashioned tool that needs no batteries is being reappreciated in an unexpected way.

cards.en: At one electronics retailer, sales of a new vacuum cleaner have dropped sharply compared with the month before last, right after it was released. At first many customers bought it, drawn by the buzz, but its high price seems to have gradually put people off. The store plans to start a trade-in campaign next month to boost sales. The manufacturer is also said to be considering launching a more affordable standard model.

cards.en: On the weekend before last, I got together with my university friends for the first time in a long while. Ten years have passed since we graduated, and because of work and family circumstances, our chances to see one another had dropped off sharply. cards.en: Obon has long been handed down as an occasion for welcoming the spirits of one's ancestors home and entertaining them. In many regions, the custom remains of lighting a small fire at the front door so the spirits can find their way back without getting lost. These days, with the rise of nuclear families and the movement of people to cities, fewer households keep up such customs. Even so, the stream of people returning to their hometowns at this time of year to visit family graves has not dried up.

words.defJa: 細長い物のいちばん先の部分。また、時代や技術のいちばん新しいところ。

cards.ja: 蚊に刺されてもすぐに気づかないのは、針の先端が細かいぎざぎざになっているからだ。このぎざぎざが皮膚に触れる面積を小さくし、神経への刺激を抑えている。ある研究チームはこの仕組みに注目し、痛みの少ない注射針を開発した。糖尿病などで毎日注射が必要な患者にとって、大きな助けになると期待されている。
cards.en: The reason we don't notice right away when a mosquito bites us is that the tip of its needle-like mouthpart is finely serrated. These serrations reduce the area that touches the skin and dampen the stimulation of nerves. One research team focused on this mechanism and developed a less painful injection needle. It is expected to be a great help to patients who need daily injections because of diabetes and other conditions.

cards.ja: マラソンの中盤、それまで集団の中にいた若手選手が一気に先頭に立った。沿道の観客からはどよめきが起こったが、残り十五キロを独走するのは無謀だという見方も多かった。ところが彼は最後までペースを落とさず、二位以下を大きく引き離してゴールした。初マラソンでの優勝は、大会史上初めての快挙となった。
cards.en: Midway through the marathon, a young runner who had been in the pack suddenly surged to the front. A stir rose from the spectators along the course, but many thought it reckless to run alone for the remaining fifteen kilometers. Yet he never slowed his pace and crossed the finish line far ahead of the rest of the field. Winning his first marathon was a feat unprecedented in the race's history.

words.meaning: the whole, all aspects; general, overall
words.defJa: ある物事にかかわることのすべて。

cards.ja: 中小企業では、一人の社員が経理や人事、さらには設備の管理まで、事務全般を担うことが珍しくない。幅広い経験が積める一方で、担当者が休むと業務が止まってしまう危うさもある。そこで最近は、作業の手順を文書にまとめ、複数の社員で分担できるようにする会社が増えている。担当者が安心して休める職場づくりにもつながるという。
cards.en: At small and medium-sized companies, it is not unusual for a single employee to handle all the general office work, from accounting and personnel to even facilities management. While this lets them gain broad experience, there is also the risk that work grinds to a halt when that person is away. So more and more companies these days are writing up work procedures so that tasks can be shared among several employees. This is also said to help create workplaces where staff can take time off with peace of mind.

cards.en: Using an air conditioner together with an electric fan lets you cool a room efficiently while keeping electricity bills down. Because cold air tends to pool near the floor, stirring up the room's air with a fan evens out the temperature. As a result, even if you raise the air conditioner's setting by one or two degrees, it reportedly feels almost the same. The trick is to aim the airflow at the ceiling.

cards.ja: 寺に泊まる宿坊の体験が、外国人旅行者の間で人気を集めている。朝は五時に起き、手早く洗面を済ませてから、本堂での読経に参加するのが決まりだ。そのあとには、肉や魚を使わない精進料理の朝食が待っている。慣れない早起きに戸惑う人も多いが、静けさの中で過ごした時間が忘れられないという声は絶えない。
cards.en: Staying overnight at temple lodgings is gaining popularity among foreign travelers. The rule is to get up at five in the morning, quickly wash up, and then join the sutra chanting in the main hall. After that, a breakfast of temple cuisine made without meat or fish awaits. Many are thrown by the unfamiliar early rising, but there is no end to people saying they will never forget the time they spent in the silence.

cards.en: The prefecture is making an all-out effort to restore a prefectural road cut off by a landslide caused by heavy rain. The road is the only main route linking the mountain villages to the town center, and quite a few elderly residents are having trouble getting to hospitals and shops. Heavy machinery is working at the site day and night, aiming to reopen one lane to alternating traffic sometime next week. Until then, the city will run temporary buses to help residents get around.

words.defJa: 電車や列車が走るための、レールを敷いた道。

cards.ja: ローカル線の廃止が相次ぐなか、使われなくなった線路を観光に生かす試みが各地で広がっている。ある町では、レールの上を足でこいで進む自転車のような乗り物を走らせ、休日には家族連れでにぎわう。継ぎ目を越えるたびに伝わる振動が、かつての列車の旅を思い出させるという。地域の記憶を残しながら人を呼び込む方法として、注目が集まっている。
cards.en: As local rail lines are shut down one after another, efforts to put disused tracks to use for tourism are spreading across the country. In one town, a bicycle-like vehicle that riders pedal along the rails runs on the old line, and on holidays it is crowded with families. The jolt felt each time it crosses a rail joint reportedly brings back memories of train journeys of the past. It is drawing attention as a way to attract visitors while preserving the area's memories.

cards.en: Japan's total population has been shrinking for more than ten years. According to the latest estimates, the number lost in a single year is equivalent to the whole population of a regional prefectural capital. Meanwhile, the share of people aged 65 and over has hit a record high, approaching one in three. How to make up for the shrinking workforce has become an issue that society as a whole must face.

cards.en: In disputes over the sale of used homes, cases where the seller's explanation differs from what is written in the contract stand out. Experts recommend writing every point of concern into the document and signing only after both parties have checked it. Not relying on verbal promises is the first step toward protecting yourself.

cards.ja: 日本の多くの小学校では、授業のあとに子どもたちが自分で教室を掃除する。机を後ろに寄せて床をほうきで掃いたあと、雑巾を手に一列に並び、廊下を端から拭いていく。海外の教育関係者からは、この習慣が責任感や協調性を育てていると評価する声も多い。自分たちが使う場所を自分たちできれいにするという考え方は、家庭の中にも通じるものだ。
cards.en: At many elementary schools in Japan, children clean their own classrooms after lessons. After pushing the desks to the back and sweeping the floor with brooms, they line up in a row, cloths in hand, and wipe the hallway from end to end. Many educators from overseas praise this custom for fostering a sense of responsibility and cooperation. The idea of cleaning the places you use yourself applies at home as well.

cards.en: In the warehouses of a major online retailer, artificial intelligence analyzes ordering trends and automatically rearranges items likely to sell so that they sit near the shipping area. words.defJa: 亡くなった人を送るために行う儀式。

cards.ja: 近年、親族やごく親しい人だけで故人を見送る、小規模な葬式を選ぶ家庭が増えている。費用を抑えられることに加え、参列者への対応に追われず、ゆっくりお別れができる点が支持されている。ただ、後から亡くなったことを知った知人が自宅を訪ねてくるなど、思わぬ負担が生じることもある。どのような形で送り出してほしいか、元気なうちに家族で話し合っておくことが大切だ。
cards.en: In recent years, more and more families are choosing small funerals where only relatives and very close friends see off the deceased. However, unexpected burdens can arise, such as acquaintances who learn of the death later dropping by the family home. It is important to talk as a family, while everyone is still well, about how each person would like to be sent off.

words.defJa: 船を設計し、つくること。

cards.ja: 戦後の日本は造船の分野で急速に力をつけ、一九五六年には建造量で世界一の座についた。鋼板を溶接でつなぐ新しい工法や、船体をいくつもの大きなブロックに分けて先に組み立て、最後に一つにつなぎ合わせる方式が、工期を大幅に縮めたのである。その後、韓国や中国が台頭すると、日本の世界シェアは長く低下を続けた。それでも、燃費性能などの技術力は今も高く評価されている。
cards.en: After the war, Japan rapidly built up its strength in shipbuilding, and in 1956 it took first place in the world in tonnage built. New methods, such as joining steel plates by welding and building the hull as large blocks that were assembled first and then joined into one, greatly shortened construction times. Later, as South Korea and China rose, Japan's global share declined for many years. Even so, its technical strength, such as in fuel efficiency, is still highly regarded.

words.defJa: 人の声や物音が多くて、落ち着かない様子だ。

cards.ja: 騒々しい場所では集中できない、と考える人は多い。しかし、ある実験では、カフェ程度のほどよい雑音がある環境のほうが、完全な静けさの中よりも発想力を問う課題の成績がよかったという。適度な音が意識を少しだけ散らし、考えの幅を広げるのではないかと研究者は見ている。もっとも、工事現場のような大きな音では、さすがに逆効果になるようだ。
cards.en: Many people believe they cannot concentrate in noisy places. In one experiment, however, people reportedly did better on tasks testing creative thinking with a moderate level of background noise, like that of a café, than in complete silence. Researchers suspect that moderate sound distracts the mind just slightly and broadens the range of thinking. That said, loud noise like that of a construction site does seem to backfire.

words.defJa: 数や量、程度などがふえて大きくなること。

cards.ja: 高齢化が進むにつれて、年金や医療にかかる社会保障費は年々増大している。現役世代が支える負担も重くなり、このままでは制度そのものが立ち行かなくなるという指摘もある。政府は給付の見直しと同時に、働く高齢者を増やす施策を打ち出した。ただ、財源をどう確保するかという根本的な議論はなお先送りされたままだ。
cards.en: As the population ages, social security costs for pensions and medical care are growing year by year. The burden carried by the working generation is getting heavier too, and some point out that if things go on like this, the system itself will become unsustainable. The government has rolled out measures to increase the number of older people in work while also reviewing benefits. However, the fundamental debate over how to secure the funding is still being put off.

words.defJa: 旅立つ人や去っていく人との別れを惜しみ、見送ること。

cards.ja: 留学のために海外へ旅立つ友人を見送ろうと、大学時代の仲間が集まって送別会を開いた。会場は、学生のころよく通った駅前の小さな居酒屋だった。思い出話に花が咲き、最後には全員で寄せ書きをした色紙を手渡した。友人は涙ぐみながら、向こうで必ず夢をかなえると約束した。
cards.en: To see off a friend leaving to study abroad, our circle of friends from university got together and held a farewell party. The venue was the small izakaya in front of the station that we often went to as students. The reminiscences flowed, and at the end we handed over a card covered with messages from all of us. Close to tears, our friend promised to make their dream come true over there.

words.defJa: わらや布、ゴムなどで作った平たい底に鼻緒をつけた、和風の履き物。

cards.ja: 成人式の会場には、振り袖に草履という装いの新成人が次々と姿を見せた。鼻緒が指の間に当たって痛くなるのを心配する人も多いが、最近は底や鼻緒に柔らかい素材を使ったものが増え、長い時間歩いても疲れにくいという。かつては毎日の履き物だった草履も、今では着物とともに特別な日に身に着けるものになった。小さな歩幅でゆっくりと歩く姿には、洋服のときとは違う落ち着きがある。
cards.en: At the coming-of-age ceremony, young adults dressed in long-sleeved kimono and zori arrived one after another. Many worry that the thong will rub between their toes and hurt, but these days more zori use soft materials for the sole and thong, and they are said to be less tiring even after walking for a long time. Zori, once everyday footwear, have now become something worn with kimono on special occasions. There is a composure in the way people walk slowly with small steps that is different from when they wear Western clothes.

cards.ja: 国会で新しい総理大臣が選ばれると、その日のうちに組閣が行われ、新内閣が発足する。首相官邸の階段で閣僚がそろって記念撮影をする光景は、毎回おなじみのものとなった。今回の就任会見では、物価高への対策と外交の立て直しが最優先の課題として掲げられた。支持率が今後どう推移するかは、最初の百日間の働きにかかっているとみられる。
cards.en: When a new prime minister is chosen in the Diet, the cabinet is formed that same day and the new government is launched. The scene of the ministers lined up for a commemorative photo on the steps of the prime minister's official residence has become a familiar one each time. At this latest inaugural press conference, measures against rising prices and the rebuilding of diplomacy were set out as the top priorities. How the approval rating moves from here is seen as depending on the work done in the first hundred days.

words.defJa: 品物を郵便や宅配便で送るときにかかるお金。

cards.ja: ネット通販を利用する人の多くが、購入をためらう理由として送料の高さを挙げている。そのため、一定額以上の購入で送料を無料にするサービスを導入する店が増えた。しかし、配送業者の人手不足や燃料費の上昇を受けて、こうした仕組みを見直す動きも出始めている。消費者にとって当たり前だった「送料無料」は、実は誰かが負担しているコストなのだ。
cards.en: Many people who shop online name high shipping charges as the reason they hesitate to buy. As a result, more shops have introduced services that waive the shipping charge once you spend over a certain amount. However, with delivery companies short of staff and fuel costs rising, moves to rethink such schemes are starting to appear. 'Free shipping,' which consumers took for granted, is in fact a cost that someone is bearing.

words.defJa: 次から次へと絶え間なく続くようす。

cards.ja: 深海の調査技術が進歩したことで、これまで知られていなかった生き物が続々と見つかっている。無人探査機が撮影した映像には、透き通った体を持つ魚や、光を放つクラゲの仲間などが映っていた。ある研究チームによると、深海にすむ生物の大半はまだ名前すら付けられていないという。私たちにとって最も身近な未踏の地は、宇宙ではなく海の底なのかもしれない。
cards.en: Thanks to advances in deep-sea survey technology, previously unknown creatures are being found one after another. Footage shot by an unmanned probe showed fish with see-through bodies and relatives of jellyfish that give off light. According to one research team, most of the organisms living in the deep sea have not even been given names yet. The unexplored territory closest to us may be not outer space but the bottom of the sea.

cards.ja: 締め切りが明日に迫った申込書を、母はあわてて郵便局の窓口に持ち込んだ。普通郵便では間に合わないかもしれないと言われ、少し高い料金を払って速達にしてもらった。封筒には赤い線が引かれ、翌日の午前中には相手に届くという。メールで済む時代になっても、紙の書類が必要な手続きはまだ意外と多い。
cards.en: My mother hurriedly took an application form due tomorrow to the post office counter. Told that ordinary mail might not get there in time, she paid a slightly higher fee and had it sent express. A red line was drawn on the envelope, and she was told it would reach the recipient the next morning. Even in an age when email does the job, there are still surprisingly many procedures that need paper documents.

words.defJa: 土地の広さや高さ、距離や位置などを器械を使ってはかること。

cards.ja: 江戸時代の後期、ある商人は家業を退いたあと天文学を学び、五十代になってから全国の測量に乗り出した。歩幅で距離をはかり、星の位置から緯度を求める地道な作業を、十数年にわたって続けたのである。こうして完成した日本地図は驚くほど正確で、後の時代にも長く使われた。一人の決意が、国の姿を初めて正確に描き出したといえる。
cards.en: In the late Edo period, a merchant who had retired from the family business studied astronomy and, in his fifties, set out to survey the whole country. He kept up the painstaking work of measuring distances by his stride and working out latitude from the positions of the stars for well over a decade. The map of Japan completed in this way was astonishingly accurate and stayed in use long afterward. One man's resolve, it could be said, drew the shape of the country accurately for the first time.

cards.ja: 新しく就航した高速フェリーは、従来の船のおよそ一・五倍の速力で海上を進む。船体を軽い素材で造り、波の抵抗を受けにくい形にしたことが、大幅な時間短縮につながった。島と本土を結ぶ航路では、これまで二時間かかっていた移動が八十分ほどになる。通勤や通院に船を使う住民からは、早くも歓迎の声が上がっている。
cards.en: The newly launched high-speed ferry crosses the sea at roughly one and a half times the speed of conventional vessels. Building the hull from lightweight materials and giving it a shape that meets less resistance from the waves led to a big cut in travel time. On the route linking the island and the mainland, a trip that used to take two hours will take about eighty minutes. Residents who use the boat to commute or to get to the hospital are already welcoming the change.

words.defJa: その家系や生物の種の、ずっと昔の世代。先祖。

cards.ja: 化石やDNAの研究から、私たちホモ・サピエンスはおよそ三十万年前のアフリカで誕生したと考えられている。その後、私たちの祖先にあたる集団の一部がアフリカを出て、長い時間をかけて世界各地へ広がっていった。興味深いのは、移動の途中でネアンデルタール人と交わった痕跡が、今を生きる人々の遺伝子に残っていることだ。人類の歴史は、一本の道ではなく複雑に枝分かれした網のようなものだといえる。
cards.en: Research on fossils and DNA suggests that we Homo sapiens emerged in Africa about 300,000 years ago. Later, some of the groups that were our ancestors left Africa and, over a long period, spread to every part of the world. What is interesting is that traces of interbreeding with Neanderthals along the way remain in the genes of people alive today. Human history, one could say, is not a single road but something like a complex, branching web.

Comments such as 'Meetings are too long' and 'Approvals take too much time' came one after another, and the department head promised several improvements on the spot. When the person at the top welcomes things that are hard to hear, the atmosphere of a workplace can change remarkably.

cards.ja: 父は四十年近く、毎朝欠かさずかみそりでひげを剃ってきた。電気シェーバーの方が楽だと家族に勧められても、刃で剃った後のさっぱりした感触は譲れないという。最近は肌が乾燥しやすくなったため、剃る前に蒸しタオルで顔を温めるようになった。小さな習慣にも、その人なりのこだわりが表れるものだ。

Even when the family suggests an electric shaver would be easier, he says he won't give up the fresh feeling after shaving with a blade. cards.ja: 瞑想を始めたばかりの人の多くは、呼吸に意識を向けようとしても、すぐに注意がそれてしまうと悩む。昨日の会議のことや夕飯の献立が、次から次へと頭に浮かんでくるのだ。しかし指導者によれば、注意がそれたことに気づき、静かに呼吸へ戻ること自体が練習の中心だという。うまく集中できない時間こそが、心を鍛える時間なのである。
cards.en: Many people who have just started meditating worry that even when they try to turn their awareness to the breath, their attention soon wanders off. Yesterday's meeting or what to make for dinner pops into their heads, one thing after another. According to teachers, however, noticing that your attention has wandered and quietly returning to the breath is itself the heart of the practice. The very time when you cannot concentrate well is the time that trains the mind.

words.defJa: 枠の中に並んだ玉を指で動かして計算する、昔からある道具。

cards.ja: 電卓やスマートフォンが普及した今でも、子どもにそろばんを習わせる家庭は少なくない。玉を指ではじいて計算を繰り返すうちに、頭の中にそろばんを思い浮かべて暗算できるようになるという。指導者によると、集中力や数の感覚が自然と身につくのが一番の利点だそうだ。最近では海外でも注目を集め、各地で教室が開かれるようになった。
cards.en: Even now that calculators and smartphones are everywhere, quite a few families have their children learn the abacus. By repeatedly flicking the beads to calculate, children are said to become able to do mental arithmetic by picturing an abacus in their heads. According to instructors, the greatest benefit is that concentration and a feel for numbers develop naturally. Recently it has been drawing attention abroad as well, and classes have opened in many places.

words.defJa: 「知る」「思う」をへりくだって言う言葉。

cards.ja: 取引先の担当者から来月の展示会の日程について尋ねられた新入社員は、「申し訳ございません、詳しくは存じておりません」と答えた。あとで上司は、とっさに丁寧な言葉が出たことをほめつつ、すぐに調べて折り返すと伝えればもっと良かったと助言した。敬語は形を覚えるだけでなく、相手の手間を減らす気配りと組み合わせてこそ生きる。新人研修では、こうした実際のやり取りをもとにした練習が重視されている。
cards.en: Asked by a contact at a client company about the schedule for next month's trade show, a new employee replied, 'I'm terribly sorry, but I don't know the details.' Afterward, the boss praised the employee for producing polite language on the spot, but advised that it would have been even better to offer to look into it right away and call back. Honorific language comes alive not just by memorizing the forms but when it is paired with the consideration of saving the other person trouble. New-employee training puts emphasis on practice based on real exchanges like this.

The young employees listening at the back of the hall straightened up at the weight of honorific language they rarely hear. Formal wording of this kind lives on in written language and ceremonial speeches.

words.defJa: 木を使って家や建物を建てたり直したりする職人。

cards.ja: 住宅の建設現場では、大工の高齢化と若い担い手の不足が深刻になっている。一人前になるまでに十年近くかかるといわれ、その間の収入の低さが敬遠される一因だ。そこで、ある工務店は見習いに給料を保証し、経験豊かな職人が付きっきりで技術を教える制度を始めた。木の家を建てる技術を次の世代へどう受け渡すかが問われている。
cards.en: At housing construction sites, the aging of carpenters and the shortage of young people to carry on the trade are becoming serious. So one local builder has started a scheme that guarantees apprentices a salary and has experienced craftsmen teach them the techniques one-on-one. The question is how to hand down the skills of building wooden houses to the next generation.

words.meaning: system, organized body (of thought or knowledge)
words.defJa: 個々の知識や考えを、一定の原理によってまとめ上げた全体。

cards.ja: 古代インドでは、ヴェーダの権威をどう受け止めるかをめぐって、さまざまな哲学の学派が生まれた。中でもヨーガやヴェーダーンタなど六つの学派は、それぞれが独自の思想体系を築き上げたことで知られる。それらは世界の成り立ちや認識の仕組み、解脱への道を論理的に説明しようとした。現代の研究者の中には、その緻密さを西洋哲学と並べて評価する人も多い。
cards.en: In ancient India, many schools of philosophy arose over the question of how to regard the authority of the Vedas. Among them, six schools, including Yoga and Vedanta, are known for each having built up its own system of thought. They tried to give a logical account of how the world came to be, how knowing works, and the path to liberation. Many present-day scholars rank their rigor alongside that of Western philosophy.

words.defJa: 木の胴の両側に革を張り、ばちで打って鳴らす楽器。

cards.ja: 夏の夕暮れ、境内に据えられた大きな太鼓が鳴り響くと、集まった人々の会話がぴたりと止んだ。打ち手たちは全身を使ってばちを振り下ろし、その音は胸の奥まで震わせるほどだった。かつて太鼓は、祭りの合図や村の連絡手段として欠かせないものだったという。今では舞台芸術として磨かれ、海外公演を重ねる団体も少なくない。
cards.en: On a summer evening, when the big drum set up in the shrine grounds boomed out, the chatter of the gathered crowd stopped dead. The drummers brought their sticks down with their whole bodies, and the sound seemed to shake you deep in the chest. Drums are said to have once been indispensable as festival signals and as a means of communication in villages. Today they have been refined into a performing art, and quite a few groups tour abroad again and again.

words.defJa: あとに打ち消しの言葉をともなって、それほど、あまり、という意味を表す。

cards.ja: 話題の高級食パンを買うために、休日の朝から一時間も並んだ。家に帰って近所のスーパーで買ったパンと食べ比べてみると、正直なところ味は大して変わらなかった。値段が三倍近くも違うだけに、少し拍子抜けしてしまった。行列の長さや評判が、知らないうちに期待を膨らませていたのかもしれない。
cards.en: To buy the much-talked-about luxury bread, I queued for a whole hour on a weekend morning. When I got home and tasted it side by side with bread from the local supermarket, honestly, the taste wasn't all that different. Given that the price was nearly three times higher, I felt a bit let down. Perhaps the length of the line and the reputation had inflated my expectations without my noticing.

words.defJa: 大きいものと小さいもの。また、物の大きさ。

cards.ja: 瀬戸内海には、大小合わせて七百を超える島が点在している。フェリーで島から島へ渡ると、穏やかな海面に浮かぶ島影が次々に姿を変えていく。近年は空き家を改装したカフェや美術館が増え、海外からの旅行者にも人気だ。急がずに一つの島で一泊し、夕日が沈むのを眺めるのがおすすめである。
cards.en: More than seven hundred islands, large and small, are scattered across the Seto Inland Sea. As you cross from island to island by ferry, the silhouettes floating on the calm water keep changing shape. In recent years, cafés and art museums in renovated empty houses have multiplied, and the area is popular with travelers from abroad as well. Rather than rushing, it is best to spend a night on one island and watch the sun go down.

cards.ja: パン作りで最も大切な工程の一つが、生地を休ませて発酵させる時間だ。酵母が糖を分解して炭酸ガスを出すと、生地はふくらみ、体積がおよそ二倍になる。室温が低い冬場は発酵が進みにくいため、オーブンの発酵機能を使う人も多い。指で軽く押した穴がすぐに戻らなければ、ちょうどよいとされる。
cards.en: One of the most important stages in bread making is the time when the dough is rested and left to rise. As the yeast breaks down sugar and gives off carbon dioxide, the dough swells and roughly doubles in volume. In winter, when room temperatures are low, rising is slow, so many people use their oven's proofing setting. If a hole made by pressing lightly with a finger does not spring back right away, the dough is considered just right.

cards.ja: 長年疎遠になっていた叔父から、ある日突然、丁寧な手紙が届いた。母が返事とともに家族の写真を送ると、叔父は大層喜んで、すぐに電話をかけてきた。受話器の向こうの声は昔と変わらず、二人は一時間以上も子どものころの思い出を語り合った。手紙という少し古風な手段が、止まっていた時間を再び動かしたのである。
cards.en: One day, a courteous letter suddenly arrived from an uncle we had lost touch with for many years. When my mother sent a reply along with photos of the family, he was overjoyed and phoned right away. The voice at the other end of the line was just as it used to be, and the two of them talked for over an hour about memories from their childhood. A slightly old-fashioned medium, the letter, had set time that had stood still moving again.

words.defJa: 健康のためや競技として、決まった動きで体を動かす運動。

cards.ja: 夏休みの朝、公園に集まった子どもや高齢者がラジオ体操の音楽に合わせて体を動かす光景は、今も各地で見られる。わずか三分ほどの運動だが、全身の筋肉や関節をまんべんなく使うよう工夫されているという。専門家によると、毎日続ければ肩こりの予防や転倒防止にも効果が期待できる。手軽さこそが、長く親しまれてきた理由だろう。
cards.en: On summer-vacation mornings, children and elderly people gathered in parks, moving to the music of the radio exercise program, are still a common sight in many places. Although it lasts only about three minutes, it is said to be designed to work the muscles and joints of the whole body evenly. According to experts, doing it every day can help prevent stiff shoulders and falls. Its sheer ease is probably why it has been popular for so long.

words.defJa: 幹が太く、背の高い大きな木。

cards.ja: 村はずれの神社には、樹齢八百年を超えるといわれるクスノキの大木がそびえている。幹の周りは大人が七、八人で手をつないでようやく囲めるほどで、枝は境内を覆うように広がっている。昨年の台風で一部の枝が折れたが、専門家の手当てを受けて新しい芽が出始めた。住民たちは、この木を村の守り神として大切に見守り続けている。
cards.en: At the shrine on the edge of the village towers a huge camphor tree said to be over eight hundred years old. Its trunk is so thick that it takes seven or eight adults holding hands to barely reach around it, and its branches spread out as if to cover the shrine grounds. Some branches broke in last year's typhoon, but after treatment by specialists, new buds have begun to appear. The residents go on caring for the tree as the village's guardian spirit.

words.defJa: 人や物、場所などの名前の代わりに使う言葉。「これ」「彼」など。

cards.ja: 日本語の会話では、英語ほど代名詞が使われない。「私」や「あなた」を省いても、文脈や敬語の使い方から誰の話かが自然に伝わるからだ。むしろ目上の人に向かって「あなた」と呼びかけると、よそよそしく失礼に響くことさえある。英語を学ぶ日本人が主語を落としがちなのは、こうした習慣の違いによるところが大きい。
cards.en: In Japanese conversation, pronouns are used far less than in English. That is because even if you leave out 'I' or 'you,' who is being talked about comes across naturally from the context and the choice of honorifics. In fact, addressing a superior as 'you' (anata) can even sound distant and rude. The tendency of Japanese learners of English to drop the subject owes a great deal to this difference in habits.

words.defJa: 二つのものが、考えや立場の違いから互いに反対し合うこと。

cards.ja: 自由と平等は、しばしば対立する価値として語られる。個人の自由を最大限に認めれば格差が広がり、平等を徹底しようとすれば自由を制限せざるを得ないという考え方だ。しかし、ある政治哲学者は、両者は本来支え合うものだと論じた。誰もが一定の条件を保障されてはじめて、自由は本当の意味を持つというのである。
cards.en: Freedom and equality are often described as opposing values. The idea is that if individual freedom is granted to the fullest, inequality widens, while if equality is pursued thoroughly, freedom has to be restricted. One political philosopher, however, argued that the two are by nature mutually supporting. Freedom, the argument goes, only takes on its real meaning once everyone is guaranteed certain basic conditions.

cards.en: When the May holidays come around, rice planting begins in the mountain villages. In the past, whole families and their neighbors turned out to plant the seedlings by hand, one clump at a time, but today almost every farmer uses machines. Even so, every year children at the local elementary school try planting by hand, getting covered in mud. It is said to be a valuable chance to learn firsthand how rice grows.

cards.ja: 地球が太陽の周りを回る軌道は、完全な円ではなく、わずかにつぶれた楕円を描いている。そのため、一年のうちで太陽との距離は少しずつ変化する。意外なことに、地球が太陽に最も近づくのは北半球が冬を迎える一月初めだ。季節の違いは距離ではなく、地軸の傾きによって生まれるのである。
cards.en: The orbit Earth traces around the Sun is not a perfect circle but a slightly flattened ellipse. As a result, its distance from the Sun changes little by little over the course of a year. Surprisingly, Earth comes closest to the Sun in early January, when the Northern Hemisphere is in winter. The seasons arise not from distance but from the tilt of Earth's axis.

In early spring he heads out to the field first thing in the morning to till the soil, carefully mixing in fertilizer. At first he complained that his back hurt, but now he is thoroughly tanned and looks healthy. Handing out the tomatoes and eggplants he harvests to the neighbors seems to be his greatest pleasure.

words.meaning: to store up, to build up; to save (money)
words.defJa: 後で使うために、お金や物、力などをためておく。

cards.ja: 冬眠に入る前のクマは、秋の間にドングリなどの木の実を大量に食べ、体に脂肪を蓄える。冬の数か月間、ほとんど何も食べずに過ごすためだ。ところが木の実が不作の年には十分な栄養をとれず、エサを求めて人里に下りてくることが増える。近年相次ぐクマの出没には、こうした事情が関係しているとみられる。
cards.en: Before going into hibernation, bears eat large amounts of acorns and other nuts during the autumn and store up fat in their bodies. This is so they can get through several winter months eating almost nothing. In years when the nut harvest is poor, however, they cannot get enough nourishment and more often come down to human settlements in search of food. This is thought to be connected to the string of bear sightings in recent years.

cards.en: Because bamboo is light, strong and flexible, it has long been indispensable to daily life in Japan as a material for baskets, chopsticks and more. One craftsman says he weaves finely split strips of bamboo by hand, one at a time, spending nearly a month to finish a single flower basket. Recently, bamboo has also been reappraised as a natural material that can replace plastic. This craftsman's work, too, has been highly praised at exhibitions abroad, and orders are reportedly increasing.

words.defJa: 前に述べたことに、条件や例外を付け加えるときに使う言葉。

cards.en: Rental housing contracts often stipulate that tenants must give at least one month's notice if they wish to cancel. Sometimes this is followed by a line such as: "However, the tenant may cancel immediately upon paying one month's rent." Conditions and exceptions like this tend to be written in small print. To avoid disputes later, it is worth reading every corner of the contract before signing.

words.meaning: digression, going off topic; derailment (of a train)
words.defJa: 列車が線路から外れること。また、話が本筋からそれること。

cards.ja: その教授の講義は、話がよく脱線することで学生の間で有名だった。言葉の語源を説明していたはずが、いつの間にか旅先での失敗談になっていることも珍しくなかった。ところが試験前にノートを見返すと、その脱線した話と一緒に要点を覚えていることに気づく学生が多かった。余談が、かえって理解を深める手がかりになっていたのだろう。

The asides, it seems, actually helped deepen their understanding.

words.defJa: わかりやすく説明するために、似ているほかのものを借りて言い表す。

words.meaning: to be enough, to suffice; to be worthy of
words.defJa: 十分である。また、それだけの値打ちがある。

cards.ja: 「足るを知る」という言葉は、古代中国の思想書に由来するといわれる。自分がすでに持っているもので満足できる人こそ、本当に豊かなのだという意味だ。次々と新しい商品が登場し、欲望がかき立てられ続ける現代社会では、なおさら心に響く教えだろう。もっとも、向上心まで捨てろと言っているわけではない。
cards.en: The phrase "knowing what is enough" is said to come from an ancient Chinese philosophical text. It means that those who can be content with what they already have are the truly rich. In modern society, where new products appear one after another and our desires are constantly stirred up, it is a teaching that resonates all the more. That said, it is not telling us to abandon ambition as well.

words.meaning: short-, brief (as in short time, short distance)
words.defJa: 名詞の前に付いて、時間や距離などがわずかであることを表す語。

cards.ja: 最近の研究で、一日に十分間ほど体を動かすといった短時間の運動でも、健康に一定の効果があることがわかってきた。忙しくてジムに通えない人でも、階段を使ったり、一駅分歩いたりするだけでよいという。大切なのは、無理なく毎日続けることだ。まとまった時間がとれないと諦める前に、できることから始めてみたい。
cards.en: Recent research is showing that even short bouts of exercise, such as moving your body for about ten minutes a day, bring certain health benefits. Even people too busy to go to the gym can benefit simply by taking the stairs or walking the distance of one train stop. What matters is keeping it up every day without overdoing it. Before giving up because you can't find a block of time, try starting with whatever you can do.

words.defJa: 限られた短い期間。

cards.ja: 夏休みを利用して、海外へ短期留学する大学生が再び増えている。二週間から一か月ほどの滞在でも、現地の家庭に泊まって授業を受ければ、語学力が高まるだけでなく異文化への理解も深まる。費用が比較的安く、就職活動への影響も少ないのが魅力だ。ただ、限られた期間で成果を上げるには、出発前の準備が欠かせないという。
cards.en: The number of university students using their summer break for short-term study abroad is rising again. Even a stay of two weeks to a month, if spent living with a local family and attending classes, improves language skills and deepens understanding of other cultures. Its appeal is that the cost is relatively low and it has little impact on job hunting. To get results in such a limited time, however, preparation before departure is said to be essential.

cards.en: From the Meiji era onward, many coal mines were opened in Kyushu and Hokkaido, supplying the energy that powered Japan's modernization. At their peak, large towns grew up around the mines, with bustling movie theaters and shopping streets. But when oil took over as the main source of energy, the mines closed one after another and the population fell rapidly. Today, some of the former sites are open to the public as industrial heritage.

words.meaning: water outage, suspension of the water supply
words.defJa: 水道の水が止まって、使えなくなること。

cards.ja: 大型の台風が通過した翌日、市内のおよそ一万世帯で断水が続いた。浄水場が停電し、水を送るポンプが止まってしまったためだ。市は各地の小学校に給水所を設け、住民はポリタンクを手に長い列を作った。こうした事態に備え、日頃から飲み水を用意しておくよう専門家は呼びかけている。
cards.en: The day after a large typhoon passed, the water supply remained cut off for about 10,000 households in the city. A power outage at the water treatment plant had stopped the pumps that send the water out. The city set up water distribution points at elementary schools in various areas, and residents lined up with plastic tanks in hand. Experts are urging people to keep drinking water on hand at all times in preparation for such situations.

words.defJa: 文法で、ものの数が一つであることを表す形。

cards.ja: 英語では、名詞が単数か複数かによって形が変わり、それに合わせて動詞の形も変わる。一方、日本語にはこうした区別がほとんどない。「本を買った」と言っても、一冊なのか何冊なのかは文脈から判断するしかない。英語を学ぶ日本人が冠詞や複数形でつまずきやすいのは、このためだともいわれる。
cards.en: In English, nouns change form depending on whether they are singular or plural, and verb forms change to match. Japanese, by contrast, makes almost no such distinction. Even when someone says the equivalent of "bought book," you can only tell from context whether it was one book or several. This is said to be one reason Japanese learners of English tend to stumble over articles and plural forms.

cards.en: In suburban housing complexes built during the period of rapid economic growth, residents are aging rapidly. Many of the buildings are five stories tall with no elevator, and going up and down the stairs has become a heavy burden. So an initiative has begun to rent vacant units cheaply to students, who in turn help elderly residents with their shopping. With the younger generation joining in, the complexes are gradually regaining their liveliness.

cards.ja: 昨年の決勝で一点差に泣いたチームは、その夜、必ずこの舞台に戻ってくると誓った。それから一年、選手たちは朝五時からの練習を一日も欠かさなかった。迎えた今年の決勝では、終盤に追いつかれながらも粘り強く戦い、延長戦の末についに優勝を果たした。試合後、主将の目には涙が光っていた。

For the following year, the players never missed a single day of practice starting at 5 a.m. In this year's final, though their opponents caught up late in the game, they fought tenaciously and at last won the championship in extra time. After the game, tears glistened in the captain's eyes.

cards.en: Rain and snow that fall on the mountains seep into the ground and become groundwater, which then flows slowly through layers of earth over many years. cards.ja: 震災から十年を迎えた港町で、地元の高校生による和太鼓の演奏会が開かれた。体の奥まで響く力強い音に、会場を埋めた住民たちはじっと聴き入った。演奏を終えた生徒の一人は、町を元気づけたい一心で練習を重ねてきたと語った。客席には、涙をぬぐう高齢者の姿も見られた。

words.defJa: 地面をつくっている岩石や地層の性質や状態。

cards.ja: 大規模なトンネル工事では、掘り始める前に周辺の地質を入念に調査する。岩盤の固さや湧き水の有無によって、工法や工事の期間が大きく変わるからだ。予想外に軟らかい地層に当たると崩落の危険が高まり、計画の見直しを迫られることもある。目に見えない地下の状態を正確に知ることが、安全な工事の第一歩となる。
cards.en: In large-scale tunnel construction, the geology of the surrounding area is carefully surveyed before digging begins. That is because construction methods and schedules change greatly depending on how hard the bedrock is and whether there is spring water. cards.en: Recently there has been a string of fraud cases in which scammers pose as acquaintances on social media, send messages and swindle people out of money. A typical ploy is to ask something like, "My phone broke, so could you buy electronic money for me instead?" When people believe the sender is someone close to them, they tend to fall for it. If anything seems even slightly suspicious, it is important to call the person directly and check.

cards.en: The new tunnel that opened this month has cut a journey that used to take nearly an hour over the mountain pass to just fifteen minutes. Because the section was often closed by snow in winter, the tunnel's opening had been a long-cherished wish of local residents. The time it takes ambulances to reach the hospital has also been shortened, and medical professionals have welcomed it too. In anticipation of more tourists, a string of new shops has been opening along the road.

words.defJa: 髪や麺、布などが、細かく波打ったように曲がる。

cards.ja: 梅雨の時期になると、髪がうねったり縮れたりして、まとまらないと悩む人が多い。髪の内部が空気中の水分を吸い、部分的に膨らむことで形が乱れるのが原因だ。美容師によると、洗髪後すぐにドライヤーでしっかり乾かすだけでも、かなり防げるという。湿気を通しにくくするオイルを毛先につけるのも効果的だ。
cards.en: When the rainy season comes, many people struggle with hair that goes wavy and frizzy and won't stay in place. The cause is that the inside of the hair absorbs moisture from the air and swells in places, throwing its shape out of order. According to hairdressers, just drying your hair thoroughly with a hair dryer right after washing it can prevent much of this. Applying an oil that keeps out humidity to the ends of your hair is also effective.

The severe heat is expected to continue through the end of this week.

words.defJa: 土地や町、村などにつけられた名前。

cards.ja: 日本の地名には、その土地の昔の姿を伝えるものが少なくない。たとえば「沢」や「谷」「池」など水に関わる字が入った地名は、かつてその場所が低湿地だったことを示している場合が多い。こうした土地は大雨の際に浸水しやすいとされ、自治体の防災担当者も注目している。何気なく呼んでいる名前が、実は災害への警告になっていることもあるのだ。
cards.en: Many Japanese place names convey what the land used to look like. For example, place names containing characters related to water, such as "marsh," "valley" or "pond," often indicate that the spot was once low-lying wetland. Such land is said to flood easily in heavy rain, and disaster-prevention officials in local governments are paying attention to this. Names we use without a second thought can actually serve as warnings of disaster.

cards.en: Lunch boxes full of fried and simmered dishes, brown all over, used to be shunned for looking drab. Recently, however, more and more people online have been praising lunch boxes deliberately packed with brown side dishes as "the really delicious-looking kind." Fried chicken and kinpira keep their flavor even when cold, and they are very popular with children. A nutritionist says that just adding one item such as cherry tomatoes or broccoli brings color and nutritional balance.

cards.ja: 来春の開業に向けて、新しい駅ビルの工事が着々と進んでいる。すでに外装はほぼ完成し、現在は内部の店舗スペースで内装作業が行われている。運営会社によると、テナントの八割以上が決まっており、地元の老舗菓子店も出店する予定だ。周辺では、開業に合わせた道路の拡幅工事も始まった。
cards.en: Construction of the new station building is proceeding steadily toward its opening next spring. The exterior is already nearly complete, and interior finishing work is now under way in the shop spaces inside. According to the operating company, more than 80 percent of the tenants have been secured, and a long-established local confectionery is also set to open a shop. Work to widen the surrounding roads in time for the opening has also begun.

cards.enTarget: Construction of the new station building is proceeding steadily toward its opening next spring.

words.defJa: 二つのものの間や、始めと終わりのちょうど間のところ。

cards.ja: 政府の有識者会議は昨日、少子化対策に関する中間報告をまとめた。最終的な提言は年末に出る予定だが、今回の報告では住宅支援の拡充と、若い世代の所得向上が柱として示された。委員からは、財源の議論を先送りにすべきではないとの意見も相次いだ。政府は報告を踏まえ、来年度予算への反映を検討する。
cards.en: Yesterday, the government's expert panel compiled an interim report on measures to address the declining birthrate. The final recommendations are due at the end of the year, but this report set out expanded housing support and higher incomes for the younger generation as its central pillars. Panel members also repeatedly argued that discussion of how to fund the measures should not be put off. The government will consider reflecting the report in next fiscal year's budget.

words.meaning: middle ten days of a month (the 11th to the 20th)
words.defJa: ひと月を三つに分けたうちの真ん中で、十一日から二十日ごろまで。

cards.ja: 今年の紅葉は、例年より一週間ほど遅れる見込みだ。十月に入っても厳しい残暑が続き、木々の葉が色づき始める時期がずれ込んだためである。気象会社の予想では、都市部の見頃は十二月上旬から中旬にかけてとなる。観光地では、イベントの日程を見直す動きも出ている。
cards.en: This year's autumn foliage is expected to be about a week later than usual. That is because the harsh lingering summer heat continued even into October, pushing back the time when the leaves begin to change color. According to a weather company's forecast, the best viewing period in urban areas will be from early to mid-December. At tourist spots, some are reconsidering the schedules of their events.

words.meaning: the Middle Ages, the medieval period
words.defJa: 歴史の時代の分け方の一つで、古代と近世の間の時代。

cards.ja: ヨーロッパの中世というと、暗く停滞した時代という印象を持つ人が多い。しかし近年の研究では、この時期に大学が生まれ、農業技術も大きく進歩したことが明らかになっている。修道院では古代の書物が書き写され、知識が後の時代へと受け継がれた。「暗黒時代」という呼び方そのものを見直す歴史家も増えている。
cards.en: When people think of the European Middle Ages, many have the impression of a dark and stagnant era. Recent research, however, has shown that universities were born in this period and that agricultural technology made great advances. In monasteries, ancient books were copied by hand, and knowledge was passed on to later ages. A growing number of historians are reconsidering the very label "Dark Ages."

cards.enTarget: When people think of the European Middle Ages, many have the impression of a dark and stagnant era.

words.meaning: neutral (neither acidic nor alkaline); neuter, gender-neutral
words.defJa: 酸性でもアルカリ性でもない性質。また、男女のどちらとも言えない性質。

cards.ja: 食器洗いに使う洗剤の多くは、酸性でもアルカリ性でもない中性だ。そのため手肌への刺激が比較的少なく、プラスチックや漆器などさまざまな素材に使える。一方、換気扇の頑固な油汚れには、アルカリ性の洗剤のほうが効果が高い。汚れの種類に合わせて使い分けることが、掃除を楽にするこつだという。
cards.en: Most of the detergents used for washing dishes are neutral, neither acidic nor alkaline. As a result they are relatively gentle on the skin of your hands and can be used on a wide range of materials, such as plastic and lacquerware. For stubborn grease on a kitchen fan, on the other hand, an alkaline detergent is more effective. Matching the detergent to the type of dirt is said to be the trick to making cleaning easier.

cards.enTarget: Most of the detergents used for washing dishes are neutral, neither acidic nor alkaline.

words.defJa: 物事が始まってから終わるまでの間。やりかけのところ。

cards.ja: 人手不足が続くなか、中途採用に力を入れる企業が増えている。かつては新卒で入社した社員を長く育てるのが一般的だったが、即戦力となる経験者を求める声が強まった。大手企業でも、採用者の多くを転職組が占める例が珍しくなくなった。年齢よりも専門性を重視する流れは、今後さらに広がりそうだ。
cards.en: Amid an ongoing labor shortage, more and more companies are putting effort into mid-career hiring. It used to be common to train employees who had joined straight out of school over many years, but demand for experienced people who can contribute right away has grown. Even at major companies, it is no longer unusual for people who have changed jobs to make up most of the hires. The trend of valuing expertise over age looks set to spread further.

cards.enTarget: Amid an ongoing labor shortage, more and more companies are putting effort into mid-career hiring.

words.defJa: 若者と老人の間の年ごろ。おおよそ四十代から五十代。

cards.ja: 中年になると、若いころと同じ食事を続けていても体重が増えやすくなる。筋肉の量が少しずつ減り、何もしなくても消費されるエネルギーが下がるためだ。専門家は、激しい運動よりも、階段を使う、一駅分歩くといった日常の工夫を勧めている。週に二回ほどの軽い筋力トレーニングを加えれば、効果はさらに高まるという。
cards.en: Once you reach middle age, you tend to gain weight more easily even if you keep eating the same meals as when you were young. This is because muscle mass gradually decreases, lowering the energy your body burns even at rest. Rather than intense exercise, experts recommend everyday habits such as taking the stairs or walking an extra station's distance. Adding light strength training about twice a week is said to make it even more effective.

words.meaning: long ~ (prefix for long duration or distance)
words.defJa: 時間や距離を表すことばの前について、それが「ながい」ことを表す。

cards.ja: 長時間労働を是正するため、トラック運転手の残業時間に上限が設けられた。運転手の健康と安全を守るための措置だが、一人が一日に運べる荷物の量は減ることになる。物流会社の間では、中継拠点で運転手が交代する仕組みを取り入れる動きが広がっている。荷物を受け取る側にも、急ぎでない配送は日時に余裕を持たせるなどの協力が求められている。
cards.en: To correct long working hours, a cap has been placed on the overtime of truck drivers. The measure is meant to protect drivers' health and safety, but it means that the amount of cargo one driver can carry in a day will fall. Among logistics companies, there is a growing move to adopt systems in which drivers hand over at relay hubs. Recipients are also being asked to cooperate, for example by allowing more leeway in delivery dates for shipments that are not urgent.

cards.enTarget: To correct long working hours, a cap has been placed on the overtime of truck drivers.

words.defJa: その家で最初に生まれた娘。

cards.ja: 両親が営んできた小さな旅館を、三年前に長女が継いだ。都会の会社で十年ほど働いた経験を生かし、予約の受け付けをインターネットに切り替え、外国人客向けの案内も整えた。父は当初、娘に苦労をかけたくないと反対していたという。いまでは週末になると、家族総出で客を迎えている。
cards.en: Three years ago, the eldest daughter took over the small inn her parents had run. Drawing on about ten years of experience working at a company in the city, she switched reservations to the internet and put together guidance for foreign guests. Her father reportedly opposed the idea at first, not wanting to put his daughter through hardship. Now, on weekends, the whole family turns out to welcome guests.

cards.ja: 五輪の代表に選ばれた選手たちは、本番に向けて最終的な調整に入った。この時期に練習量を増やしすぎると疲れが残るため、多くの選手はむしろ練習を軽めにして体を休ませる。食事や睡眠の時間も、試合が行われる現地の時刻に合わせて少しずつずらしていく。わずかな体調の差が、勝敗を分けることもあるからだ。
cards.en: The athletes selected for the Olympic team have moved into the final stage of fine-tuning for the competition. Increasing the amount of training too much at this stage leaves fatigue behind, so many athletes instead train lightly and let their bodies rest. They also gradually shift their meal and sleep times to match the local time where the competition will be held. That is because a slight difference in physical condition can decide who wins and who loses.

words.meaning: length (long versus short); merits and demerits
words.defJa: ながいことと、みじかいこと。また、よいところと悪いところ。

cards.ja: 日本語を学ぶ外国人がつまずきやすいのが、音の長短の区別だ。「おばさん」と「おばあさん」、「ビル」と「ビール」のように、母音を伸ばすかどうかで意味がまったく変わってしまう。英語などでは音の長さで意味が分かれることが少ないため、聞き分けるのに苦労するという。日本語教師は、手をたたいて拍を数える練習を勧めている。
cards.en: One thing foreign learners of Japanese often stumble over is distinguishing between long and short sounds. As with obasan (aunt) and obaasan (grandmother), or biru (building) and biiru (beer), whether or not a vowel is lengthened can completely change the meaning. Because in languages such as English the length of a sound rarely distinguishes meanings, learners reportedly struggle to hear the difference. Japanese teachers recommend practicing by clapping to count the beats.

words.defJa: 物のいちばん高いところ。また、物事の最も盛んな状態。

cards.ja: オオカミは、かつて日本の山の生態系で頂点に立つ動物だった。シカやイノシシを捕らえて食べ、その数が増えすぎないよう抑える役割を果たしていたとされる。明治時代にオオカミが絶滅して主な天敵がいなくなったうえ、近年は狩猟をする人も減り、シカが急増して森の若木や農作物が食い荒らされている。生態系のバランスを取り戻す難しさを、多くの研究者が指摘している。
cards.en: The wolf was once the animal at the top of the ecosystem in Japan's mountains. By catching and eating deer and wild boar, it is thought to have kept their numbers from growing too large. With the wolf wiped out in the Meiji era and the main natural predator gone, and with fewer people hunting in recent years, deer have increased sharply and are devouring young forest trees and crops. Many researchers point out how difficult it is to restore balance to the ecosystem.

words.defJa: その家で最初に生まれた息子。

cards.ja: かつての日本では、長男が家と墓を継ぎ、親の面倒を見るのが当然とされていた。しかし少子化が進み、都市への人口移動が続くなかで、そうした考え方は大きく揺らいでいる。最近は墓石を撤去し、遺骨を納骨堂などに移す「墓じまい」を選ぶ家庭も増えた。家族の形の変化が、弔い方にまで及んでいるのだ。
cards.en: In Japan it used to be taken for granted that the eldest son would inherit the family house and grave and look after his parents. But as the birthrate falls and people continue to move to the cities, that way of thinking has been badly shaken. Recently, more families have chosen hakajimai, removing the family gravestone and moving the remains to a columbarium or similar site. Changes in the shape of the family are reaching even the way people mourn their dead.

words.defJa: 四つの角がすべて九十度の四角形。

cards.ja: 和室に敷かれている畳は、縦と横の比率がほぼ二対一の長方形をしている。二枚並べるとちょうど正方形になるため、部屋の広さに応じてさまざまな敷き方ができる。ただし、畳の大きさは地域によって異なり、関西の畳は関東のものより一回り大きい。同じ「六畳間」でも、地域によって実際の広さが違うのはこのためだ。
cards.en: The tatami mats laid in Japanese-style rooms are rectangles with a length-to-width ratio of roughly two to one. Since two placed side by side make exactly a square, they can be laid out in various patterns depending on the size of the room. Tatami sizes differ by region, however, and those in the Kansai area are a size larger than those in the Kanto area. This is why even a so-called "six-mat room" differs in actual size from region to region.

cards.ja: 和食の煮物では、調味料を「さしすせそ」の順に入れるとよいと昔から言われる。砂糖、塩、酢、しょうゆ、みそを指す言葉で、この順番にはそれぞれ理由があるという。たとえば砂糖は分子が大きく食材にしみ込みにくいため、塩より先に入れる。一方、しょうゆやみそは香りが飛ばないよう、最後に加えるのが基本だ。
cards.en: It has long been said that in simmered Japanese dishes, seasonings are best added in the order "sa-shi-su-se-so." The phrase stands for sugar, salt, vinegar, soy sauce and miso, and there is said to be a reason behind each step of the order. Sugar, for example, has large molecules that do not soak into ingredients easily, so it goes in before salt. Soy sauce and miso, on the other hand, are as a rule added last so that their aroma does not escape.

cards.ja: 大きな地震が起きた直後は、すぐに外へ飛び出さず、まず机の下などで身を守ることが大切だ。揺れている最中に動くと、落ちてきた物や割れたガラスでけがをするおそれがある。揺れが収まったら火の元を確かめ、ドアを開けて避難経路を確保する。日ごろから家族で避難場所を話し合っておくことも欠かせない。
cards.en: Immediately after a major earthquake strikes, it is important not to rush outside but first to protect yourself, for example under a desk. Moving while the ground is still shaking risks injury from falling objects or broken glass. Once the shaking stops, check for sources of fire and open the door to secure an escape route. It is also essential for families to discuss evacuation sites with each other in everyday life.

cards.ja: 地図の上で二つの都市を直線で結んでも、それが最短の空路になるとは限らない。地球は球体なので、平面の地図に描くと実際の距離がゆがんで見えるからだ。たとえば日本からヨーロッパへ向かう飛行機は、地図上では北に大きく弧を描くように飛ぶ。これは遠回りに見えて、実は球面上の最短ルートなのである。
cards.en: Connecting two cities with a straight line on a map does not necessarily give you the shortest air route. Because the earth is a sphere, actual distances look distorted when drawn on a flat map. Planes flying from Japan to Europe, for example, follow what looks on a map like a wide arc to the north. This looks like a detour but is in fact the shortest route on the sphere.

words.meaning: just before; right in front of
words.defJa: ある物事が起こる、すぐ前。

cards.en: Just before entrance exams, quite a few students are tempted to start on a new workbook. But a cram-school instructor says that at this stage they should instead review the problems they have already worked through. By solving the problems they got wrong again and again, they can reliably fill in their weak spots. Going to bed early the night before and getting into good condition for the exam is also important, the instructor says.

cards.ja: この春から、郊外の私鉄と都心の地下鉄が直通運転を始めた。これまでは途中の駅で乗り換えが必要だったが、一本の電車で都心まで行けるようになった。通勤時間が十分ほど短くなったという利用者も多い。一方で、どちらかの路線で遅れが出ると、もう一方にも影響が広がりやすいという課題もある。
cards.en: This spring, a suburban private railway and a downtown subway line began through service. Until now a transfer was required at a station along the way, but now you can reach the city center on a single train. Many passengers say their commute has become about ten minutes shorter. On the other hand, there is the problem that when a delay occurs on one line, its effects easily spread to the other.

cards.ja: 太陽光パネルが生み出す電気は直流で、家庭のコンセントに流れている交流とは性質が異なる。そのため、発電した電気を家電で使うには、パワーコンディショナーという装置で交流に変換する必要がある。変換の際には、どうしてもわずかな電力が失われてしまう。最近は、直流のまま蓄電池や電気自動車に送る仕組みも研究されている。
cards.en: The electricity generated by solar panels is direct current, which differs in nature from the alternating current flowing through household outlets. So, to use the electricity you generate in home appliances, it must be converted to alternating current with a device called a power conditioner. Some power is inevitably lost in the conversion. Recently, systems that send the electricity to storage batteries or electric vehicles while it is still direct current are also being studied.

cards.ja: 日本は原油のほぼすべてを輸入に頼っているため、国と民間を合わせて二百日分を超える石油を貯蔵している。中東での紛争などで輸入が途絶えても、すぐに国内の供給が止まらないようにするためだ。備蓄基地には巨大なタンクが並び、地下の岩盤をくりぬいて原油をためる施設もある。ただ、維持には多額の費用がかかり、脱炭素の流れのなかで規模の見直しを求める声もある。
cards.en: Because Japan relies on imports for almost all of its crude oil, the state and private companies together store more than 200 days' worth of oil. This is so that domestic supply does not stop at once even if imports are cut off by a conflict in the Middle East or the like. Huge tanks line the stockpiling bases, and there are also facilities that hold crude oil in caverns hollowed out of underground bedrock. Maintaining them costs a great deal of money, however, and amid the shift toward decarbonization some are calling for the scale to be reconsidered.

cards.en: For carpenters building a house, assembling pillars and walls at precise right angles is the most basic of basics. Today, measuring devices that use lasers have become widespread, but many craftsmen still won't part with their sashigane.

words.defJa: 円や球の中心を通り、まわりの二点を結ぶまっすぐな線。またはその長さ。

cards.ja: 月の直径はおよそ三千五百キロで、地球の四分の一ほどしかない。それでも、惑星の大きさに比べて衛星がこれほど大きい例は、太陽系の中でも珍しい。有力な説では、誕生間もない地球に火星ほどの天体がぶつかり、飛び散った破片が集まって月になったとされる。この大きな月が地球の自転軸の傾きを安定させ、生命の進化にも影響したと考える研究者もいる。
cards.en: The moon's diameter is about 3,500 kilometers, only about a quarter of the earth's. Even so, it is rare in the solar system for a satellite to be this large compared with its planet. According to a leading theory, a body about the size of Mars collided with the newly formed earth, and the scattered fragments gathered to form the moon. Some researchers believe that this large moon has kept the tilt of the earth's axis stable and has also influenced the evolution of life.

words.meaning: to scatter around, to make a mess of
words.defJa: 物をあちこちに広げて、ごちゃごちゃにする。

cards.ja: 子どもがおもちゃを散らかすたびに叱っていた母は、ある本を読んで考え方を変えた。幼い子どもにとって、物を出して並べることは遊びそのものであり、好奇心の表れだというのだ。いまは無理に片付けさせず、寝る前に一緒に箱へ戻す時間をつくっている。叱る回数が減ってから、子どもも自分から片付けるようになったという。
cards.en: A mother who used to scold her child every time the child scattered toys around changed her thinking after reading a certain book. It said that for small children, taking things out and lining them up is play itself and an expression of curiosity. Now, instead of forcing the child to tidy up, she makes time before bed to put everything back in the box together. Since she began scolding less, the child has started tidying up without being told, she says.

words.meaning: to be cluttered, to be in disorder
words.defJa: 物があちこちに広がって、乱れた状態になる。

cards.ja: 机の上が散らかっていると、仕事の効率が落ちるという研究がある。視界に入る物が多いほど、脳は無意識のうちにそれらに注意を向け、集中力が分散してしまうからだ。一方で、物が雑然と置かれた環境のほうが新しい発想が生まれやすいという実験結果も報告されている。整理整頓が万能とは限らず、作業の内容に応じて使い分けるのがよさそうだ。
cards.en: There is research showing that when your desk is cluttered, your work efficiency drops. That is because the more objects there are in your field of vision, the more the brain unconsciously turns its attention to them, and your concentration gets scattered. On the other hand, experiments have also been reported showing that new ideas emerge more easily in an environment where things are left in disarray. Neatness is not a cure-all, and it seems best to adapt depending on the kind of work you are doing.

cards.en: In Showa-era residential neighborhoods, a common sight was a light truck making the rounds to collect old newspapers and magazines and leaving tissue paper or toilet paper in exchange. Many people probably remember the distinctive call that blared from its loudspeaker. Now that municipal recycling collection is well established, such trucks are seen far less often. Still, many people of my grandmother's generation call tissues chirigami even today.

cards.ja: この峠道は、かつて城下町から港へと通ずる唯一の街道だった。江戸時代には塩や海産物を運ぶ人馬が絶えず行き交い、峠の茶屋は旅人でにぎわったという。明治に入って鉄道が敷かれると、この道を使う人は急速に減った。いまでは石畳の一部が残るだけだが、歴史を感じさせる散策路として整備されている。
cards.en: This mountain pass road was once the only highway leading from the castle town to the port. In the Edo period, people and packhorses carrying salt and seafood came and went constantly, and the teahouse at the pass is said to have bustled with travelers. When the railway was laid in the Meiji era, the number of people using the road fell rapidly. Today only part of the stone paving remains, but it has been maintained as a walking trail that evokes the past.

cards.ja: スマートフォンには一日に数十件もの通知が届く。作業中に一度通知に気を取られると、元の集中状態に戻るまでにかなりの時間がかかるという研究もある。そこで最近は、仕事の時間帯だけ通知を止める機能を使う人が増えている。家族や上司からの連絡だけは届くように設定しておけば、大事な用件を見逃す心配もない。
cards.en: Smartphones receive dozens of notifications a day. Some research suggests that once you are distracted by a notification while working, it takes a considerable time to get back to your original level of concentration. That is why more and more people now use a feature that silences notifications only during working hours. If you set it so that messages from family or your boss still get through, there is no need to worry about missing anything important.

Textbook conversations are far more polite and slower than real ones, so people are thrown by the casual expressions and the speed they meet abroad. Recently, classes that put getting the message across ahead of grammatical correctness have been spreading.

cards.en: On long-haul flights, many people choose an aisle seat over a window seat. They can get up without having to ask the passenger next to them, which they say is a relief when they want to go to the toilet or stretch their legs. The drawback, however, is that their shoulders and knees tend to get bumped every time the meal cart passes. Which to choose is best decided by whether you put sleep first.

On weekends, it is not unusual to see customers spending hours in front of the shelves.

According to the police, the elderly man who was driving says he mistook the accelerator for the brake. There were several customers and staff inside, but fortunately the only injury was a minor one to a single employee. Similar accidents keep happening across the country, and there is an urgent need to spread devices that prevent such pedal mix-ups.

The company had originally planned to hire an outside professional, but voices were raised saying they wanted the product presented in the words of an employee who had worked on its development. cards.en: Every autumn, a giant tug-of-war is held in this town. The rope, twisted together from rice straw, is said to exceed 100 meters in length and weigh several tons. The residents split into east and west sides and pull against each other, and it has long been believed that the winning side will be blessed with a good harvest that year. Recently, tourists have started joining in on the spot, and it has become an event that draws crowds from outside the town as well.

cards.ja: 雨粒というと、しずくの形を思い浮かべる人が多いだろう。しかし実際には、小さな雨粒はほぼ球形で、大きくなるにつれて空気の抵抗を受け、底が平らなまんじゅうのような形になる。直径が五ミリほどを超えると形を保てなくなり、空中で分裂してしまう。そのため、落ちてくる雨の粒の大きさにはおのずと上限がある。
cards.en: When people think of raindrops, many picture a teardrop shape. In reality, however, small raindrops are nearly spherical, and as they grow larger they meet air resistance and take on a shape like a bun with a flat bottom. Once the diameter exceeds about five millimeters, they can no longer hold their shape and break apart in midair. For that reason, there is naturally an upper limit to the size of the drops of rain that fall.

Experts point out that the danger can be greatly reduced simply by rethinking furniture placement or installing lights that illuminate the floor. Because a fall can lead to someone becoming bedridden, taking measures early is essential.

cards.en: Nails are said to be a mirror of one's health. words.meaning: to balance; to be well matched
words.defJa: 二つのものの重さや程度が同じぐらいで、どちらにもかたよらない。

cards.ja: 左右の皿にのせた物の重さが等しくなると、天秤は水平に釣り合う。古代エジプトの壁画にはすでに天秤が描かれており、人類は数千年前からこの道具で重さを比べてきた。現代の電子はかりは仕組みこそ違うが、目盛りを正しく合わせるには今も基準となる分銅が欠かせない。正確な計量は、商取引の信頼を支える土台でもある。
cards.en: When the objects on the left and right pans weigh the same, a balance settles level. Balances already appear in ancient Egyptian wall paintings, and humans have been comparing weights with this tool for thousands of years. Modern electronic scales work differently, but reference weights are still essential for calibrating them correctly. Accurate measurement is also the foundation of trust in commerce.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: When the objects on the left and right pans weigh the same, a balance settles level.

words.defJa: 物を高い所に掛けて、下にぶら下げる。

cards.ja: エアコンが普及する前、夏の夜には部屋に蚊帳を吊って眠るのが当たり前だった。四隅のひもを柱や壁の金具に掛けると、部屋の中にもう一つ小さな部屋ができる。子どもたちは、その中に入るのが楽しみだったという。最近は、虫よけの薬を使わない方法として、キャンプなどで見直されている。
cards.en: Before air conditioners became widespread, it was normal on summer nights to hang a mosquito net in the room and sleep under it. When you hooked the cords at its four corners onto fittings on the pillars and walls, a second, smaller room appeared inside the room. Children reportedly looked forward to getting inside it. Recently it has been rediscovered, at campsites and elsewhere, as a way to keep insects off without using repellent.

cards.ja: 晩秋になると、山あいの農家の軒先には、皮をむいた渋柿がずらりと吊るされる。冷たく乾いた風に一か月ほどさらすと、渋みが抜けて甘い干し柿ができあがる。橙色の実が連なる光景は、この地方に冬の訪れを告げる風物詩だ。最近は、作り方を学ぼうと都市部から訪れる人もいる。
cards.en: In late autumn, peeled astringent persimmons are hung in long rows under the eaves of farmhouses in the mountains. After about a month of exposure to the cold, dry wind, the astringency disappears and sweet dried persimmons are ready. The sight of strings of orange fruit is a seasonal sign that announces the arrival of winter in this region. Recently, some people even come from the cities to learn how to make them.

words.meaning: restroom, toilet (usually with the polite prefix o-); hand-washing
words.defJa: トイレのこと。また、手を水で洗うこと。

cards.ja: 海外を旅して、公共のお手洗いが有料であることに驚く日本人旅行者は多い。ヨーロッパの駅では、入り口で小銭を払う仕組みが今も珍しくない。一方、日本では駅や公園のお手洗いが無料で使え、清潔さも世界有数だと評価されている。旅の前に、現地の小銭を少し用意しておくと安心だ。
cards.en: Many Japanese travelers are surprised when they go abroad to find that public restrooms charge a fee. At European train stations, systems where you pay coins at the entrance are still common. In Japan, by contrast, restrooms in stations and parks are free to use, and their cleanliness is rated among the best in the world. It is reassuring to have a few coins of the local currency ready before your trip.

words.defJa: ほかの語の前について、程度や値などがひくいことを表す。

cards.ja: 物価の上昇が続くなか、スーパー各社は自社で企画した低価格の商品を相次いで増やしている。メーカー品より二、三割安いものも多く、家計を守りたい消費者の支持を集めている。かつては安かろう悪かろうと見られがちだったが、品質の改善が進み、評価は大きく変わった。今や売り場の主役になりつつある。
cards.en: As prices keep rising, supermarket chains are one after another adding more low-priced products of their own design. Many are 20 to 30 percent cheaper than brand-name goods and are winning the support of consumers who want to protect their household budgets. They used to be seen as cheap and shoddy, but improvements in quality have greatly changed how they are rated. They are now becoming the stars of the sales floor.

cards.enTarget: As prices keep rising, supermarket chains are one after another adding more low-priced products of their own design.

words.meaning: capacity, maximum number of people allowed; authorized number
words.defJa: その場所や組織に入れる人の数として、前もって決められた数。

cards.ja: 少子化の影響で、入学者が定員に満たない私立大学が全体の半数を超えたと報じられた。特に地方の小規模な大学では、学生の確保が経営を左右する深刻な問題となっている。学部の再編や社会人向けの講座の開設など、生き残りをかけた模索が続く。一方、都市部の人気大学には志願者が集中し、二極化が進んでいる。
cards.en: It has been reported that, because of the declining birthrate, more than half of all private universities now enroll fewer students than their capacity. Especially at small regional universities, securing students has become a serious problem that determines their financial survival. They continue searching for ways to survive, such as reorganizing faculties and opening courses for working adults. Meanwhile, applicants are concentrating at popular urban universities, and polarization is deepening.
