words.defJa: お金を、決められた口座や窓口に納める。

cards.ja: 通販の代金や保険料、公共料金などを、コンビニで払い込む人は多い。郵送されてきた払込票をレジに出せば、銀行が閉まっている夜間や休日でも支払いが済むからだ。最近は払込票のバーコードをスマートフォンで読み取り、アプリから直接支払える仕組みも広がっている。ただし、期限を過ぎた払込票はコンビニで受け付けてもらえないことが多いので、届いたら早めに済ませておきたい。
cards.en: Many people pay for mail-order purchases, insurance premiums and utility bills at convenience stores. That is because handing the payment slip that came in the mail to the cashier settles the bill even at night or on holidays, when banks are closed. Recently, systems have also spread that let you scan the slip's barcode with a smartphone and pay directly from an app. However, convenience stores often will not accept a slip once its due date has passed, so it is best to take care of it soon after it arrives.

The railway company announced that it would refund express and fare tickets for canceled trains without any fee. These days, tickets booked online can be refunded through the app. To avoid crowding at the counters, the company is recommending that people handle it online.

cards.ja: 盆栽の手入れでは、枝に針金を巻きつけて形を整える作業が欠かせない。曲げたい方向に少しずつ力を加え、数か月から一年ほどかけて枝に癖をつけるのである。巻いたままにしておくと、枝が太るにつれて針金が食い込み、傷跡が残ってしまう。そのため職人は、枝の育ち具合を見ながら外す時期を慎重に見極める。
cards.en: In caring for bonsai, wrapping wire around the branches to shape them is essential work. Pressure is applied little by little in the direction one wants to bend them, training the branches into shape over several months to a year. If the wire is left on, it bites into the branch as it thickens and leaves scars. For that reason, craftsmen carefully judge when to remove it while watching how the branches are growing.

He never used to cook, but apparently he became completely hooked on cooking through a class he started attending after retiring. This week, he says, he is going to marinate bone-in chicken overnight and make a proper curry. As far as the family is concerned, it would help even more if he did the cleanup too.

cards.ja: 一九六〇年代の後半、世界各地の大学で反戦運動が大きなうねりとなった。日本でも学生たちが集会やデモを重ね、ベトナム戦争に協力する政府の姿勢に異を唱えた。運動はやがて内部の対立から勢いを失ったが、市民が声を上げる文化を残したと評価する研究者もいる。当時の写真や新聞記事は、いまも大学の資料館に保管されている。
cards.en: In the late 1960s, anti-war movements swelled into a great wave at universities around the world. In Japan, too, students held rally after rally and demonstration after demonstration, objecting to the government's cooperation with the Vietnam War. The movement eventually lost momentum because of internal conflict, but some researchers credit it with leaving behind a culture of citizens speaking out. Photos and newspaper articles from that time are still kept in university archives.

words.defJa: 円や球の中心から、そのまわりまでの長さ。

cards.ja: コンビニの出店では、店から半径五百メートルほどの範囲に住む人の数が重視される。歩いて来られる客が売り上げの中心になるためだ。最近は高齢化が進んだ地域で、この範囲をさらに狭く見積もる会社も出てきた。重い荷物を持って長い距離を歩くのが難しい客が増えているからである。
cards.en: When opening a convenience store, great weight is placed on the number of people living within a radius of about five hundred meters. That is because customers who can come on foot make up the core of sales. Recently, some companies have begun to estimate this area even more narrowly in places where the population has aged. That is because more customers find it hard to walk long distances carrying heavy bags.

words.meaning: personal seal, stamp (used in place of a signature)
words.defJa: 名前などを彫って、紙に押して使う道具。本人が認めたしるしになる。

cards.ja: 契約書や請求書にはんこを押すためだけに出社する。数年前まで、そんな働き方は珍しくなかった。行政手続きでも押印の義務が次々と廃止され、電子契約のサービスを導入する企業は急速に増えている。一方で、不動産の売買や相続の手続きなど、実印が今も欠かせない場面は残っている。
cards.en: Going into the office just to stamp your seal on contracts and invoices: until a few years ago, that way of working was not unusual. Seal requirements have been abolished one after another in administrative procedures as well, and the number of companies adopting electronic contract services is growing rapidly. On the other hand, there remain situations, such as buying or selling property and settling an inheritance, where a registered seal is still indispensable.

cards.en: As the count went on and word came that victory was assured, the campaign office erupted in loud applause. The candidate bowed deeply to supporters, and everyone gave three cheers of "banzai." It is a familiar scene repeated on election nights, but recently some candidates, mainly younger ones, have begun to drop the custom. The aim seems to be to show that they are not bound by old conventions.

At the first House of Representatives election after their appointment, they face a vote of confidence in the national review. However, many people vote without knowing how each justice has ruled, and criticism that the system has become a mere formality runs deep. Recently, more news organizations have begun compiling and publishing each justice's opinions.

words.meaning: lot number, house number (in an address)
words.defJa: 町や村をさらに細かく分けて、土地ごとにつけた番号。

cards.ja: 日本の住所は、多くの地域で通りの名前ではなく、区画ごとに振られた番号で表される。何丁目の何番地と書かれていても、隣り合う建物の番号が順番に並んでいるとは限らない。そのため、配達員や海外からの旅行者が目的地を探して迷うことも少なくない。最近は地図アプリの普及で、こうした不便さはだいぶ和らいだ。
cards.en: In many areas, Japanese addresses are expressed not by street names but by numbers assigned to each block. Even when an address gives a chome and a lot number, neighboring buildings are not necessarily numbered in order. As a result, delivery workers and travelers from abroad often get lost looking for their destination. Recently, with the spread of map apps, this inconvenience has eased considerably.

cards.enTarget: Even when an address gives a chome and a lot number, neighboring buildings are not necessarily numbered in order.

words.defJa: 海や湖に向かって、陸地が細長く突き出た部分。

cards.ja: 太平洋に突き出たある半島の南岸には、海に向かって切り立った崖が何十キロも続いている。大地震のたびに陸地が持ち上がり、波に削られることを繰り返して、今の地形ができたと考えられている。崖の上に階段のように重なる平らな土地は、かつて陸地が持ち上がった跡だ。研究者はこうした地形を手がかりに地震の間隔を調べ、次の大地震がいつ起きるのかを探っている。
cards.en: Along the southern coast of a peninsula jutting into the Pacific, cliffs dropping sheer to the sea run on for dozens of kilometers. The present landscape is thought to have formed through repeated cycles of the land being lifted by each great earthquake and then carved away by waves. The flat terraces stacked like stairs above the cliffs are traces of past uplift. Researchers use these landforms as clues to the intervals between earthquakes, trying to work out when the next great one will strike.

cards.en: Luggage for overseas trips gets lighter every year, but a smartphone and a charger can now fairly be called essentials. This is because many travelers rely on a single device for everything from maps and translation to checking their plane tickets. That makes it all the more inconvenient when the battery runs out. The more experienced the traveler, the more likely they are to always carry a spare battery and some notes on paper.

It was a very short phrase: 'Nobody knows anything at first; that's perfectly normal.' That alone took the tension out of my shoulders, and I became able to ask honestly about things I didn't understand. Perhaps you don't need a long explanation to support someone.

cards.en: On the day a new business system was introduced, the section chief first told everyone to look through the manual once from start to finish. There was no need to memorize the detailed operations; it was enough just to grasp where everything was written. In fact, how quickly people worked varied greatly depending on whether they could immediately open the relevant page when they got stuck. The overall picture grasped at the start becomes the map that supports later learning.

It could be called an adaptation peculiar to animals that hunt at night.

Speaking aloud is perhaps one way of looking at the inside of your head from the outside.

cards.en: A made-to-order suit takes more days than you might expect between ordering it and its completion. If the day you will wear it is already fixed, such as a wedding or a company entrance ceremony, you should order with time to spare. Because so much work goes into it, a suit that fits your body perfectly can be worn and cherished for many years.

A single preventive measure can sometimes make a big difference to a player's career.

In other words, by the time we see the sun disappear, it is in fact already below the horizon.

The shapes of the walls and ceiling were designed over many years so that sound reaches every corner of the seating evenly. Even after the performance ends, the last note lingers in the space for a while, and the audience savors that afterglow before applauding. It is easy to see why the hall itself is said to be a musical instrument.

Because it also contained passages criticizing religious and political authority, its publication was repeatedly banned. Even so, this attempt to share knowledge widely had a great influence on later social change.

Companies, too, are rethinking how they advertise and are shifting to gender-neutral ways of selling.

So even if two rooms are the same size on paper, one may feel cramped when you actually step inside. Before signing a contract, you should always view the place and check whether your furniture will fit.

words.defJa: とても広くて、ゆったりとしているようす。

cards.ja: 築五十年の市立図書館が改装され、見違えるほど広々とした空間に生まれ変わった。背の高い本棚を減らし、大きな窓から自然光が入るように設計したことで、館内はぐっと明るくなった。子ども向けの読み聞かせコーナーや、学生が自由に話し合える席も新たに設けられた。静かに本を読むだけでなく、人が集まり学び合う場所へと、図書館の役割が変わりつつある。
cards.en: A fifty-year-old city library has been renovated and reborn as a space so open and roomy it is hardly recognizable. By reducing the number of tall bookshelves and designing it so that natural light comes in through large windows, the interior became much brighter. A story-time corner for children and seats where students can talk freely have also been newly added. The library's role is shifting from a place just for reading quietly to one where people gather and learn from each other.

words.defJa: 手紙を書くための用紙。罫線が引かれたものが多い。

cards.ja: 最近、文房具店で便箋の売り場が少しずつ広がっているという。メールやSNSで用件は済むようになったが、季節の柄や手触りにこだわった紙に、あえて手書きで気持ちをつづりたい人が増えているらしい。店長によれば、特に若い世代が友人への誕生日の手紙用に選んでいくそうだ。文字のくせや書き直した跡まで含めて、手紙は送り手の存在を伝えてくれる。
cards.en: Sales floors for letter paper are reportedly expanding little by little in stationery shops these days. Although email and social media now take care of most business, more people apparently want to deliberately write out their feelings by hand on paper with seasonal patterns and a carefully chosen texture. According to one shop manager, young people in particular pick it out for birthday letters to friends. Down to the quirks of the handwriting and the traces of rewriting, a letter conveys the presence of the person who sent it.

words.meaning: bottling, putting up in jars; bottled goods
words.defJa: 食べ物などをびんに入れて口を閉じること。また、そうした食品。

cards.ja: 秋になると、祖母は庭でとれた果物を砂糖で煮て、いくつもの瓶詰めにしていた。よく煮沸した瓶に詰めてふたを固く閉めれば、冷蔵庫に入れなくても一年近く保存できる。冬の朝、棚から一つ取り出してパンに塗ると、夏の日差しの記憶までよみがえるようだった。保存技術が進んだ今も、手作りの瓶詰めには特別な味わいがある。
cards.en: Every autumn, my grandmother would simmer the fruit from her garden with sugar and put it up in jar after jar. Packed into thoroughly boiled jars with the lids closed tight, it keeps for nearly a year without refrigeration. On winter mornings, when I took one down from the shelf and spread it on bread, it felt as if even the memory of summer sunshine came back. Even now that preservation technology has advanced, homemade bottled preserves have a special flavor.

words.defJa: ゴムや紙の袋に空気やガスを入れて、丸くふくらませたもの。

cards.ja: 子どもの手から離れた風船は、どこまで上っていくのだろうか。ヘリウムを詰めたゴム風船は、上空に行くほど周りの気圧が下がるため、少しずつ膨らんでいく。やがてゴムが伸びきると、高度数千メートルから一万メートルほどで破裂するという。残ったゴムの破片が海に落ちることもあり、イベントでの大量の風船飛ばしを見直す動きも出ている。
cards.en: How far does a balloon that slips from a child's hand rise? A helium-filled rubber balloon gradually expands as it climbs, because the surrounding air pressure drops the higher it goes. Eventually, when the rubber is stretched to its limit, it is said to burst at an altitude of somewhere between several thousand and ten thousand meters. Leftover fragments of rubber sometimes fall into the sea, and there is a growing movement to rethink mass balloon releases at events.

Having aimed for this stage for four years, they could not hold back tears at the press conference announcing their withdrawal. Even so, the athlete said the injury was no one's fault and immediately began rehabilitation. Many fans were encouraged by the sight of someone trying to turn their mind to the next goal rather than lament their bad luck.

words.defJa: 決まった順序やリズムがなく、ばらばらであるようす。

cards.ja: 夜勤のある仕事を続けていると、どうしても食事や睡眠の時間が不規則になりやすい。体内時計が乱れると、眠りが浅くなるだけでなく、血圧や血糖値にも影響が出ることが分かってきた。研究チームは、勤務の日でも起床後に強い光を浴び、食事の時間をなるべくそろえることを勧めている。小さな習慣の積み重ねが、乱れたリズムを整える助けになるという。
cards.en: If you keep working a job with night shifts, your mealtimes and sleep inevitably tend to become irregular. It has become clear that when the body clock is disrupted, not only does sleep become shallow, but blood pressure and blood sugar levels are affected as well. A research team recommends getting bright light after waking even on workdays and keeping mealtimes as consistent as possible. An accumulation of small habits, they say, can help restore a disrupted rhythm.

words.defJa: 主となるものを補佐する、次の位の立場を表す。また、主なものに付随する二次的なものを表す。

cards.ja: 創業者の引退に伴い、長年その右腕を務めてきた副社長が、来月から社長に就任することになった。副社長は営業部門の出身で、海外市場の開拓を担ってきた人物だ。社内では、創業者の理念を守りつつ、新しい事業にも果敢に挑む姿勢が評価されている。会見では、まず社員の声に耳を傾けることから始めたいと語った。
cards.en: With the founder's retirement, the vice president, who has long served as the founder's right hand, will become president starting next month. The vice president comes from the sales division and has been in charge of opening up overseas markets. Within the company, they are valued for their readiness to boldly take on new businesses while upholding the founder's philosophy. At the press conference, they said they want to begin by listening to the voices of employees.

words.defJa: 文書や絵などを、元と同じように写し取ること。

cards.ja: 本の最後のページには、無断での複写や複製を禁じるという一文がよく添えられている。著作権法では、個人で使う範囲の複写は認められているが、それを大量に配ったりネットに載せたりすることは許されていない。大学の授業でも、教材を何十部もコピーして配る場合には、権利者の許諾が必要になることがある。コンビニでも手軽に複写ができる時代だからこそ、ルールを知っておきたい。
cards.en: On the last page of a book, you will often find a line prohibiting unauthorized copying or reproduction. Under copyright law, copying for personal use is permitted, but handing out copies in large numbers or posting them online is not. Even in university classes, photocopying dozens of sets of teaching materials to hand out can require permission from the rights holder. Precisely because we live in an age when you can easily make copies even at a convenience store, it is worth knowing the rules.

words.defJa: 数が二つ以上であること。

cards.ja: 最近の生成AIは、一つの質問に対して複数の答えの候補を作り、その中から最もふさわしいものを選んで示すことがある。人間の目には一つの返答しか見えないが、裏側では何通りもの文章が比べられているのだ。研究者によれば、こうした仕組みが回答の正確さを高める一方、計算に使う電力も増やしているという。便利さの裏にある負担にも目を向ける必要がある。
cards.en: Today's generative AI sometimes produces multiple candidate answers to a single question, then selects and presents the most suitable one. To human eyes only one reply is visible, but behind the scenes many versions of the text are being compared. According to researchers, this mechanism improves the accuracy of answers while also increasing the electricity used for computation. We also need to look at the burden hidden behind the convenience.

words.defJa: 中に空気などを入れて大きくする。また、期待や想像を大きく広げる。

cards.ja: 夏の海水浴場では、砂浜で浮き輪を膨らます親子の姿があちこちで見られる。ただ、海上保安庁によれば、浮き輪はあくまで遊び道具であり、溺れるのを防ぐ救命具ではないという。波や強い流れにさらわれ、浮き輪ごと沖へ流される事故も毎年のように起きている。子どもにはライフジャケットを着せたうえで、大人が必ずそばで見守ることが大切だ。
cards.en: At summer beaches, you see parents and children inflating swim rings on the sand everywhere. According to the Japan Coast Guard, however, a swim ring is only a toy, not a life-saving device that keeps you from drowning. Every year there are accidents in which people are swept away by waves or strong currents and carried out to sea, swim ring and all. It is important to put a life jacket on children and for an adult always to keep watch close by.

The city plans to revise part of the design to hold down costs, but completion is expected to be delayed by about a year. Some residents are asking whether the estimates at the planning stage were too optimistic.

cards.ja: 十九世紀半ばのヨーロッパの病院では、出産後に高い熱を出して亡くなる母親が後を絶たなかった。ある医師は、医者が解剖を終えた不潔な手のまま診察していることに原因があると考え、手洗いを徹底させた。すると死亡率は劇的に下がったが、当時の医学界は彼の主張をなかなか受け入れなかった。今では当たり前の手洗いも、こうした苦い歴史の上に成り立っている。
cards.en: In European hospitals in the mid-nineteenth century, there was no end to mothers who developed high fevers after childbirth and died. One doctor concluded that the cause lay in physicians examining patients with hands still unclean from performing autopsies, and he made thorough handwashing mandatory. The death rate then fell dramatically, but the medical establishment of the day was slow to accept his claims. Handwashing, taken for granted today, rests on this bitter history.

words.meaning: (of night) to grow late, to wear on; (of a season) to advance
words.defJa: 夜になってから時間がたち、だんだん遅くなる。季節が深まる。

cards.ja: 夜が更けるにつれて、山小屋の窓をたたく風の音はいっそう強くなった。登山客たちはストーブを囲み、明日の天気について小声で話し合っている。管理人によれば、この時期は天候が急に変わることが多く、無理をせず引き返す判断が何より大切だという。やがて一人、また一人と寝袋に入り、小屋は静けさに包まれた。
cards.en: As the night wore on, the sound of the wind beating against the mountain hut's windows grew even stronger. The climbers gathered around the stove, talking quietly about tomorrow's weather. According to the hut keeper, the weather often changes suddenly at this time of year, and the most important thing is the judgment to turn back rather than push on. Eventually, one by one, they crawled into their sleeping bags, and the hut was wrapped in silence.

words.meaning: to be blocked, to be closed up; to be occupied
words.defJa: 穴や通り道がつまって、通れなくなる。

cards.ja: 大雨による土砂崩れで、山あいの集落へ続く唯一の道路が塞がった。孤立した住民は約五十人で、自衛隊がヘリコプターで食料や水を運んでいる。県によると、崩れた土砂の量が多く、道路の復旧には少なくとも一週間かかる見込みだという。住民の多くは高齢者で、持病の薬が足りなくなることを心配する声も出ている。
cards.en: A landslide caused by heavy rain blocked the only road leading to a village in the mountains. About fifty residents have been cut off, and the Self-Defense Forces are delivering food and water by helicopter. According to the prefecture, the volume of collapsed earth is large, and restoring the road is expected to take at least a week. Many of the residents are elderly, and some are worried about running out of medicine for chronic conditions.

cards.ja: 駅前の歩道では、放置された自転車が点字ブロックを塞いでいることが少なくない。目の不自由な人にとって、足元の黄色い線は安全に歩くための大切な道しるべだ。市は撤去の回数を増やしているが、根本的な解決には駐輪場の整備と利用者の意識の変化が欠かせない。何気なく止めた一台が、誰かの行く手を阻んでいるかもしれないのだ。

For visually impaired people, the yellow lines underfoot are an important guide for walking safely. The city has stepped up how often it removes bicycles, but a fundamental solution requires more bicycle parking and a change in users' awareness. A bicycle left there without a second thought may be blocking someone's path.

cards.en: At the end of each year, I make a point of writing letters to acquaintances I haven't seen for a while. Looking back on a year in which I neglected to contact people, using busyness as an excuse, I feel a little apologetic. Still, each time a reply arrives, I am relieved to find that the connection, however thin, had not been broken.

words.meaning: samurai, warrior (member of the warrior class)
words.defJa: 昔の日本で、刀を持ち、戦いを仕事とした身分の人。

cards.ja: 江戸時代の武士は、刀を差して町を歩く勇ましい姿で描かれることが多い。しかし、長い平和が続いた時代には、実際に戦場に立つ機会はほとんどなかった。多くの武士は藩の役所に勤め、帳簿をつけたり年貢を管理したりする、いわば役人として働いていたのである。給料は米で支払われたため、米の値段が下がると暮らしが苦しくなる者も少なくなかった。
cards.en: Samurai of the Edo period are often portrayed as gallant figures walking through town with swords at their sides. In an era of long-lasting peace, however, they had almost no chance to actually stand on a battlefield. Many samurai worked in their domain's offices, keeping account books and managing rice taxes; they were, so to speak, bureaucrats. Because they were paid in rice, quite a few fell on hard times whenever the price of rice dropped.

cards.ja: 漢字辞典で読み方の分からない字を調べるとき、頼りになるのが部首だ。たとえば、さんずいの付く字には海や池、泳など、水に関係するものが多い。部首を手がかりにすれば、初めて見る漢字でも意味のおおよその見当がつくことがある。スマートフォンで手書き入力ができる時代になっても、漢字の成り立ちを知る面白さは変わらない。
cards.en: When you look up a character whose reading you don't know in a kanji dictionary, the radical is what you rely on. For example, many characters with the water radical, such as those for 'sea', 'pond' and 'swim', have to do with water. Using the radical as a clue, you can sometimes get a rough idea of a kanji's meaning even the first time you see it. Even in an age when you can write characters by hand into a smartphone, the pleasure of learning how kanji are built has not changed.

cards.ja: 京都のある寺では、江戸時代に描かれた襖絵が十年ぶりに一般公開されている。部屋を仕切る襖の一枚一枚に季節の草花や鳥が連なるように描かれ、座敷全体が一つの風景になる仕掛けだ。障子越しの柔らかな光の中で見ると、金箔の背景が時間とともに表情を変える。美術館のガラスケース越しでは味わえない体験だろう。
cards.en: At a temple in Kyoto, paintings on sliding doors made in the Edo period are on public view for the first time in ten years. Seasonal flowers, plants and birds are painted so that they flow across each of the sliding panels dividing the rooms, an arrangement that turns the whole tatami room into a single landscape. Seen in the soft light coming through the paper screens, the gold-leaf background changes its expression as time passes. It is an experience you could never have through a museum's glass case.

words.meaning: attached, affiliated (esp. a school or hospital attached to a university)
words.defJa: 大きな組織や施設にくっついて、その一部となっていること。

cards.ja: 国立大学の附属学校は、もともと教員を目指す学生の教育実習の場として作られたものだ。新しい授業の方法を試し、その成果を全国の学校に広める役割も担っている。近年は少子化を受けて、附属学校のあり方を見直す議論が各地で進んでいる。受験の人気校という側面ばかりが注目されがちだが、本来の使命に立ち返ろうという声も上がっている。
cards.en: The schools attached to national universities were originally created as places where students aiming to become teachers could do their teaching practice. They also play a role in trying out new teaching methods and spreading the results to schools across the country. In recent years, with the falling birthrate, debate over what these attached schools should be has been moving forward in many regions. Attention tends to focus only on their status as popular schools to get into, but voices are also calling for a return to their original mission.

cards.ja: 新しいスマートフォンの箱を開けると、中に入っていた付属品は充電用のケーブル一本だけだった。電子ごみを減らすため、充電器やイヤホンを箱に入れないメーカーが増えているのだ。すでに手元にある機器を使い回せば無駄は減るが、規格が合わず結局買い足す人もいる。環境への配慮と使い勝手のバランスをどう取るかが問われている。
cards.en: When I opened the box of my new smartphone, the only accessory inside was a single charging cable. More and more manufacturers are leaving chargers and earphones out of the box in order to reduce electronic waste. Reusing devices you already have does cut down on waste, but some people end up buying extras anyway because the standards don't match. The question is how to strike a balance between environmental concern and convenience.

cards.ja: 日本各地のマンホールの蓋には、その土地の名物や景色を描いたデザインが多い。城や祭り、特産の果物などが色鮮やかに描かれ、旅先で足元を見ながら歩くのを楽しみにする人もいる。こうした蓋をかたどったカードを配る自治体も増え、集めるために遠くから訪れるファンもいるという。普段は気にも留めない道路の一部が、町の魅力を伝える小さな看板になっているのだ。
cards.en: Many manhole covers across Japan bear designs depicting local specialties and scenery. Castles, festivals and locally grown fruit are painted in vivid colors, and some travelers look forward to walking with their eyes on the ground. A growing number of local governments hand out cards modeled on these covers, and some fans reportedly come from far away to collect them. A part of the road we normally pay no attention to has become a small signboard advertising a town's charm.

words.meaning: unsafe, dangerous (of the times or a neighborhood); alarming
words.defJa: 何が起こるか分からず、安心できないようす。

cards.ja: このところ近所で空き巣の被害が相次ぎ、どうにも物騒な世の中になったと感じる。警察によると、犯人は住人が留守にする昼間を狙い、鍵のかかっていない窓から侵入するケースが多いという。町内会では見回りの回数を増やし、防犯カメラの設置も検討している。ちょっとした外出でも、戸締まりを確かめる習慣をつけたい。
cards.en: Lately there has been a string of burglaries in my neighborhood, and I can't help feeling that the world has become an unsafe place. According to the police, the burglars often target the daytime when residents are out and get in through unlocked windows. The neighborhood association has increased its patrols and is also considering installing security cameras. Even when stepping out briefly, I want to make a habit of checking that the house is locked.

words.defJa: 船で荷物や郵便物を運ぶこと。また、その手段。

cards.ja: 海外に暮らす息子へ冬物の服や本を送ろうと郵便局へ行くと、航空便と船便のどちらにするかと尋ねられた。航空便なら一週間ほどで届くが、料金は船便の三倍近い。急ぐ荷物ではないので船便を選んだところ、到着まで二か月はかかると言われた。のんびりと海を渡る小包を思い浮かべると、待つ時間も悪くないように思えた。
cards.en: When I went to the post office to send winter clothes and books to my son, who lives abroad, I was asked whether I wanted airmail or sea mail. Airmail would arrive in about a week, but it costs nearly three times as much as sea mail. Since the package wasn't urgent, I chose sea mail and was told it would take a good two months to arrive. When I pictured the parcel leisurely crossing the ocean, the wait didn't seem so bad.

words.defJa: 強い風とともに、雪が激しく降ること。

cards.ja: 冬の北海道では、強い季節風が吹くと数メートル先も見えないほどの吹雪になることがある。視界が真っ白になるホワイトアウトの中では、車の運転はもちろん、歩いて帰宅することさえ危険だ。気象台は、大雪や暴風雪の警報が出たときには不要な外出を控えるよう呼びかけている。車で出かける場合も、毛布や食料を積んでおくと安心だという。
cards.en: In Hokkaido in winter, when strong seasonal winds blow, a blizzard can make it impossible to see even a few meters ahead. In a whiteout, where everything you see turns pure white, not only driving but even walking home is dangerous. The local meteorological observatory urges people to avoid unnecessary outings when warnings for heavy snow or snowstorms are issued. If you do go out by car, it is reassuring to keep blankets and food on board.

cards.en: Many schools and nursery schools used to have an organization called the 'father-and-mother association'. However, because many children are raised by their grandparents and single-parent households are not uncommon, more and more of them have recently renamed it the 'guardians' association'. Words that assume both a father and a mother are present can unknowingly hurt someone. Even a single name reflects how society is changing.

cards.en: In urban residential neighborhoods, there are still so-called 'never-opening crossings', where during the morning and evening rush hours the barriers stay down for more than forty minutes of every hour. Some pedestrians, unable to wait, duck under the barriers, and the risk that this will lead to serious accidents has long been pointed out. The national government and railway companies are carrying out work to raise tracks onto viaducts or move them underground, but it takes huge sums of money and many years.

words.defJa: 漢字の読み方を示すために、そばに小さく書く文字。

cards.ja: 外国人住民の増加を受けて、漢字にふりがなを付けたお知らせを配る自治体が増えている。難しい言葉を短い文に言い換える、やさしい日本語の取り組みも広がってきた。漢字が読めなくても、ふりがながあれば辞書で調べることができ、意味をつかむ手がかりになる。実は、漢字が苦手な子どもや高齢者にとっても読みやすいと好評だという。
cards.en: With the growing number of foreign residents, more local governments are handing out notices with furigana added to the kanji. Efforts at 'easy Japanese', which rephrases difficult words in short sentences, have also spread. Even if you can't read the kanji, furigana lets you look words up in a dictionary and gives you a foothold for grasping the meaning. In fact, such notices are said to be popular with children and older people who struggle with kanji too, because they are easier to read.

words.meaning: to turn around (to look), to look back over one's shoulder
words.defJa: 顔や体を後ろのほうへ向ける。

cards.ja: 人混みの中で自分の名前が聞こえると、思わず振り向いてしまうことがある。周りが騒がしくても、脳は自分に関係のある情報だけを拾い上げているのだ。心理学ではこれをカクテルパーティー効果と呼ぶ。私たちは意識していない間も、膨大な音の中から必要なものを選び続けているのである。
cards.en: When you hear your own name in a crowd, you sometimes turn around without meaning to. Even when your surroundings are noisy, your brain is picking out only the information that concerns you. In psychology this is called the cocktail party effect. Even when we are not aware of it, we keep selecting what we need from a vast flood of sounds.

The spread of flea-market apps is also giving this trend a push.

cards.en: A furoshiki is a traditional Japanese tool for wrapping and carrying things in a single square of cloth. Whether it's a box or a bottle, if you change the way you tie it to suit the shape, you can wrap almost anything. In recent years, prompted by the introduction of charges for plastic shopping bags, it has been reappraised as a reusable eco-bag. The fact that it can be folded small and kept in a bag when not in use is probably another reason for its enduring popularity.

Experts are urging caution, saying that an even larger eruption may occur.

cards.en: In the past few years, more and more people have been taking apart broken home appliances and fixing them themselves. If you remove the screws one by one and photograph the arrangement of the parts, you won't get lost when putting everything back together. Be careful, though: if you take a device apart during the manufacturer's warranty period, you may lose the warranty. Recently, calls for designs that are easy to repair have also been growing among consumers.

cards.ja: 駅前の広場には大きな噴水があり、夏になると子どもたちの格好の遊び場になる。水は一定の間隔で高く吹き上がり、夜には色とりどりの照明で照らされる。待ち合わせの目印としても便利で、「噴水の前で」と言えば地元の人なら誰でも分かる。改修工事のためしばらく止まっていたが、今月から再び水を噴き上げている。
cards.en: The square in front of the station has a large fountain, which becomes a perfect playground for children in summer. The water shoots high into the air at regular intervals, and at night it is lit up with colorful lights. It is also handy as a meeting landmark; if you say 'in front of the fountain,' any local will know where you mean. It had been shut off for a while for renovation work, but since this month it has been sending up water again.

words.defJa: ある数を別の数で割った形を、横線の上下に二つの数を書いて表したもの。

cards.ja: 小学校の算数でつまずきやすい単元の一つが分数だ。整数と違って、全体をいくつかに分けたうちのいくつ分かという関係を表すため、計算の手順だけを覚えても意味がつかめない子どもが多い。ある教員は、ピザやケーキを切り分ける絵を使って、分母と分子の関係を説明している。身近な場面と結びつけることで、苦手意識が和らぐのだという。
cards.en: One of the units in elementary school arithmetic where children most easily stumble is fractions. Unlike whole numbers, fractions express a relationship, how many parts out of a whole divided into equal parts, so many children cannot grasp what they mean even if they memorize the steps of the calculation. One teacher explains the relationship between the denominator and the numerator with pictures of a pizza or a cake being cut into portions. Linking fractions to familiar situations, the teacher says, eases children's feeling that they are bad at them.

words.defJa: 物の多さや重さ、かさの程度。どれくらいあるかという量。

cards.ja: 料理の上手な人ほど、調味料の分量を正確に量っていると言われる。目分量で作ると、その日によって味が濃くなったり薄くなったりしやすいからだ。特にお菓子作りでは、砂糖や粉の分量がわずかに違うだけで、仕上がりが大きく変わってしまう。慣れないうちは、レシピどおりに計量スプーンを使うのがいちばんの近道である。
cards.en: It is said that the better someone is at cooking, the more precisely they measure out the amounts of seasoning. That's because if you cook by eye, the flavor tends to come out stronger or weaker depending on the day. In baking sweets especially, even a slight difference in the amount of sugar or flour can drastically change the result. Until you get used to it, using measuring spoons exactly as the recipe says is the quickest route to success.

Meanwhile, the ruling parties intend to pass the remaining bills in an extraordinary session expected in the autumn.

words.defJa: 土曜日、日曜日、祝日以外の普通の日。

cards.ja: 人気の観光地を訪れるなら、平日を選ぶのが賢い。土日には駐車場に入るだけで一時間以上待つこともあるが、平日の午前中ならたいていゆっくり見て回れる。宿泊料金も、週末より二、三割安く設定されていることが多い。休みを取りやすい働き方が広がり、平日に旅行する人は年々増えている。
cards.en: If you are visiting a popular tourist spot, it's wise to choose a weekday. On weekends you can wait more than an hour just to get into the parking lot, but on a weekday morning you can usually look around at a leisurely pace. Accommodation rates are also often set 20 to 30 percent lower than on weekends. As working styles that make it easier to take time off spread, the number of people traveling on weekdays is rising year by year.

words.defJa: 軍隊に入って戦う人。また、その人たちの集まり。

cards.ja: 祖父は二十歳のとき兵隊として戦地に送られたが、その頃の話をほとんどしなかった。亡くなった後、押し入れの奥から当時の日記と古い写真が見つかった。そこには、故郷の家族を思う言葉や、飢えと病気に苦しむ仲間の様子が細かく書き残されていた。戦争を直接知る世代が減るなか、こうした記録を残す取り組みが各地で進んでいる。
cards.en: My grandfather was sent to the front as a soldier at the age of twenty, but he hardly ever talked about that time. After he died, his diary from those days and some old photographs were found at the back of a closet. In them he had left detailed accounts of his thoughts of his family back home and of comrades suffering from hunger and disease. As the generation with direct knowledge of the war dwindles, efforts to preserve records like these are under way in many places.

words.defJa: 山などがなく、広く平らに続いている土地。

cards.ja: 日本は国土のおよそ四分の三を山地が占め、平野は限られている。それでも、大きな川が運んだ土砂でできた平野には古くから人が集まり、田畑や町が広がってきた。現在も、人口の多くはこうした平らな土地に集中している。その一方で、川に近い低い土地は、大雨による洪水の危険と常に隣り合わせだ。
cards.en: Mountains occupy about three-quarters of Japan's land area, so plains are limited. Even so, people have gathered since ancient times on the plains formed by sediment carried by large rivers, and fields and towns have spread across them. Today, too, much of the population is concentrated on this kind of flat land. On the other hand, low-lying land near rivers always lives with the risk of flooding from heavy rain.

cards.ja: 駐車場で車に戻ると、運転席のドアが小さくへこんでいた。誰かが隣の車のドアを勢いよく開けてぶつけたらしいが、メモも何も残されていなかった。修理工場に持ち込むと、塗装に傷がなければ専用の工具で裏から押し戻せると言われた。費用は思ったより安く済んだものの、しばらくは気分が晴れなかった。
cards.en: When I got back to my car in the parking lot, the driver's door had a small dent in it. Apparently someone had flung open the door of the car next to mine and hit it, but they hadn't left a note or anything. When I took it to a repair shop, I was told that if the paint wasn't scratched, the dent could be pushed back out from behind with a special tool. The repair cost less than I had feared, but for a while I couldn't shake my bad mood.

cards.ja: 共働きの夫婦の間で、家計を別々に管理するスタイルが広がっている。家賃や食費などの共通の出費だけを決まった割合で出し合い、残りはそれぞれが自由に使うという方法だ。お互いの金銭感覚に口を出さずに済むため、けんかが減ったという声も多い。一方で、将来に向けた貯金が二人でどれだけあるのか把握しにくいという課題もある。
cards.en: Among dual-income couples, the style of managing household finances separately is spreading. In this method, each partner contributes a fixed share only toward common expenses such as rent and food, and each is free to spend the rest. Because they don't have to interfere with each other's attitudes toward money, many say they argue less. On the other hand, there is also the drawback that it becomes hard to grasp how much the two of them have saved together for the future.

cards.en: In old Japanese houses, the toilet was often built in a spot separate from the main building. This was to avoid problems of odor and hygiene, and to relieve yourself in the middle of the night you had to pass through a dark corridor or the garden. Today the usual word is the loanword toire, and the word benjo can sound a little old-fashioned or even crude. Even so, expressions such as 'public lavatory' and 'toilet cleaning' built on benjo are still commonly used.

cards.en: Many recent smartphones are built to be waterproof and won't easily break even if you use them in the rain. However, they are not completely impervious to water, and there are several grades of performance. If you are going to use one in the bath or at the beach, you should check the conditions written in the manual. Also, if the body cracks because it was dropped or the like, its water resistance drops sharply.

cards.ja: 宇宙に浮かぶ大型の望遠鏡が、百三十億年以上前の銀河の姿をとらえた。地上の望遠鏡では大気が光をゆがめてしまうが、宇宙ならその影響を受けずに済む。研究チームによると、この銀河は予想よりもはるかに早い時期に形づくられていたという。初期の宇宙で銀河がどのように生まれたのかについての定説が、今後見直される可能性もある。
cards.en: A large telescope floating in space has captured an image of a galaxy as it was more than 13 billion years ago. With telescopes on the ground, the atmosphere distorts the light, but in space there is no such effect. According to the research team, this galaxy took shape far earlier than expected. The established view of how galaxies were born in the early universe may come to be revised.

cards.ja: 山で道に迷ったとき、まず大切なのは方角を正しくつかむことだ。スマートフォンの地図は便利だが、電波が届かなかったり電池が切れたりすれば役に立たないこともある。晴れていれば、太陽の位置からおおよその東西南北を知ることができる。経験豊かな登山者ほど、紙の地図と方位磁石を必ず持ち歩いているという。
cards.en: When you get lost in the mountains, the first important thing is to get your bearings right. Smartphone maps are convenient, but they may be unusable if there is no signal or the battery dies. If it is sunny, you can tell roughly where north, south, east and west lie from the position of the sun. It is said that the more experienced the climber, the more certain they are to carry a paper map and a compass.

words.defJa: 床や地面のごみやほこりを掃いて集めるための道具。

cards.ja: 日本の多くの学校では、授業の後に子どもたちが自分で教室を掃除する。机を後ろに寄せ、ほうきで床を掃いてから、ぞうきんで丁寧に拭き上げるのが一般的だ。海外から視察に来た教育関係者は、この光景に驚くことが多い。掃除を通して、物を大切にする心や協力する姿勢が育つと考えられている。
cards.en: In many Japanese schools, the children clean their own classrooms after lessons. Typically they push the desks to the back, sweep the floor with brooms, and then carefully wipe it down with rags. Educators who come from overseas to observe are often surprised by this sight. Through cleaning, it is believed, children develop respect for things and a cooperative attitude.

cards.en: It was once thought that dialects would disappear as television and radio spread. In recent years, however, a movement to reappraise local speech has been spreading among the younger generation. Online, posts written in dialect are well received as approachable, and products themed on regional speech are also gaining popularity. Perhaps the warmth and fine nuances missing from standard Japanese are drawing attention anew.

cards.ja: 近所の寺のお坊さんが、月に一度、本堂で悩み相談の会を開いている。仕事や家族のことなど、参加者が打ち明ける話に、お坊さんは静かに耳を傾ける。説教をされるのではなく、ただ話を聞いてもらえることが心の支えになるのだという。寺を支える家が減って運営が難しくなるなか、地域とのつながりを取り戻そうとする試みの一つだ。

He listens quietly as participants open up about their work, their families and so on. Rather than being preached at, simply having someone listen is said to be a source of emotional support. With fewer families supporting the temple and running it becoming harder, it is one attempt to restore ties with the local community.

cards.en: An apple falling from a tree and the moon continuing to circle the earth both obey the same law. Physics can be described as the discipline that uncovers the common rules behind phenomena that at first glance seem unrelated. The wider the range a single law can explain, the more powerful the theory is considered to be. However, every law has a range within which it holds, and beyond that range a new theory becomes necessary.

cards.ja: 転んで膝をすりむいたときは、まず傷口を水道水でよく洗い流すことが大切だ。汚れが残ったまま包帯を巻くと、そこから細菌が入って傷が悪化するおそれがある。最近は、傷を乾かさずに治す専用の絆創膏も広く売られている。ただし、出血が止まらない場合や傷が深い場合は、自分の手当てだけで済ませずに病院へ行くべきだ。
cards.en: When you fall and scrape your knee, the first important step is to rinse the wound thoroughly with tap water. If you wrap a bandage around it with dirt still in it, bacteria can get in and make the wound worse. These days, special adhesive dressings that heal wounds without letting them dry out are also widely sold. However, if the bleeding won't stop or the wound is deep, you should go to a hospital rather than relying on self-care alone.

That's because even ripe tomatoes slice cleanly without getting crushed, and chopping onions is less likely to sting your eyes. cards.ja: 中学校で方程式を習ったとき、何の役に立つのか分からなかったという人は多い。しかし、分からない数を文字で表し、条件から式を立てて答えを導く考え方は、日常のさまざまな場面に通じている。旅行の予算を組むときも、仕事の段取りを考えるときも、私たちは知らず知らずのうちに同じような推論をしている。数学の授業で身につくのは、計算の技術だけではないのだ。

Whether drawing up a travel budget or planning the steps of a job, we carry out similar reasoning without realizing it. What you gain in math class is not just skill at calculation.

According to the railway company, service will resume in stages as soon as snow has been cleared from the tracks. However, the snow may intensify again toward evening, and there is no telling when full service will resume.

words.defJa: 小さな男の子を、親しみをこめて呼ぶ言葉。

cards.ja: 公園のベンチで本を読んでいると、三歳くらいの坊やが転がってきたボールを追いかけて駆け寄ってきた。拾って渡してやると、坊やは照れたように小さく頭を下げ、母親のもとへ走って戻っていった。その後ろ姿を見送りながら、息子が同じ年頃だった日々を思い出した。子どもの成長は、過ぎてしまえば本当にあっという間だ。

When I picked it up and handed it to him, he gave a shy little bow and ran back to his mother. Watching him go, I remembered the days when my own son was the same age. Once it has passed, a child's growing up really goes by in the blink of an eye.

words.meaning: to leave alone, to neglect (with -te oku); to throw, to toss
words.defJa: 気にかけずに、そのままにしておく。また、軽く投げる。

cards.ja: 肩や腰の小さな痛みを、忙しさを理由に放っておく人は多い。だが専門医によると、軽い痛みのうちに原因を確かめておけば、治療は短期間で済むことがほとんどだという。逆に、数か月も我慢を続けた結果、手術が必要になるケースも少なくない。体が出す小さな合図に耳を傾けることが、結局は健康へのいちばんの近道なのである。
cards.en: Many people leave small pains in their shoulders or lower back alone, citing how busy they are. According to specialists, however, if you check the cause while the pain is still mild, treatment is usually over quickly. Conversely, there are quite a few cases where putting up with it for months ends in the need for surgery. Listening to the small signals your body sends is, in the end, the surest shortcut to good health.

words.defJa: 牛や馬、羊などを放し飼いにして育てる広い土地。

cards.ja: 北海道のある牧場では、牛たちが春から秋まで広い草地で放牧されている。自由に歩き回り、新鮮な草を食べて育った牛の乳は、季節によって風味が少しずつ変わるという。最近は、搾りたての牛乳で作ったアイスクリームを目当てに、都市部から訪れる観光客も増えている。ただ、道内には餌代の高騰や後継者不足に悩む牧場も多く、決して楽な時代ではない。
cards.en: On one ranch in Hokkaido, cattle graze freely on wide pastures from spring to autumn. The milk of cows raised roaming freely and eating fresh grass is said to change subtly in flavor with the seasons. Recently, more tourists have been coming from the cities for ice cream made with freshly drawn milk. Still, many ranches in Hokkaido are struggling with soaring feed costs and a lack of successors, and these are by no means easy times.

cards.en: Humans are thought to have begun raising livestock about ten thousand years ago in West Asia. By domesticating goats and sheep, people became able to obtain meat, milk and wool reliably. A way of life that moved together with the herds eventually gave rise to distinctive cultures on the grasslands. Alongside farming, stock raising was a great invention that laid the foundation of civilization.

words.defJa: 体の健康を守り、病気を防ぐこと。

cards.ja: 夏場になると、各地の保健所には食中毒に関する相談が相次ぐ。保健所は飲食店への立ち入り検査を行い、原因となった食品や調理の手順を細かく調べる。最近は家庭でのバーベキューによる被害も目立つため、肉は中心までしっかり焼くよう呼びかけている。地域の健康を守る仕事は、目立たないが欠かせないものだ。
cards.en: Every summer, public health centers across the country receive a stream of inquiries about food poisoning. The centers carry out on-site inspections of restaurants and closely examine the food responsible and how it was prepared. Because cases from home barbecues have also become conspicuous recently, they are urging people to cook meat thoroughly all the way through. The work of protecting a community's health is unglamorous but indispensable.

words.meaning: to dry (in the sun or air), to air out
words.defJa: 日光や風に当てて、ぬれたものや湿ったものをかわかす。

cards.en: When the rainy season ended, the first thing my mother did was hang all the futons in the house out on the balcony. Soaked in strong sunlight, the futons were plump by evening, and when I buried my face in them they smelled of the sun. These days more households worry about pollen and yellow dust and use a dryer instead of drying things outside. Even so, that warm feel is something a machine can hardly reproduce.

words.defJa: 地球の軸の北のはし。また、そのまわりの寒い地域。

cards.ja: 北極の海氷は、この四十年ほどで夏の面積が大きく減った。氷が解けると、太陽の光を反射していた白い面が暗い海面に変わり、熱をより多く吸収するようになる。その結果、温暖化がさらに進むという悪循環が生まれている。研究者の中には、今世紀半ばには夏の北極から氷がほぼ消えると予測する人もいる。
cards.en: Over the past forty years or so, the summer extent of Arctic sea ice has shrunk dramatically. When the ice melts, white surfaces that once reflected sunlight turn into dark sea, which absorbs more heat. As a result, a vicious cycle arises in which warming accelerates further. Some researchers predict that by the middle of this century the Arctic will be almost ice-free in summer.

words.meaning: (someone else's) son, young master; sheltered, naive young man
words.defJa: 他人の男の子をていねいに呼ぶ言葉。また、苦労を知らずに育った男性。

cards.ja: 取引先の社長の家を訪ねると、玄関で小学生くらいの男の子が出迎えてくれた。「坊っちゃん、大きくなりましたね」と同行した部長が声をかけると、少年は恥ずかしそうに父親の後ろに隠れた。他人の息子をこう呼ぶのは丁寧だが、やや古風な言い方である。一方で、苦労知らずの若者を皮肉って「お坊っちゃん育ち」と言うこともある。
cards.en: When we visited the home of a client company's president, a boy of about elementary-school age greeted us at the door. When the department head accompanying me said, 'My, how you've grown, young man,' the boy hid shyly behind his father. Calling someone else's son this way is polite, but it is a somewhat old-fashioned expression. On the other hand, people also sarcastically describe a young man who has never known hardship as having had a 'pampered rich-boy upbringing.'

words.defJa: 土や岩に穴をあけたり、地面の下のものを取り出したりする。

cards.ja: 住宅の建設予定地で地面を掘ったところ、古墳時代の土器がまとまって見つかった。市の教育委員会の求めで工事は一時中断され、専門家による発掘調査が始まっている。委員会は出土品の年代を詳しく調べ、当時の暮らしぶりの解明につなげたい考えだ。何気ない土地の下にも、長い歴史が眠っているのである。
cards.en: When the ground was dug up at a planned housing construction site, a cluster of earthenware from the Kofun period was found. At the city board of education's request, construction has been temporarily halted and an excavation survey by specialists has begun. The board intends to date the finds in detail and use them to shed light on how people lived at the time. Even beneath an ordinary plot of land, a long history lies sleeping.

words.defJa: 刃物などで木や石などをけずって、形や文字、模様を作る。

cards.ja: 仏師の工房では、一本の木から仏像を彫る作業が何か月も続く。職人はまず大まかな形を削り出し、それから細い刃物で表情や衣のひだを少しずつ刻んでいく。わずかな角度の違いで、仏の顔は穏やかにも厳しくも見えるという。木目を読み、素材と対話するように手を動かすことが、何より大切なのだ。
cards.en: In a Buddhist sculptor's workshop, the work of carving a statue from a single block of wood continues for months. The craftsman first roughs out the overall shape, then little by little cuts in the facial expression and the folds of the robes with fine blades. A tiny difference in angle, it is said, can make the Buddha's face look either serene or stern. Above all, what matters is reading the grain and moving one's hands as if in dialogue with the material.

words.meaning: Obon, the summer festival of the dead; tray
words.defJa: 夏に先祖の霊を迎えてまつる行事。また、物をのせて運ぶ平たい道具。

cards.en: When the Obon season comes, expressways are clogged with long traffic jams of cars heading from the cities to people's hometowns. Many families hang lanterns to welcome the spirits of their ancestors, visit the family grave, and then gather around the table together. Going home is also a precious chance for relatives who live apart to all get together. Recently, more people have been avoiding the crowds by traveling home at a different time.

words.defJa: まわりを山にかこまれた、低くて平らな土地。

cards.ja: 周囲を山に囲まれた盆地では、夏は猛烈に暑く、冬は厳しく冷え込む。昼間に温められた空気が逃げにくく、夜には冷たい空気が底にたまるためだ。また、昼と夜の気温差が大きいことは果物の糖度を高めるとされ、各地の盆地はぶどうや桃の産地として知られている。厳しい気候が、思わぬ恵みをもたらしているのである。
cards.en: In basins surrounded by mountains, summers are fiercely hot and winters bitterly cold. That is because air warmed during the day has trouble escaping, while at night cold air pools at the bottom. The wide gap between day and night temperatures is also said to raise the sugar content of fruit, and basins in various regions are known as producers of grapes and peaches. A harsh climate, in other words, brings unexpected blessings.

cards.en: With a typhoon approaching, the prefecture set up a disaster response headquarters in the morning. cards.en: Buddhism teaches that the human mind is by nature pure and still. Anger and desire are like clouds drifting across the sky; they do not stain the mind itself. That is why, it is said, when the clouds clear through zazen or meditation, the original clear state appears of its own accord. Practice is not about gaining something new, but about noticing what is already there.

Even so, many viewers still feel Sunday night is a special time.

words.meaning: the very first, the very beginning; the forefront
words.defJa: いちばん初め。いちばん前。

cards.ja: 地震が起きたとき、真っ先に何をすべきか即答できる人は意外に少ない。専門家は、まず机の下などに身を隠し、揺れが収まるまで頭を守ることを勧めている。火を消したりドアを開けたりするのは、揺れが落ち着いてからでも遅くない。慌てて外へ飛び出すと、落ちてきたガラスや看板でけがをする恐れがあるという。
cards.en: Surprisingly few people can say right away what they should do first when an earthquake strikes. Experts recommend first taking cover under a desk or similar and protecting your head until the shaking stops. Turning off the stove or opening the door can wait until the shaking has calmed down. Rushing outside in a panic, they say, risks injury from falling glass or signs.

words.meaning: pure white; (of the mind) completely blank
words.defJa: まじりけがなく、すっかり白いようす。また、何も考えられなくなるようす。

cards.ja: 大勢の前でスピーチをしようとした瞬間、頭の中が真っ白になった経験はないだろうか。強い緊張を感じると、脳はそれを危険の合図と受け取り、記憶を呼び出す働きが一時的に鈍くなるという。心理学者は、ゆっくり息を吐くことで体の興奮を落ち着かせることができると話す。あらかじめ最初の一文だけでも暗記しておけば、立ち直るきっかけになる。
cards.en: Have you ever had your mind go completely blank the moment you were about to give a speech in front of a large audience? When we feel intense nervousness, the brain takes it as a danger signal, and its ability to retrieve memories is said to dull temporarily. Psychologists say that exhaling slowly can calm the body's arousal. Memorizing even just the first sentence in advance can give you a foothold to recover.

words.meaning: to enshrine, to deify; to worship
words.defJa: 神や祖先の霊をあがめ、決まった場所にむかえておがむ。

cards.ja: この神社には、千年以上前に村を洪水から救ったと伝えられる人物が祭られている。毎年秋の祭りの日には、その功績をしのんで地元の人々が集まり、神輿を担いで町を練り歩く。実在した人を神として祭る習慣は日本では珍しくなく、学問の神様として受験生に人気の天神様もその一例である。神と人との距離の近さは、日本の信仰の大きな特徴と言えるだろう。
cards.en: This shrine enshrines a person said to have saved the village from a flood more than a thousand years ago. Every autumn on the festival day, local people gather to honor that achievement and parade through the town carrying a portable shrine. The custom of enshrining real historical people as gods is not unusual in Japan, and Tenjin, popular with exam takers as the god of learning, is one example. The closeness between gods and people can be called a major feature of Japanese faith.

words.defJa: 役所や駅、銀行などで、客の受付や手続き、相談に応じる場所。また、外との連絡を受け持つ部署や人。

cards.ja: 市役所の窓口には、年度末になると転入や転出の手続きをする人で長い列ができる。待ち時間を減らそうと、最近はオンラインで書類を提出できる自治体も増えてきた。それでも、高齢者の中には画面の操作に不安を覚え、職員に直接相談したいという人が少なくない。便利さを追い求めるだけでなく、対面の窓口をどう残すかも問われている。
cards.en: At the city hall service counters, long lines form at the end of the fiscal year as people come to file paperwork for moving in or out. To cut waiting times, a growing number of local governments now let residents submit documents online. Even so, many elderly people feel uneasy operating a screen and would rather consult a staff member in person. The question is not only how to pursue convenience but also how to keep face-to-face counters.

words.defJa: ほかの人や物と同じようにふるまったり、作ったりする。

cards.ja: 幼い子どもは、親の話し方や仕草を驚くほど正確にまねる。電話をかけるふりをして、母親そっくりの口調で「もしもし」と言ってみせる子も珍しくない。心理学では、こうした模倣が言葉や社会のルールを身につける土台になると考えられている。まねることは、学ぶことの最初の一歩なのである。
cards.en: Young children imitate their parents' way of talking and their gestures with astonishing accuracy. It is not unusual for a child to pretend to make a phone call and say "Hello?" in a tone exactly like their mother's. In psychology, this kind of imitation is thought to be the foundation for acquiring language and the rules of society. Imitating is the very first step in learning.

words.defJa: それほど時間がたたないうちに。もうすぐ。

cards.ja: 「まもなく、終点の東京です」という車内放送が流れると、乗客たちは一斉に網棚の荷物を下ろし始めた。窓の外には高層ビルが次々と現れ、長い旅が終わりに近づいていることを告げている。隣の席の老夫婦は、孫へのお土産を確かめるように紙袋をのぞき込んでいた。私も上着を羽織り、降りる準備を整えた。
cards.en: When the announcement "We will soon arrive at Tokyo, the last stop" came over the train's speakers, the passengers all began taking their bags down from the overhead racks at once. Outside the window, high-rise buildings appeared one after another, signaling that the long journey was nearing its end. The elderly couple in the seats next to me peered into a paper bag as if checking on the souvenirs for their grandchildren. I, too, put on my jacket and got ready to get off.

words.defJa: めったに起こらない、あるいは見られないようす。

cards.ja: 患者が国内に数千人しかいないような、まれな病気は数多く存在する。その多くは初期の症状が風邪や疲れと似ているため、最初に受診した医療機関では見過ごされやすい。正しい診断がつくまでに、十年近くかかったという患者もいる。患者団体は、医師向けの研修や情報提供を充実させるよう国に求めている。
cards.en: There are many rare diseases with only a few thousand patients nationwide. Because the early symptoms of many of them resemble a cold or fatigue, they are easily overlooked at the first medical facility a patient visits. Some patients say it took nearly ten years before they received a correct diagnosis. Patient groups are calling on the government to expand training and information for doctors.

words.defJa: まっすぐ行かずに、遠回りになる道を通って行くこと。また、その道。

cards.ja: 駅前の道路が水道工事で通行止めになり、今朝は公園を抜ける回り道をして会社へ向かった。いつもより十分ほど余計にかかったが、桜並木の下を歩くのは思いのほか気持ちがよかった。普段は時間に追われ、景色に目を向ける余裕などない。たまの回り道も悪くないと思いながら、少し軽い足取りで職場に着いた。
cards.en: The road in front of the station was closed for water-main work, so this morning I took a detour through the park on my way to the office. It took about ten minutes longer than usual, but walking under the rows of cherry trees was unexpectedly pleasant. Normally I am pressed for time and have no room to look at the scenery. Thinking that an occasional detour is not so bad, I arrived at work with a slightly lighter step.

words.defJa: 決められた人数いっぱいに人が入っていること。

cards.ja: 日曜日のスタジアムは、優勝のかかった試合を見ようと集まったファンで満員になった。チケットは発売からわずか数分で売り切れ、入れなかった人たちは近くの広場に設置された大型画面の前に集まった。試合終了の笛が鳴った瞬間、スタンドは揺れるほどの歓声に包まれた。地元のチームが優勝するのは、実に三十年ぶりのことだった。
cards.en: On Sunday, the stadium was packed with fans who had come to watch a game with the championship on the line. Tickets sold out just minutes after going on sale, and those who could not get in gathered in front of a giant screen set up in a nearby plaza. The moment the final whistle blew, the stands were engulfed in cheers loud enough to shake them. It was the local team's first title in a full thirty years.

words.defJa: テストなどで、取ることのできるいちばん高い点。また、申し分のないこと。

cards.ja: 小学四年の息子が、漢字テストで初めて満点を取ってきた。毎晩、台所のテーブルで書き取りを練習していたのを知っているだけに、答案用紙を見せる誇らしげな顔がうれしかった。夫は記念にと、その答案を冷蔵庫に貼った。小さな成功でも、努力が報われる経験は子どもの大きな自信になるはずだ。
cards.en: My son, a fourth grader, came home with a perfect score on a kanji test for the first time. Because I knew he had been practicing writing every night at the kitchen table, the proud look on his face as he showed me the test made me happy. My husband stuck the test on the fridge as a keepsake. Even if it is a small success, the experience of effort being rewarded should give a child great confidence.

words.meaning: not yet, un- (something has not yet happened)
words.defJa: まだそうなっていない、まだ済んでいないという意味をそえる語。

cards.ja: 数学の世界には、百年以上も前に出された問いが今も未解決のまま残っている。素数の並び方に関する予想もその一つで、多くの研究者が挑んできたが、誰も証明に成功していない。こうした難問の中には、高額な賞金がかけられているものもある。この予想が正しいことを前提に導かれた定理も数多く、証明されれば数学の広い分野に影響が及ぶとみられている。
cards.en: In the world of mathematics, questions posed more than a hundred years ago still remain unsolved. A conjecture about how the prime numbers are distributed is one of them; many researchers have taken it on, but no one has succeeded in proving it. Some of these hard problems even carry large cash prizes. Many theorems have been derived on the assumption that this conjecture is true, so a proof is expected to have repercussions across wide areas of mathematics.

words.meaning: to look up at; to admire
words.defJa: 下から上の方を見る。また、人の行いや心がけを立派だと感心する。

cards.ja: 山道を一時間ほど登ると、樹齢千年とも言われる杉の大木が姿を現した。根元に立って見上げると、枝先は霧に隠れ、てっぺんがどこにあるのかも分からない。幹には古いしめ縄が巻かれ、地元の人々が長い間この木を神として大切にしてきたことがうかがえる。思わず手を合わせたくなるような、静かな迫力があった。
cards.en: After I had climbed the mountain path for about an hour, a giant cedar said to be a thousand years old came into view. When I stood at its base and looked up, the tips of its branches were hidden in mist, and I could not even tell where the top was. An old sacred straw rope is wrapped around the trunk, showing that local people have long cherished the tree as a god. It had a quiet power that made me want to put my hands together in prayer.

words.meaning: to shelve, to decide against (for now); to see someone off
words.defJa: 予定していたことを、今回は行わないことにする。また、出かける人を送り出す。

cards.ja: 政府は、来年春に予定していた増税を見送る方針を固めた。物価の上昇が続くなかで増税に踏み切れば、家計や中小企業への打撃が大きすぎると判断したためだ。一方、財政の悪化を懸念する専門家からは、先送りを繰り返すべきではないとの声も上がっている。最終的な判断は、年末の税制改正の議論に委ねられる。
cards.en: The government has settled on a policy of shelving the tax increase that had been planned for next spring. It judged that going ahead with a tax hike while prices keep rising would deal too heavy a blow to households and small businesses. On the other hand, experts worried about the deteriorating public finances say it should not keep being postponed. The final decision will be left to the year-end discussions on tax reform.

words.meaning: to look down at (from above), to overlook
words.defJa: 高い所から下の方を見る。

cards.ja: 展望台からは、港町の全景を見下ろすことができる。夕方になると、斜面に沿って並ぶ赤い屋根の家々が夕日に照らされ、まるで絵はがきのような光景が広がる。湾には漁を終えた船が次々と戻り、小さな白い航跡を残していく。観光客の多くは、この景色を眺めるためだけに急な坂道を上ってくるという。
cards.en: From the observation deck, you can look down on the whole port town. In the evening, the red-roofed houses lined up along the slope are lit by the setting sun, and the scene looks just like a picture postcard. In the bay, boats that have finished fishing return one after another, leaving small white wakes. Many tourists are said to climb the steep hill just to take in this view.

words.defJa: 外から見たようす。外見。

cards.ja: その店のカレーパンは、見かけはごく普通で、ショーケースの中でも少しも目立たない。ところが一口かじると、スパイスの香りと牛すじの深いうまみが口いっぱいに広がる。人は見かけによらないと言うが、パンも同じらしい。昼前には毎日売り切れてしまうため、遠くから車で買いに来る客もいるほどだ。
cards.en: The curry bread at that shop looks completely ordinary and does not stand out at all in the display case. But take one bite, and the aroma of spices and the deep savoriness of beef tendon fill your mouth. They say people are not what they seem, and apparently the same goes for bread. Because it sells out before noon every day, some customers even drive in from far away to buy it.

words.defJa: 新月から三日目ごろに見える、細く弓のような形をした月。

cards.ja: 日没直後の西の空に、細い三日月が浮かんでいた。目を凝らすと、月の欠けている部分もうっすらと灰色に見えた。これは地球に反射した太陽の光が月を照らす、地球照と呼ばれる現象だ。月の輝く部分が細いこの時期は、その淡い光を観察する絶好の機会とされている。
cards.en: Just after sunset, a thin crescent moon hung in the western sky. Looking closely, I could see that even the dark part of the moon was faintly gray. This is a phenomenon called earthshine, in which sunlight reflected off the Earth lights up the moon. This period, when the bright part of the moon is thin, is considered an ideal time to observe that faint light.

words.defJa: 海や湖に向かって、陸地が細長く突き出ている所。

cards.ja: 半島の先端にある岬には、明治時代に建てられた白い灯台が今も立っている。灯台の周りは切り立った崖になっており、冬には荒波が岩に打ち寄せて高いしぶきを上げる。晴れた日には、はるか沖を行き交う大型船や、遠くの島々まで見渡せる。最近は、初日の出を見に訪れる人も多いという。
cards.en: On the cape at the tip of the peninsula, a white lighthouse built in the Meiji era still stands today. The lighthouse is surrounded by sheer cliffs, and in winter rough waves crash against the rocks and throw spray high into the air. On clear days, you can see large ships coming and going far offshore, and even distant islands. Recently, many people are said to visit to see the first sunrise of the year.

words.defJa: 見ていられないほど、あわれで情けないようす。

cards.ja: 高校最後の大会で、私は緊張のあまり、練習では一度もしなかったミスを繰り返した。仲間に申し訳なくて、帰りのバスでは顔を上げることもできなかった。負けたことよりも、全力を出し切れなかった自分が情けなく、惨めな気持ちでいっぱいだった。だが、あの夜の悔しさがあったからこそ、その後も努力を続けられたのだと今は思う。
cards.en: At my last high school tournament, I was so nervous that I kept making mistakes I had never once made in practice. I felt so sorry toward my teammates that I could not even lift my head on the bus ride home. More than the loss itself, I was ashamed of myself for not giving it everything, and I was filled with misery. But now I think it was precisely the frustration of that night that let me keep working hard afterward.

words.defJa: 泳ぐときに着る服。

cards.ja: 競泳の世界では、かつて特殊な素材を使った水着が登場し、世界記録が次々と塗り替えられたことがある。体を強く締め付けて水の抵抗を減らし、浮力まで高める仕組みだった。しかし、選手の実力より道具の性能が結果を左右するとの批判が高まり、国際水泳連盟は規制に乗り出した。現在は素材や形に細かな基準が設けられている。
cards.en: In competitive swimming, swimsuits made of special materials once appeared, and world records were broken one after another. They compressed the body tightly to reduce water resistance and also increased buoyancy. However, criticism grew that the performance of the gear, rather than the swimmers' ability, was deciding results, and the international swimming federation moved to regulate them. Today, detailed standards are set for their materials and shape.

cards.enTarget: In competitive swimming, swimsuits made of special materials once appeared, and world records were broken one after another.

words.defJa: 品物を売る店。商店。

cards.ja: 祖母の話によると、昔のこの通りには豆腐屋や八百屋、駄菓子屋といった小さな店屋がずらりと並んでいたそうだ。どの店も家族で切り盛りしており、買い物ついでに世間話をするのが日々の楽しみだったという。今では大型スーパーに客を奪われ、シャッターを下ろしたままの建物が目立つ。それでも祖母は、通りを歩くたびに一軒一軒の名前を懐かしそうに口にする。
cards.en: According to my grandmother, this street used to be lined with small shops such as a tofu maker, a greengrocer and a candy store. Every shop was run by a family, and chatting while doing the shopping was a daily pleasure, she says. Now large supermarkets have taken their customers, and buildings with their shutters left down stand out. Even so, every time my grandmother walks down the street, she fondly says the name of each shop, one by one.

words.defJa: ある場所へ行くときに通る道の順序。

cards.ja: 初めて訪れる場所でも、今はスマートフォンの地図アプリが目的地までの道順を細かく教えてくれる。曲がり角が近づくと音声で知らせてくれるので、紙の地図を広げて迷うことはほとんどなくなった。その一方で、画面ばかり見て歩くうちに、周りの景色をまるで覚えていないという人も多い。便利さと引き換えに、私たちは道を覚える力を少しずつ失っているのかもしれない。
cards.en: Even when you visit a place for the first time, smartphone map apps now give you detailed directions to your destination. Because they announce upcoming turns by voice, people hardly ever spread out a paper map and get lost anymore. On the other hand, many people walk while staring at the screen and end up remembering nothing of their surroundings. In exchange for convenience, we may be gradually losing our ability to learn our way around.

words.meaning: to gaze at, to stare at
words.defJa: 目をそらさずに、じっと見続ける。

cards.ja: 美術館の一室で、一人の老人が一枚の絵の前から動かずにいた。描かれているのは、窓辺で手紙を読む若い女性の横顔である。老人は椅子に腰掛け、三十分以上もじっとその絵を見つめていた。帰り際に係員が声をかけると、亡くなった妻に似ているのだと、照れくさそうに笑ったという。
cards.en: In one room of the art museum, an elderly man stayed in front of a single painting without moving. It depicts the profile of a young woman reading a letter by a window. The man sat on a chair and gazed intently at the painting for more than thirty minutes. When a staff member spoke to him as he was leaving, he reportedly smiled shyly and said she resembled his late wife.

words.meaning: to review, to reconsider; to think better of
words.defJa: もう一度よく調べて、悪いところを改める。また、人や物のよさを改めて認める。

cards.ja: ある大手メーカーは、在宅勤務の広がりを受けて、社員の通勤手当の仕組みを見直すことにした。これまでは定期券代を一律に支給していたが、出社が週に数日の社員には、実際に使った交通費を払う方式に切り替える。浮いた費用は、自宅で働くための光熱費の補助に回すという。働き方の変化に合わせて、制度も少しずつ形を変えつつある。
cards.en: In response to the spread of remote work, a major manufacturer decided to review its system of commuting allowances for employees. Until now it paid everyone the cost of a commuter pass uniformly, but for employees who come to the office only a few days a week it will switch to paying the travel costs they actually incur. The money saved will go toward subsidizing utility bills for working from home. Systems, too, are gradually changing shape to keep up with changes in the way people work.

words.meaning: to become used to seeing, to be familiar with
words.defJa: 何度も見て、珍しくなくなる。

cards.ja: 留学を終えて三年ぶりに故郷の駅に降り立つと、見慣れたはずの景色がどこか新鮮に映った。駅前のロータリーも、古い喫茶店の看板も昔のままなのに、まるで初めて訪れた町のように感じられる。離れて暮らすうちに、自分の目のほうが変わってしまったのだろう。当たり前だと思っていたものの良さに、ようやく気づいた気がした。
cards.en: When I stepped off the train at my hometown station for the first time in three years, after finishing my studies abroad, the scenery that should have been so familiar somehow looked fresh. Though the rotary in front of the station and the sign of the old coffee shop were just as they had been, it felt like a town I was visiting for the first time. Perhaps, while living away, it was my own eyes that had changed. I felt I had finally noticed the value of things I had taken for granted.

words.defJa: 見た目が悪く、いやな感じがする。また、行いが恥ずかしく見苦しい。

cards.ja: 党の代表選挙は、政策論争よりも候補者同士の中傷合戦が目立つ展開となった。互いの過去の発言や金銭問題を暴き合う姿に、支持者からも「醜い争いだ」と嘆く声が上がっている。世論調査では、党の支持率がこの一か月で大きく下がった。新しい代表には、まず失った信頼を取り戻すことが求められる。
cards.en: The party's leadership election turned into a contest more notable for mudslinging between candidates than for policy debate. Seeing them dig up each other's past remarks and money problems, even supporters are lamenting that it is an ugly fight. In opinion polls, the party's approval rating has fallen sharply over the past month. The new leader will first of all be required to win back the trust that has been lost.

words.meaning: to ripen, to bear fruit; to pay off (effort)
words.defJa: 植物が実をつける。また、努力などがよい結果となって表れる。

cards.ja: 秋になると、山あいの棚田では黄金色に実った稲穂が風に揺れる。この地域では十年ほど前から農薬を減らした米作りに取り組んできたが、当初は虫の害で収穫量が落ち、やめていく農家も少なくなかった。それでも工夫を重ねた結果、今では香りのよい米として評判を呼び、都市部の料理店からも注文が届くようになった。地道な努力が、ようやく実ったのである。
cards.en: In autumn, golden ears of ripened rice sway in the wind in the terraced paddies among the mountains. For about ten years this area has been growing rice with fewer pesticides, but at first harvests fell because of insect damage, and quite a few farmers gave up. Even so, after repeated improvements the rice has earned a reputation for its fragrance, and orders now come in even from restaurants in the cities. The steady efforts have finally paid off.

words.defJa: 社会の中での地位や立場。

cards.ja: 江戸時代の社会では、武士や百姓、町人といった身分が生まれによってほぼ決まっていた。身分によって住む場所や着る物、結婚できる相手まで細かく定められていたのである。ただし近年の研究では、養子縁組などを通じて別の身分に移る人も一定数いたことが分かってきた。かつて考えられていたほど、社会は固定されたものではなかったらしい。
cards.en: In Edo-period society, a person's status, such as samurai, peasant or townsperson, was almost entirely determined by birth. Status dictated in detail everything from where people lived and what they wore to whom they could marry. Recent research, however, has shown that a certain number of people moved from one status to another through means such as adoption. Society apparently was not as rigid as was once thought.

words.meaning: to visit (a sick or injured person); (passive) to be hit by a disaster
words.defJa: 病気やけがをした人を訪ねて、様子を尋ねたり慰めたりする。また、災害などが襲う。

cards.ja: 週末、骨折して入院している叔父を見舞った。病室に入ると、叔父はベッドの上で退屈そうに新聞を広げていたが、私の顔を見るなり、うれしそうに手を振った。好物の和菓子を差し出すと、病院の食事は味が薄くてかなわないと笑いながら、さっそく一つ口に運んだ。思ったより元気そうな姿に、ほっと胸をなで下ろした。
cards.en: Over the weekend, I visited my uncle, who is in the hospital with a broken bone. When I entered the room, he was reading a newspaper spread out on his bed, looking bored, but as soon as he saw my face he waved happily. When I held out the Japanese sweets he loves, he laughed that the hospital food was unbearably bland and promptly popped one into his mouth. Seeing him looking livelier than I had expected, I breathed a sigh of relief.

words.meaning: less than, under (not including the number)
words.defJa: ある数に達していないこと。基準の数そのものは含まない。

cards.ja: 日本では2022年に成人年齢が18歳に引き下げられたが、飲酒や喫煙は今も20歳未満には認められていない。健康への影響を考えると、年齢の線引きを変えるべきではないと判断されたためだ。一方、18歳になれば親の同意なしにローンを組んだり、携帯電話の契約を結んだりできるようになった。若者が思わぬトラブルに巻き込まれないよう、学校での消費者教育も進められている。
cards.en: In Japan, the age of adulthood was lowered to 18 in 2022, but drinking and smoking are still not allowed for those under 20. This is because it was judged that, given the effects on health, the age line should not be changed. Meanwhile, at 18 young people can now take out loans or sign mobile phone contracts without their parents' consent. Consumer education is also being promoted in schools so that young people do not get caught up in unexpected trouble.

words.defJa: 家の名前として、家族が共通して名乗る名。

cards.ja: 日本には十万種類を超える名字があると言われ、その多くは地名や地形に由来している。田んぼの中、山のふもと、川のそばといった、先祖が暮らした土地の様子がそのまま名前になったのである。庶民が名字を公に名乗れるようになったのは、明治時代になってからのことだ。それまでは、武士など一部の人々にだけ許された特権だった。
cards.en: Japan is said to have more than 100,000 surnames, many of which come from place names or features of the land. The look of the land where people's ancestors lived, such as in the middle of rice paddies, at the foot of a mountain or beside a river, simply became their names. It was only in the Meiji era that ordinary people were allowed to use surnames publicly. Until then, it had been a privilege granted only to some people, such as samurai.

words.defJa: 国や役所に属さない、一般の人々や会社の世界。

cards.ja: かつて宇宙開発は、国家が巨額の予算を投じて進める事業だった。しかし近年は民間の企業が独自にロケットを開発し、人工衛星の打ち上げを請け負うまでになっている。部品を再利用して費用を大幅に下げたことで、大学や中小企業でも衛星を持てる時代が近づいてきた。宇宙は、いまや新たなビジネスの舞台になりつつある。
cards.en: Space development was once an undertaking pursued by nations pouring in huge budgets. In recent years, however, private companies have been developing their own rockets and have even come to take on contracts to launch satellites. By reusing parts and drastically lowering costs, they are bringing closer an era in which even universities and small businesses can own satellites. Space is now becoming a new stage for business.

words.defJa: 国民が主権を持ち、国民の意思に基づいて政治を行うという意味を表す語。

cards.ja: 戦後の日本では、占領下で社会の仕組みが大きく作り変えられた。女性が初めて選挙権を得たほか、農地改革によって多くの小作農が自分の土地を持てるようになった。こうした改革は、軍国主義の土台を取り除き、社会の民主化を進めることを目的としていた。新しい憲法が施行されたのは、1947年5月のことである。
cards.en: In postwar Japan, the structure of society was thoroughly remade under the occupation. Besides women gaining the right to vote for the first time, land reform allowed many tenant farmers to own their own land. These reforms aimed to remove the foundations of militarism and advance the democratization of society. The new constitution took effect in May 1947.

cards.en: In this mountain town, a folk song handed down from long ago has been sung whenever rice-planting season comes. It is said that it was once a song for easing the hardship of the work and keeping everyone in rhythm together. With its performers aging, it nearly died out at one point, but since the local elementary school began teaching it in its hands-on rice-planting lessons, children's singing voices once again ring out over the rice fields.

words.defJa: 限りがなく、どこまでも終わりがないこと。

cards.ja: 数学でいう無限は、単に「とても大きな数」のことではない。たとえば自然数はどこまで数えても終わりがなく、どんなに大きな数にも必ず次の数がある。不思議なことに、偶数だけを取り出しても、その数は自然数全体とちょうど同じだけあることになる。こうした直感に反する性質が、昔から多くの数学者を魅了してきた。
cards.en: Infinity in mathematics is not simply 'a very large number.' For example, the natural numbers never come to an end however far you count, and every number, however large, always has a next one. Curiously, even if you pick out only the even numbers, there turn out to be exactly as many of them as there are natural numbers altogether. Counterintuitive properties like these have fascinated many mathematicians for a long time.

cards.en: A patterned shirt is fun to have, but when you think about putting outfits together every day, the ones you end up reaching for most are the plain ones. As long as you choose the color well, they are easy to match with a jacket or a sweater. Lately, more shops sell only plain clothes made with careful attention to fabric and tailoring. Perhaps because the decoration has been stripped away, the quality of the material comes across all the more clearly.

cards.ja: 街の明かりから遠く離れた高原に立つと、夜空には無数の星が広がっている。都会ではせいぜい数十個しか見えないが、条件がよければ肉眼でも数千個の星を見分けられるという。双眼鏡を向ければ、天の川もぼんやりした雲ではなく、小さな光の粒が集まったものだとわかる。その光景を前にすると、自分の悩みがひどく小さなものに思えてくる。
cards.en: Standing on a highland far from the city lights, you see countless stars spread across the night sky. In the city you can see a few dozen at most, but under good conditions you can reportedly make out several thousand stars with the naked eye. Point binoculars at it, and you can tell that the Milky Way, too, is not a hazy cloud but a gathering of tiny grains of light. Faced with that sight, your own worries begin to seem terribly small.

words.defJa: 赤と青をまぜたような色。

cards.ja: 古代の日本では、紫は最も高貴な色とされていた。紫の染料は植物の根からわずかしか取れず、布を染めるには大変な手間がかかったからだ。七世紀に定められた冠位の制度でも、紫は最上位の色に位置づけられていたと考えられている。身分の低い者が紫の衣を身につけることは、長く禁じられていたという。
cards.en: In ancient Japan, purple was regarded as the noblest of colors. That is because purple dye could be obtained only in tiny amounts from the roots of a plant, and dyeing cloth with it took enormous effort. In the system of court ranks established in the seventh century, too, purple is thought to have been assigned to the highest rank. It is said that people of low status were long forbidden to wear purple robes.

words.defJa: 自分のきょうだいの娘。

cards.ja: 春休みに、小学三年生になる姪が一人で泊まりに来た。姉からは、最近すっかり生意気になったと聞いていたが、会ってみると相変わらずの甘えん坊だった。夜は布団の中で、学校で流行っている遊びを延々と説明してくれた。翌朝、駅で見送るときには、こちらのほうがすっかり名残惜しくなっていた。
cards.en: During spring break, my niece, who is about to start third grade, came to stay with me on her own. I had heard from my sister that she had become quite cheeky lately, but when I saw her she was as clingy and affectionate as ever. At night, lying in her futon, she explained at great length the games that are popular at her school. The next morning, seeing her off at the station, I was the one who found it hard to say goodbye.

cards.ja: 高校野球の歴史には、今も語り継がれる名勝負がいくつもある。延長戦にもつれ込み、両チームの投手が最後まで一歩も譲らなかった試合は、何十年たってもテレビで繰り返し紹介される。勝敗そのものより、極限の状況で互いに全力を尽くした姿が、見る人の心を打つのだろう。
cards.en: The history of high school baseball contains a number of legendary matches that are still talked about today. Games that went into extra innings, with the pitchers on both sides refusing to give an inch until the very end, are shown again and again on television even decades later. More than the result itself, it is probably the sight of both teams giving their all under extreme pressure that moves viewers.

words.defJa: すぐれていて、高く評価されている作品。

cards.ja: 名作と呼ばれる小説は、読むたびに違う顔を見せる。学生のころは主人公の若さにばかり目が向いたが、四十を過ぎて読み返すと、脇役である父親の苦しみが痛いほどわかった。作品は少しも変わっていないのに、受け取る側が変わったのだ。長く読み継がれる本には、そうした読者の変化を受け止める深さがある。
cards.en: A novel called a masterpiece shows a different face each time you read it. As a student I paid attention only to the hero's youth, but when I reread it after turning forty, I understood all too painfully the suffering of his father, a supporting character. The work had not changed in the slightest; it was the reader who had changed. Books that are read across generations have the depth to absorb such changes in their readers.

words.defJa: 景色がよかったり歴史があったりして、広く知られている場所。

cards.ja: 川沿いに千本の桜が並ぶこの公園は、県内でも指折りの花見の名所だ。満開の時期には週末だけで数十万人が訪れ、周辺の道路は朝から渋滞が続く。近年はごみの放置や夜間の騒音に悩む住民も多く、市は今年から一部の区域で有料の予約制を試すことにした。集まった料金は、清掃や桜の手入れの費用に充てるという。
cards.en: This park, where a thousand cherry trees line the riverbank, is one of the foremost cherry-blossom viewing spots in the prefecture. At full bloom, hundreds of thousands of people visit on weekends alone, and the surrounding roads stay congested from the morning on. In recent years many residents have been troubled by litter left behind and noise at night, so the city has decided to try a paid reservation system in some areas starting this year. The fees collected will reportedly go toward cleaning and the care of the cherry trees.

words.defJa: 権限や上の立場をもつ者が、相手に何かをするよう言いつける。また、ある役職につかせる。

cards.ja: 地方裁判所は、工場の騒音で眠れない日が続いたと訴えた住民の主張を認め、運営会社に賠償金の支払いを命ずる判決を言い渡した。判決は、会社が苦情を受けながら十分な対策をとらなかった点を重く見た。会社側は判決の内容を精査したうえで、控訴するかどうかを決めるとしている。
cards.en: The district court accepted the claims of residents who said they had gone night after night unable to sleep because of factory noise, and handed down a ruling ordering the operating company to pay damages. The ruling placed heavy weight on the fact that the company had received complaints yet failed to take adequate measures. The company says it will decide whether to appeal after carefully examining the content of the ruling.

cards.en: The longest line at the harbor town's morning market forms at the stall selling grilled squid, a local specialty. Freshly caught squid is grilled whole on an iron griddle and finished with a sweet-and-savory sauce. Drawn by the fragrant aroma, not only tourists but even neighbors stop in their tracks. According to the owner, he has not changed the way he makes the sauce in forty years in order to protect this flavor.

It used to be taken for granted that the whole department would go out together to a set restaurant, but that custom has disappeared without anyone noticing. words.defJa: よいものや運などを、十分に与えられている。

cards.ja: インド南西部の海沿いの地域は、毎年のモンスーンがもたらす豊かな雨に恵まれ、古くから香辛料の産地として栄えてきた。コショウやカルダモンを求めて、アラブやヨーロッパの商人が次々と船でやって来た。今も港町の市場には、乾燥させた香辛料の強い香りが漂っている。
cards.en: The coastal region of southwestern India is blessed with abundant rain brought by the monsoon every year, and it has flourished since ancient times as a source of spices. In search of pepper and cardamom, merchants from Arabia and Europe arrived by ship one after another. Even today, the strong aroma of dried spices hangs in the air of the harbor towns' markets.

words.meaning: to aim at, to strive for
words.defJa: ある目標を決めて、そこにたどり着こうとする。

cards.ja: 多くのIT企業が、人間と同じようにさまざまな仕事をこなせるAIの開発を目指して、競い合っている。必要な計算能力を確保するため、巨大なデータセンターが次々と建設され、その電力消費も急増している。一方で、性能の向上ばかりを追い求めることへの懸念も根強い。安全性や社会への影響をどう確かめるのかが、今後の大きな課題になるだろう。
cards.en: Many IT companies are competing with one another, aiming to develop AI that can handle a wide range of tasks just as humans do. To secure the computing power this requires, huge data centers are being built one after another, and their electricity consumption is rising sharply. On the other hand, concerns about pursuing performance gains alone remain deep-rooted. How to verify safety and the impact on society will likely be a major challenge from here on.

cards.ja: 朝が苦手な人の中には、目覚まし時計をわざと部屋の反対側に置く人がいる。止めるには布団から出て歩かなければならないため、二度寝を防げるというわけだ。最近はスマートフォンのアラームで起きる人が多いが、枕元に置くとつい画面を見てしまい、寝つくのが遅くなりやすいとも言われている。
cards.en: Among people who struggle with mornings, some deliberately put their alarm clock on the opposite side of the room. Since they have to get out of bed and walk over to stop it, the idea is that this keeps them from falling back asleep. These days many people wake up to their smartphone's alarm, but it is also said that keeping the phone by the pillow tempts you to look at the screen and tends to delay falling asleep.

cards.ja: 多くの山では、木の幹に巻かれた赤いテープが登山道の目印になっている。霧が出て視界が悪くなったときは、地図と登山道の目印を照合しながら進むのが鉄則だ。山に慣れた人ほど、近道をしようとして道を外れ、迷ってしまうことがある。遭難の多くは、疲れが出やすい下山中に起きているという。
cards.en: On many mountains, red tape wrapped around tree trunks serves as a marker for the hiking trail. When fog rolls in and visibility worsens, the iron rule is to proceed while checking trail markers against a map. The more used to the mountains people are, the more likely they are to leave the trail trying to take a shortcut and get lost. Many mountain accidents reportedly happen during the descent, when fatigue tends to set in.

cards.en: Walking through residential areas in the countryside, you notice many vacant houses with their storm shutters left closed. Reportedly, in many cases the people who lived there died or moved into care facilities, and their children live far away and cannot look after the houses. Neglected houses deteriorate quickly and pose a risk of collapse and arson, so local governments are asking owners to take action.

cards.ja: 健康のために一日一万歩を目安にしている人は多い。ただ、近年の研究では、一日七千歩前後でも死亡リスクが大きく下がることがわかってきた。大切なのは数字にこだわりすぎず、毎日無理なく体を動かす習慣を続けることだ。歩く時間がとれない日は、階段を使うだけでも効果があるという。
cards.en: Many people use 10,000 steps a day as a rough target for their health. Recent research, however, has shown that even around 7,000 steps a day substantially lowers the risk of death. What matters is not to fixate on the numbers but to keep up a habit of moving your body every day without overdoing it. On days when you cannot find time to walk, simply taking the stairs reportedly helps.

words.defJa: 法律で決められた税金を払わなくてよいこと。

cards.ja: デパートの免税カウンターには、化粧品や家電の箱を抱えた外国人観光客の列ができていた。日本では、旅行者が一定額以上の買い物をすると、消費税が免除される仕組みがある。ただ、免税で買った品物を国内で転売する不正が相次いだため、出国の際に持ち出しを確認してから税金を返す方式に改められることになった。
cards.en: At the department store's tax-free counter, a line of foreign tourists had formed, their arms full of boxes of cosmetics and electronics. In Japan, there is a system under which travelers who buy at least a certain amount are exempted from consumption tax. However, because of repeated fraud in which goods bought tax-free were resold within the country, the system is being changed so that the tax is refunded only after it is confirmed at departure that the goods are being taken out of the country.

words.defJa: 平面や土地などの広さ。

cards.ja: 日本は国土面積のおよそ三分の二が森林に覆われた、世界でも有数の森林国だ。ただ、その約四割は戦後に植えられたスギやヒノキの人工林で、手入れが行き届かずに荒れた山も少なくない。国産の木があまり使われなくなったことが、森を管理する人手と資金の不足に拍車をかけている。
cards.en: Japan is one of the most heavily forested countries in the world, with about two-thirds of its land area covered by forest. However, around 40 percent of that is plantation forest of cedar and cypress planted after the war, and many mountains have fallen into neglect without proper care. The decline in the use of domestic wood has worsened the shortage of labor and funds for managing the forests.
