words.meaning: troublesome, a hassle, too much bother
words.defJa: 手間がかかって、やる気が起きない。わずらわしい。

cards.ja: 部屋の片づけや書類の提出など、面倒くさいと感じる作業ほど、つい後回しにしてしまうものだ。心理学では、取りかかる前に感じる負担は、実際に作業するときの負担より大きく見積もられがちだとされる。そこで勧められるのが、まず五分だけやってみるという方法である。いったん手をつけてしまえば、意外とそのまま続けられることが多い。
cards.en: With tasks like tidying your room or submitting paperwork, the more of a hassle something feels, the more you tend to put it off. In psychology, it is said that the burden we feel before starting tends to be overestimated compared with the burden of actually doing the task. That is why one recommended method is to try doing it for just five minutes first. Once you have made a start, you can often keep going surprisingly easily.

cards.en: At conveyor-belt sushi restaurants, star items such as tuna that draw customers in reportedly earn almost no profit in some cases. The reason the restaurants still make money is that they secure their overall profit through low-cost side dishes and drinks. This approach of separating the products that attract customers from the products that earn money is used across much of the retail industry.

cards.en: Stories of people who made big money in a short time from stocks or crypto assets are spreading one after another online. But it is seldom mentioned that behind such success stories there are people who lost just as much money, or even more. Experts urge people to be all the more suspicious of offers that sound too good to be true and not to get involved in things they do not understand.

cards.en: In recent years, timber has been reconsidered as a building material to replace steel and concrete. New construction materials made by gluing boards together in many layers are very strong, and wooden buildings of more than ten stories are now being built both in Japan and abroad. Because trees absorb carbon dioxide as they grow, using wood in buildings also has the advantage of locking carbon away for a long time.

words.meaning: to lean against, to lean on
words.defJa: 体の重みを、壁や柱などにかけて寄りかかる。

cards.ja: 終電間際の車内では、座席の端の仕切りにもたれて眠り込んでいる人をよく見かける。一日の疲れがどっと出るのだろう。ただ、立ったままドアにもたれていると、開いた瞬間にバランスを崩して転ぶおそれがある。鉄道会社も車内放送で、ドアに寄りかからないよう注意を呼びかけている。
cards.en: On trains close to the last service of the night, you often see people fast asleep leaning against the partition at the end of the seats. The fatigue of the whole day probably hits them all at once. However, if you lean against the door while standing, there is a risk of losing your balance and falling the moment it opens. Railway companies, too, use onboard announcements to warn passengers not to lean against the doors.

cards.ja: 正月に欠かせない餅だが、毎年この時期になると、のどに詰まらせる事故が相次ぐ。特に高齢者は飲み込む力が弱くなっているため、注意が必要だ。消防は、餅を小さく切り、お茶や汁物でのどを湿らせてから、ゆっくりかんで食べるよう呼びかけている。万一詰まらせたときに備え、背中を強くたたくなどの応急手当てを家族で確かめておくことも大切だという。
cards.en: Mochi is an indispensable part of New Year's, but every year around this time, accidents in which people choke on it occur one after another. Elderly people in particular need to be careful because their ability to swallow has weakened. The fire department urges people to cut mochi into small pieces, moisten their throats with tea or soup first, and chew slowly as they eat. It is also important, it says, for families to go over first aid in advance, such as slapping the person firmly on the back, in case someone does choke.

cards.ja: 毎日のように口にする「ありがとう」も、もともとは感謝を表す言葉ではなかった。語源とされる「有り難し」は、存在するのが難しい、つまりめったにないという意味だったのだ。めったにない出来事を神仏の恵みと受け止めるうちに、やがて感謝の気持ちを表す言葉へと変わっていったと考えられている。

'Arigatashi,' regarded as its origin, meant that something was hard to come into being, in other words, rare. It is thought that as people came to receive rare events as blessings from the gods and the Buddha, it gradually turned into a word expressing feelings of thanks.

words.defJa: ふだん使わない道具や品物をしまっておく小屋や部屋。

cards.ja: 実家の庭の物置を開けると、古い扇風機や子どものころに乗っていた自転車が、ほこりをかぶったまま押し込まれていた。父は何でも「いつか使う」と言って、物を捨てられない人だった。一つ手に取るたびに思い出がよみがえり、片づけは一向に進まない。結局その日は、壊れたものをいくつか運び出しただけで終わってしまった。
cards.en: When I opened the storage shed in the garden of my parents' house, I found an old electric fan and the bicycle I rode as a child crammed inside, covered in dust. My father was the kind of person who could not throw anything away, always saying he would use it someday. Every time I picked something up, memories came flooding back, and the tidying made no progress at all. In the end, that day ended with me carrying out just a few broken things.

words.meaning: to show, to testify to (a fact); to tell (a story)
words.defJa: ある事実や状態を、はっきりと示す。また、話して聞かせる。

cards.ja: 古代の港町の跡から、大量の陶磁器のかけらが見つかった。その多くは遠く中国や東南アジアで焼かれたもので、当時この町が広い交易網の一部だったことを物語っている。研究チームは、かけらの産地と年代を一つずつ調べ、船がいつ、どこから来ていたのかを明らかにしようとしている。文字の記録がほとんど残っていない時代の暮らしが、小さなかけらから少しずつ見えてきた。
cards.en: Large quantities of ceramic fragments have been found at the site of an ancient port town. Many of them were fired far away in China and Southeast Asia, which shows that the town was part of a wide trading network at the time. The research team is examining the origin and age of each fragment one by one, trying to work out when and from where ships came. Little by little, life in an era that left almost no written records is coming into view through these small fragments.

words.meaning: yardstick, standard of judgment; ruler (measuring tool)
words.defJa: 長さを測る道具。また、物事を評価したり判断したりするときの基準。

cards.ja: 私たちはつい、年収や肩書きといった他人の物差しで自分の価値を測ってしまう。周りと比べて劣っていると感じるたびに、焦りや不安が募っていく。心理学の研究でも、他人との比較が多い人ほど生活への満足度が低い傾向が報告されている。自分にとって何が大切なのかを知り、自分なりの物差しを持つことが、心の安定につながるのかもしれない。
cards.en: We tend to measure our own worth by other people's yardsticks, such as income or job title. Each time we feel inferior compared with those around us, impatience and anxiety build up. Psychological research has also reported that people who compare themselves with others more often tend to be less satisfied with their lives. Knowing what matters to you and having a yardstick of your own may be what leads to peace of mind.

cards.ja: 試合終了まで残り数秒、ゴール前に上がったボールを途中出場の若手選手が頭で押し込んだ。その瞬間、スタジアムはものすごい歓声に包まれた。見知らぬ観客同士が抱き合い、涙を流す人もいた。十年ぶりの優勝を決めたこの一点は、地元の人々にとって忘れられない記憶になるだろう。

Spectators who had never met hugged each other, and some were in tears. This single goal, which clinched the first championship in ten years, will surely become an unforgettable memory for the local people.

words.meaning: to massage, to knead; to rub
words.defJa: 手で何度もつかんだり押したりして、やわらかくする。

cards.ja: 実家に帰ると、母はいつも「肩がこって」とこぼす。子どものころは、肩を揉むとお小遣いがもらえたので、喜んで引き受けたものだ。久しぶりに揉んでみると、母の肩は思っていたよりずっと細く、小さくなっていた。黙って手を動かしながら、離れて暮らした年月の長さを感じた。
cards.en: Whenever I go back to my parents' home, my mother always complains that her shoulders are stiff. As a child I was happy to take on the job, because I got pocket money for massaging her shoulders. When I massaged them for the first time in a long while, her shoulders were much thinner and smaller than I had imagined. Moving my hands in silence, I felt how long the years of living apart had been.

In front of the large rice pot, there are students who heap it up like a mountain and older customers who scoop out just a little. words.defJa: 質問したり答えたりすること。また、言い合い。

cards.ja: 禅の修行では、師と弟子が短い言葉を交わす問答が重んじられてきた。師の問いには決まった正解がなく、弟子は理屈で答えようとするほど行き詰まってしまう。そのため、意味の通じにくいやりとりを、今でも「禅問答のようだ」と言うことがある。だが本来の問答は、相手を言い負かすためではなく、思い込みを揺さぶるためのものだった。
cards.en: In Zen training, great importance has been placed on dialogues in which master and disciple exchange brief words. The master's questions have no set correct answer, and the more the disciple tries to answer with logic, the more stuck he becomes. That is why even today people sometimes describe a hard-to-follow exchange as being like a Zen dialogue. Originally, however, these dialogues were meant not to defeat the other person in argument but to shake up their assumptions.

words.defJa: 音や声が大きくてうるさい。また、細かいことまで口うるさい。

cards.ja: 隣の空き地で工事が始まってから、毎朝八時になると重機の音がやかましく響くようになった。在宅で仕事をしている身には、オンライン会議の相手の声が聞き取れないほどだ。管理会社に問い合わせると、工事は春まで続くという。仕方なく、近くの図書館の自習室に通う日が増えた。
cards.en: Ever since construction began on the vacant lot next door, the noise of heavy machinery has been booming loudly at eight every morning. For someone working from home, it is so bad that I cannot hear the other people in online meetings. When I asked the management company, they said the work would continue until spring. With no other choice, I have been going more and more often to the study room at the nearby library.

cards.enTarget: Ever since construction began on the vacant lot next door, the noise of heavy machinery has been booming loudly at eight every morning.

words.defJa: 日が暮れてから朝までの間。夜のあいだ。

cards.ja: 人手不足を背景に、二十四時間営業をやめるコンビニが増えている。夜間は客が少ないうえに働き手を集めにくく、店長が自ら深夜の勤務を続ける店も少なくなかった。夜間の営業をやめた店では、従業員の負担が軽くなり、売り上げもそれほど落ちなかったという。便利さと働く人の暮らしをどう両立させるかが問われている。
cards.en: Against the backdrop of labor shortages, a growing number of convenience stores are giving up 24-hour operation. At night there are few customers and workers are hard to find, and in quite a few stores the manager kept working the late-night shifts himself. Stores that stopped operating at night reportedly found that the burden on staff eased and sales did not fall very much. The question now is how to balance convenience with the lives of the people who work there.

cards.enTarget: At night there are few customers and workers are hard to find, and in quite a few stores the manager kept working the late-night shifts himself.

words.meaning: actor (especially on stage or in kabuki)
words.defJa: 芝居で役を演じることを仕事にしている人。

cards.ja: 歌舞伎の役者は、幼いころから舞台に立ち、踊りや発声を体で覚えていく。同じ演目でも、演じる役者によって観客の受ける印象はまったく違う。ある老舗の劇場では、若手の役者が主役を務める公演を毎年開き、次の世代を育てている。客席には、祖父母に連れられて初めて歌舞伎を見る子どもの姿も目立つ。
cards.en: Kabuki actors take to the stage from early childhood and learn dance and vocal technique with their bodies. Even in the same play, the impression the audience receives differs completely depending on the actor. One long-established theater holds performances every year in which young actors play the leading roles, nurturing the next generation. In the audience, many children can be seen watching kabuki for the first time, brought along by their grandparents.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.enTarget: Kabuki actors take to the stage from early childhood and learn dance and vocal technique with their bodies.

words.meaning: government office, public office (especially a city or ward office)
words.defJa: 国や市町村の仕事をする機関。また、その建物。

cards.ja: 引っ越しをすると、住所の変更や保険の手続きのために役所へ行かなければならない。窓口は平日の昼間しか開いていないことが多く、仕事を休んで出かける人も少なくなかった。最近はオンラインで申請できる手続きが増え、わざわざ足を運ぶ必要は減りつつある。それでも、高齢者を中心に、窓口で直接相談したいという声は根強い。
cards.en: When you move house, you have to go to the local government office to change your address and handle insurance procedures. Because the counters are often open only during weekday daytime hours, quite a few people had to take time off work to go. Recently more procedures can be done online, and the need to make a special trip is decreasing. Even so, there is still strong demand, especially among older people, to consult someone in person at the counter.

cards.enTarget: When you move house, you have to go to the local government office to change your address and handle insurance procedures.

words.defJa: 国や地方の公の機関で働く人。公務員。

cards.ja: 大臣が交代しても、政策の細部を実際に詰めるのは各省庁の役人たちだ。彼らは長い時間をかけて現場の事情を調べ、法律の条文を一字一句練り上げていく。ただ、国会答弁の準備で深夜まで働く生活が続き、若手の離職が増えていると報じられている。優秀な人材をどう確保するかが、行政の大きな課題となっている。
cards.en: Even when ministers change, it is the officials in each ministry and agency who actually work out the details of policy. They spend a long time investigating conditions on the ground and refine the text of laws word by word. However, it has been reported that, with working lives that run late into the night preparing answers for questioning in the Diet, more young officials are quitting. How to secure talented people has become a major challenge for the administration.

cards.enTarget: Even when ministers change, it is the officials in each ministry and agency who actually work out the details of policy.

words.defJa: 薬や、実験・工業などに使う化学的な物質。

cards.ja: 理科の実験室では、まず薬品の扱い方を厳しく教えられる。濃い塩酸や水酸化ナトリウムの水溶液は、皮膚に付くとただれるおそれがあり、保護眼鏡と手袋が欠かせない。使い終わった薬品も、そのまま流しに捨てることは許されない。種類ごとに決められた容器に集め、専門の業者に引き取ってもらう決まりになっている。
cards.en: In a school science lab, students are first taught strict rules for handling chemicals. Concentrated hydrochloric acid or sodium hydroxide solution can burn the skin on contact, so safety goggles and gloves are essential. Used chemicals may not simply be poured down the sink either. The rule is to collect them in designated containers by type and have a specialist contractor take them away.

words.defJa: その人や物が受け持っている仕事。果たすべきつとめ。

cards.ja: 私の職場では長年、会議の議事録をとるのは新人の役目とされてきた。発言を聞き漏らすまいと必死にメモをとっていると、議論の中身はほとんど頭に入らない。最近、発言を自動で文字に起こすソフトを導入したので、新人も議論に加われるようになった。記録の役目を機械に任せたことで、若手の意見が出やすくなったのは思わぬ効果だった。
cards.en: At my workplace, taking the minutes of meetings has long been considered the newcomer's job. When you are desperately taking notes so as not to miss a word anyone says, you barely take in what the discussion is about. Recently we introduced software that automatically transcribes what is said, so newcomers can now join in the discussion. Handing the job of record-keeping to a machine had an unexpected benefit: young staff now speak up more readily.

cards.enTarget: At my workplace, taking the minutes of meetings has long been considered the newcomer's job.

words.defJa: 熱い物や火に触れて、皮膚が傷つくこと。また、その傷。

cards.ja: 冬になると、湯たんぽや電気毛布による低温やけどの相談が増える。それほど熱く感じない温度でも、同じ場所に長時間触れていると、皮膚の奥まで傷つくことがあるという。特に感覚が鈍くなりがちな高齢者や、自分で寝返りを打てない乳児は注意が必要だ。専門家は、湯たんぽは寝る前に布団から出し、電気毛布も布団が温まったら電源を切るよう呼びかけている。
cards.en: In winter, inquiries about low-temperature burns from hot-water bottles and electric blankets increase. Even at temperatures that do not feel very hot, touching the same spot for a long time can reportedly damage the skin deep down. Elderly people, whose sensation tends to be dulled, and infants who cannot yet turn over on their own need particular care. Experts urge people to take hot-water bottles out of the bedding before going to sleep and to switch off electric blankets once the bed has warmed up.

cards.enTarget: In winter, inquiries about low-temperature burns from hot-water bottles and electric blankets increase.

words.meaning: night train or bus; traveling by night
words.defJa: 夜のうちに走る列車やバス。また、夜に移動すること。

cards.ja: 新幹線や格安航空が普及した今も、夜行バスの人気は根強い。夜遅くに出発し、眠っている間に目的地に着くため、宿代を一泊分浮かせることができるからだ。最近は座席を広くしたり、個室のように仕切ったりした車両も登場している。一方、かつて全国を走っていた夜行列車は、ほとんどが姿を消した。
cards.en: Even now that bullet trains and budget airlines are widespread, overnight buses remain popular. Because they leave late at night and arrive at the destination while you sleep, you can save the cost of a night's lodging. Recently, vehicles with wider seats or seats partitioned off like private rooms have appeared. Meanwhile, almost all of the night trains that once ran across the country have disappeared.

cards.enTarget: Even now that bullet trains and budget airlines are widespread, overnight buses remain popular.

words.defJa: 方向を示すために使う、矢の形をした記号。

cards.ja: 最新の車の中には、進むべき方向を示す矢印をフロントガラスに映し出すものがある。運転手は視線を前に向けたまま、次の交差点で曲がる方向を確かめることができる。画面に目を落とす時間が減るため、わき見運転による事故を防ぐ効果が期待されている。将来は、歩行者や自転車の位置まで知らせる機能も加わる見通しだ。
cards.en: Some of the latest cars project an arrow showing which way to go onto the windshield. The driver can check which way to turn at the next intersection while keeping their eyes forward. Because it cuts down the time spent looking down at a screen, it is expected to help prevent accidents caused by inattentive driving. In the future, functions that also alert drivers to the positions of pedestrians and cyclists are expected to be added.

cards.enTarget: Some of the latest cars project an arrow showing which way to go onto the windshield.

words.defJa: 薬を調合したり売ったりする店。

cards.ja: 処方箋を持って薬局に行くと、薬剤師から飲み合わせや副作用について説明を受ける。最近は、患者の服薬の記録を一か所で管理する「かかりつけ薬局」を持つよう勧められている。複数の病院から薬をもらっている高齢者は、同じ成分の薬を重ねて飲んでしまうおそれがあるからだ。薬局は、地域の健康を支える身近な窓口になりつつある。
cards.en: When you take a prescription to a pharmacy, the pharmacist explains drug interactions and side effects. Recently people are being encouraged to have a regular family pharmacy that keeps all of a patient's medication records in one place. This is because elderly people who receive medicine from several hospitals risk taking drugs with the same ingredients twice over. Pharmacies are becoming a familiar point of contact that supports the health of the community.

words.meaning: landlord, owner of a rented house
words.defJa: 人に貸している家や部屋の持ち主。大家。

cards.ja: 賃貸住宅を出るとき、壁の汚れや床の傷の修理費を誰が負担するかで、家主と借り手がもめることは珍しくない。国のガイドラインでは、普通に暮らしていて生じる日焼けや家具の跡などは、借り手が負担しなくてよいとされている。トラブルを防ぐには、入居した時点で部屋の状態を写真に残しておくことが有効だ。
cards.en: When moving out of rented housing, it is not unusual for landlords and tenants to argue over who should pay for repairing stains on the walls and scratches on the floor. Under national guidelines, tenants do not have to pay for things such as sun fading or marks left by furniture that arise from ordinary living. To prevent disputes, it is effective to take photos of the room's condition at the time you move in.

words.defJa: 紙や布などを引っぱって、さく。

cards.ja: 三歳の娘は、プレゼントの包み紙を丁寧に開けるということをしない。リボンをほどくのももどかしそうに、両手でびりびりと紙を破いてしまう。祖母は「せっかくきれいな紙なのに」と苦笑いするが、娘の目はもう中身に釘付けだ。破れた紙の山に囲まれて笑う顔を見ると、こちらもつい許してしまう。
cards.en: My three-year-old daughter never opens wrapping paper carefully. As if impatient even to untie the ribbon, she rips the paper apart with both hands. Her grandmother smiles wryly and says it is such pretty paper, but my daughter's eyes are already glued to what is inside. Seeing her laughing, surrounded by a pile of torn paper, I cannot help forgiving her.

words.defJa: かたくなくて、押すとすぐに形が変わる様子。

cards.ja: 落ち葉が厚く積もった森の土は、手で握るとほろりと崩れるほど軟らかい。土の中には多くのミミズや微生物がすみ、落ち葉や枯れた根を分解して植物の養分に変えている。一方、重い機械で何度も踏み固められた畑の土は硬くなり、水はけが悪くなって根が伸びにくい。そのため、森の土に近い状態を目指して、なるべく耕さない農法に取り組む農家も増えている。
cards.en: Forest soil thickly covered in fallen leaves is so soft that it crumbles when you squeeze it in your hand. Many earthworms and microorganisms live in it, breaking down fallen leaves and dead roots and turning them into nutrients for plants. By contrast, field soil packed down again and again by heavy machinery becomes hard, drains poorly and makes it difficult for roots to grow. For this reason, more farmers are adopting methods that till as little as possible, aiming for a condition close to that of forest soil.

words.defJa: 乗り物など、遊ぶための設備がそろっている場所。

cards.ja: 遊園地のジェットコースターには、多くの場合エンジンが付いていない。最初に巻き上げ機で最も高い地点まで引き上げられると、あとは重力だけで坂を下り、次の山を登っていく。高い所で蓄えた位置エネルギーが、下るにつれて運動エネルギーに変わるのだ。摩擦によって少しずつエネルギーが失われるため、後半の山ほど低く造られている。
cards.en: Roller coasters at amusement parks usually have no engine. Once the train has been hauled up to the highest point by a lift, it runs down the slopes and climbs the next hills using gravity alone. The potential energy stored at the high point turns into kinetic energy as it descends. Because energy is gradually lost to friction, the later hills are built lower.

words.defJa: 夕方に発行・配達される新聞。朝刊に対していう。

cards.ja: かつては多くの家庭で、朝刊と夕刊の両方を取るのが当たり前だった。夕刊には、その日の昼までに起きた出来事や株価の動きが載り、仕事帰りの楽しみにする人も多かった。しかし、ニュースをスマートフォンで読む人が増え、部数は大きく落ち込んでいる。ここ数年、地方紙を中心に夕刊の発行をやめる新聞社が相次いでいる。
cards.en: There was a time when it was taken for granted that many households subscribed to both the morning and evening editions. The evening paper carried events and stock price movements up to noon that day, and many people looked forward to it on their way home from work. However, as more people read the news on smartphones, circulation has dropped sharply. In recent years, one newspaper company after another, mainly regional papers, has stopped publishing an evening edition.

words.defJa: 郵便を使って送ること。

cards.ja: 大学入試の出願は、かつては願書を郵送するのが一般的だった。締め切り当日の消印まで有効とされる場合もあり、受験生が郵便局の窓口に駆け込む光景も見られた。現在はインターネットでの出願が主流となり、書類を郵送する手間はずいぶん減った。ただ、一部の証明書は今も原本を送らなければならない。
cards.en: It used to be standard to apply for university entrance exams by mailing in the application forms. In some cases, applications postmarked on the deadline day were accepted, and you could see examinees rushing to the post office counter. Today applying online is the norm, and the trouble of mailing documents has been greatly reduced. Even so, some certificates still have to be sent as originals.

words.defJa: 夏の午後から夕方にかけて、急に激しく降る雨。

cards.ja: 夕立は、俳句では夏を表す季語として親しまれてきた。真夏の午後、急に空が暗くなり、大粒の雨が激しく降ったかと思うと、一時間もしないうちにからりと晴れる。昔の人は、その雨が地面の熱を冷まし、夕方の涼しさを運んでくることを喜んだ。近年の局地的な豪雨とは違い、夕立にはどこか風情が感じられる。
cards.en: In haiku, the evening shower has long been cherished as a seasonal word representing summer. On a midsummer afternoon the sky suddenly darkens and big drops of rain pour down hard, and then in less than an hour it clears up completely. People of old welcomed the way that rain cooled the heat of the ground and brought the coolness of evening. Unlike the localized torrential downpours of recent years, the evening shower has a certain charm to it.

words.defJa: 夕方に西の空に沈んでいく太陽。また、その光。

cards.ja: 島の西側にある岬は、夕日の名所として知られている。その日も、日が傾き始めると、展望台にはカメラを構えた観光客が少しずつ集まってきた。太陽が水平線に近づくにつれて、海も空も橙色に染まり、あちこちから小さな歓声が上がった。最後の光が消えるまで、誰もがほとんど口をきかずに西の空を見つめていた。
cards.en: The cape on the west side of the island is known as a famous spot for watching the setting sun. That day too, as the sun began to sink, tourists holding cameras gradually gathered at the observation deck. As the sun neared the horizon, both sea and sky turned orange, and small cheers rose here and there. Until the last light faded, everyone gazed at the western sky, barely saying a word.

words.meaning: calmly, leisurely, unhurriedly; easily, with room to spare
words.defJa: ゆったりと落ち着いていて、急がない様子。

cards.ja: 水族館の大水槽では、体長八メートルを超えるジンベエザメが悠々と泳いでいる。巨大な体に似合わず、主な食べ物は小さなプランクトンで、人を襲うことはない。周りを小魚の群れがせわしなく行き来する中、その動きはまるで別の時間が流れているかのようにゆったりとしている。
cards.en: In the aquarium's giant tank, a whale shark more than eight meters long swims leisurely about. Despite its enormous body, its main food is tiny plankton, and it does not attack people. Amid schools of small fish darting busily around it, its movements are so unhurried that it seems as if a different time were flowing for it.

cards.ja: 2020年にレジ袋が有料になってから、エコバッグを持ち歩く人が目に見えて増えた。一枚数円とはいえ、毎回お金を払うとなれば、袋を断る客が増えるのは自然なことだ。国の調査では、一週間レジ袋を受け取らなかった人の割合が、約三割から七割余りに増えたという。ただ、プラスチックごみ全体に占めるレジ袋の割合はわずかで、効果を疑問視する声もある。
cards.en: Since plastic shopping bags began to carry a charge in 2020, the number of people carrying reusable bags has visibly increased. Even if it is only a few yen per bag, it is natural that more customers turn bags down when they have to pay every time. According to a government survey, the share of people who did not take a plastic bag for a whole week rose from about 30 percent to more than 70 percent. However, plastic bags make up only a small fraction of all plastic waste, and some question how effective the measure has been.

words.defJa: お湯や温かい食べ物などから、白く立ちのぼって見えるもの。

cards.ja: 湯を沸かしたときに立ちのぼる白い湯気を、水蒸気だと思っている人は多い。しかし、水蒸気そのものは目に見えない気体である。ケトルの注ぎ口のすぐ近くをよく見ると、何も見えない透明な部分があり、そこにあるのが本当の水蒸気だ。それが周りの冷たい空気に触れ、小さな水の粒に変わったものが、私たちの目に白く映る湯気なのである。
cards.en: Many people think the white steam that rises when water boils is water vapor. However, water vapor itself is an invisible gas. If you look closely right next to a kettle's spout, there is a transparent section where nothing can be seen, and that is where the real water vapor is. What we see as white steam is that vapor after it meets the cooler surrounding air and turns into tiny droplets of water.

cards.enTarget: Many people think the white steam that rises when water boils is water vapor.

words.defJa: 病気やけがの治療のために、ほかの人の血液を体に入れること。

cards.ja: けがや手術、がんの治療などで輸血を必要とする患者は、国内だけで年間約百万人にのぼるとされる。血液は人工的に作ることができず、長く保存することもできないため、献血に頼るしかない。ところが、献血をする人の多くは中高年で、若い世代の協力は年々減っている。少子高齢化が進めば、輸血に使う血液が足りなくなるおそれがある。
cards.en: Patients who need blood transfusions for injuries, surgery, cancer treatment and so on are said to number about one million a year in Japan alone. Blood cannot be manufactured artificially or stored for long, so there is no choice but to rely on donations. However, most blood donors are middle-aged or older, and cooperation from younger generations is declining year by year. As the birthrate falls and the population ages, there is a risk that there will not be enough blood for transfusions.

cards.en: As the shortage of truck drivers grows serious, concerns have been raised that the transport of goods could be disrupted. This is because a cap on drivers' overtime hours has made it difficult for one person to drive long distances. So a shift is spreading in which long-distance stretches are switched to rail or ships, with trucks handling only short distances. Combining transport methods in this way can reportedly also cut carbon dioxide emissions.

cards.en: In marathons, it is not unusual for a runner who has led until the final stretch to be overtaken. That is because the slight carelessness that creeps in the moment a runner feels sure of victory leads to a broken pace. One veteran runner reportedly makes a rule of never looking back until breaking the finish tape. The last kilometer is precisely the stretch that tests concentration the most.

The teacups for guests are kept on a separate shelf and brought out only when visitors come. Every time I go home and see that my own teacup is still there, I somehow feel a little reassured.

They have long been popular as gifts for weddings and for celebrations of long life. Recently, more sets come in the same size and differ only in color, rather than pairing a large cup with a small one. The section manager says this lets customers choose to suit the lifestyle of the person receiving the gift.

cards.en: Lava that overflows from the crater moves slowly down the slope while still hotter than 1,000 degrees. Its surface cools as soon as it touches the air and hardens into something like a black shell, but the interior stays liquid for some time. So at the front of the flow, the crust sometimes cracks open to reveal the glowing red material inside. Over decades, plants gradually take root on top of the lava once it has cooled and hardened.

cards.en: With the spread of generative AI, terms once used only by researchers have made their way into everyday conversation. For example, the phenomenon in which AI produces plausible-sounding errors is called 'hallucination,' and the word is now heard even in workplace meetings. But just because a term has spread does not mean its meaning is accurately understood. To use the technology properly, it is essential to check the definitions of such words at least once.

words.defJa: 入れ物の中に入れることのできる量。

cards.ja: 冷蔵庫を買い替えるとき、多くの人がまず確かめるのは容積だろう。売り場には四百リットルや五百リットルといった数字が大きく表示されているが、数字だけで選ぶと失敗することがある。同じ容積でも、棚の配置や冷凍室の広さによって、実際に入れられる量はかなり変わるからだ。購入前には、普段の買い物の量を思い浮かべながら、扉を開けて中を確かめておきたい。
cards.en: When replacing a refrigerator, the first thing many people check is probably its capacity. Showrooms display figures such as 400 or 500 liters in large print, but choosing by the numbers alone can lead to mistakes. That is because even with the same capacity, how much you can actually fit varies considerably with the shelf layout and the size of the freezer. Before buying, it is worth opening the doors and checking the inside while picturing how much you usually buy.

words.defJa: 考え方ややり方が子どもっぽく、未熟なようす。

cards.ja: 抽象画の展覧会では、「子どもでも描けそうだ」「幼稚な絵に見える」という感想をよく耳にする。しかし、画家たちの多くは若いころに写実的な技法を徹底的に身につけている。そのうえで、あえて線や形を単純にし、見る人の感覚に直接訴えかけようとしたのだ。一見幼稚に見える作品ほど、長い試行錯誤の末に生まれていることが少なくない。
cards.en: At exhibitions of abstract painting, one often hears remarks like 'even a child could paint this' or 'it looks like a childish picture.' Yet many of these painters had thoroughly mastered realistic techniques when they were young. Having done so, they deliberately simplified line and form, trying to appeal directly to the viewer's senses. Often, the works that look childish at first glance are the ones born of long trial and error.

cards.en: Drones, small unmanned aircraft, spread among the general public as tools for aerial photography and as a hobby. Today, however, their uses have expanded to spraying pesticides, inspecting bridges and assessing damage after disasters. Their greatest strength is that they can survey hard-to-reach places in a short time. At the same time, the more their uses multiply, the bigger the question of how to handle flight rules and safety becomes.

Having lost customers to large suburban stores and mail-order shopping, it had reportedly seen sales fall year after year. Regulars who heard the news have been coming by almost every day to say goodbye.

cards.en: The fallen leaves that cover the forest floor in autumn are eventually broken down by tiny soil creatures and fungi. The nutrients produced this way seep into the soil with rainwater and are drawn up by the trees' roots. It is said that if the fallen leaves are removed, the forest soil gradually becomes poorer. A single leaf becomes material for raising new buds the following spring.

It is thanks to these properties that your skin is less likely to feel sticky even when you sweat.

Reportedly, just getting into the habit of putting the screen away an hour before bed can noticeably change how you feel when you wake up.

cards.ja: 休日の朝、スマートフォンに上司から着信があり、システムの障害で会社に呼び出された。駆けつけると、すでに数人の同僚が原因の調査に取りかかっていた。復旧したのは夕方で、結局その日の予定はすべて取りやめることになった。こうした急な呼び出しが特定の人に偏らないよう、最近は当番制を取り入れる職場が増えている。
cards.en: On the morning of my day off, my boss called my smartphone, and I was summoned to the office because of a system failure. When I rushed over, several colleagues had already started investigating the cause. Service was restored in the evening, and in the end I had to cancel all my plans for the day. To keep such sudden call-outs from always falling on the same people, more workplaces have recently been introducing on-call rotations.

words.meaning: to come back (to mind), to be revived
words.defJa: 一度消えたり弱まったりしたものが、再びあらわれたり元気を取り戻したりする。

cards.ja: ある香りをかいだ瞬間に、忘れていたはずの記憶が鮮やかに蘇ることがある。においの情報は、感情や記憶に関わる脳の部位に直接届きやすいと考えられている。そのため、においと結びついた思い出は、写真を見たときよりも生々しく感じられるのだという。祖母の家の畳のにおいや、夏休みのプールのにおいに、心が一気に引き戻される人も多いだろう。
cards.en: The moment you catch a certain scent, a memory you thought you had forgotten can come back vividly. Information from smell is thought to reach the parts of the brain involved in emotion and memory relatively directly. That is said to be why memories tied to smells feel more vivid than those prompted by looking at a photograph. Many people probably find their minds pulled back all at once by the smell of tatami at their grandmother's house or of the pool during summer vacation.

words.meaning: to rejoice, to be glad (formal spelling used to offer congratulations on auspicious occasions)
words.defJa: めでたいことを祝って、うれしく思う。

cards.ja: 改まった手紙では、「喜ぶ」の代わりに、祝いの意味を持つ別の字が使われることがある。たとえばビジネス文書の冒頭には、「貴社ますますご清栄のこととお慶び申し上げます」という決まり文句がよく見られる。年賀状の「新春のお慶びを申し上げます」も、同じ使い方である。ただし「慶」の「よろこぶ」という読みは常用漢字表に含まれておらず、公用文や日常の文章では「喜ぶ」と書くのが一般的だ。
cards.en: In formal letters, the usual character for "to rejoice" is sometimes replaced with a different character that carries a sense of celebration. For example, business documents often open with the stock phrase, "I am delighted at your company's continued prosperity." The New Year's card greeting, "Please accept my best wishes for the New Year," uses it in the same way. However, the reading meaning "to rejoice" for this celebratory character is not included in the official list of common-use kanji, so official documents and everyday writing generally use the ordinary character.

words.meaning: coming to Japan, visit to Japan
words.defJa: 外国の人が日本にやって来ること。

cards.ja: 近年、インドから来日するエンジニアや留学生が増えている。日本企業の間では、デジタル化を進めるうえで、高い技術を持つ人材への期待が大きい。一方で、言葉の壁や住まい探しの難しさに戸惑う人も少なくない。受け入れる側が生活面の支援まで考えられるかどうかが、定着の鍵を握っている。
cards.en: In recent years, more engineers and students have been coming to Japan from India. Among Japanese companies, expectations are high for highly skilled people who can help push digitalization forward. On the other hand, many of the newcomers are bewildered by the language barrier and the difficulty of finding housing. Whether the host side can extend its support to daily life holds the key to whether they settle in.

words.meaning: failing (an exam or grade), being held back a year
words.defJa: 試験に受からないこと。また、成績が足りず上の学年に進めないこと。

cards.ja: 日本の小中学校では、成績が悪くても落第することはほとんどない。義務教育では、年齢に応じて進級させるのが原則だからだ。一方、大学では必要な単位を取れなければ留年となり、卒業もそれだけ遅れる。年齢で一律に進級させる仕組みについては、学力の定着という面から賛否両論がある。
cards.en: In Japanese elementary and junior high schools, students almost never have to repeat a year, even with poor grades. That is because the principle in compulsory education is to promote students according to their age. At university, on the other hand, students who fail to earn the required credits are held back, and their graduation is delayed accordingly. Opinions are divided on promoting everyone uniformly by age, from the standpoint of whether learning really takes hold.

words.defJa: 新聞や雑誌、書類などで、内容ごとに区切られた部分。

cards.ja: 新聞の投書欄には、毎日さまざまな世代の読者から意見が寄せられる。子育ての悩みや戦争の記憶、地域の小さな出来事など、記者の記事では拾いきれない声が並ぶのが魅力だ。担当者によると、この欄に載るのは届いた投書のごく一部で、内容だけでなく読みやすさも考えて選んでいるという。一通の投書が反響を呼び、社会の議論につながることもある。
cards.en: Every day, a newspaper's letters-to-the-editor column receives opinions from readers of all generations. Its appeal lies in the array of voices that reporters' articles cannot fully capture: worries about raising children, memories of war, small events in the community and more. According to the staff in charge, only a tiny fraction of the letters received appear in this column, and they choose them with an eye not only to content but also to readability. Sometimes a single letter strikes a chord and sparks a wider public debate.

cards.en: There has long been a view that people who handle things roughly also tend to lack consideration for others. The idea is that a person's state of mind shows even in small, unthinking actions such as slamming a door or tossing a bag onto the floor. Zen temple training places great weight on the proper way to clean and to eat because daily conduct has long been thought to shape the mind. Moving with care may be the first step toward putting one's inner life in order.

cards.en: In elementary school science classes, children do not just read textbooks; they actually grow plants and build circuits with batteries and miniature light bulbs. Results they have checked with their own hands tend to stay in memory better than knowledge learned from text. Yet some surveys find that the number of children who feel they are bad at science grows as they move up through the grades. How to keep alive the fascination they felt in experiments, even as calculations and memorization increase, is a challenge for those who teach.

cards.ja: 温暖化対策をめぐる国際会議では、毎回のように各国の利害が激しくぶつかる。排出削減を急ぎたい島国と、経済成長を優先したい新興国とでは、求めるものが大きく異なるからだ。資金の負担をどう分け合うかについても、先進国と途上国の主張はなかなかかみ合わない。それでも交渉が続くのは、利害を超えた共通の危機感があるためだろう。
cards.en: At international conferences on climate measures, the interests of different countries clash fiercely almost every time. Island nations that want to hurry emission cuts and emerging economies that want to prioritize growth are after very different things. On how to share the financial burden, too, the positions of developed and developing countries rarely mesh. That negotiations continue nonetheless is probably because of a shared sense of crisis that goes beyond those interests.

words.meaning: to abbreviate, to shorten; to omit
words.defJa: 言葉や手順などの一部をはぶいて、短くする。

cards.ja: 日本語には、長い言葉を略して使う習慣が根づいている。「スマートフォン」が「スマホ」に、「コンビニエンスストア」が「コンビニ」になったように、外来語は特に短くされやすい。四文字前後に縮めると言いやすく覚えやすいからだと、よく説明される。ただし、略した形が仲間内でしか通じない場合もあるので、相手を選んで使う必要がある。
cards.en: Japanese has a deep-rooted habit of shortening long words. Loanwords in particular tend to be clipped, just as 'smartphone' became 'sumaho' and 'convenience store' became 'konbini.' It is often explained that cutting a word down to around four kana makes it easier to say and remember. Sometimes, however, the shortened form is understood only within a particular group, so you need to consider whom you are talking to before using it.

words.defJa: 川に水が流れこむ範囲の土地。川の流れにそった地域。

cards.ja: 梅雨の終わりの大雨で、川の上流に降った雨が一気に下流へ押し寄せた。被害は川沿いの一つの町にとどまらず、流域全体に広がった。専門家は、堤防を高くするだけでは限界があり、森や田んぼに水をためる工夫も欠かせないと指摘する。最近は流域の自治体が連携して、洪水対策に取り組む動きが出てきている。
cards.en: In the heavy rains at the end of the rainy season, rain that fell on the upper reaches of the river surged downstream all at once. The damage was not confined to a single riverside town but spread across the entire river basin. Experts point out that simply raising the levees has its limits, and that measures to hold water in forests and rice paddies are also essential. Recently, municipalities in the basin have begun working together on flood countermeasures.

The union demanded a large raise to keep pace with rising prices, while management held to a cautious stance, saying the business outlook was uncertain. In the end, the two sides agreed to raise base pay by three percent. Many union members see it as a reasonable result, if not quite a satisfying one.

words.defJa: 外国に駐在して、自国民の保護や旅券の発行などの仕事をする役人。

cards.ja: 海外旅行中にパスポートをなくしたり、事件や事故に巻き込まれたりしたときに頼りになるのが、現地の大使館や総領事館で働く領事だ。領事は自国民の保護を主な仕事とし、帰国のための書類の発行や家族への連絡などを手伝ってくれる。ただし、ホテルの手配や弁護士費用の立て替えまでしてくれるわけではない。出発前に、渡航先の大使館や総領事館の連絡先を控えておくと安心だ。
cards.en: When you lose your passport while traveling abroad or get caught up in a crime or accident, the people you can rely on are the consuls working at the local embassy or consulate general. A consul's main job is protecting their country's citizens, and they can help by issuing documents for your return home or contacting your family. They will not, however, go so far as to book hotels for you or advance your lawyer's fees. It is reassuring to note down the contact details of the embassy or consulate general at your destination before you leave.

If the addressee or date is missing, the accounting department sends it back, so it is best to check it on the spot when you receive it. More and more companies now accept receipts as electronic data instead of on paper.

The next morning, every newspaper gave the earthquake prominent front-page coverage.

words.meaning: looking after the house while others are out; staying home alone

When I got back about an hour later, she reported with a slightly proud look that a delivery person had come but she hadn't answered the door. It was a day when I felt she had grown up a little.

cards.en: In the early Meiji era, the government lined the Ginza district with brick buildings in an effort to create a fire-resistant city. However, they did not suit Japan's humid climate, and they were reportedly not always popular with residents. Moreover, many brick structures collapsed in the Great Kanto Earthquake of 1923, after which reinforced concrete gradually became the norm. The red-brick warehouses and station buildings that still remain convey the ambitions of that era to the present day.

cards.ja: 欧州連合の出発点は、二度の世界大戦で争ったフランスやドイツなどが、石炭と鉄鋼を共同で管理しようとした取り組みにある。今では加盟国の間で人や物が自由に行き来でき、多くの国が共通の通貨ユーロを使っている。一方で、大事なことを自国だけで決められないという不満も根強く、二〇二〇年にはイギリスが離脱した。統合をどこまで深めるかは、今も連合の行方を左右する大きな問いである。
cards.en: The European Union traces its origins to an effort by France, Germany and other countries that had fought each other in two world wars to manage coal and steel jointly. Today people and goods move freely among its member states, and many of them use the single currency, the euro. At the same time, resentment at not being able to decide important matters on their own runs deep, and in 2020 Britain left. How far to deepen integration remains a major question for the union's future.

words.meaning: romanization; Japanese written in Roman letters
words.defJa: 日本語の音を、ABCなどのアルファベットで書き表したもの。

cards.ja: パソコンで日本語を打つとき、多くの人はキーボードからローマ字で読みを入力し、漢字に変換している。かな入力に比べて覚えるキーが少なく、英語の入力にも自然と慣れることができるからだ。一方、スマートフォンではフリック入力が主流で、若い世代にはパソコンのキーボードが苦手な人も少なくない。入力方法の変化は、文字との付き合い方そのものを変えつつある。
cards.en: When typing Japanese on a computer, most people enter the reading in romaji on the keyboard and then convert it to kanji. Compared with kana input, there are fewer keys to memorize, and you naturally get used to typing English as well. On smartphones, by contrast, flick input is the norm, and quite a few young people are uncomfortable with a computer keyboard. Changes in input methods are transforming our very relationship with written characters.

words.defJa: 音や声を、あとで聞けるように機械に記録すること。

cards.ja: あるバンドが、新しいアルバムを山あいにある廃校の木造校舎で録音した。スタジオと違って音が壁に吸い込まれすぎないため、教室ではピアノやギターの響きが柔らかく広がるのだという。窓の外から聞こえる鳥の声や雨音も、あえて消さずに残した。完成した作品には、その場の空気まで閉じ込めたような温かさがある。
cards.en: A band recorded its new album in the wooden building of a closed-down school in the mountains. Unlike in a studio, the walls do not soak up too much of the sound, so in the classrooms the piano and guitar are said to resonate softly and spread through the room. The band deliberately left in the birdsong and the sound of rain coming through the windows rather than removing them. The finished work has a warmth that seems to capture even the atmosphere of the place.

words.meaning: to argue, to discuss (a subject in depth)
words.defJa: 物事について、筋道を立てて考えを述べる。

cards.ja: 幸福とは何かを論ずるとき、私たちはつい収入や健康といった条件の話から始めてしまう。だが古代ギリシャの哲学者たちは、幸福を持ち物ではなく、人がどう生きるかという活動の問題としてとらえた。条件がそろっていても満たされない人がいる一方で、厳しい状況の中でも充実を感じる人がいる。この事実は、幸福を考える出発点そのものを問い直すよう私たちに迫っている。
cards.en: When we discuss what happiness is, we tend to start by talking about conditions such as income and health. The ancient Greek philosophers, however, understood happiness not as a possession but as a matter of activity, of how a person lives. There are people who are not fulfilled even when all the conditions are met, while others feel a sense of fulfillment even in harsh circumstances. This fact presses us to reconsider the very starting point from which we think about happiness.

words.defJa: 日本の、日本風の、という意味を表す。

cards.ja: 最近建てられるマンションでは、和室のない間取りが当たり前になりつつある。畳の手入れが面倒だと感じる人が多いことや、ベッドで寝る生活が定着したことが背景にあるようだ。その一方で、リビングの一角に小さな畳のスペースを設ける家も増えている。子どもが昼寝をしたり、洗濯物をたたんだりするのに便利だと好評だという。
cards.en: In newly built condominiums, floor plans without a Japanese-style room are becoming the norm. Behind this seem to be the many people who find caring for tatami a chore and the spread of a lifestyle of sleeping in beds. At the same time, more homes are setting aside a small tatami space in a corner of the living room. It is said to be popular as a convenient place for children to nap or for folding laundry.

words.defJa: 日本語と英語。特に、日本語の言葉に当たる英語を調べるための辞書。

cards.ja: 英語でメールを書くとき、和英辞典で単語を引いてそのまま並べても、自然な文になるとは限らない。日本語の一つの言葉に対して、場面によって使い分けるべき英語がいくつも載っているからだ。そこで最近は、例文の多い辞書や、実際に使われた文章を集めたデータベースを併用する人が増えている。どの言葉を選ぶかは、結局、文脈を読む力にかかっている。
cards.en: When writing an email in English, looking up words in a Japanese-English dictionary and simply lining them up does not necessarily produce natural sentences. That is because, for a single Japanese word, the dictionary lists several English equivalents that have to be chosen according to the situation. So more people these days also use dictionaries with plenty of example sentences, or databases of text that has actually been used. In the end, choosing the right word depends on your ability to read the context.

words.meaning: our ~, my ~ (e.g. our country, our home)
words.defJa: 自分の、自分たちの、という意味を表す。

cards.ja: 我が国では二〇二二年に改正民法が施行され、成人の年齢が二十歳から十八歳に引き下げられた。これにより、十八歳になれば親の同意がなくても、携帯電話の契約を結んだりローンを組んだりできるようになった。一方で、飲酒や喫煙ができる年齢は従来どおり二十歳のまま据え置かれている。若者が契約トラブルに巻き込まれないよう、学校での消費者教育の重要性が増している。
cards.en: In our country, the revised Civil Code took effect in 2022, lowering the age of adulthood from twenty to eighteen. As a result, eighteen-year-olds can now sign mobile phone contracts and take out loans without parental consent. On the other hand, the legal age for drinking and smoking remains unchanged at twenty. To keep young people from getting caught up in contract disputes, consumer education in schools is becoming increasingly important.

words.defJa: 年のわりに元気があり、いかにも若い感じがする様子。

cards.ja: 近所に住む八十代の男性は、毎朝五キロのジョギングを欠かさない。背筋がぴんと伸び、話し方にも張りがあって、とても八十を過ぎているようには見えない。本人によれば、若々しくいられる秘訣は運動よりも、毎日新しいことに興味を持つことだそうだ。体だけでなく、心の持ち方も見た目に表れるのかもしれない。
cards.en: A man in his eighties who lives in my neighborhood never misses his five-kilometer jog every morning. He stands perfectly straight and speaks with vigor, and he doesn't look at all like someone past eighty. According to him, the secret to staying youthful is not so much exercise as taking an interest in something new every day. Perhaps it is not only the body but also one's state of mind that shows in one's appearance.

words.defJa: 着物など、日本に昔から伝わる衣服。

cards.ja: 正月や成人式などの特別な日を除けば、今の日本で和服姿の人を見かけることは少ない。着付けに手間がかかるうえ、汚したときの手入れも大変だからだ。ところが最近、古着の着物を手頃な値段で買い、洋服のように気軽に着こなす若者が増えている。決まりごとにとらわれない自由な楽しみ方が、伝統に新しい風を吹き込んでいる。
cards.en: Apart from special occasions such as New Year's and coming-of-age ceremonies, you rarely see people in Japanese clothes in Japan today. That is because putting them on takes effort, and caring for them is a hassle if they get dirty. Recently, however, more young people are buying secondhand kimono at reasonable prices and wearing them casually, just like Western clothes. This free way of enjoying them, unbound by convention, is breathing new life into tradition.

cards.ja: 都心から郊外の古い一軒家に引っ越して半年がたった。駅まで歩いて二十分以上かかるため、不便な暮らしを覚悟していたが、住んでみると割合に快適だ。近くに大きなスーパーはないものの、週に二回、農家の人が軽トラックで朝どりの野菜を売りに来てくれる。都心にいたころより、季節の移り変わりに敏感になった気がする。
cards.en: Six months have passed since I moved from the city center to an old house in the suburbs. Because it takes more than twenty minutes to walk to the station, I had braced myself for an inconvenient life, but now that I live here it is relatively comfortable. There is no big supermarket nearby, but twice a week a farmer comes by in a small truck to sell vegetables picked that morning. I feel more attuned to the changing seasons than I did when I lived in the city center.

words.defJa: ある数を別の数で等しく分けると、いくつずつになるかを求める計算。

cards.ja: 小学校の算数で、多くの子どもが最初につまずくのが割り算だといわれる。整数の足し算や掛け算と違い、答えに余りが出たり、小数になったりするからだ。ある小学校では、クッキーを友達に同じ数ずつ分ける場面を実際に演じさせ、計算の意味を体で理解させている。式を覚える前に意味をつかむことが、その後の学習を支える土台になる。
cards.en: It is said that division is the first thing many children stumble over in elementary school arithmetic. That is because, unlike addition and multiplication of integers, the answer can leave a remainder or turn into a decimal. At one elementary school, children act out sharing cookies equally among friends, so that they grasp the meaning of the calculation physically. Grasping the meaning before memorizing formulas lays the foundation for later learning.

cards.ja: パン作りは難しそうだと思われがちだが、実際にやってみると割と簡単だ。材料は小麦粉と水、塩、イーストだけで、こねる時間も十分ほどで済む。生地を冷蔵庫に一晩入れておけば、発酵はゆっくり進んでくれる。朝、焼き上がったばかりのパンの香りが台所に広がると、それだけで少し得をした気分になる。
cards.en: People tend to think baking bread is difficult, but when you actually try it, it is fairly easy. The only ingredients are flour, water, salt and yeast, and kneading takes just about ten minutes. If you leave the dough in the refrigerator overnight, it will rise slowly on its own. In the morning, when the aroma of freshly baked bread fills the kitchen, that alone makes you feel a little lucky.

cards.ja: 全国高校駅伝で、初出場の公立高校が三位に入る快挙を成し遂げた。部員はわずか十二人で、練習場所も校舎の周りの坂道しかない。それでも選手たちは、毎朝の地道な走り込みで力をつけてきた。表彰台に上がった主将は、支えてくれた地域の人たちに恩返しができたと涙ぐんだ。
cards.en: At the national high school ekiden relay, a public high school making its first appearance achieved the remarkable feat of finishing third. The team has only twelve members, and its only training ground is the sloping road around the school building. Even so, the runners built up their strength through steady running every morning. Standing on the podium, the captain was moved to tears, saying they had been able to repay the local people who had supported them.

words.defJa: 地域や集団を表すことばのあとにつけて、その中で最もすぐれていること、または程度が最も大きいことを表す。

cards.ja: 山に囲まれたこの町は、桃の生産量で長年日本一を誇ってきた。しかし最近は農家の高齢化が進み、収穫の担い手が足りなくなっている。そこで町は、都会の若者が短い期間働きながら滞在できる制度を始めた。一番の座を守るための試みは、町に新しい人の流れも生み出している。
cards.en: Surrounded by mountains, this town has long prided itself on producing more peaches than anywhere else in Japan. Recently, however, its farmers have been aging and there are not enough hands for the harvest. So the town has launched a program that lets young people from the city stay for short periods while working. The effort to defend its number-one position is also bringing a new flow of people to the town.

words.defJa: 動物や植物などを集めて、人々に見せるために整えた場所。また、幼い子どもを預かる施設。

cards.ja: 植物園は花を眺めながら散歩を楽しむ場所という印象が強いが、実は研究機関としての顔も持っている。多くの植物園では、野生では絶滅のおそれがある植物の種子を保存し、育て方を研究している。中には、自然の中ではすでに姿を消し、園内でしか生き残っていない種もある。来園者の入場料は、こうした地道な活動を支える貴重な資金となっている。
cards.en: Botanical gardens are widely thought of as places to stroll and look at flowers, but in fact they also serve as research institutions. Many botanical gardens store the seeds of plants that are in danger of extinction in the wild and study how to grow them. Some species have already disappeared from nature and survive only within the gardens. Visitors' admission fees are a valuable source of funding for this steady work.

words.meaning: the end; it's all over, done for (after a conditional)
words.defJa: 物事が終わること。また、もう取り返しがつかない状態になること。

cards.ja: 完璧主義の人ほど、一度失敗したらもうおしまいだと思い込みやすいといわれる。小さなミスを人生全体の失敗のように受け止め、次の挑戦をためらってしまうのだ。心理学では、こうした極端な考え方を少しずつ修正していく方法が研究されている。失敗を書き留め、実際にはどんな結果になったかを振り返るだけでも、心の負担は軽くなるという。
cards.en: It is said that the more of a perfectionist someone is, the more easily they convince themselves that a single failure means it is all over. They take a small mistake as if it were a failure of their whole life and hesitate to take on the next challenge. In psychology, methods for gradually correcting such extreme thinking have been studied. Simply writing down one's failures and looking back at how things actually turned out is said to ease the burden on the mind.

cards.ja: 地方の工場への出張は三日間の予定だった。ところが最終日に大型の台風が近づき、帰りの飛行機が欠航してしまった。結局、ホテルでの滞在を二泊延長し、会社に戻れたのは出発から五日目の朝だった。その間、急ぎの仕事はすべてオンライン会議とメールで何とか乗り切った。
cards.en: My business trip to a regional factory was scheduled to last three days. But on the last day a large typhoon approached, and my flight home was canceled. In the end I extended my hotel stay by two nights, and it was the morning of the fifth day after I set out before I got back to the office. In the meantime, I somehow got through all my urgent work with online meetings and email.

cards.en: Under the state of emergency, the nightlife districts were nearly deserted after eight in the evening. words.defJa: ことばのあとにつけて、そういう状態に変わること、または変えることを表す。

cards.ja: 生成AIの普及によって、これまで人が担ってきた事務作業の自動化が急速に進んでいる。議事録の作成や問い合わせへの回答など、決まった手順の業務の多くはすでに機械に任せられるようになった。その一方で、AIが出した答えが正しいかを確かめる仕事は、むしろ増えているという。自動化が進むほど人間の判断の重みが増すというのは、皮肉なことだ。
cards.en: With the spread of generative AI, the automation of office work that people have handled until now is advancing rapidly. Much routine work, such as taking meeting minutes and answering inquiries, can already be left to machines. At the same time, the work of checking whether the answers AI produces are correct is reportedly growing. It is ironic that the further automation advances, the more weight human judgment carries.

words.defJa: 病院や学校で、専門ごとに分けた部門を表す。また、生物の分類の一つ。

cards.ja: 地方では小児科の医師が不足しており、夜中に子どもが熱を出しても診てもらえる病院が限られている。そのため、車で一時間以上かけて隣の市の救急外来に向かう家族も少なくない。こうした不安を和らげるため、夜間や休日に看護師などへ電話で相談できる窓口が全国に設けられている。すぐに受診すべきかどうかの目安を聞くだけでも、親の負担はずいぶん軽くなる。
cards.en: In rural areas there is a shortage of pediatricians, and only a limited number of hospitals will see a child who runs a fever in the middle of the night. As a result, quite a few families drive more than an hour to the emergency room in a neighboring city. To ease such worries, phone lines where parents can consult a nurse or other professional at night and on holidays have been set up nationwide. Just getting guidance on whether to seek care right away greatly lightens the burden on parents.

cards.en: When people think of summer high school baseball, many probably picture the fight songs ringing out from the stands. Each school's brass band plays a set tune every time a player steps up to bat, energizing the whole ballpark. In recent years more schools have also taken up anime songs and current pop hits. On the other hand, playing for hours under the blazing sun puts a heavy strain on band members' bodies, and preventing heatstroke has become an issue.

words.defJa: 名詞について、その範囲に入らないことを表す。

cards.ja: 新しい技術が登場すると、法律の整備が追いつかないことがある。空撮などに使われるドローンも、かつては一部の空域を除き、航空法による規制の対象外で、比較的自由に飛ばすことができた。2015年に首相官邸の屋上でドローンが見つかった事件をきっかけに法改正が行われ、飛行禁止の区域や必要な手続きが定められた。技術の進歩と安全をどう両立させるかは、立法にとって常に難しい課題である。
cards.en: When a new technology appears, the law sometimes fails to keep pace. Drones, used for aerial photography and other purposes, were once outside the scope of regulation under the Civil Aeronautics Act except in certain airspace and could be flown relatively freely. Prompted by an incident in 2015 in which a drone was found on the roof of the prime minister's office, the law was amended to establish no-fly zones and the necessary procedures. How to reconcile technological progress with safety is always a difficult problem for lawmakers.

cards.ja: 二十年前に旅先で出会った老夫婦のことは、今でも忘れ難い思い出として心に残っている。道に迷って途方に暮れていた私を、二人は自宅に招き入れ、温かい夕食まで用意してくれた。言葉はほとんど通じなかったが、身ぶり手ぶりで笑い合った夜のことはよく覚えている。見知らぬ人の親切が、人生観を変えることもあるのだと思う。
cards.en: The elderly couple I met on a trip twenty years ago still remain in my heart as an unforgettable memory. When I was lost and at my wits' end, the two of them invited me into their home and even prepared a warm dinner for me. We could barely understand each other's language, but I remember well that night we spent laughing together through gestures. I think a stranger's kindness can sometimes change one's whole outlook on life.

words.defJa: 新聞や雑誌などが出されること、また出される時期や回数を表す。

cards.ja: 新聞の夕刊を廃止する動きが全国で広がっている。かつては帰宅途中の会社員が駅の売店で買い求めたものだが、ニュースをスマートフォンで読む人が増え、部数は大きく減った。印刷や配達にかかる費用、配達員の人手不足も経営を圧迫している。各社は夕刊をやめる代わりに、電子版での速報や解説記事の充実を図っている。
cards.en: Moves to discontinue the evening editions of newspapers are spreading across the country. Office workers on their way home once bought them at station kiosks, but as more people read the news on smartphones, circulation has dropped sharply. The costs of printing and delivery, along with a shortage of delivery staff, are also squeezing the business. In place of the evening edition, each company is working to expand breaking news and explanatory articles in its digital version.

cards.ja: 十年以上続いた人気漫画の連載がついに完結し、単行本は全二十巻となった。最終巻の発売日には、早朝から書店の前に行列ができ、完売する店も相次いだ。作者はあとがきで、読者からの手紙に何度も励まされたと振り返っている。完結を記念して、来春には原画展が開かれる予定だ。
cards.en: The serialization of a popular manga that ran for more than ten years has finally concluded, and the collected edition stands at twenty volumes in all. On the release day of the final volume, lines formed outside bookstores from early morning, and one store after another sold out. In the afterword, the author recalls being encouraged time and again by letters from readers. To mark the conclusion, an exhibition of the original artwork is scheduled for next spring.

cards.ja: 近年、多くの水族館が絶滅のおそれのある生き物の繁殖に取り組んでいる。野生の個体を捕まえて展示するだけでは、自然界の生き物の数を減らしてしまうからだ。ある施設では、クラゲやサンゴを館内で何世代にもわたって育て、ほかの水族館に提供している。水族館は今、展示の場であるだけでなく、種を守る研究の拠点としての役割も担いつつある。
cards.en: In recent years many aquariums have been working to breed endangered creatures. That is because simply catching wild individuals and putting them on display reduces the number of creatures in the wild. One facility raises jellyfish and coral on its premises over many generations and supplies them to other aquariums. Aquariums are now taking on a role not only as places of display but also as bases for research to protect species.

cards.ja: 人口減少が続く地方の自治体では、首長たちが強い危機感を抱いている。若者が進学や就職で都市へ移り、税収が減る一方で、高齢者を支える費用は膨らんでいる。ある町の町長は、このままでは十年後に行政サービスを維持できなくなると訴えた。国に財源の見直しを求める声は、党派を超えて広がっている。
cards.en: In regional municipalities where the population keeps shrinking, local leaders feel a strong sense of crisis. While young people move to the cities for school or work and tax revenue falls, the cost of supporting the elderly keeps swelling. The mayor of one town warned that, if things continue as they are, it will become impossible to maintain public services in ten years. Calls on the national government to rethink funding are spreading across party lines.

words.meaning: period, stage, age (of development or history)
words.defJa: 名詞について、ある区切られた時間やその段階を表す。

cards.ja: 思春期の子どもが急に口数を減らし、親を避けるようになるのは珍しいことではない。脳の研究によれば、この時期には感情をつかさどる部分が先に発達し、衝動を抑える働きは二十代まで成熟し続けるという。親にとっては寂しい変化だが、自立に向けた自然な過程でもある。専門家は、無理に話を聞き出すより、いつでも相談できる雰囲気を保つことが大切だと助言する。
cards.en: It is not unusual for a child in adolescence to suddenly become less talkative and start avoiding their parents. According to brain research, during this period the parts that govern emotion develop first, while the ability to restrain impulses keeps maturing into one's twenties. For parents it is a lonely change, but it is also a natural process on the way to independence. Experts advise that rather than forcing children to talk, it is important to maintain an atmosphere in which they feel they can come to you at any time.

cards.ja: 日本の街角に並ぶ自動販売機は、技術の面でも進化を続けている。画面を備えた機種の中には、カメラで客の年齢や性別を推定し、おすすめの飲み物を表示するものがある。在庫の状況は通信で管理会社に送られ、補充の効率も大きく上がった。災害時には中の飲み物を無料で取り出せるようにした自販機も、各地に設置されている。
cards.en: The vending machines that line Japan's street corners keep evolving in technical terms as well. Some models with screens use a camera to estimate a customer's age and gender and display recommended drinks. Stock levels are sent over a network to the operating company, greatly improving the efficiency of restocking. Machines that can dispense their drinks free of charge in a disaster have also been installed in many places.

cards.en: With the end of the fiscal year approaching, people who seem a little run-down have become noticeable around the office. That is because handovers for personnel transfers have piled up on top of preparing the financial statements, and overtime has continued day after day. The section chief proposed that everyone pick one day this week to go home on time. According to the company doctor, even a short rest is quite effective in restoring concentration.

cards.ja: インドでは人口の約八割がヒンドゥー教を信仰しているとされる。多くの神々が崇拝され、地域によって祭りや食の習慣も大きく異なる。たとえば牛は神聖な動物とみなされ、牛肉を口にしない人が多い。一方でインドは、仏教やシク教、ジャイナ教が生まれた土地でもある。
cards.en: In India, roughly 80 percent of the population is said to follow Hinduism. Many gods are worshipped, and festivals and food customs differ greatly from region to region. For example, cows are regarded as sacred animals, and many people do not eat beef. At the same time, India is also the land where Buddhism, Sikhism and Jainism were born.

words.defJa: 文章で、横または縦に並んだ文字のひと続き。また、それを数えることば。

cards.ja: 一般的な原稿用紙は、一行二十字、一枚二十行の四百字詰めになっている。作文の授業では、段落の始めを一字下げ、句読点にも一マスを使うよう教わる。字数の制限がある試験では、この書き方に慣れているかどうかで時間の使い方が変わってくる。手書きの機会は減ったが、原稿用紙で何枚分という数え方は、今も文章の分量を示す目安として広く使われている。
cards.en: A standard sheet of manuscript paper holds 400 characters: twenty characters to a line and twenty lines to a sheet. In composition classes, students are taught to indent the start of each paragraph by one square and to give punctuation marks a square of their own as well. In exams with character limits, how familiar you are with this way of writing makes a difference in how you use your time. Opportunities to write by hand have dwindled, but counting length in sheets of manuscript paper is still widely used as a rough measure of how long a text is.

words.defJa: 動詞の連用形について、最後まで残らずすっかりそうするという意味を表す。

cards.ja: 家庭から出る食品ロスを減らすには、買った食材を最後まで使いきる工夫が欠かせない。大根の葉や野菜の皮も、刻んで炒め物やスープに加えれば立派な一品になる。週末にまとめ買いをする家庭では、冷蔵庫の中身を写真に撮ってから買い物に出かける人も多い。小さな習慣の積み重ねが、家計にも環境にもやさしい台所をつくる。
cards.en: To reduce food waste from households, it is essential to find ways to use up the ingredients you buy down to the last bit. Daikon leaves and vegetable peels, too, become a fine dish if you chop them and add them to stir-fries or soups. In households that shop in bulk on the weekend, many people take a photo of what is in the fridge before heading out for groceries. Small habits, accumulated, create a kitchen that is kind to both the household budget and the environment.

cards.ja: 外出先でスマートフォンが電池切れになり、困った経験のある人は多いだろう。地図も乗り換え案内も使えず、待ち合わせの相手に連絡することさえできない。最近は駅やコンビニでモバイルバッテリーを借りられるサービスが広がり、返却も別の場所でできる。それでも、念のため自分の充電器を持ち歩く人は少なくない。
cards.en: Many people have probably had the trouble of their smartphone's battery dying while they were out. They can't use maps or transit directions, and can't even contact the person they are meeting. Recently, services that let you rent a portable battery at stations and convenience stores have spread, and you can return it at a different location. Even so, quite a few people carry their own charger just in case.

cards.ja: 江戸時代の将軍家にとって、跡継ぎを確保することは政権の安定に直結する重大な問題だった。幼くして亡くなる子どもも多く、男子に恵まれない将軍もいたからだ。血筋が途絶えそうになると、親戚にあたる大名家から養子を迎えて家を継がせた。こうした仕組みが、二百六十年余り続いた政権を支えた一因とされる。
cards.en: For the shogun's family in the Edo period, securing an heir was a serious matter directly tied to the stability of the regime. Many children died young, and some shoguns were not blessed with sons. When the bloodline was in danger of dying out, a son was adopted from a related daimyo house to carry on the family line. Such arrangements are considered one reason the regime lasted more than 260 years.

cards.ja: 大相撲の土俵は、直径約四・五五メートルの円形に区切られている。力士は相手をこの円の外に出すか、足の裏以外の部分を土につかせれば勝ちとなる。土俵は本場所のたびに裏方の人たちが土を盛り、数日かけて手作業で仕上げる。わずかな高さや硬さの違いが取組に影響するため、作業には熟練の技が求められる。
cards.en: The ring in professional sumo is marked out as a circle about 4.55 meters in diameter. A wrestler wins by pushing his opponent outside this circle or by making him touch the clay with any part of his body other than the soles of his feet. Before every official tournament, backstage staff pile up the clay and finish the ring by hand over several days. Because slight differences in height or firmness affect the bouts, the work demands seasoned skill.

words.defJa: 名詞について、つながりのある一つのまとまりや、その流れをくむものを表す。

cards.ja: 太陽系には八つの惑星があり、地球は太陽から三番目の軌道を回っている。かつては冥王星も惑星に数えられていたが、2006年に国際天文学連合が定義を見直し、準惑星に分類し直した。海王星の外側では、冥王星と似た大きさの天体が次々と見つかっており、惑星として扱うと数が増え続けるおそれがあったためだ。教科書の記述が書き換えられたこの出来事は、科学の知識が常に更新されていくことを示している。
cards.en: The solar system has eight planets, and Earth travels in the third orbit from the sun. Pluto was once counted as a planet too, but in 2006 the International Astronomical Union revised the definition and reclassified it as a dwarf planet. Beyond Neptune, objects of a size similar to Pluto were being found one after another, and treating them as planets risked the number growing endlessly. This event, which led to textbooks being rewritten, shows that scientific knowledge is constantly being updated.

cards.ja: 首都圏への人口集中は、新型コロナの流行で一時は落ち着いたものの、再び強まっている。仕事や進学の機会を求めて地方から移り住む若者が多く、特に女性の転入が目立つ。一方で、通勤ラッシュや住宅費の高さに疲れ、郊外や地方へ移る家族もいる。国は企業の地方移転を後押ししているが、流れを大きく変えるには至っていない。
cards.en: The concentration of population in the greater Tokyo area eased temporarily during the coronavirus pandemic, but it is intensifying again. Many young people move in from the regions seeking job and educational opportunities, and the influx of women is especially notable. On the other hand, some families, worn out by rush-hour commutes and high housing costs, move to the suburbs or the countryside. The government is encouraging companies to relocate to the regions, but this has not significantly changed the flow.

words.defJa: 児童や生徒が学ぶ施設の数を数えることば。

cards.ja: 少子化の影響で、地方では小学校の統廃合が急速に進んでいる。ある市では、昨年度末に五校が閉校し、今春から一つの新しい学校に統合された。遠くから通う子どもたちのために、市はスクールバスを運行している。地域の拠点だった校舎をどう活用するかが、新たな課題となっている。
cards.en: Due to the declining birthrate, the consolidation of elementary schools is advancing rapidly in rural areas. In one city, five schools closed at the end of last school year and were merged into a single new school this spring. For the children who commute from far away, the city runs school buses. How to make use of the school buildings, which served as hubs for their communities, has become a new challenge.

cards.ja: 世界の貿易港では、取り扱うコンテナの量をめぐる競争が激しさを増している。かつてアジア有数の規模を誇った日本の主要港は、近隣国の巨大な港湾に順位で大きく引き離された。船の大型化に対応するには、岸壁の水深を深くし、荷物の積み降ろしを自動化する設備投資が欠かせない。港湾の競争力は、輸出入にかかる時間と費用を通じて、国の産業全体に影響を及ぼす。
cards.en: At the world's trading ports, competition over the volume of containers handled is growing ever fiercer. Japan's major ports, which once ranked among the largest in Asia, have fallen far behind the huge ports of neighboring countries in the rankings. To cope with ever-larger ships, investment that deepens the water at quays and automates the loading and unloading of cargo is essential. A port's competitiveness affects a country's entire industry through the time and cost of imports and exports.

cards.ja: ある科学雑誌が十月号でAIを特集したところ、発売から数日で完売し、異例の増刷が決まった。誌面では、文章や画像を生み出す仕組みから、雇用や著作権への影響まで幅広く取り上げている。編集部によると、読者の多くは専門家ではなく、仕事でAIを使い始めた会社員だという。反響の大きさを受けて、次号では読者から寄せられた質問に答える企画を予定している。
cards.en: When a science magazine ran a special feature on AI in its October issue, it sold out within a few days of going on sale, and an unusual second printing was ordered. The pages cover a wide range of topics, from how AI generates text and images to its impact on employment and copyright. According to the editors, most readers are not specialists but office workers who have started using AI in their jobs. In response to the strong reaction, they plan a feature in the next issue answering questions sent in by readers.

words.defJa: 時間や数を表すことばについて、そのたびに、その一つ一つにという意味を表す。

cards.ja: 新しい法律には、施行から一定の期間がたった後に内容を見直すという規定が盛り込まれることが多い。個人情報保護法も、技術の変化に対応するため、三年ごとに見直しを検討すると定めている。実際、この規定に基づいて改正が重ねられ、事業者の義務は少しずつ強化されてきた。社会の変化に法律が遅れないための工夫といえる。
cards.en: New laws often include a provision requiring their contents to be reviewed after a certain period has passed since they took effect. The Act on the Protection of Personal Information likewise stipulates that a review be considered every three years in order to keep up with technological change. In fact, it has been amended repeatedly on the basis of this provision, and the obligations of businesses have gradually been strengthened. It can be called a device to keep the law from falling behind changes in society.

words.defJa: 土地や国の名前について、そこでとれたりつくられたりしたものであることを表す。

cards.ja: 日本は国土の約三分の二が森林に覆われているが、使われる木材の多くは長く輸入に頼ってきた。戦後に植えられたスギやヒノキの多くが、今まさに切って使うのに適した樹齢に達している。手入れの行き届かない人工林は土砂災害の原因にもなるため、国産の木材を積極的に使う動きが広がっている。木を切って使い、再び植えるという循環が、森を健やかに保つ鍵となる。
cards.en: About two-thirds of Japan's land is covered by forest, yet for a long time the country has relied on imports for much of the wood it uses. Many of the cedar and cypress trees planted after the war have now reached just the right age to be cut and used. Because poorly tended plantation forests can also cause landslides, a movement to actively use domestically produced wood is spreading. A cycle of cutting trees, using them and planting again is the key to keeping forests healthy.

words.defJa: 名詞について、その分野や物事がたどってきた歩みや、それをまとめた記録を表す。

cards.ja: 哲学史を学ぶ意味は、昔の思想家の名前や主張を覚えることにあるのではない。ある時代の人々が何を当たり前とみなし、何に疑問を抱いたのかをたどることで、私たち自身の考え方の前提が見えてくる。たとえば、心と体を別のものとする見方は、長い議論の中で生まれたものだ。過去の問いを追体験することは、今を考えるための練習でもある。
cards.en: The point of studying the history of philosophy does not lie in memorizing the names and claims of thinkers of the past. By tracing what people of a given era took for granted and what they questioned, the assumptions behind our own ways of thinking come into view. For example, the view that mind and body are separate things emerged out of a long debate. Re-living the questions of the past is also practice for thinking about the present.

cards.ja: 和紙は、コウゾなどの木の皮の繊維をほぐして水に混ぜ、竹で編んだ道具ですくい上げて作られる。繊維が長く絡み合っているため薄くても丈夫で、千年以上前の文書が今も残っているほどだ。2014年には、その手すきの技術がユネスコの無形文化遺産に登録された。近年は照明や建築の素材としても注目され、海外の美術館の修復作業にも使われている。
cards.en: Washi is made by loosening the bark fibers of plants such as paper mulberry, mixing them into water, and scooping them up with a tool of woven bamboo. Because the long fibers are intertwined, it is strong even when thin, so much so that documents more than a thousand years old still survive today. In 2014, the craft of making it by hand was inscribed on UNESCO's list of Intangible Cultural Heritage. In recent years it has also drawn attention as a material for lighting and architecture, and it is used in restoration work at museums abroad.

cards.ja: 奈良にある法隆寺は、現存する世界最古の木造建築群として知られている。七世紀初めに建てられ、一度焼失したのちに再建されたとされるが、それでも千三百年以上の歴史をもつ。1993年には、日本で最初の世界文化遺産の一つに登録された。地震の多い国で長く建ち続けてきた理由は、建築の専門家にとっても興味深い研究対象である。
cards.en: Horyuji Temple in Nara is known as the oldest surviving group of wooden buildings in the world. It was built in the early seventh century and is said to have burned down once and been rebuilt, yet even so it has a history of more than 1,300 years. In 1993 it was registered as one of Japan's first World Cultural Heritage sites. Why it has kept standing for so long in an earthquake-prone country is a fascinating subject of research even for architecture specialists.

cards.en: Fifth period, right after school lunch, is said to be the sleepiest time of the day. That is because, on top of having a full stomach, fatigue from the morning starts to show. So one junior high school reworked its timetable to put more classes involving physical activity and experiments in this slot. According to the teachers, students' concentration now lasts longer, and dozing off has visibly decreased.

cards.en: A long-established inn in a hot spring town nestled in the mountains has carried out renovations that cut its guest rooms from twenty to twelve. Room rates went up, but bookings from overseas also increased, and the occupancy rate actually rose.

cards.en: During the pandemic, deliveries of new cars were badly delayed, and as a result used car prices rose sharply. Production stalled due to a semiconductor shortage, and people who needed a car right away turned to the used market. Japanese cars are also popular overseas, and even vehicles with high mileage are exported at high prices. Later, as the supply of new cars recovered, prices began to settle down.

According to a manager there, the younger the generation, the more strongly people tend to avoid work that disrupts their daily rhythm. cards.ja: 雨上がりの公園から戻ってきた息子は、頭の先から靴の中まで泥だらけだった。玄関で服を脱がせながら叱ろうとしたが、本人は捕まえたカエルの話に夢中で、こちらの小言など耳に入らない。洗濯は大変だが、こんなふうに服を汚して遊べるのも今のうちだと思い直した。
cards.en: My son came back from the park after the rain covered in mud from his head to the inside of his shoes. I tried to scold him as I pulled off his clothes in the entryway, but he was so absorbed in telling me about the frog he had caught that none of my nagging got through. The laundry is a chore, but I reminded myself that he can only play like this, getting his clothes filthy, while he is young.

cards.ja: 大学や研究機関の専門家でつくる調査団が、豪雨で崩れた山の斜面に入り、地盤の状態を詳しく調べた。調査団によると、地下にたまった大量の雨水が、土砂の崩落を引き起こした可能性が高いという。今後は周辺の住宅地にも同じ危険がないか、範囲を広げて確認を進める方針だ。
cards.en: A survey team made up of experts from universities and research institutions went onto the mountain slope that collapsed in the torrential rain and examined the condition of the ground in detail. According to the team, a large amount of rainwater that had built up underground most likely caused the landslide. It plans to widen its checks to see whether nearby residential areas face the same danger.

cards.ja: 引っ越しを機に、クローゼットの服を思い切って十着まで減らした。最初は着回しに困るかと心配したが、毎朝何を着るか迷う時間がなくなり、むしろ気持ちが軽くなった。持ち物を減らすことは、自分にとって本当に大切なものを見極めるための、ささやかな練習なのかもしれない。
cards.en: When I moved, I took the plunge and cut the clothes in my closet down to ten pieces. At first I worried I would struggle to mix and match, but the time I used to spend each morning agonizing over what to wear disappeared, and I actually felt lighter. Cutting down on possessions may be a small way of practicing how to see what truly matters to you.

cards.ja: 気象庁は、梅雨前線の停滞により、西日本を中心にこの先数日は大雨が続く見通しだと発表した。特に山間部では、局地的に非常に激しい雨が降るおそれがあるという。今月の降水量が、すでに平年の二倍を超えた地点もある。同庁は、土砂災害や川の氾濫に警戒し、早めに避難の準備をするよう呼びかけている。
cards.en: The Japan Meteorological Agency announced that, with the rainy-season front stalled, heavy rain is expected to continue for the next several days, mainly in western Japan. In mountainous areas in particular, there is a risk of very intense localized downpours. At some observation points, this month's rainfall has already exceeded twice the normal amount. The agency is urging people to stay alert for landslides and flooding rivers and to prepare early for evacuation.

cards.ja: この春、地元の小学校に赴任した校長は、毎朝校門に立って子どもたちを出迎えている。名前を呼んであいさつするうちに、表情から体調や悩みに気づくことも多いという。小さな変化を担任と共有し、早めに声をかけるのが学校の新しい方針になった。校長自身も、子どもたちと過ごす朝のひとときが一日の励みになっていると話す。
cards.en: The principal who took up the post at the local elementary school this spring stands at the school gate every morning to greet the children. The principal says that calling them by name and saying hello often makes it possible to notice from their faces how they are feeling or whether something is troubling them. Sharing small changes with homeroom teachers and speaking to children early has become the school's new policy. The principal adds that those morning moments with the children are a source of encouragement for the whole day.

words.defJa: 予定や記録を書きこむための冊子を表す。

cards.ja: スマートフォンで予定を管理する人が増えたいまも、年末になると書店には来年の手帳がずらりと並ぶ。手で書くと記憶に残りやすい、ページをめくれば一年を振り返れるなど、紙ならではの良さを挙げる人は少なくない。最近は、日記や家計簿を兼ねて使う若い世代も増えているという。
cards.en: Even now that more people manage their schedules on smartphones, bookstores fill up with rows of next year's planners at the end of the year. Many people point to the advantages of paper, such as things being easier to remember when written by hand, and being able to look back on the whole year by flipping through the pages. Recently, more young people are said to be using them as a diary and household account book as well.

This corner escaped wartime damage, and narrow alleys and wells still remain. Recently, young shop owners drawn to its atmosphere have begun renovating empty houses into cafes and general stores. On weekends, more and more people can be seen strolling around to enjoy the old streetscape.

cards.ja: 敬語の正しさ以上に大切なのは、相手との距離に合った言葉遣いだと言われる。丁寧すぎる表現はかえって冷たく響き、親しい間柄ではよそよそしさを生むこともある。反対に、初対面でくだけすぎると失礼に受け取られかねない。相手と状況を見ながら言葉を選ぶ感覚は、教科書だけでは身につかない。
cards.en: It is often said that more important than correct honorifics is a way of speaking that suits your distance from the other person. Overly polite expressions can actually sound cold, and between close friends they can create a sense of distance. Conversely, being too casual with someone you have just met can come across as rude. The feel for choosing words while reading the person and the situation cannot be learned from textbooks alone.

cards.ja: 温泉地の旅館では、二食付きの宿泊が定番だった。しかし最近は、夕食を町の店で楽しみたいと、朝食付きのプランを選ぶ客が増えている。宿の側にとっても、夕食の準備にかかる人手を減らせる利点がある。地元の飲食店と組んで食べ歩きの地図を配る旅館もあり、町全体のにぎわいにつながっている。
cards.en: At ryokan in hot-spring towns, stays with two meals included used to be the norm. Recently, however, more guests want to enjoy dinner at restaurants in town and choose plans that include breakfast only. For the inns, too, this has the advantage of reducing the staff needed to prepare dinner. Some ryokan team up with local eateries to hand out food-walking maps, which is bringing life to the whole town.

cards.en: In a survey of young employees, the most common workplace worry was that 'it is hard to voice my opinions to my boss.' Many apparently keep quiet, afraid that pointing out mistakes will hurt their evaluations. To change this atmosphere, some companies have started having newcomers speak first in meetings.

cards.ja: 紫キャベツを煮出した汁は、混ぜたものが酸性かアルカリ性かによって色を変える。透明なコップに汁を取り分けて酢を数滴垂らすと、紫色がたちまち鮮やかなピンクに変わった。別のコップの汁に重曹水を加えると、今度は青みを帯び、やがて緑色になった。身近な台所の材料だけで、化学の不思議を目で確かめられる実験だ。
cards.en: Juice from boiled red cabbage changes color depending on whether what you mix into it is acidic or alkaline. When I poured some into a clear glass and added a few drops of vinegar, the purple instantly turned bright pink. When I added baking-soda water to the juice in another glass, it took on a bluish tint this time and soon turned green. It is an experiment that lets you see the wonders of chemistry with your own eyes using only everyday kitchen ingredients.

cards.en: My daughter, a junior high school student, came home having scored ninety points for the first time on her end-of-term exam in math, a subject she had always struggled with. She says it was the result of re-solving problems a little every night and writing down in a notebook why she had gotten them wrong. More than the number itself, the experience of getting over a wall in her own way seems to have given her real confidence. Next, she says, she will try the same approach in English.

cards.en: India's long-distance trains have several classes, from air-conditioned sleeper cars to second-class unreserved carriages lined with hard seats. cards.en: On the main street in front of the station, construction is under way to cut the roadway by one lane and widen the sidewalk. Until now it was hard even for strollers and wheelchairs to pass each other, and at commuting hours the sidewalk overflowed with people. The city says that once the work is finished next spring, it plans to plant trees along the street and install benches as well. Local shopkeepers also hope that a street pleasant to walk along will bring in more customers.

From now on, the question will be not only whether the promise was kept but whether the city can assess how free lunches have changed the lives of families raising children.

cards.ja: 人の体内には、およそ二十四時間の周期で働く時計のような仕組みがある。この体内時計は朝の光を浴びることでリセットされ、睡眠や体温、ホルモンの分泌を調整している。夜遅くまでスマートフォンの画面の光を浴び続けると、そのリズムが乱れやすいことが研究で分かってきた。
cards.en: Inside the human body there is a clock-like mechanism that runs on a cycle of roughly twenty-four hours. This body clock is reset by exposure to morning light and regulates sleep, body temperature and the secretion of hormones. Research has shown that staying exposed to the light of a smartphone screen late into the night tends to disrupt that rhythm.

These days she happily tells us at every dinner about the songs she has learned at school and the names of her new friends.

cards.ja: 連休を利用して、山あいの温泉地に二泊三日で出かけた。初日は宿で地元の野菜を使った料理を味わい、二日目は渓谷沿いの遊歩道をゆっくり歩いた。夜には露天風呂につかりながら、都会ではまず見られない満天の星を眺めた。日帰りでは得られない、時間に追われない旅の良さを改めて感じた。
cards.en: Taking advantage of the long weekend, I went to a hot-spring town in the mountains for two nights and three days. Many families are trying to hold down spending by lowering the heating temperature or spending their time in a single room. Experts recommend measures that can be started relatively cheaply, such as insulating curtains and sealing gaps around windows.

cards.ja: 糖尿病や高血圧などの生活習慣病は、日々の食事や運動、睡眠、喫煙や飲酒の習慣と深く関わっている。初期には自覚症状がほとんどないため、気づいたときには進行していることも少なくない。年に一度は健康診断を受け、数値の小さな変化を見逃さないことが予防の第一歩だ。
cards.en: Lifestyle diseases such as diabetes and high blood pressure are closely tied to daily habits of diet, exercise, sleep, smoking and drinking. Because there are almost no noticeable symptoms in the early stages, it is not unusual for them to have progressed by the time people notice. Getting a health checkup once a year and not overlooking small changes in the numbers is the first step in prevention.

The yawns that slip out in front of others may actually be the body's way of fighting off drowsiness.

The next morning, a sea of clouds stretched out beyond the window, and the distant peaks were tinged red by the rising sun. It was a breathtaking view that made us forget the grueling climb of the day before.

cards.en: With more dual-income households, demand is rising for facilities that look after children after school. In urban areas, places fill up quickly, and many families are left waiting for an opening. In response, programs in which older local residents look after children in their own homes are spreading. Local governments have also begun to offer support, saying such programs create bonds across generations.
