cards.en: Article 32 of the Labor Standards Act limits working hours, as a rule, to 8 hours a day and 40 hours a week. As a rule, to have employees work beyond this, a company must conclude an agreement with a representative of the workers and file it with the Labor Standards Inspection Office. This agreement is called the '36 Agreement' after the number of the article it is based on. Since 2019, a legal cap backed by penalties has also been placed on overtime hours.

cards.ja: 雪の多い地方へ車で出かけるなら、冬用タイヤへの交換は欠かせない。夏用タイヤのままでは、路面がわずかに凍っただけでブレーキが効きにくくなり、坂道で立ち往生することにもなりかねない。高速道路では、大雪のときに冬用タイヤを履いていてもチェーンがなければ通れない区間もある。出発前には、天気予報と道路情報を必ず確かめておきたい。
cards.en: If you are driving to a snowy region, switching to winter tires is essential. On summer tires the brakes lose their grip once the road is even slightly icy, and you could end up stuck on a slope. On expressways, during heavy snowfall there are sections you cannot drive through without chains, even on winter tires. Before setting out, be sure to check the weather forecast and road information.

With the money saved, I can now take my family on a trip once a year.

cards.ja: この画家の晩年の作品は、若いころの明るい風景画と鮮やかな対照をなしている。画面の大部分は深い藍色で塗られ、人物の顔だけがかすかな光を帯びて浮かび上がる。批評家の多くは、戦争で家族を失った経験がこの変化をもたらしたと見ている。会場では両時代の作品を向かい合わせに並べ、その違いを体感できるよう工夫している。
cards.en: This painter's late works stand in striking contrast to the bright landscapes of his younger years. Most of each canvas is painted a deep indigo, and only the figures' faces emerge, faintly lit. Many critics believe that losing his family in the war brought about this change. At the exhibition, works from the two periods are hung facing each other so that visitors can feel the difference for themselves.

words.meaning: title (of a book, film, song, etc.)
words.defJa: 本や映画、歌などにつける名前。タイトル。

cards.ja: 外国映画が日本で公開されるとき、題名が原題とまったく違うものになることは珍しくない。直訳では内容が伝わりにくい場合、配給会社は観客の心をつかむ言葉を一から考え直す。中には、元の題名より日本語の題名のほうが有名になった作品もある。一方で最近は、原題をそのままカタカナにする例が増え、意味が分かりにくいという声も出ている。
cards.en: When a foreign film is released in Japan, it is not unusual for its title to be completely different from the original. When a literal translation would not convey the content well, the distributor works out from scratch words that will grab audiences. Some films have even become better known by their Japanese title than by the original one. On the other hand, more and more original titles are now simply rendered in katakana, and some people complain that the meaning is hard to grasp.

words.defJa: 列車の運行を、時刻と駅を軸にした線で表した図。運行計画。

cards.ja: 鉄道会社には、列車の運行計画を専門に作る部署がある。担当者は、横軸に時刻、縦軸に駅をとったダイヤグラムの上に、一本一本の列車を斜めの線として書き込んでいく。線の傾きは速さを表し、線どうしが交わる点は列車のすれ違いや追い越しを意味する。わずか一分の変更でも、ほかの多くの列車に影響が及ぶという。
cards.en: Railway companies have a department devoted to drawing up train operating plans. The staff plot each train as a diagonal line on a diagram with time on the horizontal axis and stations on the vertical axis. The slope of a line shows speed, and the points where lines cross mean trains passing each other or one overtaking another. Even a change of just one minute reportedly affects many other trains.

words.defJa: 炭素だけでできた、最も硬い天然の鉱物。宝石として価値が高い。

cards.ja: ダイヤモンドは、地下百五十キロより深いマントルの中で、高い温度と圧力によって炭素が結晶したものだ。それが地表まで運ばれてくるのは、主に地下深くから始まる火山の噴火で一気に押し上げられたときである。近年は、高温高圧の条件を装置で再現したり、ガスから結晶を育てたりして作る人工のダイヤモンドも量産されている。硬さや熱の伝えやすさを生かして工具に使われるほか、次世代の半導体材料としての研究も進んでいる。
cards.en: Diamonds are carbon that has crystallized under high temperature and pressure in the mantle, more than 150 kilometers underground. They reach the surface mainly when rapidly pushed up by volcanic eruptions that begin deep underground. In recent years, synthetic diamonds, made either by recreating high temperature and pressure in machines or by growing crystals from gas, have also been mass-produced. Thanks to their hardness and their ability to conduct heat they are used in tools, and research into them as a next-generation semiconductor material is also moving forward.

words.defJa: 回したり押したりして、番号や目盛りを合わせるための部分。

cards.ja: 昔の黒電話は、数字の書かれた穴に指を入れてダイヤルを回し、番号を一つずつ送る仕組みだった。9や0のように指を大きく回す数字ほど戻るまでに時間がかかり、番号によってかける手間がずいぶん違った。今の子どもたちに見せると、どう使えばいいのか分からず戸惑うことが多い。それでも、電話をかけることを「ダイヤルする」と言う表現は今も残っている。
cards.en: Old black telephones worked by putting a finger in the hole marked with a number and turning the dial, sending the digits one at a time. Numbers like 9 and 0, which meant turning your finger a long way, took longer to spring back, so the effort of calling varied quite a bit with the number. When today's children are shown one, they are often puzzled and do not know how to use it. Even so, the expression 'to dial' for making a phone call still survives.

words.defJa: 程度や価値、能力などを上のほうへ引き上げる。

cards.ja: 子どもの学ぶ意欲を高めるには、ほめ方にも工夫がいるという。テストの点数や頭の良さをほめるより、粘り強く取り組んだ過程を認めるほうが、難しい課題に挑み続ける子が育ちやすいことが研究で分かってきた。結果だけで評価されると、失敗を恐れて易しい問題ばかり選ぶようになるからだ。教員向けの研修でも、こうした声かけの練習が取り入れられている。
cards.en: Raising children's motivation to learn apparently takes some thought about how to praise them. Research has shown that recognizing the process of sticking with a task, rather than praising test scores or cleverness, tends to produce children who keep taking on difficult challenges. That is because children judged only on results come to fear failure and start choosing only easy problems. Training for teachers has also begun to include practice in this kind of encouragement.

words.meaning: I'm home; I'm back (greeting on returning)
words.defJa: 外から家に帰ったときに、家にいる人に向かって言うあいさつ。

cards.ja: 日本の家庭では、外から帰ると「ただいま」と言い、家にいる人が「おかえり」と応える。一人暮らしでも、誰もいない部屋に向かってこの言葉を口にする人は少なくない。返事がなくても、声に出すことで外の世界から自分の場所へ戻ったと気持ちを切り替えられるのだろう。あいさつは、相手のためだけにあるのではないのかもしれない。
cards.en: In Japanese homes, when you come back from outside you say 'I'm home,' and whoever is in answers 'Welcome back.' Even among people who live alone, quite a few say these words to an empty room. Even with no reply, saying it aloud probably lets them shift their mood from the outside world back to their own place. Greetings may not exist only for the sake of the other person.

words.defJa: とても短い時間のうちに。あっという間に。

cards.ja: ある地方の小さなパン屋が、閉店を知らせる手書きの貼り紙の写真をSNSに投稿した。投稿はたちまち拡散し、翌朝には開店前から店の前に長い行列ができた。遠方から車で駆けつけた客も多く、用意したパンは昼前に売り切れたという。ネットの力の大きさを改めて感じさせる出来事だった。
cards.en: A small bakery in a provincial town posted a photo of a handwritten notice announcing its closure on social media. The post spread in no time, and by the next morning a long line had formed in front of the shop before it even opened. Many customers rushed over by car from far away, and the bread prepared for the day reportedly sold out before noon. It was an event that brought home once again how great the power of the internet is.

words.meaning: to be built, to be erected
words.defJa: 建物などが新しくつくられて、その場所に立つ。

cards.ja: 駅前の商店街の跡地に、三十階の高層マンションが建つことになった。完成すれば千人以上が新たに暮らす計画で、地元では人口の回復を期待する声が上がっている。一方で、長年親しまれてきた古い店がなくなり、町の雰囲気が変わってしまうことを惜しむ住民も少なくない。再開発をどう進めるか、話し合いが続いている。
cards.en: A 30-story high-rise apartment building is to be built on the former site of the shopping street in front of the station. Once completed, it is planned to house more than a thousand new residents, and locals have voiced hopes that the population will recover. On the other hand, many residents regret that old shops loved for years will disappear and the character of the town will change. Discussions on how to go ahead with the redevelopment are continuing.

words.defJa: 和服を着るときにはく、親指とほかの指が分かれた布の靴下。

cards.ja: 着物を着るとき、足元に欠かせないのが足袋である。茶道や能の舞台では、汚れのない白い足袋が清潔さと礼儀を表すとされてきた。底にゴムを張った地下足袋は、今も建設現場の職人や祭りの担ぎ手に愛用されている。近年はつま先が二つに割れた形がおしゃれだとして、足袋をまねた靴が海外のファッション界でも人気を集めている。
cards.en: When you wear a kimono, the one thing your feet cannot do without is tabi. In the tea ceremony and on the Noh stage, spotless white tabi have long been regarded as a sign of cleanliness and courtesy. Rubber-soled jika-tabi are still favored today by construction workers and by people who carry portable shrines at festivals. In recent years the split-toe shape has come to be seen as stylish, and shoes modeled on tabi have become popular in the fashion world overseas as well.

words.defJa: 二つ重なること。二倍。また、二人用の大きさのもの。

cards.ja: 町の小さな食堂が、円安と電気代の値上がりというダブルパンチに苦しんでいる。輸入に頼る小麦や食用油の仕入れ値は二年前の一・五倍近くになり、店を開けているだけで光熱費がかさむ。店主は値上げに踏み切ったが、常連客が離れるのを恐れて上げ幅は最小限にとどめた。「もうけはほとんど出ない」と苦笑いする。
cards.en: A small neighborhood diner is struggling under the double blow of a weak yen and rising electricity bills. The purchase price of wheat and cooking oil, which rely on imports, has climbed to nearly one and a half times what it was two years ago, and utility costs pile up just from keeping the place open. The owner went ahead with a price increase, but kept it to a minimum for fear of driving away regulars. 'I make almost no profit,' he says with a wry smile.

words.defJa: 川の水をせき止めてためるために造った、大きな堤。

cards.ja: 山あいの川に大きなダムを造れば、洪水を防ぎ、発電や農業に使う水を確保できる。しかしその一方で、海から川をさかのぼる魚の通り道がふさがれ、下流へ運ばれるはずの土砂もせき止められてしまう。各地で海岸の砂浜がやせている原因の一つは、こうした土砂の不足だと指摘されている。最近は魚のための水路を設けるなど、自然への影響を抑える試みも進んでいる。
cards.en: Building a large dam on a mountain river can prevent floods and secure water for power generation and farming. On the other hand, it blocks the route of fish swimming upriver from the sea, and also holds back sediment that would otherwise be carried downstream. A shortage of this sediment has been pointed out as one reason beaches are shrinking in many places. Recently, efforts to limit the impact on nature, such as building channels for fish, have also been moving forward.

words.defJa: どうしようか迷って、なかなか決められない。思い切って行動できない。

cards.ja: 体の不調を感じながらも、病院に行くのをためらう人は多い。忙しくて時間が取れない、大したことはないと思いたい、といった気持ちが働くからだ。しかし、症状が軽いうちに受診すれば、治療は短く、費用も少なくて済むことが多い。迷ったときは、まず自治体の電話相談窓口を利用してみるのも一つの方法である。
cards.en: Many people hesitate to go to the hospital even when they feel unwell. Feelings such as being too busy to find the time, or wanting to believe it is nothing serious, come into play. Yet if you see a doctor while the symptoms are still mild, treatment is often shorter and cheaper. When in doubt, one option is to start by calling your local government's telephone advice line.

words.defJa: 身なりや生活、態度などにきちんとしたところがなく、しまりがない。

cards.ja: 在宅勤務が続くと、生活がだらしなくなりがちだと感じる人は多い。起きる時間が日ごとにずれ、気づけば一日中パジャマのまま過ごしていることもある。ある会社員は、毎朝必ず着替え、机に向かう時刻を決めたところ、仕事への集中力が戻ってきたという。小さな区切りを作ることが、気持ちの張りを保つ鍵なのかもしれない。
cards.en: Many people feel that when they work from home for a long stretch, their daily life tends to get sloppy. Their wake-up time drifts from day to day, and before they know it they sometimes spend the whole day in pajamas. One office worker says that once he made a rule of always getting dressed every morning and set a fixed time to sit down at his desk, his concentration at work came back. Creating small boundaries may be the key to staying on your toes.

cards.ja: 育児や介護と仕事を両立させるため、短時間勤務を選ぶ社員が増えている。勤務を一日六時間ほどに短くしても、正社員のまま働き続けられる企業が多い。ただ、仕事の量が減らないまま勤務時間だけが削られ、かえって負担が増したという声もある。制度を整えるだけでなく、業務の配分を見直すことが欠かせない。
cards.en: More and more employees are choosing shorter working hours so they can balance their jobs with raising children or caring for family members. At many companies, staff can keep working as regular employees even after cutting their day to about six hours. However, some say their burden has actually grown, because only their hours were cut while their workload stayed the same. Beyond simply putting the system in place, it is essential to rethink how work is distributed.

words.defJa: 手で細かく引き裂く。また、つまんで取る。

cards.ja: このサラダのこつは、レタスを包丁で切らずに手でちぎることだ。断面がでこぼこになるため、ドレッシングがよく絡むうえ、切り口が変色しにくいという。パンも同じで、ナイフで切るより手でちぎったほうが香りが立つと話すパン職人は多い。包丁を使わずに済むので、子どもと一緒に料理するときにもおすすめだ。
cards.en: The trick to this salad is to tear the lettuce by hand instead of cutting it with a knife. Because the torn edges are uneven, the dressing clings to them better, and the torn surfaces reportedly discolor less easily. Bread is the same: many bakers say it gives off more aroma when torn by hand than when sliced with a knife. Since no knife is needed, it is also a good method when cooking with children.

words.meaning: tip, gratuity; chip (e.g. a semiconductor chip)
words.defJa: サービスへのお礼として、料金とは別に払うお金。

cards.en: Since Japan has almost no custom of tipping, quite a few people are confused when traveling abroad. At American restaurants, it is standard to add roughly 15 to 20 percent to the bill. Lately, card terminals display a choice of tip amounts, and many customers reportedly find it hard to say no. It is reassuring to look up the going rate in a country before you travel.

words.defJa: 黒板に字や絵をかくための、白などの細い棒。

cards.ja: 黒板にチョークで書く授業は、日本の学校の見慣れた風景だった。しかし近年は、電子黒板やタブレットを導入する学校が増え、チョークの需要は年々減っている。それでも、手書きの文字には教師の考える速度が表れ、生徒もついていきやすいという意見は根強い。新しい道具と古い道具をどう使い分けるかが問われている。
cards.en: Lessons with the teacher writing in chalk on a blackboard used to be a familiar sight in Japanese schools. In recent years, however, more schools have introduced electronic whiteboards and tablets, and demand for chalk falls year by year. Even so, the view persists that handwriting reflects the pace of the teacher's thinking and is easier for students to follow. The question now is how to divide roles between the new tools and the old.

words.defJa: ある用事をするときに、それと一緒に別のこともできる機会。

cards.en: While I was out shopping, I stopped by the post office and mailed the letters that had piled up, all at once. Even if making a special trip is a hassle, it is no trouble when combined with another errand. These days, many people reportedly return library books on their way to work or pick up litter while out for a walk. Neatly stacking small errands may be the knack for keeping a busy life running.

cards.ja: 円安が進み、輸入品の値上がりが家計を圧迫している。通貨の価値は、金利差や貿易収支など、さまざまな要因によって日々変動する。最近では、国が発行するお金とは別に、ネット上でやり取りされる暗号資産も注目を集めている。ただ、価格の変動が激しく、日常の決済手段として定着するかどうかは見通せない。
cards.en: The yen has weakened further, and rising prices of imported goods are squeezing household budgets. A currency's value fluctuates daily depending on many factors, such as interest-rate differences and the trade balance. Recently, apart from money issued by governments, crypto-assets traded online have also been drawing attention. Their prices swing wildly, however, and it is hard to tell whether they will take hold as an everyday means of payment.

cards.en: In the Tokyo metropolitan area, it is not unusual for people to spend over an hour each way commuting. The time spent swaying in packed trains adds up to several hundred hours a year. The pandemic spread remote work and also prompted people to rethink the very meaning of commuting. On the other hand, a growing number of companies value the casual conversation and stimulation that arise in the workplace and are asking employees to come back to the office.

words.defJa: ちがう言葉を話す人の間に入って、話を別の言葉に言いかえて伝えること。また、その人。

cards.ja: 首脳会談では、それぞれの首脳の傍らに通訳が控え、発言を一つずつ訳していく。わずかな言い回しの違いが外交上の誤解を招きかねないため、通訳には語学力だけでなく、政治や歴史の深い知識が求められる。事前に資料を読み込み、担当する首脳の話し方や口癖まで頭に入れておくこともあるという。会談の成否を陰で支える存在だと言える。
cards.en: At summit meetings, an interpreter sits at each leader's side and renders every statement in turn. Because a slight difference in wording can cause a diplomatic misunderstanding, interpreters need not only language skills but also deep knowledge of politics and history. They reportedly study the materials thoroughly in advance, sometimes even learning the speaking style and pet phrases of the leader they work for. They can be called the people who quietly underpin the success of the talks.

words.defJa: 順位や程度などが、あるもののすぐあとに来る。

cards.en: India's population long ranked second in the world after China's, but according to United Nations estimates it overtook China in 2023 to become the world's largest. More than half of the population is said to be under 30, and an abundance of young workers is supporting economic growth. On the other hand, whether the country can provide enough jobs for the huge numbers of young people entering the workforce every year is a major challenge.

words.defJa: 話や知らせ、気持ちなどが、人から人へ広がって届く。

cards.ja: 災害の直後には、SNSを通じて現地の様子が瞬く間に伝わる。テレビや新聞より早く情報が届く一方で、真偽の確かめられていない投稿も同じ速さで広がってしまう。過去の地震では、動物園からライオンが逃げたという偽の情報が拡散し、混乱を招いた。情報を共有する前に、発信元を確かめる習慣が欠かせない。
cards.en: In the immediate aftermath of a disaster, news of conditions on the ground spreads in an instant via social media. While information arrives faster than through television or newspapers, unverified posts spread just as quickly. After one past earthquake, a false report that a lion had escaped from a zoo went viral and caused confusion. It is essential to make a habit of checking the source before sharing information.

Manufacturers have a responsibility to keep providing security updates over the long term.

words.meaning: to stumble, trip (over something); to suffer a setback
words.defJa: 歩いているときに足が物に当たって、転びそうになる。

cards.ja: 高齢者の転倒事故の多くは、外出先ではなく自宅の中で起きている。わずか数センチの段差や、床に置いたコードにつまずいて転び、骨折してしまう例が後を絶たない。足腰の筋力が落ちると、本人が思っている以上につま先が上がらなくなるという。家の中を片付けるとともに、日頃から軽い運動を続けることが予防になる。
cards.en: Many falls among older people happen not when they are out but inside their own homes. Cases keep occurring in which someone trips over a step of just a few centimeters or a cord left on the floor, falls and breaks a bone. When leg and hip strength declines, the toes reportedly lift less than people themselves realize. Tidying up the house and keeping up light exercise every day help prevent such falls.

cards.ja: 城の石垣は、大小さまざまな石を、セメントなどを使わずに積んで造られている。石の形や重さを見極め、互いにかみ合うように組むことで、数百年にわたり地震にも耐えてきた。それでも大きな地震で崩れることはあり、修復の現場では石を一つずつ番号で管理し、元の位置に戻していく。ただ、こうした技術を受け継ぐ職人は、今では全国でもわずかしかいない。
cards.en: Castle stone walls are built by stacking stones of all sizes without cement or any similar binder. By judging each stone's shape and weight and fitting them so that they interlock, the walls have withstood earthquakes for centuries. Even so, a major earthquake can still bring them down, and at restoration sites each stone is tracked by number and returned to its original position. However, only a handful of craftsmen across the country still carry on this technique.

cards.en: This year's art festival has taken water and memory as its theme, and about 50 artists and groups from Japan and abroad are taking part. In an old warehouse serving as a venue, works made from fishing gear that once sustained the port town are on display. One artist plays recordings of memories gathered from local people, inviting visitors to imagine the area's past. Because the theme is so clear, the works resonate with one another, giving the whole exhibition a single flow.

cards.ja: スーパーの棚には、低カロリーや糖質オフをうたう食品がずらりと並ぶ。ダイエット中の人には心強いが、表示だけを見て安心するのは危険だ。糖質を減らした分、脂質や塩分で味を補っている商品もあり、つい食べ過ぎれば結局は逆効果になる。大切なのは、成分表示を確かめ、食事全体のバランスを考えることだ。
cards.en: Supermarket shelves are lined with foods advertised as low-calorie or reduced-carbohydrate. They are reassuring for people on a diet, but it is risky to feel safe just by looking at the label. Some products make up for the reduction in carbohydrates by adding fat or salt for flavor, and if you end up eating too much of them, it backfires. What matters is checking the nutrition label and thinking about the balance of your diet as a whole.

words.defJa: 電気が送られてこなくなって、使えなくなること。

cards.ja: 大型の台風が上陸し、強風で倒れた木が電線を切断したため、各地で大規模な停電が起きた。一部の地域では復旧までに一週間以上かかり、住民は冷蔵庫も冷房も使えない暮らしを強いられた。電気が止まる事態に日頃から備えておくことの大切さが、改めて浮き彫りになった。この経験をきっかけに、太陽光パネルや蓄電池を備える家庭も増えている。
cards.en: A powerful typhoon made landfall, and trees toppled by the strong winds severed power lines, causing large-scale blackouts in many areas. In some places restoration took more than a week, forcing residents to live without refrigerators or air conditioning. The disaster highlighted once again the importance of preparing in everyday life for the power going out. Prompted by that experience, more households have also been installing solar panels and storage batteries.

cards.ja: 生成AIは、質問に対してもっともらしい文章を一瞬で作り出す。しかし、存在しない論文や判例をあたかも事実のように挙げることがあり、こうしたでたらめな回答はハルシネーションと呼ばれている。海外では、AIが作った架空の判例をそのまま裁判所に提出した弁護士が処分を受けた例もある。便利な道具だからこそ、出典を自分で確かめる姿勢が求められる。
cards.en: Generative AI produces plausible-sounding text in response to questions in an instant. However, it sometimes cites papers or court precedents that do not exist as if they were fact, and such made-up answers are called hallucinations. Abroad, there have been cases of lawyers being sanctioned for submitting fictitious precedents generated by AI directly to the court. Precisely because it is a convenient tool, users need to check the sources themselves.

cards.ja: 市内の公園にあるテニスコートが改修され、今月から再び利用できるようになった。表面は、水はけがよく足腰への負担が少ない人工芝に張り替えられた。平日の昼間は高齢者のサークル、夕方からは仕事帰りの会社員と、時間帯によって利用者の顔ぶれが変わる。予約はインターネットで受け付けているが、週末は数週間先まで埋まっているという。
cards.en: The tennis courts in a city park have been renovated and became available again this month. The surface was replaced with artificial turf, which drains well and is easier on the legs and back. Weekday daytimes bring clubs of older players, while evenings bring office workers on their way home from work, so the faces change with the time of day. Reservations are taken online, but weekends are reportedly booked up several weeks ahead.

cards.en: A major domestic automaker announced that it will begin trials of driverless self-driving taxis next spring. According to the company, for the time being the taxis will run only in areas with light traffic, with staff monitoring the vehicles remotely to ensure safety. As the aging of taxi drivers and the labor shortage grow more serious, the company aims to put the service into practical use within a few years.

cards.ja: 日本語の教科書では、「ありがとう」と言われたら「どういたしまして」と返すように教わる。ところが、実際の会話でこの表現を耳にすることはそれほど多くない。多くの人は「いえいえ」「とんでもない」などと軽く打ち消したり、笑顔でうなずいたりして済ませる。改まった響きがあり、親しい間柄ではかえって堅苦しく聞こえるからだろう。
cards.en: Japanese textbooks teach learners to reply 'you're welcome' when someone says 'thank you'. In real conversation, however, you do not hear this expression all that often. Many people simply brush the thanks off lightly with something like 'no, no' or 'not at all', or just nod with a smile. Perhaps it is because the phrase has a formal ring and can sound stiff between people who are close.

words.defJa: 日本や中国、インドなど、アジアの国々をまとめて指す言葉。西洋と対比して使われる。

cards.ja: 西洋の哲学が、世界を分析して言葉で説明しようとしてきたのに対し、東洋の思想は、修行や実践を通じて体で理解することを重んじてきた。坐禅やヨガの瞑想は、その代表的な例である。近年は欧米でもマインドフルネスとして瞑想が広まり、東洋の知恵が科学の言葉で語り直されている。二つの伝統は対立するものではなく、互いを補い合う関係にあるのかもしれない。
cards.en: Whereas Western philosophy has sought to analyze the world and explain it in words, Eastern thought has valued understanding with the body through training and practice. Zazen and yoga meditation are representative examples. In recent years meditation has spread in Europe and North America as mindfulness, and Eastern wisdom is being retold in the language of science. The two traditions may not be opposed at all, but rather complement each other.

words.defJa: 緊張したり期待したりして、心臓の鼓動が速く強くなる様子。

cards.ja: 人前で話す直前、胸がどきどきして手のひらに汗がにじむ。これは体が危険に備えて心拍数を上げる自然な反応で、恋をしたときやジェットコースターに乗ったときにも同じことが起きる。心理学の研究では、この胸の高鳴りを不安ではなく期待の表れだと捉え直すだけで、発表の出来が良くなるという結果も報告されている。
cards.en: Right before speaking in front of people, your heart pounds and sweat beads on your palms. This is a natural reaction in which the body raises its heart rate to prepare for danger, and the same thing happens when you fall in love or ride a roller coaster. Psychology research has even reported that simply reframing this racing heart as a sign of excitement rather than anxiety improves how well people perform in presentations.

words.defJa: 固いものが熱で液体になる。また、水などにまざって見えなくなる。

cards.ja: 地球温暖化の影響で、北極やグリーンランドの氷が急速に溶けている。陸の上の氷が溶けて海に流れ込むと、その分だけ海面が上昇する。一方、海に浮かぶ氷が溶けても海面はほとんど変わらないが、白い氷が減って暗い海面が広がると、太陽の熱が吸収されやすくなる。その結果、温暖化がさらに進むという悪循環が生じる。
cards.en: Because of global warming, ice in the Arctic and Greenland is melting rapidly. When ice on land melts and flows into the sea, sea levels rise by that amount. Melting sea ice, by contrast, barely changes sea levels, but as the white ice shrinks and more dark ocean is exposed, the sun's heat is absorbed more easily. The result is a vicious circle that accelerates warming.

words.meaning: all at once, suddenly (of laughter, crowds, fatigue)
words.defJa: 大勢の人や物、気持ちなどが、一度にたくさん押し寄せる様子。

cards.ja: 落語家が舞台の座布団に座って深々と頭を下げると、客席は静まり返った。何気ない世間話から始め、羽織を脱いで本題に入ると、登場人物の間の抜けた一言に会場がどっと沸いた。笑いの起きるところは日によって違うため、演者は客の反応を見ながら間の取り方を変えるという。同じ話でも、その日の客と一緒に作り上げていくところに落語の面白さがある。
cards.en: When the rakugo storyteller sat down on the cushion on stage and bowed deeply, the audience fell silent. He began with casual small talk, and once he slipped off his haori jacket and moved into the main story, the whole hall burst into laughter at one character's foolish remark. Because the laughs come in different places from day to day, performers reportedly adjust their timing while watching the audience's reactions. What makes rakugo fun is that even the same story is built together with that day's audience.

cards.en: A friend from my university days was coming to Tokyo on a business trip, so I decided to put him up at my place. Hotel prices have soared, and besides, I wanted to have a good long talk after so many years. We stayed up late reminiscing, and the next morning I saw him off at the station. Having a guest in your home takes preparation and consideration, but I realized again that it offers a warmth no hotel can match.

Unable to watch any longer, the department head proposed that, whatever else, we should try it once on a small scale. If a three-month trial run shows promise, the company will consider a full rollout. Sometimes it is faster to fix things as you go than to wait for a perfect plan.

words.defJa: 石油などから作られる、軽くて丈夫な合成繊維。

cards.ja: ナイロンは、1930年代にアメリカの化学メーカーが開発した世界初の合成繊維である。石炭と水と空気から作られる繊維として売り出され、絹より丈夫なストッキングが大ヒットした。その影響で、日本の主要な輸出品だった生糸の需要は大きく落ち込んだ。今ではナイロンは衣類だけでなく、歯ブラシや釣り糸など身近な製品に幅広く使われている。
cards.en: Nylon is the world's first synthetic fiber, developed in the 1930s by an American chemical company. It was marketed as a fiber made from coal, water and air, and stockings that were stronger than silk became a huge hit. As a result, demand for raw silk, then one of Japan's main exports, fell sharply. Today nylon is used widely not only in clothing but also in familiar products such as toothbrushes and fishing line.

cards.en: The tactic of keeping prices the same while reducing only the contents of products is spreading. In many cases, bags of snack food stay the same size while their net weight shrinks a few grams at a time. For manufacturers struggling with soaring raw-material costs, it is a desperate measure, but consumers persistently criticize it as a price increase in disguise. When shopping, it is worth checking not only the price but also the quantity on the label.

The man was drunk and is believed to have become angry at being cautioned. According to an association of rail operators, there are several hundred cases of violence against station staff every year, most of them by passengers who have been drinking. The companies have added more security cameras and are strictly enforcing a policy of always reporting any assault to the police.

Even so, when I stepped outside before dawn, the sun rose beyond a sea of clouds, and I forgot my exhaustion and the cold in an instant. I feel I finally understood why so many people keep making the climb despite the hardship.

cards.ja: 古い眼鏡のつるがぐらつくようになったので、近所の眼鏡店に持っていった。店員は小さなドライバーで、緩んでいたねじを手早く締め直してくれた。ねじは使っているうちに少しずつ緩むため、半年に一度は点検してもらうとよいという。料金は取られず、ついでにレンズまできれいに拭いてもらえた。
cards.en: The arm of my old glasses had started to wobble, so I took them to a nearby optician. The clerk quickly retightened the loose screw with a tiny screwdriver. Screws gradually work loose with use, so it is apparently a good idea to have them checked every six months. I wasn't charged anything, and they even cleaned my lenses while they were at it.

words.defJa: 首にかけて身につける飾り。

cards.ja: 海辺の町にある小さな工房では、浜で拾ったガラス片を磨いてネックレスに仕立てている。波にもまれて角が取れたガラスは柔らかな光を帯び、一つとして同じ色や形のものはない。職人は一つひとつに小さな穴を開け、細い革ひもを通していく。素朴な仕上がりが評判を呼び、今では海外からも注文が届くという。
cards.en: At a small workshop in a seaside town, bits of glass picked up on the beach are polished and made into necklaces. Glass tumbled by the waves loses its sharp edges and takes on a soft glow, and no two pieces share the same color or shape. The artisan drills a small hole in each one and threads a thin leather cord through it. The rustic finish has built a reputation, and orders now reportedly arrive even from overseas.

cards.ja: 日本ののこぎりは、引くときに木が切れるように作られている。押して切る西洋式に比べて刃を薄くでき、切り口が細くきれいに仕上がるのが特長だ。大工たちはさまざまな刃を使い分け、釘を使わずに木材を組み合わせる技を受け継いできた。最近では、その使いやすさが海外の職人の間でも注目されている。
cards.en: Japanese saws are made to cut wood on the pull stroke. Compared with Western saws, which cut on the push, the blade can be made thinner, and a distinctive feature is the narrow, clean cut it leaves. Carpenters have used a range of blades for different jobs and handed down the craft of joining timber without nails. Recently, their ease of use has been drawing attention among craftspeople abroad as well.

cards.en: On the first day of the long holiday weekend, the expressway was hit by heavy traffic jams from the morning on. For hours, cars could only crawl forward, and a trip that normally takes an hour reportedly took more than three. Experts point out that simply shifting departure to early morning or night avoids much of the congestion. If so many people still travel at the same time, it is probably because their days off are limited.

words.defJa: 相手の言葉に答えたり、同意したりするときに使う返事の言葉。

cards.ja: 日本語の「はい」は、必ずしも同意を表すとは限らない。電話や会議で相手が話している間に繰り返される「はい」は、多くの場合「聞いています」という合図にすぎないのだ。この違いを知らない外国人は、話がまとまったと思い込み、後で食い違いに戸惑うことがある。言葉の意味だけでなく、使われる場面にも目を向ける必要がある。
cards.en: The Japanese "hai" does not necessarily express agreement. The "hai" repeated on the phone or in meetings while the other person is talking is often nothing more than a signal meaning "I'm listening." Foreigners unaware of this difference may assume an agreement has been reached, only to be confused by a mismatch later. We need to pay attention not only to what words mean but also to the situations in which they are used.

cards.en: Every morning a little drama plays out in front of the nursery school gate. Some children cling to their mothers and won't let go, while others run off to their friends without even looking back. One child, coaxed by a caregiver, waves a small hand and finally manages to say "bye-bye," tears still glistening in their eyes. Even so, by evening that same child is waiting with a smile to be picked up, as if nothing had happened.

cards.en: Producing long reports that nobody reads for a weekly meeting is absurd. Responding to employees who felt this way, one company introduced a rule that materials must fit on a single page. As a result, preparation time fell to less than half, and the discussions reportedly became, if anything, more substantive. Reviewing procedures that exist only for form's sake may be the first step toward reforming the way we work.

cards.en: As autumn deepens, the sound of fallen leaves being swept can be heard from early morning in front of the houses along the street. The leaves gathered with a broom are usually bagged and put out for collection. Recently, more people reportedly mix the leaves into the soil as fertilizer and use them in their home gardens. A daily chore that seems tedious may also be a precious moment for feeling the seasons change.

cards.en: At the end of summer, local elementary school children took part in a beach cleanup. Wearing work gloves, they dropped piece after piece of plastic they had picked up into buckets. words.meaning: How do you do; nice to meet you
words.defJa: 初めて会った人にするあいさつの言葉。

cards.ja: 日本のビジネスの場では、初対面の相手に「はじめまして」とあいさつしながら名刺を差し出すのが一般的だ。名刺は両手で受け取り、すぐにしまわずに机の上に置いておくのが礼儀とされる。こうした作法は細かく見えるが、相手を尊重する気持ちを形にしたものだ。最近はオンライン会議が増え、画面越しに名刺を見せ合う光景も珍しくない。
cards.en: In Japanese business settings, it is common to hand over a business card while greeting someone you are meeting for the first time with "hajimemashite." It is considered polite to receive a card with both hands and leave it on the table instead of putting it away immediately. Such etiquette may look fussy, but it gives concrete form to respect for the other person. With online meetings on the rise, it is no longer unusual to see people showing each other their cards through the screen.

cards.ja: 画像認識のAIは、大量の写真から特徴的なパターンを学習することで、猫や犬を見分けられるようになる。ただし、学習に使うデータに偏りがあると、思わぬ誤りを犯すことがある。たとえば、雪の中で撮ったオオカミの写真ばかりを学ばせたところ、AIが動物の姿ではなく背景の雪を手がかりに判断するようになったという例が知られている。AIが何を根拠に答えを出しているのかを確かめる研究が、いま急速に進んでいる。
cards.en: Image-recognition AI becomes able to tell cats from dogs by learning characteristic patterns from huge numbers of photos. If the training data is skewed, however, it can make unexpected mistakes. In one well-known example, an AI trained only on photos of wolves taken in snow ended up judging not by the animal itself but by the snow in the background. Research into checking what an AI bases its answers on is now advancing rapidly.

words.defJa: 間違いや不可を表す、二本の線を斜めに交差させた印。

cards.ja: 日本の学校では、正しい答えに○、間違った答えに×をつけて答案を返すのが一般的だ。ところが、欧米の申込書などでは、選んだ項目の四角い欄に×を書き込むことが少なくない。そのため、日本人が英語の書類で「当てはまらない」つもりで×をつけ、まったく逆の意味に受け取られることがある。記号の意味も、文化によって同じとは限らないのだ。
cards.en: In Japanese schools, answer sheets are usually returned with a circle on correct answers and a cross on wrong ones. On Western application forms and the like, however, people often write a cross in the box next to the item they choose. As a result, a Japanese person may put a cross on an English document meaning "does not apply" and be taken to mean exactly the opposite. Even the meaning of a symbol is not necessarily the same from culture to culture.

cards.en: Accidents in which drivers start reversing in a parking lot without properly checking behind them keep happening. Many recent cars are equipped with a camera showing what is behind, but relying too heavily on the screen is also dangerous. The camera's field of view is limited, and a small child right behind the car may not be visible. Experts urge drivers always to combine the screen with a check by eye.

cards.en: When a spring is stretched or compressed, it produces a force that tries to return it to its original shape. That the size of this force is proportional to how far it is stretched or compressed was discovered in the seventeenth century and is still taught in junior high school science. Around us, springs are used in a surprising number of products, from ballpoint pens to beds and cars. They are inconspicuous parts, but they quietly support our daily lives.

cards.ja: 結婚の証として指輪をはめる習慣は、古代ローマにまでさかのぼるといわれる。左手の薬指が選ばれたのは、そこから心臓へ直接つながる血管が通っていると信じられていたからだ。もちろん医学的な根拠はないが、この言い伝えは今も多くの国で語り継がれている。日本でこの習慣が広く根づいたのは、戦後になってからである。
cards.en: The custom of wearing a ring as a sign of marriage is said to date back to ancient Rome. The ring finger of the left hand was chosen because people believed a blood vessel ran from it directly to the heart. There is of course no medical basis for this, but the legend is still handed down in many countries. In Japan, the custom took root widely only after the war.

Participants held up placards reading "Protect our livelihoods" and marched along the main avenues of the city center. The organizers stress that the rally has nothing to do with any particular party, but some are voicing concern about the spread of an anti-government movement. The government is expected to consider partly revising its plan soon.

words.defJa: 車や自転車の向きを変えるために、手で握って操作する部分。

cards.en: In Japan, close to forty percent of employees are said to be in non-regular employment, such as part-time or temp work. Such work offers flexible hours, but wages tend to be low and jobs insecure. When the economy turns down, it is often non-regular workers whose contracts are cut first. The government is building a system of equal pay for equal work, but closing the gap looks likely to take more time.

However, it had long been pointed out that the slight delay before the sound reached each athlete could affect their times. So at major competitions today, the standard method is to place a speaker behind each lane and deliver the starting signal to everyone at the same moment. In a world where hundredths of a second count, such fine adjustments are essential.

words.defJa: 体の働きを整えるために欠かせない栄養素の一つ。

cards.ja: 冬場は日光を浴びる時間が短くなるため、体内でビタミンDが不足しがちになる。ビタミンDは骨を丈夫にするだけでなく、免疫の働きにも関わっていることが分かってきた。鮭やきのこなどの食品から取り入れるほか、晴れた日には短時間でも外を歩くとよいという。サプリメントに頼る前に、まず食事と生活習慣を見直したい。
cards.en: In winter we spend less time in sunlight, so the body tends to run short of vitamin D. It has become clear that vitamin D not only strengthens bones but is also involved in immune function. Besides getting it from foods such as salmon and mushrooms, it is reportedly good to walk outside, even briefly, on sunny days. Before turning to supplements, we would do well to review our diet and daily habits first.

cards.ja: 民間の気象会社は、今年の桜が例年より五日早く開花すると予想していた。実際に気象台が標本木で開花を確認した日は、その予想とぴたりと一致した。近年は気温のデータを細かく分析することで、開花日の予測精度が大きく向上している。それでも、天候が急に変わる年には、数日のずれが生じることも珍しくない。
cards.en: A private weather company had forecast that this year's cherry blossoms would open five days earlier than usual. The day the meteorological observatory actually confirmed blooming on its sample tree matched that forecast exactly. In recent years, detailed analysis of temperature data has greatly improved the accuracy of bloom-date forecasts. Even so, in years when the weather changes suddenly, it is not unusual for forecasts to be off by a few days.

cards.ja: 山頂までの道のりは、思っていた以上に険しかった。急な岩場をようやく抜けたところで小さな山小屋が見え、私たちはそこで一息つくことにした。温かいお茶を飲みながら眺める谷の景色は、それまでの疲れを忘れさせるほど美しかった。小屋の主人によれば、山頂まではまだ半分ほど残っているという。
cards.en: The trail to the summit was far steeper than I had expected. Just as we finally got past a stretch of steep rock, a small mountain hut came into view, and we decided to take a breather there. The view of the valley as we sipped hot tea was so beautiful that it made us forget how tired we were. According to the hut keeper, about half the climb to the summit still lay ahead.

words.defJa: 完全ではないが、とりあえず。今のところは。

cards.ja: 来年度予算案の修正をめぐる与野党の協議は、深夜まで続いた末にひとまず決着した。焦点となっていた子育て支援の財源については、新たな税を設けず、既存の予算を見直して確保することで折り合った。ただ、具体的に何を削るのかはまだ決まっておらず、議論の火種は残ったままだ。
cards.en: Talks between the ruling and opposition parties over amending next fiscal year's budget ran late into the night before being settled for the time being. On the key issue of funding for child-rearing support, the two sides agreed to secure the money by reviewing existing budgets rather than creating a new tax. However, exactly what will be cut has not yet been decided, so the seeds of further dispute remain.

words.meaning: by itself; of its own accord; spontaneously
words.defJa: 誰も何もしないのに、自然にそうなる様子。

cards.ja: シマウマのしまやヒョウの斑点は、どのようにしてできるのだろうか。ある数学者は、二種類の物質が互いに働きかけながら広がると、均一だった状態から模様がひとりでに生まれることを理論的に示した。この考え方は長く仮説にすぎなかったが、近年、魚の皮膚の模様などで実際に確かめられつつある。設計図がなくても複雑な形が現れるという発想は、生命を理解する手がかりとして注目されている。
cards.en: How do a zebra's stripes and a leopard's spots come about? A certain mathematician showed theoretically that when two kinds of substances spread while acting on each other, patterns can arise by themselves out of an initially uniform state. For a long time this idea remained only a hypothesis, but in recent years it has increasingly been confirmed in real cases such as the patterns on fish skin. The notion that complex forms can appear without any blueprint is drawing attention as a key to understanding life.

cards.ja: レジ袋の有料化から数年がたち、買い物にエコバッグを持参するのはすっかり当たり前になった。それでも海岸を歩くと、波打ち際にはビニールの切れ端やペットボトルが数多く打ち上げられている。こうしたごみは紫外線や波で細かく砕け、魚や海鳥の体内に取り込まれて生態系に影響を与えるとされる。専門家は、使い捨てを減らす取り組みをさらに進めるべきだと指摘している。
cards.en: Several years have passed since stores began charging for plastic shopping bags, and bringing your own eco-bag when shopping has become completely normal. Even so, if you walk along the coast, you find countless scraps of plastic film and PET bottles washed up at the water's edge. This litter is broken into tiny pieces by ultraviolet light and waves, and is said to be taken into the bodies of fish and seabirds and to affect the ecosystem. Experts point out that efforts to reduce disposable items should be pushed further.

cards.ja: 生成AIの普及に伴い、データセンターの電力消費が急増している。中でも大きな割合を占めるのが、膨大な計算で熱を帯びたサーバーを冷やすための電力だ。最近では、空気の代わりに液体を循環させて効率よく熱を逃がす方式や、寒冷地に施設を建てて外気を利用する試みも広がっている。
cards.en: With the spread of generative AI, electricity consumption at data centers is rising sharply. A large share of it goes to cooling servers that heat up from enormous amounts of computation. Recently, systems that circulate liquid instead of air to carry heat away efficiently, and efforts to build facilities in cold regions to make use of the outside air, have also been spreading.

words.defJa: あらゆる分野の知識を項目ごとにまとめて解説した本。

cards.ja: かつて、多くの家庭の本棚には分厚い百科事典がずらりと並んでいた。子どもたちは宿題のたびにそれを開き、知らない国や動物、歴史上の出来事を調べたものだ。今ではインターネットで何でもすぐに検索できるため、紙の百科事典を新たに買う家庭はほとんどない。それでも、ページをめくるうちに思わぬ項目に出会う楽しさは紙ならではだという声も根強い。
cards.en: There was a time when the bookshelves of many homes were lined with thick encyclopedias. Children would open them for every homework assignment to look up unfamiliar countries, animals and historical events. Now that anything can be searched instantly online, hardly any families buy a new paper encyclopedia. Even so, many people still insist that the pleasure of stumbling on unexpected entries while turning the pages is something only paper can offer.

words.meaning: building (especially a large multistory office building)
words.defJa: 何階もある大きな建物。特に事務所などが入る高い建物。

cards.ja: 大正時代、東京の中心部には、鉄筋コンクリート造りの大きなオフィスビルディングが次々と建てられた。館内には銀行や商社のほか、食堂や理髪店まで入り、建物の中で一日の用事が済むことが評判を呼んだ。こうした建物の多くはすでに建て替えられたが、当時の外観の一部を残した新しい高層ビルも少なくない。
cards.en: In the Taisho era, large reinforced-concrete office buildings went up one after another in central Tokyo. Inside, they housed not only banks and trading companies but even restaurants and barbershops, and the fact that a whole day's errands could be taken care of within one building won them a good reputation. Most of these buildings have since been rebuilt, but quite a few of the new high-rises preserve part of the original facade.

words.defJa: 範囲や規模を大きくする。たたんである物を開く。

cards.ja: 創業七十年になる地方の小さな和菓子店が、三年前に始めたネット販売で販路を全国に広げた。きっかけは、店を継いだ孫が商品の写真を交流サイトに投稿したことだった。今では注文の半分以上が県外からで、海外からの問い合わせも届くようになった。店主は「先代が守ってきた味を、より多くの人に届けたい」と話している。
cards.en: A small Japanese confectionery shop in the countryside, founded seventy years ago, has expanded its sales nationwide through online sales it started three years ago. It all began when the grandchild who took over the shop posted photos of the sweets on social media. Today more than half of its orders come from outside the prefecture, and inquiries have even started arriving from abroad. The owner says, 'I want to bring the flavor the previous owner preserved to more people.'

cards.ja: 動物園で人気のフラミンゴは、鮮やかなピンクの羽で知られている。しかし、生まれつきあの色をしているわけではなく、生まれたばかりのひなは灰色の羽毛に覆われている。羽の色は、餌となる藻や小さなエビに含まれる色素が体にたまることで生まれるのだ。そのため飼育下では、餌の色素が不足すると、だんだん色があせてしまうという。
cards.en: Flamingos, popular at zoos, are known for their vivid pink feathers. They are not born that color, however; newly hatched chicks are covered in gray down. The color of their feathers comes from pigments in the algae and small shrimp they eat, which build up in their bodies. That is why, in captivity, their color gradually fades if their feed lacks sufficient pigment.

cards.ja: 課税事業者が消費者向けに出す店頭の値札やチラシでは、消費税を含めた総額を表示することが法律で義務づけられている。以前は税抜き価格だけを大きく示す店も多く、レジで思ったより高いと感じた人も少なくなかった。総額表示が徹底されたことで、買い物の際に支払額が一目で分かるようになった。一方、事業者の側からは、値上げしたような印象を与えやすいという声も聞かれる。
cards.en: By law, consumer-facing price tags and flyers from taxable businesses must show the total price including consumption tax. In the past, many stores displayed only the pre-tax price prominently, and quite a few people felt things cost more than expected at the register. Now that total-price display is strictly enforced, shoppers can see at a glance how much they will pay. Businesses, on the other hand, say it tends to give the impression that prices have gone up.

cards.ja: 夏休みに入ると、市民プールは連日、子どもたちでにぎわう。監視員が特に目を光らせているのは、友達同士でふざけて相手を水に沈めたり、プールサイドを走り回ったりする行動だ。本人たちにとっては遊びの延長でも、水の中ではほんの数秒の油断が命取りになりかねない。そのため監視員は、少しでも危ない様子を見かけたら、すぐに笛を吹いて注意するよう心がけているという。
cards.en: Once summer vacation begins, public pools are crowded with children every day. What lifeguards watch most closely for is friends fooling around, pushing each other under the water or running around the poolside. To the children it may just be an extension of play, but in the water a few seconds of carelessness can prove fatal. That is why lifeguards make a point of blowing their whistles and warning children the moment they see anything even slightly dangerous.

These days, instead of complaints, I get to hear him boast about it every day.

Wind chimes are said to have begun as charms against evil, but today they are loved as a sign of summer that lets you enjoy coolness through your eyes and ears.

For dirt between the teeth, a special small brush or dental floss is effective.

cards.ja: 都市部の駅では、プラットホームからの転落事故を防ぐため、ホームドアの設置が急ピッチで進んでいる。特に目の不自由な人にとって、端に柵のないホームは、手すりのない橋を渡るようなものだと言われるほど危険だ。一方で、車両によってドアの位置が異なる路線では設置が難しく、鉄道各社は開口部の広い新しいタイプのドアの開発を進めている。
cards.en: At urban stations, platform screen doors are being installed at a rapid pace to prevent people from falling off the platform. Especially for people with visual impairments, a platform with no barrier at its edge is so dangerous that it is said to be like crossing a bridge without handrails. On lines where door positions vary from train to train, however, installation is difficult, so railway companies are developing new types of doors with wider openings.

words.defJa: 会社などに所属せず、自分で仕事を受けて働くこと。また、制限がないこと。

cards.ja: 雑誌の編集部を辞めてフリーになった先輩は、最初の一年は収入が半分以下に落ちたと笑う。それでも、自分で企画を立て、取材先を選べる自由は何ものにも代えがたいそうだ。ただ、病気やけがで仕事ができなくなれば、たちまち収入が途絶えてしまう。会社員時代には意識しなかった保障の大切さを、今になって痛感しているという。
cards.en: A former senior colleague of mine who left a magazine's editorial department to go freelance laughs that their income fell to less than half in the first year. Even so, they say the freedom to plan their own projects and choose whom to interview is worth more than anything. But if illness or injury kept them from working, their income would dry up at once. They say they now keenly feel the importance of the safety net they never thought about as a company employee.

In households where both parents work, it is not unusual to find a crumpled sheet at the bottom of a child's school bag and realize that the deadline for handing something in passed long ago. To reduce this burden, more and more schools are moving notices and handouts onto an app.

cards.en: In recent years, second-hand clothing has been growing popular again among the younger generation. Its appeal reportedly lies in a faded texture that new clothes lack and the individuality that comes with one-of-a-kind pieces. As mass production and mass disposal come to be seen as problems, more people are also choosing used clothes on the grounds that wearing clothes for a long time is a way of caring for the environment. The fact that such clothes can now be bought and sold easily on flea-market apps, not just in specialty shops, is also boosting their popularity.

The town had changed, but the scenery my body remembered had not faded in the least.

cards.en: In the farming villages of cold northeastern Japan, where cotton grew poorly, people once never threw away precious cloth, patching it again and again and using it for decades. The rags produced this way were long tucked away out of sight as a symbol of poverty. In recent years, however, the beauty of their many layers of indigo cloth has drawn attention abroad, to the point that they are exhibited in art museums. Cloth born of everyday ingenuity is now discussed as art.

No wonder so many astronauts who have looked at the Earth from outside say they were astonished by how thin it is.

Perhaps the people close to us see through what lies behind our vague answers more than we expect.

words.defJa: 細長いものを、ほかの物のまわりにぐるぐると回してつける。また、うずの形になる。

cards.ja: 扇風機や洗濯機を動かすモーターの中には、細い銅線を何百回も巻いたコイルが入っている。そこに電流を流すとコイルは電磁石となり、周りに置かれた磁石と引き合ったり反発したりして軸が回る。巻く回数を増やすほど磁力は強くなるが、その分モーターは重く大きくなってしまう。そのため各メーカーは、限られた空間に線を隙間なくきれいに巻く技術を競い合っている。
cards.en: Inside the motors that drive electric fans and washing machines is a coil of thin copper wire wound hundreds of times. When current flows through it, the coil becomes an electromagnet, attracting and repelling the magnets placed around it so that the shaft turns. The more turns you wind, the stronger the magnetic force, but the heavier and bulkier the motor becomes. That is why manufacturers compete over techniques for winding the wire neatly and without gaps into a limited space.

There was also a practical reason: in old wooden houses, a worn threshold made the sliding doors run poorly. Even casual etiquette hides the wisdom of daily life.

words.defJa: 目をおおって、開けたり閉じたりする皮膚の部分。

cards.ja: パソコンに向かう時間が長い日が続くと、まぶたがぴくぴくと勝手に動くことがある。多くは目の疲れや睡眠不足、ストレスによる一時的なもので、しっかり休めば自然に治まる。ただ、数週間たっても止まらない場合や、けいれんが顔の他の部分にまで広がる場合は、別の病気が隠れている可能性もある。早めに眼科や神経内科を受診したい。
cards.en: When you spend long hours at the computer day after day, your eyelid may start twitching on its own. Most cases are temporary, caused by eye strain, lack of sleep or stress, and settle down naturally with proper rest. However, if it hasn't stopped after several weeks, or if the twitching spreads to other parts of the face, another illness may be behind it. It is best to see an ophthalmologist or a neurologist early.

cards.enTarget: When you spend long hours at the computer day after day, your eyelid may start twitching on its own.

words.defJa: 寒さを防ぐために首にまく、細長い布。

cards.ja: 十二月に入り、朝晩の冷え込みが一段と厳しくなってきた。駅のホームでは、厚手のコートにマフラーを巻いた人の姿が目立つ。首には太い血管が皮膚の近くを通っているため、ここを温めるだけで体感温度がかなり変わるといわれる。手袋や帽子を忘れても、マフラー一本あればずいぶん違うものだ。
cards.en: Now that it is December, the morning and evening chill has grown noticeably harsher. On station platforms, people in heavy coats with scarves wrapped around their necks stand out. Because large blood vessels run close to the skin in the neck, warming it alone is said to change how warm you feel considerably. Even if you forget your gloves or hat, a single scarf makes quite a difference.

words.defJa: 四十二・一九五キロメートルを走る長距離の競走。

cards.ja: 市民マラソンの人気が高まり、大都市の大会では参加希望者が定員の数倍に達することも珍しくない。完走を目指す初心者の多くは、半年ほど前から少しずつ走る距離を延ばしていく。専門家によると、四十二キロ余りを走り切るには、脚力だけでなく、レース中にこまめに水分と栄養を補う計画が欠かせないという。最後の数キロを支えるのは、案外こうした地道な準備なのだ。
cards.en: As citizen marathons grow in popularity, it is not unusual for big-city races to receive applications several times their capacity. Many beginners aiming to finish gradually increase their running distance starting about half a year beforehand. According to experts, running the full forty-two-plus kilometers requires not only leg strength but also a plan for frequently replenishing fluids and nutrition during the race. What carries you through the last few kilometers is, surprisingly, this kind of steady preparation.

words.defJa: 鉄筋コンクリートなどで造られた、何階もある集合住宅。

cards.ja: 都市部では、築四十年を超える古いマンションが年々増えている。建物の老朽化に加えて住民の高齢化も進み、大規模な修繕に必要な費用を集めることが難しくなっているという。建て替えには所有者の多くの賛成が必要なため、話し合いがまとまらず、管理が行き届かないまま放置される例も少なくない。国も、建て替えの条件を緩めるなど、対策に乗り出している。
cards.en: In urban areas, the number of old condominium buildings more than forty years old grows every year. With the residents aging as well as the buildings deteriorating, it is reportedly becoming difficult to collect the funds needed for major repairs. Because rebuilding requires the approval of a large majority of owners, there are many cases where discussions stall and buildings are left without proper upkeep. The national government, too, has begun taking measures, such as relaxing the conditions for rebuilding.

cards.ja: 二〇二二年四月、民法の改正により、成人年齢が二十歳から十八歳に引き下げられた。これにより、十八歳になれば親の同意がなくても、携帯電話の契約を結んだり、ローンを組んだりできるようになった。一方で、未成年であることを理由に契約を取り消せる仕組みが使えなくなるため、若者が悪質な商法の標的になることが心配されている。なお、飲酒や喫煙は引き続き二十歳になるまで認められていない。
cards.en: In April 2022, a revision of the Civil Code lowered the age of adulthood from twenty to eighteen. As a result, eighteen-year-olds can now sign mobile phone contracts or take out loans without parental consent. On the other hand, because they can no longer use the system that lets contracts be canceled on the grounds of being a minor, there are concerns that young people will become targets of fraudulent sales practices. Drinking and smoking, however, are still not permitted until age twenty.

cards.en: Crying in front of my teammates felt more wretched to me than losing the match itself. Even now, that memory from my high school days sometimes comes back to me. Shame and self-loathing are said to grow stronger when we judge ourselves harshly through the eyes of others. Yet looking back after some time has passed, I realize that it was that very frustration that gave me the strength to take the next step.

cards.ja: ミシンという言葉は、英語のマシンがなまって生まれたといわれる。江戸時代の末に日本へ持ち込まれた当初は大変な貴重品で、ごく限られた人しか目にすることができなかった。やがて国産化が進むと家庭にも広く普及し、昭和の半ばには、母親が子どもの服を縫う音が多くの家で聞かれた。今では、手作りを楽しむ人の間で改めて見直されている。
cards.en: The Japanese word for a sewing machine is said to have arisen from a corrupted pronunciation of the English word 'machine.' When it was first brought to Japan at the end of the Edo period, it was an extremely precious item that only a very limited number of people ever got to see. As domestic production advanced, it spread widely into homes, and by the mid-Showa era the sound of mothers sewing their children's clothes could be heard in many households. Today it is being rediscovered by people who enjoy making things by hand.

cards.ja: 天気予報で耳にする一時間に五十ミリの雨とは、どれほどの量なのだろうか。これは、降った雨がどこにも流れずにたまったとすると、一時間で深さ五センチになることを意味する。気象庁はこの強さの雨を非常に激しい雨と呼び、滝のように降って傘がまったく役に立たない状態だと説明している。近年、こうした大雨の回数は全国的に増える傾向にある。
cards.en: Just how much rain is the fifty millimeters an hour we hear about in weather forecasts? It means that if the rain that fell stayed put without flowing anywhere, it would reach a depth of five centimeters in one hour. The Japan Meteorological Agency calls rain of this intensity very heavy rain and describes it as falling like a waterfall, with umbrellas completely useless. In recent years, such downpours have tended to become more frequent nationwide.

words.defJa: 国の主権が国民にあり、国民の意思にもとづいて政治を行うこと。

cards.ja: 一九八〇年代後半から九〇年代にかけて、東欧や中南米、アジアの多くの国で独裁的な政権が倒れ、民主化が進んだ。人々は自由な選挙を勝ち取り、新しい時代への期待に沸いた。しかし近年は、選挙で選ばれた指導者が権力を集中させ、報道や司法の独立を弱める例も目立つ。民主主義は一度手に入れれば終わりではなく、守り続ける努力が欠かせないのである。
cards.en: From the late 1980s through the 1990s, authoritarian regimes fell in many countries across Eastern Europe, Latin America and Asia, and democratization advanced. People won free elections and were filled with hope for a new era. In recent years, however, there have been conspicuous cases of elected leaders concentrating power and weakening the independence of the press and the judiciary. Democracy is not something you obtain once and are done with; continued effort to protect it is indispensable.

cards.en: Toward the end of the rainy season, there are more days that feel terribly muggy even though the temperature is not all that high. This is because when the humidity is high, sweat has trouble evaporating and the body cannot release heat well. On such days you can get heatstroke even indoors, so it is wise to make good use of your air conditioner's dehumidifying function. Simply running a fan as well to keep the air moving makes a big difference to how it feels.

words.defJa: 品詞の一つで、人や物、ことがらの名前を表す言葉。

cards.ja: 日本語の文章は、英語と違って単語の間に空白を入れない。そのため、コンピューターで文章を扱うには、まず文を単語に区切り、名詞や動詞といった品詞を見分ける処理が欠かせなかった。この技術は形態素解析と呼ばれ、検索エンジンや機械翻訳を長く支えてきた。ただ、近年の大規模言語モデルは、文字列を細かな断片に分けて大量の文章から直接学ぶため、必ずしもこの手順を必要としない。
cards.en: Unlike English, written Japanese does not put spaces between words. For that reason, handling text on a computer required first splitting sentences into words and identifying parts of speech such as nouns and verbs. This technique, called morphological analysis, long underpinned search engines and machine translation. Recent large language models, however, break text into small fragments and learn directly from vast amounts of writing, so they do not necessarily need this step.

cards.ja: 日本のビジネスの場では、初対面の相手とまず名刺を交換するのが基本とされる。相手の名刺は両手で受け取り、会議中は机の上に並べておいて、名前と顔を一致させるのに使う。受け取った名刺をすぐにポケットにしまったり、その場でメモを書き込んだりするのは失礼に当たるという。最近は、スマートフォンで名刺の情報を読み取り、データとして管理する会社も増えている。
cards.en: In Japanese business settings, exchanging business cards with someone you are meeting for the first time is considered basic. You receive the other person's card with both hands, and during the meeting you keep it laid out on the table, using it to match names to faces. Putting a card away in your pocket right after receiving it, or writing notes on it on the spot, is said to be rude. Recently, more companies scan card information with smartphones and manage it as data.

words.defJa: ひどく乱れて、元の形がわからないほどになるようす。

cards.ja: 年末に家族で北海道を旅行する予定だったが、出発の前日に記録的な大雪となり、乗るはずだった飛行機が欠航してしまった。振り替えの便は三日後まで満席で、ホテルも観光の予約も取り消すしかなかった。半年も前から楽しみにしていた計画がめちゃくちゃになり、子どもたちはしばらく口もきかなかった。それでも翌年の夏に同じ旅をやり直せたので、今ではあの冬の騒ぎも家族の笑い話になっている。
cards.en: Our family had planned a trip to Hokkaido at the end of the year, but the day before we were to leave there was record snowfall, and the flight we were supposed to take was canceled. Replacement flights were full for the next three days, so we had no choice but to cancel our hotel and sightseeing reservations as well. The plan we had been looking forward to for half a year was completely ruined, and for a while the children would barely speak. Still, we managed to redo the same trip the following summer, so now the upheaval of that winter has become something the family laughs about.

Besides more people buying books online, the slump in magazine sales is reportedly a major factor. Meanwhile, small bookstores that stock only books chosen by their owners have sprung up in various places and are attracting new customers.

Meaning is entrusted not only to its lavish appearance but also to the sound of its name and its shape.

words.defJa: 目が回るように感じたり、体がふらついたりすること。

cards.ja: 朝、寝返りを打った途端に天井がぐるぐると回り出し、激しいめまいに襲われる人がいる。こうした症状の原因として最も多いのは、耳の奥にある砂粒のような小さな石がはがれ落ち、頭の回転を感じ取る三半規管に入り込んでしまう病気だ。頭を動かしたときにだけ起こり、たいてい一分足らずで治まるのが特徴で、それ自体が命に関わることはないとされる。頭を決まった順に動かして石を元の場所へ戻す体操が、治療として勧められることも多い。
cards.en: Some people roll over in bed in the morning and suddenly the ceiling starts spinning, bringing on violent dizziness. The most common cause of such symptoms is a condition in which tiny sand-like stones deep in the ear come loose and get into the semicircular canals, which sense the head's rotation. It strikes only when the head moves and usually subsides in under a minute, and the condition itself is not considered life-threatening. Exercises that move the head in a set sequence to return the stones to their proper place are often recommended as treatment.

cards.ja: 港町の古い倉庫が、現代美術のギャラリーとして生まれ変わった。れんが造りの外観はそのまま残し、内部には白い壁とガラスを使ったモダンな空間が広がる。古さと新しさが同居する独特の雰囲気が評判を呼び、週末には若い世代の来館者でにぎわう。地元の商店街にも、少しずつ人の流れが戻ってきたという。
cards.en: An old warehouse in a port town has been reborn as a contemporary art gallery. The brick exterior has been kept as it was, while inside a modern space of white walls and glass opens up. Its unique atmosphere, where old and new coexist, has won a following, and on weekends it bustles with younger visitors. Foot traffic is said to be gradually returning to the local shopping street as well.

cards.en: Backstage at a fashion show is as hectic as a battlefield right up until the show starts. The models change outfits every few minutes, while the hair and makeup staff swiftly touch up their hair and faces. In recent years more brands have been casting models of different ages and body types, and the trend of showcasing diverse kinds of beauty is taking hold. Audience reactions, too, are said to have become far more positive than before.

cards.en: The monorail linking the airport with the city center has become an indispensable way to get around for business travelers and tourists. The cars, which run straddling a single rail, offer the appeal of looking down on the townscape and the sea from the elevated track. Recently, use by foreign tourists has surged, and multilingual signs and large luggage areas have been added. During the morning and evening rush, trains arrive and depart every few minutes.

cards.ja: 庭で落ち葉やごみを燃やす行為は、法律で原則として禁止されている。煙や悪臭が近所の迷惑になるうえ、火災につながるおそれもあるからだ。ただし、農家が田畑でわらを処理する場合や、地域の伝統行事などは例外として認められている。迷ったときは、まず市役所や消防署に相談するのが望ましい。
cards.en: Burning fallen leaves or trash in your yard is, as a rule, prohibited by law. This is because smoke and foul odors bother the neighbors, and it can also lead to fires. However, cases such as farmers disposing of straw in their fields, as well as local traditional events, are allowed as exceptions. When in doubt, it is best to consult the city office or the fire station first.

cards.en: The new department head is known throughout the company as a stickler about time. If you are even one minute late to a meeting, you are questioned closely about why. Employees who at first found it stifling had to admit it worked once meetings started ending on schedule. Now other departments are moving to adopt the same approach.

words.defJa: 湯をわかすための、注ぎ口と取っ手のついた金属の入れ物。

cards.ja: 夏になると、実家の台所ではいつも大きなやかんで麦茶を煮出していた。火を止めてしばらく置き、冷めたら容器に移して冷蔵庫で冷やすのが母の習慣だった。今はティーバッグを水に入れるだけで手軽に作れるが、やかんで煮出した麦茶の香ばしさは格別だ。最近、その味を求めて、あえて昔ながらの方法に戻る家庭も増えているという。
cards.en: Every summer, barley tea was always simmering in a big kettle in the kitchen of the house I grew up in. My mother's habit was to turn off the heat, let it stand for a while, and once it cooled, pour it into a container and chill it in the fridge. Today you can make it easily just by dropping a tea bag into water, but the toasty aroma of barley tea brewed in a kettle is something special. Recently, more households are said to be deliberately going back to the old-fashioned way in search of that taste.

cards.en: A local public high school beat a private powerhouse, the favorite to win, in the semifinal of the prefectural tournament. Last year they lost to the same opponent by a wide margin, and the players reportedly spent the whole year practicing with that frustration in their hearts. Residents watching from the stands rejoiced, saying, "They actually took down that powerhouse for us!" In town, preparations have already begun to run buses of supporters to the final.

words.defJa: いろいろ考えたが、結局は。また、思っていたとおり。

cards.ja: 人は迷った末に一度決めたことでも、あとから「やっぱりやめておけばよかった」と後悔しがちだ。心理学の研究によると、選択肢が多いほど、この後悔は強くなる傾向があるという。選ばなかった道の良い面ばかりが、頭の中で大きくなってしまうからだ。ある程度で満足する姿勢が、心の安定につながるのかもしれない。
cards.en: Even after finally making a decision following much hesitation, people tend to regret it later, thinking, "I should have passed on it after all." According to psychological research, this regret tends to grow stronger the more options there are. That is because only the good sides of the paths not taken grow large in one's mind. An attitude of being content with "good enough" may lead to peace of mind.

cards.ja: 海に流れ込むプラスチックごみの多くは、食品や飲み物の容器だといわれる。波や紫外線で細かく砕けた破片は、魚や海鳥の体内からも見つかっている。こうした状況を受け、紙や植物由来の素材を使った容器に切り替える外食チェーンが増えてきた。ただ、コストが高くなるため、普及にはまだ課題が残る。
cards.en: Much of the plastic waste flowing into the sea is said to be food and drink containers. Fragments broken into tiny pieces by waves and ultraviolet light have even been found inside fish and seabirds. In response, more restaurant chains have been switching to containers made of paper or plant-based materials. Because costs go up, however, obstacles to their widespread use remain.

words.meaning: the next; the following (day, year, etc.)
words.defJa: 日・朝・年などの前について、「その次の」という意味を表すことば。

cards.ja: 江戸の町は木造の家が密集していたため、たびたび大火に見舞われた。中でも十七世紀半ばの大火では、町の大半が焼け、多くの命が失われたと伝えられている。幕府は翌年から道幅を広げ、火よけのための空き地を各地に設けるなど、町づくりを大きく見直した。この経験は、その後の防災の考え方にも影響を与えたという。
cards.en: Because Edo was densely packed with wooden houses, it was frequently struck by great fires. In the great fire of the mid-seventeenth century in particular, much of the city is said to have burned and many lives were lost. From the following year, the shogunate overhauled its town planning, widening streets and setting aside open spaces as firebreaks in various places. This experience is said to have shaped later thinking about disaster prevention as well.

cards.ja: 進学のために家を出た息子は、めったに連絡をよこさない。こちらから電話をかけても、「元気だから大丈夫」と言ってすぐに切ってしまう。それでも母の日には、短いメッセージと一緒に料理の写真を送ってきた。自分で作ったらしいその一皿を見て、少しだけ安心した。
cards.en: My son, who left home for university, rarely gets in touch. Even when I call him, he says, "I'm fine, don't worry," and hangs up right away. Still, on Mother's Day he sent a short message along with a photo of some food. Seeing that dish, which he had apparently cooked himself, I felt a little relieved.

cards.en: One kindergarten sets aside days when children can get covered in mud and play without worrying about dirtying their clothes. A big puddle is made in the yard, and the children run around barefoot and shape balls out of mud. At first, some parents worried about the extra laundry. But many reportedly changed their minds after seeing usually quiet children absorbed in play.

cards.en: As prices keep rising, changes are showing up in how much office workers spend on lunch. According to one survey, the average cost per meal is more than 10 percent higher than a few years ago. As a result, more people are reportedly bringing a packed lunch or making do with rice balls from a convenience store. Restaurants, meanwhile, are trying to hold on to customers by expanding their affordable daily specials.

cards.en: The number of people taking up running for their health has grown considerably over the past few years. Its ease, needing no special equipment and doable alone whenever you like, explains its popularity. However, running long distances right from the start makes it easy to hurt your knees and ankles. Experts recommend beginning by running two or three times a week at a pace at which you can still hold a conversation.

cards.ja: 私たちが口にする食べ物は、目に見えない形で大量の水を使って作られている。たとえば牛肉一キロを生産するには、飼料の栽培も含めて約二万リットルもの水が必要だとされる。こうした水の量を計算する考え方は「バーチャルウォーター」と呼ばれる。食料の多くを輸入に頼る国は、実は海外の水を大量に消費していることになるのだ。
cards.en: The food we eat is produced using vast amounts of water in ways we cannot see. For example, producing one kilogram of beef is said to require about 20,000 liters of water, including what it takes to grow the feed. This way of calculating such amounts of water is called "virtual water." A country that relies on imports for much of its food is in effect consuming large amounts of other countries' water.

cards.en: As the typhoon approached, each TV station sent reporters to the scene for live coverage. Reports by journalists standing their ground in strong winds are dramatic, but there is plenty of criticism that they are dangerous. As a result, more stations now convey the situation from safe indoor locations or use footage from unmanned cameras. Among viewers, too, there is growing awareness that excessive theatrics are not needed.

words.defJa: 決まりや一般的なやり方に当てはまらないもの。

cards.ja: 日本語を学ぶ人を悩ませるものの一つに、動詞の活用がある。ほとんどの動詞は規則どおりに形を変えるが、「来る」と「する」は例外で、一つ一つ覚えるしかない。また、「帰る」や「切る」のように、見た目は一段動詞なのに五段動詞として活用するものもある。もっとも、不規則動詞が数多くある英語などに比べれば、日本語の活用は例外が少ないほうだといわれる。
cards.en: One of the things that trouble learners of Japanese is verb conjugation. Most verbs change form according to the rules, but kuru (to come) and suru (to do) are exceptions that simply have to be memorized one by one. There are also verbs such as kaeru (to return) and kiru (to cut) that look like ichidan verbs but conjugate as godan verbs. That said, compared with languages such as English, which have many irregular verbs, Japanese conjugation is said to have relatively few exceptions.

cards.en: If you go hiking in the rainy season, a raincoat is an essential item. However, the thin kind worn in town may not fully keep out heavy rain and wind. For mountain hiking, a two-piece set made of a material that lets sweat and dampness escape is recommended. Even if the forecast says sunny, mountain weather can change suddenly, so it is wise to keep one in your backpack just in case.

words.defJa: 仕事や勉強の疲れをいやすために、みんなで楽しむ遊びや運動。

cards.ja: かつて日本の企業では、社員旅行や運動会などのレクリエーションが盛んに行われていた。その後、私生活を優先したいという声が強まり、多くの会社で廃止された時期があった。ところが最近、在宅勤務の広がりで社員同士の交流が減ったことから、こうした行事を見直す企業が増えている。参加を強制せず、短時間で気軽に楽しめる形にするのが今の主流だという。
cards.en: Japanese companies used to hold plenty of recreational events such as company trips and sports days. Later, as more people wanted to put their private lives first, there was a period when many companies dropped them. Recently, however, because the spread of remote work has reduced contact among employees, more companies are taking a fresh look at such events. The current trend is said to be keeping them voluntary and short so people can enjoy them casually.

words.defJa: 仕事のない時間に楽しむ遊びや旅行。

cards.ja: 大型連休を前に、レジャー関連の消費が活発になっている。旅行会社によると、国内の温泉地やテーマパークへの予約は前年を一割ほど上回るという。一方で、燃料費や人件費の高騰で航空券や宿泊料金も値上がりしており、近場への日帰り旅行で済ませる人も多い。消費者の節約志向と楽しみたい気持ちが、複雑に入り交じっている。
cards.en: Ahead of the long holiday, leisure-related spending is picking up. According to travel agencies, bookings for domestic hot-spring resorts and theme parks are running about 10 percent above last year. Meanwhile, soaring fuel and labor costs have pushed up airfares and hotel rates, so many people are settling for day trips close to home. Consumers' urge to economize and their desire to have fun are intricately intertwined.

words.defJa: 光を集めたり広げたりするために使う、ガラスなどでできた透明な物。

cards.ja: 最近のスマートフォンには、背面に三つ以上のレンズを備えた機種が珍しくない。それぞれのレンズは、広い範囲を写す広角や遠くを大きく写す望遠など、役割が分かれている。撮影した画像は内部で瞬時に合成され、暗い場所でもくっきりとした写真に仕上がる。かつては一眼レフカメラでしかできなかった表現が、手のひらの上で実現しているのだ。
cards.en: These days it is not unusual for smartphones to have three or more lenses on the back. Each lens has its own role, such as wide-angle for capturing a broad scene or telephoto for enlarging distant subjects. The images are instantly combined inside the device, producing sharp photos even in dark places. Shots that once only a single-lens reflex camera could achieve are now possible in the palm of your hand.

words.defJa: ろうを固めて中に糸を通した、火をともして明かりにするもの。

cards.ja: 大きな地震のあと、停電が数日間続いた地域も少なくなかった。夜になると、家族でろうそくの明かりを囲み、ラジオのニュースに耳を傾けたという声も聞かれる。ただ、ろうそくは倒れると火災の原因になるため、専門家は懐中電灯やランタンを優先するよう呼びかけている。日ごろから、防災用品の置き場所を確認しておくことが大切だ。
cards.en: After the major earthquake, quite a few areas went without power for several days. Some people recall gathering as a family around candlelight at night and listening to the news on the radio. However, because candles can start fires if they tip over, experts urge people to rely on flashlights and lanterns first. It is important to check in advance where your emergency supplies are kept.

words.defJa: かぎをかけて荷物などを入れておく、仕切られた戸棚。

cards.ja: 駅やスーパーに設置された宅配ロッカーの利用が広がっている。ネットで注文した商品を、仕事帰りなど自分の都合の良い時間に受け取れるのが便利だ。配達員にとっても、不在による再配達の手間が減るという利点がある。物流業界の人手不足が深刻になるなか、国も設置を後押ししている。
cards.en: Use of parcel lockers installed at stations and supermarkets is spreading. They are convenient because you can pick up items ordered online at a time that suits you, such as on the way home from work. For delivery workers, too, they have the advantage of cutting down on redeliveries when no one is home. As the labor shortage in the logistics industry grows severe, the government is also promoting their installation.

words.defJa: ホテルや劇場などの入り口近くにある、広い部屋や空間。

cards.ja: 開演の三十分前になると、劇場のロビーは観客でにぎわい始める。パンフレットを買う人や、知り合いと談笑する人の姿があちこちに見られる。最近では、ロビーで若手演奏家のミニコンサートを開き、来場者を早めに呼び込む工夫をする劇場もある。幕間には再びロビーに人が集まり、作品について語り合う場にもなっている。
cards.en: Thirty minutes before the curtain rises, the theater lobby begins to fill with audience members. Here and there you see people buying programs and chatting with acquaintances. Recently, some theaters hold mini-concerts by young performers in the lobby to draw people in early. During the intermission people gather in the lobby again, and it becomes a place to talk about the work as well.

words.defJa: 日本の伝統的なもの。日本風。

cards.ja: 海外からの旅行者の間で、和の文化を体験できる宿の人気が高まっている。畳の部屋で布団を敷いて眠り、浴衣を着て季節の料理を味わうことが、特別な思い出になるのだという。こうした需要に応えるため、古い民家を改装し、和の雰囲気を残したまま現代的な設備を整えた施設も増えた。伝統を守りながら、新しい形で受け継ぐ試みといえる。
cards.en: Among travelers from overseas, inns where guests can experience traditional Japanese culture are growing in popularity. Sleeping on a futon in a tatami room, wearing a yukata and savoring seasonal dishes reportedly make for special memories. To meet this demand, more places have renovated old houses and added modern amenities while keeping the Japanese-style atmosphere. It can be seen as an attempt to preserve tradition while passing it on in a new form.

words.meaning: to be divided; to split (of opinions, groups, roads)
words.defJa: 一つだったものが、二つ以上の部分やグループになる。

cards.ja: 朝食を抜くと体に悪い、とよく言われる。しかし、この点については専門家の間でも意見が分かれている。朝食をとる人のほうが太りにくいという調査がある一方で、朝食の有無そのものより、一日を通して何をどれだけ食べるかが重要だとする研究も少なくない。結局のところ、自分の体調や生活のリズムに合った食べ方を見つけるのがいちばんなのかもしれない。
cards.en: It is often said that skipping breakfast is bad for you. On this point, however, opinion is divided even among experts. While some surveys find that people who eat breakfast are less likely to gain weight, quite a few studies argue that what and how much you eat over the whole day matters more than whether you eat breakfast at all. In the end, the best approach may simply be to find a way of eating that suits your own health and daily rhythm.

words.defJa: 上と下がつながった一枚の服。主に女性が着る。

cards.ja: 夏になると、一枚でさっと着られるワンピースが重宝する。上下の組み合わせに悩む必要がなく、カーディガンを羽織ったりベルトを締めたりするだけで、印象をがらりと変えられるからだ。最近は家で洗えて、しわになりにくい素材のものも増えており、旅行や出張に一着持っていくという人も多い。
cards.en: In summer, a dress you can just slip on by itself is a real boon. You don't have to agonize over matching a top and bottom, and simply throwing on a cardigan or adding a belt can completely change the look. Recently there are also more made of fabrics that can be washed at home and resist wrinkles, and many people say they pack one for trips and business travel.
